_readme: Known symbols for ES1's DBSIM.EXE (ES1DBSIM): confirmed address -> meaning mappings, applied to the ES1Recon Ghidra project by ES2ApplySymbolNames.java.
Addresses are offsets into the flat X-32 image (Herculan/docs/es1/formats/x32-executable.md#the-image).
Schema, confidence rules and run order: tools/ghidra_scripts/README.md, 'Known symbols'.
Entries are in address order. tools/scripts/es2_naming.py insert and edit keep it, and check that it holds.

entries.name: X32_AllocMemory
entries.description: (size), C convention: rounds size up to a multiple of 0x1000 and asks the extender for that much memory (INT 21h AX=350Ch). On carry it returns -1; otherwise it stores EDX at 00090024, raises the high-water mark 00090028 to the block's end when the end is above it, and returns the block's address. Mem_InitHeap takes the heap's block from it, and operator new and malloc fall back on it while the heap is off.

entries.name: __x386_coproc_init
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `__x386_coproc_init`, from `x386.asm`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. The match covers 86 bytes from here.

entries.name: Camera_IsMountedOn
entries.description: (camera, object) in stack order: 1 when the camera's int16 +0x36 is 2 and its +0x32 is the object, otherwise 0. ObjList_DrawFrameObjects (00021008) leaves such an object out of the frame's draw; Sim_StartMission (0005a9dc) sets its main camera's +0x36 to 2.

entries.name: Cam_AttachOrbit
entries.description: (camera, centre, object) in stack order, callee-cleaned: copies the 6-byte orbit centre to +0x38, stores object at +0x32, zeroes the orbit angles +0x26/+0x28/+0x2a, the distance +0x22, the angle rates +0x2c/+0x2e/+0x30 and the zoom rate +0x24, and sets the mode +0x36 to 1. ES2's Cam_AttachOrbit (DBSIM 0040109c) without its lock test. One call found by es2_xref, from Cam_AttachTo (0005923c).

entries.name: Cam_AttachEye
entries.description: (camera, eye, object) in stack order, callee-cleaned: copies the 6-byte eye offset to +0x3e, stores object at +0x32 and sets the mode +0x36 to 2. ES2's Cam_AttachEye (DBSIM 0040111c) without its lock test.

entries.name: Cam_SetMode
entries.description: (camera, mode) in stack order, callee-cleaned: stores mode in +0x36 when it is 0, 1 or 2 and does nothing otherwise. ES2's Cam_SetMode (DBSIM 00401148), which also takes 3 and tests the lock.

entries.name: Cam_Update
entries.description: (camera), callee-cleaned: places the camera by its mode +0x36. Mode 0, free: pitch +0x0c += +0x2c, clamped to +-0x3000 with +0x2c zeroed, roll +0x0e += +0x2e, heading +0x10 += +0x30; position +0 = that view's BuildEulerRotationMatrixQ14 applied to (0, int16 +0x24, 0) plus the position, its z raised to 100. Mode 1, orbit: distance +0x22 = clamp(+0x22 + +0x24, 2500, 30000); +0x2a += +0x30, +0x26 += +0x2c (clamped to +-0x3000, +0x2c zeroed), +0x28 += +0x2e; view = (+0x26, +0x28, +0x2a + the object's int16 +0x0a); eye = the object's frame (Context_GetTransform of object +6) applied to the centre +0x38, plus the view's rotation of (0, -distance, 0). When the eye's z is under 100: with the zoom rate +0x24 under 1 it restores the position, view and orbit angles it started the call with and returns; otherwise the pitch becomes Math_AsinBam((centre z - 100) * 0x4000 / distance), in the view and in +0x26, and the eye is recomputed. Mode 2, attached: through the object's vtable (+2) slot +0x28 node, Transform_Concat with the frame, the eye +0x3e applied and Transform_RotationToEuler plus +0x44/+0x46/+0x48 as the view; with a null node the frame applied to +0x3e and the object's own euler triple +6. ES2's Cam_Update (DBSIM 004011a0), which keeps the chase ring and mode 3, tests terrain height plus 0x226 where this tests 100, and keeps position and view at +4 and +0x10. Sim_Main calls it each frame on the main camera ViewObjectPtr (000b5b8a).

entries.name: Cam_ApproachRate
entries.description: (axis, rate) in stack order, callee-cleaned: Math_RateLimitedMoveToward(0xc0, Math_Q8Multiply(0x800, axis), rate). ES2's Cam_ApproachRate (DBSIM 00401c20).

entries.name: Cam_ApproachZoom
entries.description: (axis, rate) in stack order, callee-cleaned: Math_RateLimitedMoveToward(0x50, Math_Q8Multiply(0x400, axis), rate). ES2's Cam_ApproachZoom (DBSIM 00401c4c).

entries.name: Cam_Steer
entries.description: (camera, trigger, throttle, steer) in stack order, callee-cleaned: ES2's Cam_Steer (DBSIM 00401c74) with no lock test. Mode 0: Cam_ApproachRate(-steer, +0x30); with trigger set Cam_ApproachZoom(-throttle, +0x24) and Cam_ApproachRate(0, +0x2c), otherwise Cam_ApproachZoom(0, +0x24) and Cam_ApproachRate(throttle, +0x2c). Mode 1: the same with steer for the heading rate and throttle for the zoom rate. Other modes: nothing. Two calls found by es2_xref, from DemoTape_PickRandom (0005771c) and Sim_PollPlayerInput (0005a0c0).

entries.name: RegisterSubsystemLoader
entries.description: (phase, function) in stack order, callee-cleaned: stores function and the int16 phase in the next 6-byte record at 000bbcb0, the record index being the int16 count at 0009011c, which it increments; Subsystem_RunPhase (00000af4) walks the records. Static initialisers call it, among them Weapons_RegisterSubsystem (0000d67c), Bullet_RegisterSubsystem (000081f8), Base_StaticInit (00004b80) and Explosion_RegisterSubsystem (00005e78) for Weapons_LoadResourceTables (0000bf48), Bullet_LoadResources (00007bb0), Base_LoadResources (000046ac) and Explosion_LoadResources (00005764) at phase 2. ES2's RegisterSubsystemLoader (DBSIM 00401d64).

entries.name: Subsystem_RunPhase
entries.description: (phase), callee-cleaned: calls, in order, each function of the 6-byte {function, int16 phase} records at 000bbcb0 (count int16 0009011c) whose phase matches. Sim_RenderFrame runs phase 5. ES2's Subsystem_RunPhase (DBSIM 00401d94).
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 00000af4, against ES2's Subsystem_RunPhase

entries.name: HeapPtr_DtorVcrCopy
entries.description: (p, flags), callee-cleaned: byte for byte the code of HeapPtr_DtorGunlistCopy (0000baf0), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: ConfigPart_DtorVcrCopy
entries.description: (part, flags), callee-cleaned: slot +0x1c of the vtable 00090122: byte for byte the code of ConfigPart_DtorDetAnimObjCopy (000028e0), relocated operands aside, storing 00090122 and 00090156 where that stores 000903ae and 0009037a. ES2's ConfigPart_Dtor (DBSIM 00420730).

entries.name: ConfigPart_GetClassTagVcrCopy
entries.description: Frameless: a NOP, then XOR EAX,EAX and RET 4: returns 0. Slot +4 of the vtable 00090122; the code of ConfigPart_GetClassTagDetAnimObjCopy (000028d6).

entries.name: TSPartBase_DtorVcrCopy
entries.description: (part, flags), callee-cleaned: slot +0x1c of the vtable 00090156 (entered at its padding 00000ba5): byte for byte the code of TSPartBase_Dtor (0005d614), relocated operands aside, storing 00090156 where that stores 000974aa. ES2's TSPartBase_Dtor (DBSIM 0049224b).

entries.name: Vcr_Checkpoint
entries.description: (label, size, data) in stack order, its arguments removed by this function: ES2's Vcr_Checkpoint (DBSIM 00401dc0). With DmpFile (000b5b7e) open: while recording (TapeRecording, TapePlayback clear) it copies size bytes of data to the buffer cursor Vcr_Cursor (00090188) and adds size to the cursor and to the total Vcr_Total (0009018c); in playback it reads size bytes from DmpFile into the buffer Vcr_Buffer (000adcd8), and when memcmp finds them different from the data, formats the label into a stack buffer it discards and sets Vcr_MismatchFlag (00090190) to 1. es2_xref finds no branch to it.

entries.name: Vcr_FlushCheckpoints
entries.description: No arguments, the phase-6 subsystem function: ES2's Vcr_FlushCheckpoints (DBSIM 00401e5c). With DmpFile (000b5b7e) open: while recording it opens Path_WithExtension (00060644)("dmp", TapeStem) in mode ab, asserting at severity 5 (vcr.cpp line 0x30) when that fails, writes the buffer Vcr_Buffer (000adcd8) for the total Vcr_Total (0009018c) bytes, closes the file, and sets the cursor Vcr_Cursor (00090188) back to Vcr_Buffer (000adcd8) and the total to 0; in playback it formats "Playback error. Frame #%ld" with FrameRate_GetFrameCount (0006020c) into a stack buffer it discards.

entries.name: Vcr_StaticInit
entries.description: Frameless static initializer, the static constructor table's entry 000adbb4: RegisterSubsystemLoader (00000ac4)(6, Vcr_FlushCheckpoints (00000c84)), then RET. ES2's Vcr_StaticInit (DBSIM 00401ef8).

entries.name: Memory_Ctor
entries.description: (this), its argument removed by this function: ES2's Memory_Ctor (DBSIM 00476ccc). With a null this it allocates 0x14 bytes through Mem_New (000015a4) and returns 0 if that fails. Stores the address of X32_FreeListHead (000bc166) into it, then zeroes +0, +4, +8 and +0xc of any heap but g_SimPool (000ae4ac), which it leaves as it is. Returns this. Its one call found by es2_xref is from Mem_StaticInit (000016dc).

entries.name: Memory_Init
entries.description: (heap, block, size) in stack order, its arguments removed by this function: ES2's Memory_Init (DBSIM 00476ce8), tagging the block FBLK (0x4b4c4246) where ES2's tags KLBF. Mem_InitHeap (00001524) gives the heap g_SimPool (000ae4ac) its block with it.

entries.name: Memory_IsAllocatedBlock
entries.description: (heap, payload), its arguments removed by this function: ES2's Memory_IsAllocatedBlock (DBSIM 00476d20), testing the header for ABLK (0x4b4c4241) where ES2's tests KLBA. Its one call found by es2_xref is from Memory_CheckOverrun (00000e3c).

entries.name: Memory_IsBlockHeader
entries.description: (heap, block header), its arguments removed by this function: ES2's Memory_IsBlockHeader (DBSIM 00476d50), testing for FBLK (0x4b4c4246) at +8 or ABLK (0x4b4c4241) at +0 where ES2's tests KLBF and KLBA.

entries.name: Memory_CheckOverrun
entries.description: (heap, payload), its arguments removed by this function: ES2's Memory_CheckOverrun (DBSIM 00476d8c), with its fault (Herculan/docs/retail/runtime-library.md#the-overrun-check-checks-nothing): 0 when Memory_IsAllocatedBlock (00000dd0) fails; 1 when the block ends at the heap's base plus 8 times its byte size (+4); otherwise Memory_IsBlockHeader (00000e00) of the block's own header. No branch or stored pointer to it found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Memory_LargestFreeBlock
entries.description: (heap), its argument removed by this function: ES2's Memory_LargestFreeBlock (DBSIM 00476dd0), answering the largest size on the free list (+8) less the 8-byte header where ES2's subtracts 0x6c and clamps at 0. Like ES2's, it reads the list's head without testing it for null. Arena_Push sizes its arena with it on the heap g_SimPool (000ae4ac).

entries.name: Memory_Alloc
entries.description: (heap, trackLow, size) in stack order, its arguments removed by this function: ES2's Memory_Alloc (DBSIM 00476e00), tagging the block ABLK (0x4b4c4241) and a split-off tail FBLK (0x4b4c4246) where ES2's use KLBA and KLBF.

entries.name: Memory_Free
entries.description: (heap, payload), its arguments removed by this function: ES2's Memory_Free (DBSIM 00476f00), tagging the block FBLK (0x4b4c4246) where ES2's tags KLBF.

entries.name: Memory_Realloc
entries.description: (heap, size, payload) in stack order, its arguments removed by this function: ES2's Memory_Realloc (DBSIM 00476f9c), moving the data with memmove where ES2's uses memcpy, and testing for ABLK (0x4b4c4241) and writing FBLK (0x4b4c4246) where ES2's use KLBA and KLBF.

entries.name: Memory_DrawUsageMap
entries.description: (heap, rows, columns, top, left) in stack order, its arguments removed by this function (RET 0x14): ES2's Memory_DrawUsageMap (DBSIM 004771b4). Shares out the byte size (+4) of the heap it is passed, walks g_SimPool (000ae4ac) with Memory_BlockIterBegin (000014b0) and Memory_BlockIterNext (000014e0), and prints each cell with Mono_Printf (00060e78)(left + column, top + row, '%c' at 000901d0, character). No branch or stored pointer to it found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Memory_PrevLinkedHeader
entries.description: (heap, block), its arguments removed by this function: ES2's Memory_PrevLinkedHeader (DBSIM 004772e8).

entries.name: Memory_BlockIterBegin
entries.description: (walker, heap), its arguments removed by this function: ES2's Memory_BlockIterBegin (DBSIM 00477310). With a null walker it allocates 8 bytes through Mem_New (000015a4) and returns 0 if that fails. Returns the walker. Its one call found by es2_xref is from Memory_DrawUsageMap (00001304), through the padding at 000014af.

entries.name: Memory_BlockIterNext
entries.description: (walker), its argument removed by this function: ES2's Memory_BlockIterNext (DBSIM 00477324). Its one call found by es2_xref is from Memory_DrawUsageMap (00001304), through the padding at 000014dd.

entries.name: Mem_InitHeap
entries.description: (size): caps size at X32_LargestFreeBlock() - 25000, takes a block that large from X32_AllocMemory, asserting 'Memory alloc failed' (memory.cpp line 504, severity 5) through Assert_Report when it returns -1, makes it the heap g_SimPool (000ae4ac) (Memory_Init) and sets Mem_UseHeap (000901d4), which sends operator new, malloc and the frees to the heap. Returns the capped size.

entries.name: Mem_HeapOff
entries.description: Clears Mem_UseHeap (000901d4), after which operator new and malloc take memory from X32_AllocMemory and the frees do nothing.

entries.name: Mem_New
entries.description: The global operator new (size), its argument removed by this function (RET 4): ES2's Mem_New (DBSIM 00477390) with a switch in place of its size test. Memory_Alloc(g_SimPool (000ae4ac), 1, size) while Mem_UseHeap (000901d4) is set, otherwise X32_AllocMemory (000001d7)(size) with -1 returned as 0; the extender's block is returned as the extender gives it, where ES2's Mem_New clears every block it returns. It is the allocation a constructor makes for a null this (Herculan/docs/es1/formats/compiler.md#constructors-and-destructors). malloc is the same body with the C convention.

entries.name: maybe_Memory_OperatorNew
entries.description: (heap, size) in stack order, its arguments removed by this function (RET 8): ES2's maybe_Memory_OperatorNew (DBSIM 00477358): Memory_Alloc(heap, 1, size). The name assumes a class operator new(size_t, Memory*). No branch or stored pointer to it found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Mem_Delete
entries.description: The global operator delete (pointer), its argument removed by this function (RET 4): ES2's Mem_Delete (DBSIM 0047743c) with a switch in place of its pool test. Memory_Free(g_SimPool (000ae4ac), pointer) while Mem_UseHeap (000901d4) is set, otherwise a return; ES2's tests the pointer with Memory_IsAllocatedBlock first and frees the rest. It is the release a destructor makes when bit 0 of its flags is set (Herculan/docs/es1/formats/compiler.md#constructors-and-destructors). free is the same body with the C convention.

entries.name: malloc
entries.description: The game's malloc (size), C convention: Mem_New's body, returning with a plain RET. It is the _malloc of the startup's argument vector (Herculan/docs/es1/formats/compiler.md#startup).

entries.name: free
entries.description: The game's free (pointer), C convention: Mem_Delete's body, returning with a plain RET.

entries.name: realloc
entries.description: The game's realloc (pointer, size), C convention: Memory_Realloc(g_SimPool (000ae4ac), size, pointer), whether or not Mem_UseHeap (000901d4) is set.

entries.name: calloc
entries.description: The game's calloc (count, size), C convention: count * size bytes from Memory_Alloc(g_SimPool (000ae4ac), 1, ...) while Mem_UseHeap (000901d4) is set, otherwise from X32_AllocMemory with -1 returned as 0, then memset to zero over the block's size from the header at payload-4, less 8. A block from X32_AllocMemory has no header, so that size is read from the 4 bytes before it.

entries.name: Mem_StaticInit
entries.description: Frameless static initializer, the static constructor table's entry 000adbb8: Memory_Ctor (00000d4c)(g_SimPool (000ae4ac)), then RET. ES2's Mem_StaticInit (DBSIM 004774c4).

entries.name: Context_GetTransform
entries.description: (context), callee-cleaned: the rotation an object's orientation block holds, built on demand. When the word at +0x26 is 0 it builds the Q14 rotation at +6 from the three int16 Euler angles at +0 with BuildEulerRotationMatrixQ14 (0005f0ac) and sets the word to 1; it returns context + 6. Most of the calls es2_naming.py callers lists pass an object's +6. ES2's class 'Context' (0x28 bytes, no vptr; MAT_OBJ's base at +0xc) has this layout, and ES2's SimObject_InstallModelTransform (DBSIM 00401fe4) builds the matrix inline.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 000016e8, against ES2's SimObject_InstallModelTransform

entries.name: Context_SetFromTransform
entries.description: (block, transform) in stack order, callee-cleaned: sets an orientation block from a 0x20-byte transform: Transform_RotationToEuler of the transform's rotation into the three int16 Euler angles at +0, the transform copied to +6, and the word +0x26 set to 1, saying the rotation matches the angles. es2_naming.py match finds no ES2 counterpart; es2_xref finds no branch to it, its one stored-pointer hit (00001717 at 000584ed) being a call's displacement.

entries.name: TinyObj_GetPosition
entries.description: (object), callee-cleaned: slot +8 of TINY_OBJ's and TS_TINY_OBJ's tables (TinyObjVtable (0009022a), TSTinyObjVtable (0009024a)): copies the two position dwords +6 and +0xa into the static triple TinyObj_PositionBuffer (000ae4c4), whose third dword (000ae4cc) it zeroes on the first call under the latch TinyObj_PositionBufferInit (000ae4c0), and returns the triple. ES2's TinyObj_GetPosition (DBSIM 00401f08), whose fields are +0xc and +0x10.

entries.name: TinyObj_InstallModelTransform
entries.description: (object), callee-cleaned: slot +4 of TINY_OBJ's table TinyObjVtable (0009022a): takes the position from the object's slot +8, builds a Q14 rotation from the Euler triple (0, 0, the heading +0xe) with BuildEulerRotationMatrixQ14 and installs the two with Raster_SetModelTransform. ES2's TinyObj_InstallModelTransform (DBSIM 00401f50).

entries.name: Raster_SetModelTransformFromPose
entries.description: (object), callee-cleaned: slot +4 of REG_OBJ's table RegObjVtable (0009027a): builds a rotation from the Euler angles at +0x12 with BuildEulerRotationMatrixQ14, takes the translation from +6, +0xa and +0xe (the TSContext at +6) and installs the transform with Raster_SetModelTransform. ES2's Raster_SetModelTransformFromPose (DBSIM 00401fa8).

entries.name: SimObject_InstallModelTransform
entries.description: (object), callee-cleaned: installs an object's orientation as the renderer's model transform: Raster_SetModelTransform(Context_GetTransform(object + 6)), Context_GetTransform building the rotation on demand. es2_xref finds 16 calls and 10 stored pointers (draw slots of object vtables). ES2's SimObject_InstallModelTransform (DBSIM 00401fe4) builds the matrix inline.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile and disassembly at 00001854, against ES2's SimObject_InstallModelTransform

entries.name: TSTinyObj_Ctor
entries.description: (object, shape) in stack order, callee-cleaned: TS_TINY_OBJ's constructor, allocating 0x14 bytes when object is null (0 when that fails): DRAWABLE's table DrawableBaseVtable (0009020a) at +2, TINY_OBJ's TinyObjVtable (0009022a) with the position dwords +6 and +0xa and the heading +0xe zeroed, TS_TINY_OBJ's TSTinyObjVtable (0009024a), and TSShapeInstance_Ctor (00063080)(0, shape) at +0x10. ES2's TSTinyObj_Ctor (DBSIM 0040201c). es2_xref finds no branch or stored pointer to it.

entries.name: Drawable_Dtor
entries.description: (object, flags), callee-cleaned (RET 8): slot +0xc of DRAWABLE's table DrawableBaseVtable (0009020a) (entered at its padding 000018d2): stores that table at +2 and returns; it tests nothing and frees nothing. Drawable_DtorMechCopy (00011ae8) and Drawable_DtorCopy (000206b4) are its code. ES2's Drawable_Dtor (DBSIM 00478615) deletes on flags bit 0.

entries.name: TSObj_ReturnZero
entries.description: (object), callee-cleaned (RET 4), frameless: returns 0. Slot +0x10 of TS_OBJ's vtable TSObjVtable (000902ea), MAT_OBJ's MatObjVtable (000902ca) and three others.

entries.name: Drawable_GetRadius
entries.description: Frameless: three NOPs, then XOR EAX,EAX and RET 4: returns 0. Slot +0x14 of DRAWABLE's table DrawableBaseVtable (0009020a) and of TinyObjVtable (0009022a) and TSTinyObjVtable (0009024a), and, entered at 000018f0, of RegObjVtable (0009027a), TSRegObjVtable (000902aa) and MatObjVtable (000902ca). Drawable_GetRadiusMechCopy (00011ade) and Drawable_GetRadiusCopy (000206aa) are its code. ES2's Drawable_GetRadiusZero (DBSIM 004785c6).

entries.name: TinyObj_Dtor
entries.description: (object, flags), callee-cleaned: slot +0xc of TINY_OBJ's table TinyObjVtable (0009022a) (entered at its padding 000018f5): for a non-null object stores TinyObjVtable (0009022a) and DRAWABLE's DrawableBaseVtable (0009020a) at +2 and calls Mem_Delete on flags bit 0. Byte for byte the code of MatObj_Dtor (00001cb0) with TINY_OBJ's table for MAT_OBJ's. ES2's TinyObj_Dtor (DBSIM 00402f94).

entries.name: TSTinyObj_Draw
entries.description: (object), callee-cleaned: slot +4 of TS_TINY_OBJ's table TSTinyObjVtable (0009024a): TinyObj_InstallModelTransform (000017a8)(object), then the shape instance at +0x10 through its slot +0x20. ES2's TSTinyObj_Draw (DBSIM 00402e98).

entries.name: TSTinyObj_Dtor
entries.description: (object, flags), callee-cleaned: slot +0xc of TS_TINY_OBJ's table TSTinyObjVtable (0009024a): for a non-null object stores TSTinyObjVtable (0009024a), destroys the shape instance at +0x10 through its slot +0x1c with 3, stores TINY_OBJ's and DRAWABLE's tables and calls Mem_Delete on flags bit 0. ES2's TSTinyObj_Dtor (DBSIM 00402eb3).

entries.name: TSRegObj_Ctor
entries.description: (object, shape) in stack order, callee-cleaned: TS_REG_OBJ's constructor, allocating 0x20 bytes when object is null (0 when that fails): DRAWABLE's table at +2, TSContext_CtorWithFrame (0005b7d0)(object + 6, a zero orientation, a zero position), REG_OBJ's tables RegObjContextVtable (0009026a) at +0x18 and RegObjVtable (0009027a) at +2, TS_REG_OBJ's TSRegObjContextVtable (0009029a) and TSRegObjVtable (000902aa), and TSShapeInstance_Ctor (00063080)(0, shape) at +0x1c. ES2's TSRegObj_Ctor (DBSIM 004020b8). es2_xref finds no branch or stored pointer to it.

entries.name: REG_OBJ_DtorThunk
entries.description: Frameless this-adjusting thunk, slot +4 of REG_OBJ's second table RegObjContextVtable (0009026a) (the TSContext's, at the object's +0x18): ADD DWORD PTR [ESP+4],-6, then JMP to RegObj_Dtor (00001a38) through its padding 00001a36. ES2's REG_OBJ_DtorThunk (DBSIM 00402e3a) subtracts 0xc.

entries.name: RegObj_GetPosition
entries.description: Frameless: two NOPs, then MOV EAX,[ESP+4], ADD EAX,6 and RET 4: returns the object + 6, the TSContext's position. Slot +8 of REG_OBJ's table RegObjVtable (0009027a) and of TS_REG_OBJ's TSRegObjVtable (000902aa). ES2's RegObj_GetPosition (DBSIM 00402cef) returns +0x10.

entries.name: RegObj_Dtor
entries.description: (object, flags), callee-cleaned: slot +0xc of REG_OBJ's table RegObjVtable (0009027a) (entered at its padding 00001a36): for a non-null object stores RegObjContextVtable (0009026a) at +0x18 and RegObjVtable (0009027a) at +2, runs TSContext_Dtor (0005b878)(object + 6, 0), stores DRAWABLE's table and calls Mem_Delete on flags bit 0. ES2's RegObj_Dtor (DBSIM 00402e02).

entries.name: TS_REG_OBJ_DtorThunk
entries.description: Frameless this-adjusting thunk, slot +4 of TS_REG_OBJ's second table TSRegObjContextVtable (0009029a) (at the object's +0x18): ADD DWORD PTR [ESP+4],-6, then JMP to TSRegObj_Dtor (00001aa4) through its padding 00001aa3. ES2's TS_REG_OBJ_DtorThunk (DBSIM 00402d9c) subtracts 0xc.

entries.name: TSRegObj_Draw
entries.description: (object), callee-cleaned: slot +4 of TS_REG_OBJ's table TSRegObjVtable (000902aa): Raster_SetModelTransformFromPose (00001808)(object), then the shape instance at +0x1c through its slot +0x20. ES2's TSRegObj_Draw (DBSIM 00402cd4).

entries.name: TSRegObj_Dtor
entries.description: (object, flags), callee-cleaned: slot +0xc of TS_REG_OBJ's table TSRegObjVtable (000902aa): for a non-null object stores TSRegObjContextVtable (0009029a) at +0x18 and TSRegObjVtable (000902aa) at +2, destroys the shape instance at +0x1c through its slot +0x1c with 3, stores REG_OBJ's two tables, runs TSContext_Dtor (0005b878)(object + 6, 0), stores DRAWABLE's table and calls Mem_Delete on flags bit 0. ES2's TSRegObj_Dtor (DBSIM 00402cfa).

entries.name: TSObj_Ctor
entries.description: (object, shape) in stack order, callee-cleaned: TS_OBJ's constructor, allocating 0x3b bytes when object is null. ES2's BeamTracer_Draw (DBSIM 0040bc14) draws this way only its two ELF subtypes, and draws every tracer's first two points as a textured ribbon facing the camera.

entries.name: Bullet_FireBurst
entries.description: (power, machine, range, shot transform, subtype) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the beam's shot. The ray record {shot transform, range, 200}; the shot record from Proj_LookupRecord (0000c2d0)(subtype, 4): Math_Q10Multiply (0005e818)(record +6, power) and (record +4, power), record +8 and +0xc, the machine as owner and 5; Sim_RaycastObjectList (0001f1d0), the distance travelled being its answer or the range when that is 0; the far end Transform_ApplyToPoint (0005f58c)((0, travelled, 0), shot transform); one tracer, BeamTracer_Ctor (00008268)(0, machine, far end, the transform's translation +0x14, subtype); then Sound_PlayAt (0004deb8)(that translation, 0xb). es2_xref finds two calls, from WeaponMount_FireDispatch_GunBeam (0000b024) and ElfMount_FireDispatch (0000b218). ES2's Bullet_FireBurst (DBSIM 0040bf74), which plays the sound first and spawns one tracer per 5000 units for every subtype but 1 and 7.

entries.name: BeamTracer_LifeTick
entries.description: (tracer), callee-cleaned: slot +0x18 of BeamTracerVtable (00090d1e) by its padding 000089a7, the tick: returns 1 when Math_CountdownTimerTick (0006410c)(+0x56) reads 0, which BeamTracer_Ctor's countdown of 0 makes the first tick. ES2's BeamTracer_LifeTick (DBSIM 0040c2a0).

entries.name: Beam_RegisterSubsystem
entries.description: No arguments, no Ghidra function: the beams' static initializer, entry 000adbe8 of the static constructor table and its object file's last code: RegisterSubsystemLoader (00000ac4)(2, Beam_BuildIndexTable (00008230)) in stack order. Its RET at 000089d0 is followed by three zero bytes and the sphere tests' object file at Collision_RaySphereTest (000089d4). ES2's Beam_RegisterSubsystem (DBSIM 0040c2c0).

entries.name: Collision_RaySphereTest
entries.description: (clip, radius, point) in stack order, callee-cleaned, the point three int32 in muzzle space: with reach = Collision_RayClearance (000bc2aa) + radius as an int16 and m = Math_FastMagnitude2D (00063234)(x, z), passes when y, compared unsigned, is below Collision_RayRemaining (000bc2a6), m is below 0x7fff and the low 16 bits of m + reach are below those of 2 * reach, unsigned; with clip set it then cuts Collision_RayRemaining to y - (reach - m), or 0 when that is not positive. Answers 1 in AX for a pass, else 0. ES2's Collision_RaySphereTest (DBSIM 0040c428). The first function of the sphere tests' object file, after the three zero bytes that follow Beam_RegisterSubsystem.

entries.name: Collision_RayNodeOriginTest
entries.description: (radius), callee-cleaned: Collision_RaySphereTest (000089d4)(0, radius, the translation at +0x14 of Collision_NodeToMuzzleTransform (000bc2a2)), whose answer stays in AX. ES2's Collision_RayNodeOriginTest (DBSIM 0040c4a4). es2_xref finds no branch or stored pointer to it.

entries.name: Collision_ClusterBoundTest
entries.description: (radius, center) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the int16 center through Collision_NodeToMuzzleTransform (000bc2a2) with Transform_ApplyToShortPoint (0005e858), then Collision_RaySphereTest (000089d4)(0, radius, that point), whose answer stays in AX. So the bound passes only with its center nearer than Collision_RayRemaining, where ES2's Collision_ClusterBoundTest (DBSIM 0040c4c4) compares against the remaining length plus the radius and tests the off-axis magnitude against radius + clearance directly.

entries.name: Collision_ClusterSphereTest
entries.description: (cluster, offset) in stack order, callee-cleaned: for each of the cluster's sphere count (+0) 8-byte spheres at +2, the center plus the offset's three int16 when the offset is not null, through Collision_NodeToMuzzleTransform (000bc2a2) with Transform_ApplyToShortPoint (0005e858), goes to Collision_RaySphereTest (000089d4)(1, the sphere's radius +6, that point). Returns Collision_RayRemaining (000bc2a6) + 1 when any sphere passed, else 0. ES2's Collision_ClusterSphereTest (DBSIM 0040c524).

entries.name: Collision_ComputeBoundingSphere
entries.description: (cluster, out center) in stack order, callee-cleaned: a box seeded at 10000 and -10000 widened by each 8-byte sphere's center plus and minus its radius (+6), the out center its middle (each int16 sum shifted right 1, arithmetic), and returns Math_FastMagnitude3D (0006325a) of the box's top corner less the center. ES2's Collision_ComputeBoundingSphere (DBSIM 0040c5d0).

entries.name: Collision_ClusterReach
entries.description: (cluster, offset) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the greatest, over the cluster's 8-byte spheres, of Math_FastMagnitude3D (0006325a) of the sphere's center plus the offset's three int16 when the offset is not null, plus the sphere's radius (+6), returned as an int16 in AX. ES2's Collision_ClusterReach (DBSIM 0040c71c). es2_xref finds no branch or stored pointer to it.

entries.name: Collision_ReadSphereArray
entries.description: (cluster, stream) in stack order, callee-cleaned: reads the int16 sphere count into cluster+0; when the read succeeds and count * 8, as an int16, is non-zero, builds count 8-byte spheres with __vec_new into cluster+2 and reads that many bytes into them. ES2's Collision_ReadSphereArray (DBSIM 0040c7c4), which tests count & 0x1fff.

entries.name: CollisionSphere_ElementCtor
entries.description: (sphere), callee-cleaned: returns its argument, allocating 8 bytes with Mem_New (000015a4) when it is null and returning 0 when that fails; the base constructors' own allocations of 6 and 4 bytes that follow run only for a null pointer, which the first test has already replaced. ES2's CollisionSphere_ElementCtor (DBSIM 0040c8be). es2_xref finds two stored pointers to it, one the element constructor Collision_CopyClusterSpheres (00008eb0) passes to __vec_new.

entries.name: Collision_CopyClusterSpheres
entries.description: (cluster, offset, source cluster) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the cluster's sphere count (+0) becomes the source's and, when it is not 0, +2 a new array of that many 8-byte spheres (__vec_new with CollisionSphere_ElementCtor (00008e68)) holding the source's spheres with the int16 offset triple added to each centre. ES2's Collision_CopyClusterSpheres (DBSIM 0040c834).

entries.name: Collision_ClusterTest
entries.description: (cluster), callee-cleaned: Collision_ClusterBoundTest (00008a88)(the bound's radius +0xe, its center +8) and, when that passes, returns Collision_ClusterSphereTest (00008ab8)(cluster, null); otherwise 0. ES2's Collision_ClusterTest (DBSIM 0040c8c8). The first function of the object file the zero fill after Collision_CopyClusterSpheres opens.

entries.name: Mech_ComponentGeometryTest_Candidate
entries.description: (node, occupancy flags, object-to-muzzle frame, object) in stack order, callee-cleaned: for a node whose part id (+0) is negative copies the 32-byte frame; otherwise asks the shape at +4 of the object's shape instance (+0x2e) for the part through its slot +0x24 and composes the instance's node-array (+0x16) entry at the part's node index (+4) with the frame through Transform_Concat (0005ea08), passing a null node transform when the shape has no such part. The result becomes Collision_NodeToMuzzleTransform (000bc2a2). Then for each 16-byte cluster (count +4, array +6) whose component's (+6) flag is set, a non-zero Collision_ClusterTest (00008f54) stores its answer to Collision_HitDistance (000af130) and the component to Collision_HitComponent (000af134). Returns 0. ES2's Mech_ComponentGeometryTest_Candidate (DBSIM 0040c8fc), which uses the identity for a missing part or a negative node index.

entries.name: Mech_SelectStruckComponent
entries.description: (model, occupancy flags, object-to-muzzle frame, ray record, object) in stack order, callee-cleaned: sets Collision_HitComponent (000af134) to 0xffff and Collision_HitDistance (000af130) to 0, Collision_RayRemaining (000bc2a6) from the ray record's +4 and Collision_RayClearance (000bc2aa) from its +8, runs Mech_ComponentGeometryTest_Candidate (00008f84)(node, flags, frame, object) on each of the model's 10-byte nodes (count +0, array +2), copies the distance and component to Collision_HitResult (000af138) and returns its address, or null when the distance is 0. ES2's Mech_SelectStruckComponent (DBSIM 0040c9d4). es2_xref finds three calls: Mech_DirectFireHitTest (00013b44), Base_DirectFireHitTest (00003a58) and Flyer_DirectFireHitTest (0001b370).

entries.name: Collision_FindClusterInNode
entries.description: (node, out part id, component) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the first of the node's 16-byte clusters (count +4, array +6) whose component (+6) is the one asked for; it writes the node's part id (+0) through the out pointer and returns the cluster, or returns 0 when none matches. ES2's Collision_FindClusterInNode (DBSIM 0040ca58).

entries.name: Collision_FindClusterForComponent
entries.description: (model, out part id, component) in stack order, callee-cleaned: Collision_FindClusterInNode (000090fc)(node, out, component) over the model's 10-byte nodes (count +0, array +2), returning the first cluster found, or 0. ES2's Collision_FindClusterForComponent (DBSIM 0040ca8c). es2_xref finds one call, from Component_DestroyAndCascade (00009cd4).

entries.name: Collision_CollectNodeComponents
entries.description: (node, out) in stack order, callee-cleaned: writes each of the node's 16-byte clusters' (+6, count +4) component index (cluster +6) to out and returns the count. ES2's Collision_CollectNodeComponents (DBSIM 0040cacc).

entries.name: Collision_CollectNodeAnchors
entries.description: (node, points, node ids, components) in stack order, callee-cleaned: for each of the node's 16-byte clusters (+6, count +4), the cluster's component index (+6), the address of its bound centre (+8) and the node's own int16 (+0); returns the count. ES2's Collision_CollectNodeAnchors (DBSIM 0040cafc).

entries.name: Collision_CollectComponentIds
entries.description: (model, out) in stack order, callee-cleaned: Collision_CollectNodeComponents (000091bc) over each 10-byte node of the model (+2, count +0), each writing after the last; returns the total. ES2's Collision_CollectComponentIds (DBSIM 0040cb48). es2_xref finds no branch or stored pointer to it.

entries.name: Collision_CollectComponentAnchors
entries.description: (model, points, node ids, components) in stack order, callee-cleaned: Collision_CollectNodeAnchors (00009218) over each 10-byte node of the model (+2, count +0), each writing after the last; returns the total. ES2's Collision_CollectComponentAnchors (DBSIM 0040cb84). es2_xref finds its one call in Mech_ConfigureLoadout (00012c00).

entries.name: CollisionTable_Reserve
entries.description: (n), callee-cleaned: returns the int16 count at CollisionTable_Count (00090da0) and adds n to it. ES2's CollisionTable_Reserve (DBSIM 0040cbd4).

entries.name: CollisionTable_Alloc
entries.description: No arguments: when the int16 count CollisionTable_Count (00090da0) is not 0, allocates count * 6 bytes to CollisionTable_Array (000bc2ac). ES2's CollisionTable_Alloc (DBSIM 0040cbec). Caller found by es2_xref: DBSim_LoadScriptDat.

entries.name: Collision_ReadCluster
entries.description: (cluster, stream) in stack order, callee-cleaned: reads the int16 component index into cluster+6 and, when that read succeeds, the spheres with Collision_ReadSphereArray (00008e00). ES2's Collision_ReadCluster (DBSIM 0040cc14).

entries.name: Collision_ReadNode
entries.description: (node, stream) in stack order, callee-cleaned: reads the int16 node index into the 10-byte node's +0 and the cluster count into +4; for a count not 0, __vec_new builds that many 16-byte clusters with CollisionCluster_ElementCtor (00009458) at +6, each read with Collision_ReadCluster (0000938c). Returns 1. ES2's Collision_ReadNode (DBSIM 0040cc50).

entries.name: CollisionCluster_ElementCtor
entries.description: (this) callee-cleaned: the __vec_new element constructor Collision_ReadNode (000093c8) passes for its 16-byte clusters. Allocates 0x10 bytes when this is null and returns null when that fails; the inlined constructors of the 6-byte member at +8 and its 4-byte member only repeat the null test and allocation at their own sizes. Writes nothing; returns this. ES2's CollisionCluster_ElementCtor (DBSIM 0040cf04).

entries.name: Collision_ComputeAllBoundingSpheres
entries.description: (node), callee-cleaned: for each of the node's int16 cluster count (+4) 16-byte clusters at +6, stores Collision_ComputeBoundingSphere (00008b8c)(cluster, cluster + 8) at the cluster's +0xe. ES2's Collision_ComputeAllBoundingSpheres (DBSIM 0040ccc8).

entries.name: Collision_LoadRecordArray
entries.description: (slot, stream) in stack order, callee-cleaned, collide.cpp: a severity-5 assert (line 0xee, 'collision data load') when the stream status is set; reads the int16 node count into the 6-byte slot's +0 and, for a count not 0, allocates count * 10 bytes at +2 and reads each node with Collision_ReadNode (000093c8) and then Collision_ComputeAllBoundingSpheres (000094a0). ES2's Collision_LoadRecordArray (DBSIM 0040ccf8). Callers found by es2_xref: Base_LoadResources (000046ac), once per BASES.DAT type over dat\basecol, and Collision_RegisterObject (00009580).

entries.name: Collision_RegisterObject
entries.description: (path), callee-cleaned: opens the path with VolRStream_CtorFromPath, asserting at severity 5 (collide.cpp line 0x101) when the stream's status is set, takes the next 6-byte slot of CollisionTable_Array (000bc2ac) by CollisionTable_Cursor (00090da2), which it increments, loads the stream into it with Collision_LoadRecordArray (000094f0), destroys the stream and returns the slot. ES2's Collision_RegisterObject (DBSIM 0040cd88). es2_xref finds two calls: Mech_Constructor (00011330) and FlyerType_LoadResources (0001c6c8).

entries.name: Collision_ReplaceClusterIfMatch
entries.description: (cluster, count, offsets, template clusters) in stack order, callee-cleaned: at the first of count templates whose component (+6) is the cluster's, Collision_CopyClusterSpheres (00008eb0)(cluster, that entry's offset, template); answers whether one matched. ES2's Collision_ReplaceClusterIfMatch (DBSIM 0040ce28).

entries.name: Collision_ReplaceNodeCluster
entries.description: (node, count, offsets, template clusters) in stack order, callee-cleaned: Collision_ReplaceClusterIfMatch (000095f4) over the node's 16-byte clusters (+6, count +4) until one matches; answers whether one did. ES2's Collision_ReplaceNodeCluster (DBSIM 0040ce78).

entries.name: Collision_ReplaceClusters
entries.description: (model, count, offsets, template clusters) in stack order, callee-cleaned: Collision_ReplaceNodeCluster (00009680) over the model's 10-byte nodes (+2, count +0); for the first node that replaced a cluster, Collision_ComputeAllBoundingSpheres (000094a0)(node), and it returns. ES2's Collision_ReplaceClusters (DBSIM 0040cec0). es2_xref finds its one call in Mech_ConfigureLoadout (00012c00).

entries.name: Component_AllDependentsDestroyed
entries.description: (piece, internal damage) in stack order, callee-cleaned: 0 as soon as one of the piece's dependents (the list +8, count +6, the internal index at each entry's +2) has a damage entry that is not negative, else 1. ES2's Component_AllDependentsDestroyed (DBSIM 0040cf10).

entries.name: Component_SpillIntoDependents
entries.description: (piece, internal maxima, damage, internal damage) in stack order, callee-cleaned: repeatedly sums the spill weights (+0) of the piece's dependents whose damage entry is not negative; with a non-zero sum draws Math_RandomBelow (00063b3c)(000b5bd4, sum), walks the live entries subtracting weights to the one the draw falls on and runs Component_AddDamage (00009c88)(the damage argument, that internal's maximum, its entry), going round again while that destroys it. Answers 1 when the sum was 0. ES2's Component_SpillIntoDependents (DBSIM 0040cf44).

entries.name: HercPiece_ReadRecord
entries.description: (piece, stream) in stack order, callee-cleaned: reads 8 bytes into piece+0 and, when the int16 dependent count at +6 is non-zero, operator new of count * 4 bytes into +8 and that many bytes into it. ES2's HercPiece_ReadRecord (DBSIM 0040cff8).

entries.name: HercPiece_CopyRecord
entries.description: (piece, source) in stack order, callee-cleaned: copies the 18-byte piece record, then gives the copy a dependent list of its own: Mem_New of count (+6) x 4 bytes at +8, the source's list copied in. ES2's HercPiece_CopyRecord (DBSIM 0040d050).

entries.name: HercPiece_LoadTable
entries.description: (slot, stream) in stack order, callee-cleaned: reads the int16 internal count into +0xa and that many int16 maxima into a new array at +4, the int16 piece count into +8, and that many 18-byte pieces into a new array at +0, each with HercPiece_ReadRecord (00009890). DBSIM's HercPiece_LoadTable (0040d09c).

entries.name: HercPiece_SetInternalMaxima
entries.description: (table, count, maxima, internal indices) in stack order, callee-cleaned: for each of count, the table's maxima array (+4) at the next index takes the next maximum. ES2's HercPiece_SetInternalMaxima (DBSIM 0040d128). es2_xref finds its one call in Mech_ConfigureLoadout (00012c00).

entries.name: Damage_LoadMechDmgFile
entries.description: (path), callee-cleaned: opens path with VolRStream_CtorFromPath, asserting at severity 5 (damage.cpp line 0x85) when the stream status is set; takes the 12-byte slot of the table at DmgTable_Array (000bc2b0) numbered by the word DmgTable_Cursor (00090dfe), which it increments; reads the file into it with HercPiece_LoadTable (00009930); destroys the stream and returns the slot. DBSIM's Damage_LoadMechDmgFile (0040d160), without its exception frame.

entries.name: DmgTable_Reserve
entries.description: (n), callee-cleaned: returns the int16 count at DmgTable_Count (00090e00) and adds n to it. ES2's DmgTable_Reserve (DBSIM 0040d200).

entries.name: DmgTable_Alloc
entries.description: No arguments: when the int16 DmgTable_Count (00090e00) is not 0, allocates count x 12 bytes to DmgTable_Array (000bc2b0). ES2's DmgTable_Alloc (DBSIM 0040d218). Caller found by es2_xref: DBSim_LoadScriptDat.

entries.name: HercPiece_ReplacePieces
entries.description: (table, count, template pieces, component indices) in stack order, callee-cleaned: for each of count, HercPiece_CopyRecord (000098e8)(the table's piece at the next index, 18 bytes apart from the table's +0, the next template). ES2's HercPiece_ReplacePieces (DBSIM 0040d240). es2_xref finds its one call in Mech_ConfigureLoadout (00012c00).

entries.name: HercPiece_BindComponentAnchors
entries.description: (table, points, node ids, components, count) in stack order, callee-cleaned: for each of count, the table's piece at the next component index takes the next node id at +0xc and the next point at +0xe. ES2's HercPiece_BindComponentAnchors (DBSIM 0040d284). es2_xref finds its one call in Mech_ConfigureLoadout (00012c00).

entries.name: Component_AllocDamageArrays
entries.description: (header, internals, components) in stack order, callee-cleaned: allocates 0x1c bytes when header is null (0 when that fails); +0 a zeroed array of internals int16, +4 a zeroed array of components int16, +8 an array of components int16 with every byte 1, the component count at +0x18 and the internal count at +0x1a; returns header. ES2's Component_AllocDamageArrays (DBSIM 0040d2cc). es2_xref finds two calls: Mech_Constructor (00011330) and Flyer_Constructor (0001ac58).

entries.name: Component_LinkMaxRefData
entries.description: (header, model, table, machine) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the table at +0xc, the model at +0x10, the machine at +0x14; when maybe_ComponentDependencyList (00090e04) is null, makes it: a 6-byte record holding Mem_New(0x14) at +0, the capacity byte 10 at +4 and a zero count byte at +5. ES2's Component_LinkMaxRefData (DBSIM 0040d354), whose list has room for 20. es2_xref finds two calls: Mech_Constructor (00011330) and Flyer_Constructor (0001ac58).

entries.name: Component_AddDamage
entries.description: (damage, maximum, entry) in stack order, callee-cleaned: for an entry not negative adds the damage to it as an int16 and, when that reaches the maximum, writes entry - maximum back through the damage pointer and stores -1; answers whether the entry is negative. ES2's Component_AddDamage (DBSIM 0040d3ec) sums in 32 bits and stores only a sum under the maximum, so an ES1 sum past 32767 wraps negative with neither -1 nor the excess written.

entries.name: Component_DestroyAndCascade
entries.description: (header, component) in stack order, callee-cleaned: Collision_FindClusterForComponent (0000916c) on the model (+0x10) for the cluster, used unchecked, and its part id. Returns 0 when the component's occupancy flag (+8 array) is clear; otherwise its entry (+4 array) becomes -1 and its flag 0, and Component_SpillIntoDependents (0000979c) gives its dependents 32000. For a piece sequence byte +3 not negative: with ComponentCascade_EffectLatch (000af140) clear and flags (+5) bit 1 set, Smoke_Construct (000069ec)(0, 0, the cluster's bound center +8, the part id, the machine +0x14); then the int16 at that sequence in the array at +8 of the machine's shape instance (+0x2e) becomes 2. The anchor: the bound center widened, or through the part's node transform (null for a part the shape lacks) with Transform_ApplyToShortPoint (0005e858); then Context_GetTransform (000016e8)(machine + 6) with Transform_ApplyToPoint (0005f58c). With the latch clear, Explosion_Construct (00005af0)(0, anchor, 10), or 0x11 setting the latch when flags bit 2 is set. Then, whatever the latch, Debris_ThrowGroup (00005fb8)(g_DebrisGroups (000bc1c0)'s group 3, anchor, g_DebrisShapes (000bc1c6)). Last, each of the header's components (+0x18 count) with its flag set whose piece's parent byte +4 is this component is appended to maybe_ComponentDependencyList (00090e04) at its count byte +5, with no capacity test. Returns 1. ES2's Component_DestroyAndCascade (DBSIM 0040d434), which also puts out the machine's fires for bit 1, lights fire 2 for bit 3 and throws the piece's +2 group.

entries.name: Component_IsFullyDestroyed
entries.description: (header, component) in stack order, callee-cleaned: when the component's entry (+4 array) is negative, Component_AllDependentsDestroyed (00009734)(the piece, the internals' damage +0); otherwise 0. ES2's Component_IsFullyDestroyed (DBSIM 0040d9f8). es2_xref finds two calls, from Mech_ComponentDamageWrite (00013250).

entries.name: Component_ApplyDamageAndCascade
entries.description: (header, damage, component) in stack order, callee-cleaned: Component_AddDamage (00009c88)(the damage, the piece's armor +0, the component's entry); when that answers destroyed, Component_SpillIntoDependents (0000979c)(piece, the internals' maxima, the excess, the internals' damage). When the spill leaves a dependent standing and the piece's sequence byte +3 is not -1, the int16 at that sequence in the array at +8 of the machine's (+0x14) shape instance (+0x2e) becomes 1; ES2's has no such step. When it leaves none and the piece's flags (+5) have bit 0, it clears ComponentCascade_EffectLatch (000af140), runs Component_DestroyAndCascade (00009cd4) on the component and then on the last entry of maybe_ComponentDependencyList (00090e04) while its count byte +5 is not 0, taking 1 from the count first, and returns 1; otherwise 0. ES2's Component_ApplyDamageAndCascade (DBSIM 0040da38). es2_xref finds three calls: Mech_ComponentDamageWrite (00013250), Mech_DirectFireHitTest (00013b44) and Flyer_ComponentDamageWrite (0001b290).

entries.name: Component_ReadOverallDamage
entries.description: (header), callee-cleaned: over the header's components (+0x18 count), whatever their flags, sums each entry (+4 array), or the piece's armor for a negative entry, and each piece's armor (+0); over the internals (+0x1a count) each entry (+0 array), or the maximum for a negative one, and each maximum (the table's +4 array); returns the damage sum shifted left 8 divided by the maximum sum, signed (IDIV). ES2's Component_ReadOverallDamage (DBSIM 0040db2c). es2_xref finds two calls, from Mech_GetOverallDamage (00010eb0) and Flyer_GetOverallDamage (0001b50c).

entries.name: Component_ReadDamagePercent
entries.description: (damage header, component), callee-cleaned: a component's damage as Q8 of its maximum: the component's int16 in the array at header+4 (its maximum when -1) plus the internal damage (header+0, -1 read as the maximum) of each entry the component's 0x12-byte record lists, shifted left 8 and divided by the sum of the maxima from header+0xc. ES2's Component_ReadDamagePercent (DBSIM 0040dbc0).

entries.name: Component_TotalArmor
entries.description: (header, component) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the piece's armor (+0) plus the maximum (the table's +4 array) of each dependent, the int16 at +2 of each 4-byte entry of the list at +8 (count +6), returned as an int16 in AX. ES2's Component_TotalArmor (DBSIM 0040dc58), which returns an int. es2_xref finds one call, from Mech_SpreadImpactDamage (00013078). The last function of its object file: its RET 8 at 0000a2da is followed by three zero bytes and the mount classes' file at 0000a2e0.

entries.name: HeapPtr_DtorMountsCopy
entries.description: (p, flags), callee-cleaned: byte for byte the code of HeapPtr_DtorGunlistCopy (0000baf0), relocated operands aside: frees the block p points at and, on flags bit 0, p. The weapon mount classes' object file opens with it. The scan's frameless stub at 0000a304 is its own POP EBP; RET 8.

entries.name: Shape_TranslatePointLists
entries.description: (offset, part) in stack order, its arguments removed by this function: adds the int16 triple at offset to the points of part's tree. Takes the part's class tag from its vtable +4 and finds it among the eleven dwords at Shape_TranslatePointListsTags (00090e08) with REPNE SCASD, jumping through the eleven targets after them: 0x1e0005, 0x1e0003 and 0x140005 return; 0x14000a and 0x140014 (TSBSPGroup, TSGroup) memset one byte per point (count +0x22) of Shape_TranslatePointMarks (000af178) to 0, mark for each poly (pointer array +0x1c, count +0x26) whose tag is one of the five at Shape_TranslatePointPolyTags (00090e60) its point +6 and the +8 entries of the int16 index list +0x10 from its +0xa, and add offset's x, y and z to each marked point of the list at +0x14, 6 bytes each; 0x140006 calls itself with the same arguments; 0x140015, 0x140008, 0x140007, 0x14000b and 0x14000c recurse into each child (pointer array +0x12, count +0x10); any other tag returns. The cases are jump targets inside the function, 0000a333-0000a4bf, ending at its RET 8. ES2's Shape_TranslatePointLists (DBSIM 0040dd4c), whose tag comes from vtable +0 and whose arguments are (part, offset). es2_xref finds calls from WeaponMount_CtorBase (0000a530) and from itself.

entries.name: WeaponMount_PrepareShot
entries.description: (mount, free-shot flag, machine) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the base fire slot +0x2c and the prologue of every fire dispatch; it never reads its second argument. Looks up the node of the hardpoint's bone (int16 +0 of the record at +0x18) through slot +0x24 of the object at +4 of the machine's +0x2e, taking the 0x20-byte frame the answer's int16 +4 indexes in the +0x16 array of the machine's +0x2e, or a null pointer with no answer; when +0x5f or +0x5b is 0 it builds BuildEulerRotationMatrixQ14 of (+0x24 when +0x5b is 0, 0, +0x28 when +0x5f is 0) and composes it with the frame through Transform_ConcatRotation (000647f4). Transform_Concat of the frame and Context_GetTransform(machine + 6) goes to WeaponMount_ShotTransform (000af144); the template's +0x40 triple plus WeaponMount_MuzzleOffset (0000b918)(mount) goes through Transform_ApplyToShortPoint to WeaponMount_ShotMuzzlePoint (000af164), and Transform_RotationToEuler of the transform to WeaponMount_ShotEuler (000af170). Sets the refire countdown +0x31 to the template's +0x4c and byte 0 of +0x33 and +0x3b to 1. ES2's WeaponMount_PrepareShot (DBSIM 0040e788), which scales the refire by +0x63, substitutes a fixed transform for a missing node, builds the machine's transform from its angles and swaps in the spectator's watched object.

For a projectile record (+0x20) of int16 type 0 it calls Rocket_Fire (00007748)(0, machine, WeaponMount_ShotEuler (000af170), WeaponMount_ShotMuzzlePoint (000af164), the record's +2); otherwise Bullet_Fire (00008134)(machine, the angles, the muzzle point, the record's +2), then sets +0x44 when the hardpoint's byte +6 is below 4. For a record of type 4 it copies WeaponMount_ShotMuzzlePoint (000af164) into the shot transform's translation (000af158), takes min(the template's +0x38, the capacitor +0x7d) as the power, calls Bullet_FireBurst (000088cc)(power, machine, the template's int32 +0x30, WeaponMount_ShotTransform (000af144), the record's +2) and takes the power off +0x7d. Otherwise, with +0x7d below the cost +0x38, Bullet_FirePowered (000081d4)(the charge, machine, the angles, the muzzle point, the record's +2), and when the template's +0x3c is 3 two more at the muzzle offset with x = 0 and x = -(the template's +0x40); then +0x7d = 0. With +0x7d at or above the cost, subtracts the cost and calls Bullet_Fire (00008134)(machine, the angles, the muzzle point, the record's +2). Score: b = 0x1000 - (|bearing error| >> 3), the error being the heading from this +0x20 to the candidate's +0x20 (Math_HeadingToward) less this's heading +0xa, 0 with mask 0x20; Q10(100, b), raised inside a Math_DistanceBetweenPoints range of 25000 to b / max(range >> 11, 1) when that is larger; then Q10-multiplied by the weight tables 00091620 (candidate's +0x15e is this, unless mask bit 1), 00091628 (candidate's behaviour descriptor byte +9 clear), 00091630 (candidate's +0x15e is another object) and 00091638 (by the candidate's int16 +0x162), the first three indexed by this's vtable +0x50 (this, candidate), called for every candidate past the tier gate, each product the rounding Math_Q10Multiply (0005e818) cut to an int16; and divided by one more than the candidate's holders +0x15c, less one when this's +0x15e is the candidate, unless mask bit 2. entries.name: Mech_ApplyThrottleInput
entries.description: (machine, throttle axis, steer) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the player's throttle. The axis is negated when ThrottleLeverMode (000919ce) is negative; the steer is negated when |axis| is under 0x3d and the throttle int16 +0x226 is not negative, or when the axis is under 1. A non-zero Math_Q8Multiply (0005e7f8)(-axis, 0x91) sets +0x8d and moves the throttle, clamped to [-0x400, 0x400] narrowed to one side by the mode's sign, or zeroes it when it would cross 0. Then Mech_LocomotionTick (00012038)(machine, 0, Math_Q10Multiply (0005e818)(throttle, the type record's reverse +4 or forward +6 top speed by the throttle's sign), steer). es2_xref finds one call, from 0005a319. ES2's Mech_ApplyThrottleInput (DBSIM 004160dc), which also takes an absolute throttle lever.

entries.name: Mech_AiObstacleAvoidance
entries.description: (machine, flags, desired speed, steer) in stack order, callee-cleaned (RET 0x10). It returns at once when the speed +0x224 and the desired speed are both 0, or when the desired speed is negative and the unstick counter, the int32 +0x204, is 0; otherwise left and right start at 22000. With flags bit 0 clear, two probes from (-1500, 0, 0) to (-10000, 20000, 0) and from (1500, 0, 0) to (10000, 20000, 0) in the machine's frame (Context_GetTransform (000016e8), Transform_ApplyToPoint (0005f58c)), each through Sim_RaycastShapes (00020b70), whose hit sets the side's figure, and then Structure_RaycastShapes (000038b8)(-1, 0, to, from, result), whose hit sets it only when nearer; then each live object but itself whose group holds no action (+0x16) and whose slot +0x60 is non-zero, at Math_Q10Multiply (0005e818)(Math_DistanceBetweenPoints (00063c20), 2000), when under either figure and within +/-0x2000 of the heading by Math_HeadingToward (00063cc8), lowers the right figure to it for a negative bearing and the left for 0 or more, each only when under that figure. With either under 22000: the unstick side +0x1e8 is added to the left when +0xa8 is set and both are; the steer gains (22000 - nearer) x 2000 / 22000 by IDIV, cut to an int16 and negated when left <= right; and the desired speed becomes 0 when the nearer is negative. es2_xref finds one call, from Mech_LocomotionTick (00012038). ES2's Mech_AiObstacleAvoidance (DBSIM 00416274), which also tests the terrain and the player's line of fire and gains 700 or 1000.

entries.name: Mech_LocomotionTick
entries.description: (mech, avoidance arg, desired speed, steer) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the HERC control law and gait machine, with the type record at +0x188. An immobilised machine (+0x9e) has desired speed and steer zeroed. Otherwise, while Timer_CountDown (00064178)(mech + 0x203) reports the timer running, the desired speed becomes the type's +4 when +0xa8 is set and +6 when not; once it reports 0 the desired speed is clamped to [+4, +6] and +0xa8 is left as it is. A machine other than the player (PlayerMech (000bc42a)) that is not immobilised runs Mech_AiObstacleAvoidance (00011c80). Leg damage scales the desired speed by Q10 400 (+0xa3) or 750 (+0xa2), steer is clamped to +/-0x100, and the speed +0x224 moves toward the desired speed by typeRec +8 (Math_RateLimitedMoveToward). The gait machine then compares |speed| with last tick's on the locomotion thread +0x1c0, cutting to or requesting the type's sequences +0xe, +0x10, +0x12, +0x14, +0x46 and +0x7c with AnimThread_SetSequence (0006200c) and AnimThread_SetTarget (0006265c), shifting at the walk-to-run speeds +0x2e and +0x6e (file offsets 44 and 108), and setting the playback rate +0x236: an immobilised machine off +0x7c falls to +0x46, requesting it at rate 100 with Sound_PlayAt 0x1e at +0x20 unless +0xae is latched, then running at rate 0x78 and, once the sequence has played, latching +0xae, calling Mech_SpreadImpactDamage (00013078)(mech, 0x78, 0x96) and playing 0x29. Rising off the walk and stop sequences, falling on the run at or above +0x2e, and falling on the walk at a non-zero speed leave the playback rate as it was. The turn rate +0x222 then moves by typeRec +0xa toward Q8(steer, tent): the tent is 0 when a gait branch set its step flag this tick or |speed| is below 45; otherwise it rises from 0 at 45 to typeRec +2 midway between 45 and the top speed +6, and falls to half that at the top speed. The heading +0xa takes the turn rate and +0x2c, the orientation block's cached-rotation word, is cleared. ES2's Mech_LocomotionTick (DBSIM 00416a04) clears its unstick direction when the countdown has run out, adds the terrain slope and the Turbo Pod, scales for reactor damage too, sets the playback rate to the speed in those three branches, lifts a crawl's rate to 60, takes a speed of 1 to 44 as 45 with its tent rising from half, and scales the tent by Q10(1600).
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 00012038, against ES2's Mech_LocomotionTick

entries.name: Mech_Draw
entries.description: (machine), callee-cleaned, slot +4 of MechVtable (00091ae6): while Mech_DrawEnabled (000bc428) is set, Mech_SpliceHardpointShapes (00002654)(entry, type record + 0xd4, the manager +0x198) for each 6-byte CONNECT_INFO entry of the record's +0xce, the root count +0xd2 of them, then Shape_DrawAtDetailLevel (00002b30)(machine). ES2's Mech_Draw (DBSIM 004174c8), which calls Mech_SpliceHardpointShapes and Shape_DrawAtDetailLevel at those places.

entries.name: Shape_StampTransformId
entries.description: (node id, part) in stack order, callee-cleaned: reads the part's class tag through its slot +4 and dispatches by REPNE SCASD over the ten tags at Shape_StampTransformIdTags (00091c04): 0x140014 stores the id at +4 and returns; 0x14000b stores it at +4, then recurses; 0x140015 fills the +0x16 int16 at +0x1c with it, then recurses; 0x140007, 0x140008 and 0x14000c recurse; 0x1e0003, 0x1e0005, 0x140005, 0x140006 and any other tag return. Recursing calls itself on each of the +0x10 children at +0x12. es2_xref finds two calls, its own and one from Mech_ConfigureLoadout (00012c00). ES2's Shape_StampTransformId (DBSIM 00417530), whose tag is slot 0's.

entries.name: Mech_ConfigureLoadout
entries.description: (machine, ammunition types, weapon fit) in stack order, callee-cleaned: builds the manager at +0x198 from Mech_GetGunLayout (0001a0f8), with WeaponMounts_CtorLocal (0000c808) for a machine whose +0x9d is set and MechLoadout_ConstructWeaponMounts (0000c31c) otherwise; SimObject_ApplyRootMotionIfEnabled (0000215c)(machine, 0); for each fitted mount, with the template +0x1c, WeaponMount_MuzzleOffset (0000b918) and the component .GL +0x17 + 0x13 and internal +0xc: when the mount has a model (+0x10), Shape_StampTransformId (00012b58) with the node of the part WeaponMount_HardpointBoneId (0000ac40) names (the shape's slot +0x24); the template cluster's component and piece's internal, the piece's parent byte, then Collision_ReplaceClusters (000096e8) on +0x18c and HercPiece_ReplacePieces (00009ad4) and HercPiece_SetInternalMaxima (000099e4) on +0x190. Then Collision_CollectComponentAnchors (000092e4) on +0x18c into HercPiece_BindComponentAnchors (00009b28) on +0x190, and clears the occupancy flag (+0x1a4) of each of 28 components whose piece's +6 is 0. es2_xref finds one call, from DBSim_SpawnMissionObjects (0001e638), and the address as a dword at 00096bcb, 00096be3 and 000ad900. ES2's Mech_ConfigureLoadout (DBSIM 004175dc), which goes on to file the pods and size the shields and reactor.

entries.name: Mech_ApplyFormationOffset

ES2's Mech_ApplyFormationOffset (DBSIM 00417898). Callers found by es2_xref: Mech_AttachToGroup (00013124), Ai_KeepFormation (00019660).

entries.name: Mech_ApplyStartingCondition
entries.description: (machine, condition), callee-cleaned: outside 0-0x4f nothing; under 0x14, Mech_ComponentDamageWrite (00013250)(machine, 0, 32000, 7 or 8 by Math_RandomNext (00063af4)(000b5bd4) bit 0), the same with 0xd or 0xe when the type record's +0x4a is above 2, and +0x9e, +0xad and +0xae set, damage 0x96; 0x14-0x27 the internal maximum +0xa of the .DMG table's +4 written to internal 5 and +0xad set, damage 0x78; 0x28-0x3b 0x50; 0x3c-0x4f 0x32; then Mech_SpreadImpactDamage (00013078)(machine, damage + 0x19, damage). es2_xref finds one call, from DBSim_SpawnMissionObjects (0001e638). ES2's Mech_ApplyStartingCondition (DBSIM 004178e8), which writes through the vtable.

entries.name: Mech_SpreadImpactDamage
entries.description: (machine, odds, damage) in stack order, callee-cleaned: with damage non-zero, each of 28 components whose occupancy flag (+0x1a4) is set and whose Math_RandomNext (00063af4)(000b5bd4) & 0xff is under the odds takes Math_Q8Multiply (0005e7f8)(Component_TotalArmor (0000a24c)(+0x19c, component), Math_RandomBelow (00063b3c)(damage) + damage / 2) through Mech_ComponentDamageWrite (00013250)(machine, 0, that, component). es2_xref finds three calls: Mech_LocomotionTick (00012038), Mech_ApplyStartingCondition (00012f20) and Mech_ApplyOutnumberedDamage (00015a5c). ES2's Mech_SpreadImpactDamage (DBSIM 00417a04), over 29 components through the vtable.

entries.name: Mech_AttachToGroup
entries.description: (machine, member slot, group) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the group to +0x3f and the slot to +0x43; when the rotation's first word +6 is -32768, the rotation becomes (0, 0, the group's heading +0xc) and +0x2c is cleared; when the position's Z dword +0x28 is negative, the position becomes the group's point +0x20 or, with none, Route_WaypointAt (0001cfb8)(group + 6, the cursor's index), its Z raised by the type record's int16 +0x16, moved by Mech_ApplyFormationOffset (00012ed0). es2_xref finds one call, from DBSim_BuildGroupRecord (0001cff4). ES2's Mech_AttachToGroup (DBSIM 00417aa8), which tests Z for -32768, takes the ground height, lifts a flyer and offsets through the vtable.

entries.name: Mech_GetAimNodeTransform
entries.description: (machine), callee-cleaned, slot +0x28 of MechVtable (00091ae6): finds the type record's +0xc part through slot +0x24 of the shape (+4) of the shape instance at +0x2e and returns the instance's node array (+0x16) + 32 x the part's int16 +4, or 0 when the shape has no such part. ES2's Mech_GetAimNodeTransform (DBSIM 00417b98), which answers DAT_006c572c for a missing part or a negative index.

entries.name: Mech_ComponentDamageWrite
entries.description: (machine, attacker, damage, component) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the damage endpoint. Returns at once for the player's machine (+0x9d) while MissionModeFlag (000bc4a0) is 0 and the header word at 000bc4a8 is 1, or for a component whose occupancy flag (+0x1a4) is clear. Then Component_ApplyDamageAndCascade (00009f7c)(+0x19c, damage, component); WeaponMount_Destroy (0000b968)(mount, 0, machine) for each mount not yet destroyed (+0x49) whose component flag reads 0. Legs, for internals 0 and 1, and 10 and 11 when the type record's +0x4a is above 2: each leg i below the leg count reading 0x100 destroys its shadow, slot i of +0x1cc when not null, through its slot +0xc with 3 and nulls the slot, the count +0x1d0 left as it was; unless immobilised (+0x9e), the count of legs at 0x100 reaching the leg count >> 1 runs, while +0x93 is clear, the attacker's slot +0x64(attacker, 0, machine) for a non-null attacker, Mech_ReportOutOfAction (0000d77c), Action_Activate (0001cc5c) of +0x170 and Behaviour_SetState (0000fdfc)(+0x47, disabled 000af564), then sets +0x9e, posts Computer_PostMessage (0001a154)(7) when the attacker is LocalPlayerMech (000b5b86) and its +0x15e is the machine, and for LocalPlayerMech itself sets the heading +0xa to the third int16 (Z) of Transform_RotationToEuler (0005e988) of Rotation_Concat (00064fe4)(the node transform of the type record's +0xc part, or a null pointer when the shape has no such part, Context_GetTransform (000016e8)(machine + 6)), clears +0x2c and the twist +0x22e, seeks the twist thread +0x1c4, when not null, with AnimThread_SeekToPosition (000620c4)(thread, 0, the type record's +0x1c) and runs SimObject_ApplyRootMotionIfEnabled (0000215c)(machine, 1); otherwise the two sides, legs 0 and 1, each averaged with leg 2 or 3 when the count is 4, latch +0xa3 when either is 0xc1 or more, else +0xa2 when either is above 0x80. Death, while +0x93 is clear, when Component_IsFullyDestroyed (00009f30) reports component 0 or 1 or internal 9 reads 0x100: +0x93 set, the attacker's slot +0x64 with +0x9e, the report and action when +0x9e was clear, +0x90 cleared, message 3 when the attacker is LocalPlayerMech and its +0x15e is the machine, then dead (000af53c), or for a type with +0x4c set +0x32 set, the dword Z +0x28 set to -100000, in limbo (000af514) and every shadow destroyed with the count +0x1d0 zeroed. Last, while +0xa4 and +0xa5 are clear, internal 5 latches +0xa5 past 0xc0 or +0xa4 past 0x80. es2_xref finds six calls: Mech_ApplyStartingCondition (00012f20) twice, Mech_SpreadImpactDamage (00013078), Mech_ApplyExplosiveDamage (00013a7c), Mech_DirectFireHitTest (00013b44) and Mech_BehaviourRamTick (00018278). ES2's Mech_ComponentDamageWrite (DBSIM 00417de4), which also posts the damage warnings, recomputes the shields, grades the legs at 0x8d and 0x50, kills on life support and finishes component 0.

entries.name: Mech_ApplyExplosiveDamage
entries.description: (machine, attacker, radius, point, damage) in stack order, callee-cleaned: for each of 28 components whose occupancy flag (+0x1a4) is set and whose Math_RandomNext (00063af4)(000b5bd4) & 0xfff is under 0x802, the position from slot +0x5c; one closer to the point than the radius by Math_DistanceBetweenPoints (00063c20) takes damage x (radius - distance) / radius through Mech_ComponentDamageWrite (00013250)(machine, attacker, that, component). es2_xref finds four calls: Damage_ExplosiveBlastSweep (0001f75c), Mech_DirectFireHitTest (00013b44) and Mech_CollisionTest (00014174) twice. ES2's Mech_ApplyExplosiveDamage (DBSIM 004187d0), which first passes the damage through the facing's shields.

entries.name: Mech_DirectFireHitTest
entries.description: (machine, shot), callee-cleaned, slot +0x24 of MechVtable (00091ae6): 0 when the shot's origin is farther than its length + its int16 +8 + the type record's +0x1a. Copies the shot's +6 and +4, both through Damage_ScaleByDifficulty (0001f82c) when the owner's (+0xe) group side byte is 0; an AI machine's radar +0x90 goes on for shot type +0x12 0 or 1 unless the counter +0x201 runs, off with +0x201 = 6000 for type 2. Mech_ShieldAbsorb_DirectFire (0000fca8)(+0x1b8, the +6 copy, the length, the shot in the machine's frame by Transform_Concat (0005ea08), machine); with an entry: +0x8e cleared, +0x21e raised by what the shields took; a stopped shot makes its impact at the entry; otherwise the player's machine posts Computer_PostMessage (0001a154)(8) once, latched on +0xaa; Mech_SelectStruckComponent (00009064)(+0x18c, +0x1a4, frame, shot, machine) picks the component, and on a strike +0x21e takes the +4 copy, the splash Math_Q10Multiply (0005e818)(+4 copy, shot +8), Component_ReadDamagePercent (0000a16c) before, Mech_ComponentDamageWrite (00013250)(machine, owner, rest, component), Mech_ApplyExplosiveDamage (00013a7c)(machine, owner, 500, point, splash) for a splash; on a band change (>> 5), Cockpit_StartHitShake (0002e17c) for the player's component 0 or 1, and ES2's mount roll with WeaponMounts_MountForHardpointSlot (0000ca04), WeaponMount_Destroy (0000b968), Salvage_QueueWeapon (0001f7e8) and Component_ApplyDamageAndCascade (00009f7c). With a non-zero answer and a component reading other than 0x100, Explosion_Construct (00005af0)(0, point, effect 4n + random & 3 of the shot's +0xa table) and, for a strike, Debris_ThrowGroup (00005fb8)(group n of g_DebrisGroups (000bc1c0), point, g_DebrisShapes (000bc1c6)), n 0 stopped, 1 same band, 2 changed. Returns the entry distance. ES2's Mech_DirectFireHitTest (DBSIM 00418ba8) with Mech_ApplyDirectFireDamage (DBSIM 004188c8).

entries.name: Mech_SalvageValue
entries.description: (machine), callee-cleaned: 0 when the byte +0xad is set. Otherwise, for each hardpoint of the list at +0x198 (pointer array at +0, int16 count at +4) whose reading Component_ReadDamagePercent(+0x19c, 0x13 + the byte +0x17 of the hardpoint's +0x18) is below 0x80, passes the pair {the int16 +0x56 of the hardpoint's +0x1c, ((0x100 - reading) * 100) >> 8} to Salvage_QueueWeapon; then returns Math_Q10Multiply(Mech_WeightedArmorRemaining(+0x19c), the type record's (+0x188) int16 +0x54), that second value halved when component 0 reads 0x100. ES2's Mech_SalvageValue (DBSIM 00418e60) with the machine's fields 0x6a lower from the type record on.

entries.name: Mech_IntegrateMotion
entries.description: (machine), callee-cleaned: AnimThread_SetPlaybackRate (000626c8)(the locomotion thread +0x1c0, the rate +0x236), then SimObject_ApplyRootMotionIfEnabled (0000215c)(machine, Math_IntegrateRateOverTick (00063fa4)(100)). es2_xref finds three calls: Mech_MovementTick (00014844) twice and Mech_BehaviourRamTick (00018278). ES2's Mech_IntegrateMotion (DBSIM 00418f40).

entries.name: Mech_CollisionTest
entries.description: (machine), callee-cleaned: 1 when a move is refused. For each live object but itself whose group holds no action (+0x16) and whose slot +0x60 is non-zero, nearer than that radius and the machine's together: the object's slot +0x6c, and for a HERC (class +0x162 0) the collision damage: Math_Q10Multiply (0005e818)(Q10(own speed +0x224, own mass +0x4e) cut to an int16 - Q10(the other's speed resolved onto this machine's forward axis, other mass), 300), an int32, above 200 goes to Mech_ApplyExplosiveDamage (00013a7c) on both, which reads it as an int16, radius 1200, at the midpoint in X and Y and the lower Z of the two camera nodes (type record +0xc); returns 1. Then 1 when Structure_GatherWalkCandidates (0000375c)(radius, position) answers non-zero, and otherwise Zone_WalkCollisionTest (00020860)(radius, position)'s answer. es2_xref finds three calls: Mech_MovementTick (00014844) twice and Mech_BehaviourRamTick (00018278). ES2's Mech_CollisionTest (DBSIM 00418f74), which also records the structure a machine stands in and refuses or slides on steep ground.

entries.name: Mech_PlaceLegsOnGround
entries.description: (machine), callee-cleaned: for each shadow at +0x1cc (count +0x1d0) still held, a null slot passed over with the record's bytes advancing and the footfall latch not, the translation of the node of the part the type record's byte +0x77 + i names (shape slot +0x24) through the machine's frame becomes its position +0x20, the heading its +0xa, and +0x2c is cleared; a part the lookup answers 0 for is read at address 0x14. For the player's machine (+0x9d) the footfall tests follow, ES2's on the step latches +0x24a and on and the record's +0x98 and +0xac thresholds, playing Sound_PlayAt (0004deb8)(machine + 0x20, 0x1d) on a plant; and while the death sequence +0x46 plays, a kind-2 entry plays 0x1f once, latched on +0x24e, when its point's world Z falls below the record's +0x9e. es2_xref finds two calls: Mech_MovementTick (00014844) and Mech_BehaviourRamTick (00018278). ES2's Mech_PlaceLegsOnGround (DBSIM 004195c8), which tests the thread and the part, tests machines within 15000 of the camera too, plays only within 15000, kicks the cockpit, and sets no sound for the death arm.

entries.name: Mech_MovementTick
entries.description: (machine), callee-cleaned: SimObject_PushTransform (00002184)(machine), Mech_IntegrateMotion (00014148), and when Mech_CollisionTest (00014174) refuses: SimObject_PopTransform (00002248)(machine); a machine other than the player's gets the unstick counter +0x204 = 20000, +0x1e8 = 5000 or -5000 by Math_RandomNext (00063af4)(000b5bd4) bit 0 and +0xa8 = speed above 0, the player's Sound_Play (0004de84)(0x29); the throttle +0x226 zeroed and +0x8d set; outside a transition frame (thread +0x50 bit 2 clear) the speed becomes -speed clamped to [type record +0x6e, +6], the rate +0x236 negated, and a second refused integrate restores again and zeroes the speed; inside one, AnimThread_SetSequence (0006200c)(thread, 0, 0, the record's +0x12). Then Mech_PlaceLegsOnGround (000144dc); returns 1. es2_xref finds 17 stored pointers, the move of Behaviour_BuildStateTable's states. ES2's Mech_MovementTick (DBSIM 0041a360), which also takes the ground height, slides the player and unsticks for 10000.

entries.name: Mech_TorsoTwistTick
entries.description: (machine, axis), callee-cleaned: target = Math_Q8Multiply (0005e7f8)(type record +0x1e, axis); the rate +0x22a moves toward it by Math_RateLimitedMoveToward (0005e598) at Math_IntegrateRateOverTick (00063fa4)(+0x20) while |rate| is under |target|, otherwise takes it; the twist +0x22e adds Math_IntegrateRateOverTick(mean of the rates), clamped to +/- the record's +0x22; the thread +0x1c4 is seeked to (unsigned)twist >> 2 of sequence +0x1c with AnimThread_SeekToPosition (000620c4); then Mech_TorsoTwistServoSound (00014afc) through its padding entry 00014afa for the player's machine (+0x9d). es2_xref finds three calls, from Mech_CenterTorsoTick (000186f8), Cockpit_TargetAnglesFromCameraBone (00018b78) and Sim_PollPlayerInput (0005a0c0). ES2's Mech_TorsoTwistTick (DBSIM 0041a550), which also takes a snap target and flag.

entries.name: Mech_TorsoTwistServoSound
entries.description: (machine, axis), callee-cleaned: with TwistServo_Latch (00091c54) clear, |axis| above 0xc0 and the twist +0x22e not TwistServo_LastAngle (00091c56), plays Sound_Play (0004de84)(0x21) and sets the latch when Sound_IsPlaying (0004e05c)(0x21) answers 0; with the latch set and the axis 0 or the twist unchanged, Sound_Stop (0004df70)(0x21) and clears it; then stores the twist in the last angle. es2_xref finds one call, from Mech_TorsoTwistTick (000149ac) through 00014afa. ES2's Mech_TorsoTwistServoSoundTest (DBSIM 0041a6d0), which only sets and clears its byte.

entries.name: Mech_TorsoPitchTick
entries.description: (machine, range, axis) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the steps of Mech_TorsoTwistTick (000149ac) on the pitch rate +0x22c and pitch +0x230 with the type record's +0x26 and +0x28, clamped to [+0x2c, +0x2a], seeking the thread +0x1c8 in sequence +0x24; then gun convergence for each mount: range 0 zeroes the dword +0x24 and bytes +0x28 and +0x29, otherwise Math_EulerToward (00063d2c) from WeaponMount_MuzzleOffset (0000b918) less the record's +0x66 in Z to (0, range, 0) fills them; then Mech_TorsoPitchServoSound (00014dc4) for the player's machine (+0x9d). es2_xref finds three calls, from Mech_CenterTorsoTick (000186f8), Cockpit_TargetAnglesFromCameraBone (00018b78) and Sim_PollPlayerInput (0005a0c0). Timer_CountDown (00064178) on +0x208, +0x20d and +0x212 (expiry zeroes +0x217), Math_CountdownTimerTick (0006410c) on +0x200 and +0x21b (expiry: 4000 and +0x21e zeroed); Mech_ComputeCombatRating (000189f0)(machine) while +0x8e is clear. The five lock flags at the manager's +6 and +0x95 cleared, WeaponMounts_RoundsByMissileType (0000be6c); with a target: the ECM roll on +0x1fd against a jamming HERC (& 0xfff < 0x334: +0x96 and 5000, else 1500), the reload min(distance >> 2, 0x7fff), and unless +0x97 is set or the twist-adjusted bearing (Math_HeadingToward (00063cc8)) is outside +/-0x3000, ES2's countdowns +0x1ee, +0x1fa, +0x1f1, +0x1f4 set the flags; otherwise the first three reload and +0x97 clears at the end. For the player's machine, +0x95 from the armed mount's subtype (slot +0x64) and Mech_LockTonePlay (0001552c). es2_xref finds one call, from Sim_MainTick (00059700). ES2's Mech_PerTickSystemsUpdate (DBSIM 0041aa5c), with the spawn reactor rate, 500 held back, a line-of-sight test and the Targeting Pod's weight.
