entries.name: Mech_ComponentNearestAim
entries.description: (machine, pose), callee-cleaned, slot +0x58 of MechVtable (00091ae6) by its padding 00015883: for each of the 28 components whose occupancy flag (an int16 of the array at +0x1a4) is set, placed through slot +0x5c, Math_EulerToward (00063d2c) from the pose's +0x1a to it less the pose's euler triple as int16; returns in AX the index with the least sum of the absolutes of elements 0 and 1 (-0x8000 counted as 0x7fff), the first of equals kept, or -1, element 2 less the heading being computed and left unused. Math_EulerToward's element 1 is always 0, so the sum is the pitch difference plus a term the same for every component, and the pick weighs the pitch alone. es2_xref also finds the address as a dword at 000035f4, 0003fa4d and 0005a308. ES2's Mech_ComponentNearestAim (DBSIM 0041b534), which sums elements 0 and 2, the pitch and the heading, over 29.

ES2's Mech_ComponentPosition (DBSIM 0041b60c), which answers the machine's position for a null point.

Otherwise, over g_MechPool (000af68c), g_FlyerPool (000af72c) and g_BasePool (000aed70) by Pool_Prev (00063a20), each object neither disarmed (+0x9f), immobilised (+0x9e) nor destroyed (+0x93), whose group holds no action (+0x16), within 45000, 50000 or 35000 by Math_DistanceBetweenPoints (00063c20), and for a base whose type record's +0x34 is non-zero, adds the HERC's record +0x54 or 500 to the friendly or the hostile sum by the group side byte +0x14. The friendly sum loses 600, floored at 0; while it is under the hostile one, Mech_SpreadImpactDamage (00013078)(machine, 0x40, 0x40) and the hostile one loses 400. es2_xref finds two calls: Group_ApplyOutnumberedDamage (0001d4d0) and Mech_HandleCommand (00011050) through 00015a5a. ES2's Mech_ApplyOutnumberedDamage (DBSIM 0041b804).

entries.description: (machine), callee-cleaned, the think of the player state; returns 0, doing nothing for a machine that is not entry 0 of its group's (+0x3f) member array +0xe. The waypoint arm: Route_WaypointAt (0001cfb8)(group + 6, the cursor + 1) within 10000 by Math_DistanceBetweenPoints2D (00063c64) with Route_NextWaypointClosesRoute (0001c908) answering 0: Computer_PostMessage (0001a154)(0) and Route_AdvanceCursor (0001c8c0). Then by script.dat header word 3 (000bc4a2): 0, with MissionTarget_Announced (000af70c) 0, the target +0x15e set and Group_IsOrderTarget (0001ce3c)(group, target) non-zero, sets the latch to 1, posts 5 and sets +0x99; 5 sets +0x99 within 40000 of Mech_AiGoalPosition (000179a0); 3, while DataLink_Step (000af700) is not 4, runs the data link on s = Group_OrderTargetObject (0001cda0)(group), used without a test for 0. While s's byte +0x93 is clear, its group's action +0x16 is 0, s is within 10000 by Math_DistanceBetweenPoints (00063c20), and the int16 Math_HeadingToward (00063cc8) from the machine's +0x20 to s's less the heading +0xa, sign-extended, plus the twist +0x22e and 0x2000, unwrapped and compared unsigned, is below 0x4000: it returns while Timer_CountDown (00064178)(DataLink_Timer (000af704)) answers non-zero, and otherwise reloads the counter 000af705 from DataLink_StepDelays (00091ce8)[step], posts 0x1d + the step, adds 1 to the step and at 4 sets +0x9a. Otherwise it posts 0x21 and zeroes the step when the step is not 0, and zeroes the counter 000af705 whatever the step. ES2's Mech_BehaviourPlayerThink (DBSIM 0041c194), whose messages are 0x1d, 0x19, 0x34 and 0x38 and which gives selector 7 the data link too.

ES2's Mech_BehaviourAttackThink (DBSIM 0041c594).

Ends with Ai_CombatMoveStep (00018618) on the block. ES2's Ai_CircleStep (DBSIM 0041c72c), which makes no move step itself.

ES2's Mech_BehaviourAttackBaseThink (DBSIM 0041c86c), which holds a target the mission names until destroyed.

ES2's Mech_BehaviourAttackFlyerThink (DBSIM 0041c9cc), which also advances and gives up past 150000.

entries.name: Mech_CompareCombatRating
entries.description: (machine, candidate), callee-cleaned, slot +0x50 of MechVtable (00091ae6): for a candidate of class (+0x162) 0, each rating +0x234 plus Math_RandomNext & 1000; 1 when they differ by under 400, 2 when the candidate's is the higher, 0 otherwise; 0 for any other class. ES2's Mech_CompareCombatRating (DBSIM 0041cabc).

entries.description: (machine), callee-cleaned: the sum of the ratings +0x234 of every HERC in g_MechPool (000af68c), walked with Pool_Prev, whose target +0x15e is the machine. ES2's Ai_SumAttackerRatings (DBSIM 0041cb44).

entries.name: Mech_AiFleeCheck
entries.description: (machine), callee-cleaned: a machine disarmed, immobilized or destroyed goes to Mech_AiSelectBehaviour (0001892c) when its target is of class 1 with type record +0x34 at 0, and to fleeing otherwise, returning 1. Otherwise the fear is the overall damage (slot +0x44) plus a band's penalty from AiFlee_BandPenalties (00091d04) for each band of AiFlee_BandThresholds (00091d0c) some internal of AiFlee_InternalComponents (00091cf8) passes; fear 71 and up writes +0x240 = 1000 and flees for any holder (+0x15c); 51-70 writes 600 and flees for 3 or more holders, or 1-2 whose Ai_SumAttackerRatings (00016a14) beats the rating +0x234; 31-50 writes 300 and flees for 3 or more holders whose average beats it. Returns whether it installed fleeing. ES2's Mech_AiFleeCheck (DBSIM 0041cb94), which tests classes 1 and 3 and BASES.DAT +0x2e.

entries.name: Mech_AiSelectAimComponent
entries.description: (machine), callee-cleaned: writes the aim slot +0x238: the target +0x15e read with no null or class test; slot 0 alone when the target is collapsed (+0xae); otherwise Math_RandomNext & 0x7f under 0x28 takes slots 7-18, under 0x50 slots 19 to 18 + this machine's mount count (+0x198's +4), and the rest slots 0-6. Of the slots the target's occupancy array (+0x1a4) still has, it keeps the highest Component_ReadDamagePercent (0000a16c) of this machine's own +0x19c plus Math_RandomNext & 0x3f above 0, or -1. ES2's Mech_AiSelectAimComponent (DBSIM 0041ce08), which adds the Targeting Pod term.

entries.name: Mech_AiCombatReassess
entries.description: (machine), callee-cleaned, the reassess of the combat states and fleeing: the radar +0x90 on unless the radar silence +0x201 runs, or off for a squadmate of the player without +0xac; with +0xa6 clear, squad verbs 0-2 take Ai_SelectTarget (0000ddf4)(machine, 1) unless the machine is committed (descriptor +9) under verb 1 or verb 0 with its group's word +4 at 11, and higher verbs replace a destroyed target with Ai_SelectTarget(machine, 0); no target runs Mech_AiSelectBehaviour (0001892c) and returns. With +0xa6 set it clears it. The group's first member runs Mech_AiEnterCombat (000174cc) on each other member neither immobilized, destroyed nor committed. Then +0x238 = -1 and Mech_AiFleeCheck (00016a74); unless it decided, class 1 installs attacking base, class 2 attacking flyer, and any other runs the flee check again, which answers as the first did (were it to answer non-zero, Behaviour_SetState (0000fdfc) would take the stack dword [EBP-0x44], unwritten on that path), and Mech_CompareCombatRating (slot +0x50): 0 facing off, 1 attacking, 2 flanking, then Mech_AiSelectAimComponent (00016cf4). Returns 0. ES2's Mech_AiCombatReassess (DBSIM 0041cf18), which gates flanking on speed and legs and installs a squad order's target.

entries.name: Mech_BehaviourFleeThink
entries.description: (machine), callee-cleaned, the think of fleeing: with a target, stashes it at +0x5b, releases it and clears the squad verb +0x1d2; Ai_BuildCombatGeometry (0001851c) against the stash; under 0x3000 of bearing error approach -1 and the error less 0x8000, otherwise on Timer_CountDown (00064178) of +0x54 at 0 the countdown 4000 and the side +0x59 = Math_RandomNext & 1, approach 1 and the error +/-0x6000; standoffs 0 and 10000000; Ai_CombatMoveStep (00018618), Ai_AimAndFire (00018894)(machine, stash, aspect). Returns 1 when the machine or the stash is disarmed, immobilized or destroyed, else 0. ES2's Mech_BehaviourFleeThink (DBSIM 0041d2c4), which engages the Turbo Pod and returns 1 for the stash alone.

ES2's Mech_BehaviourFaceOffThink (DBSIM 0041d41c).

ES2's Mech_BehaviourFlankThink (DBSIM 0041d4e4).

entries.description: (machine), callee-cleaned, the think of search destroy: Ai_NavigationStep (00017478), releases the target, returns 0 for any but the group's first member; on Math_CountdownTimerTick of +0x54 at 0 sets the countdown +0x55 to 10000, then a machine disarmed, immobilized or destroyed takes Ai_SelectTarget (0000ddf4)(machine, 0) and, with one, +0x238 = -1 and fleeing; any other takes Ai_SelectTarget(machine, 1) and, when Group_IsOrderTarget (0001ce3c) passes it, installs it, sets +0xa6 and runs Mech_AiEnterCombat (000174cc). Returns 0. ES2's Mech_BehaviourSearchDestroyThink (DBSIM 0041d60c), whose gate also passes FIRE AT WILL.

entries.name: Mech_BehaviourPatrolThink
entries.description: (machine), callee-cleaned, the think of patrolling: samples the squad verb +0x1d2, Ai_NavigationStep (00017478), releases the target, returns 0 for a machine that is neither its group's first member nor under a squad verb; on Math_CountdownTimerTick of +0x54 at 0 sets +0x55 to 10000, then a machine disarmed, immobilized or destroyed takes Ai_SelectTarget (0000ddf4)(machine, 0) and with one +0x238 = -1 and fleeing; any other, when its group's word +4 is 8 with no squad verb or the squad verb is 2, takes Ai_SelectTarget(machine, 1) and with one sets +0xa6 and runs Mech_AiEnterCombat (000174cc). Returns 0. ES2's Mech_BehaviourPatrolThink (DBSIM 0041d7d0), whose gate also passes FIRE AT WILL and whose patrol verb is 3.

entries.name: Mech_BehaviourTravelThink
entries.description: (machine), callee-cleaned, the think of travelling and bulldog travel: Ai_FollowRoute (00019604), releases the target; on Timer_CountDown (00064178) of +0x54 at 0, Ai_SelectTarget (0000ddf4)(machine, 0) into the look-at +0x59, the countdown 10000, and the radar +0x90 on with a look-at or +0x91 set, off otherwise; with a look-at, Ai_AimAndFire (00018894)(machine, look-at, its twist (slot +0x40) plus the bearing back from it less its heading). Returns 0. ES2's Mech_BehaviourTravelThink (DBSIM 0041d9cc).

entries.name: Mech_AiGoalPosition
entries.description: (machine), callee-cleaned: the position the machine holds: the squad order's point +0x1d4 for verb 6 (+0x1d2), the position (+0x20) of the object at +0x1e0 for verb 3 and of +0x1dc for verb 5, otherwise Group_OrderTargetPosition (0001cde0) of the group. ES2's Mech_AiGoalPosition (DBSIM 0041dbcc), which takes verb 6's object when set.

entries.name: Ai_LineOfSightBlocked
entries.description: (machine), callee-cleaned: 1 when Structure_RaycastShapes (000038b8)(the side byte +0x14 of the machine's group, sign-extended with CBW, 0, the target's position, the machine's, result) or Sim_RaycastShapes (00020b70)(0, the target's position, the machine's, result) answers non-zero (00017a67), otherwise 0 (00017a74). es2_xref finds one call, from Mech_BehaviourSkirtThink (00017aa4). ES2's Ai_LineOfSightBlocked (DBSIM 0041dc24), which lifts the ends to the aim nodes, ignores a hit on the target and walks the terrain.

entries.name: Mech_AiOnLineOfFireBlocked
entries.description: (machine, object), callee-cleaned, slot +0x68 of MechVtable (00091ae6): stores the object at +0x246 and sets +0xa7. Sim_RaycastObjectList (0001f1d0) passes the blocker's +6. ES2's Mech_AiOnLineOfFireBlocked (DBSIM 0041dd2c), which copies the target's position.

entries.name: Mech_BehaviourSkirtThink
entries.description: (machine), callee-cleaned, the think of skirting, the blocker's position at +0x246 + 0x1a, the blocker an object or a zone shape: on the first tick (+0x58 clear) +0x5a = the bearing to the blocker less the heading is negative, +0x58 set, the countdown +0x5d = 5000, stepped on that same tick; when Timer_CountDown (00064178) of +0x5c reaches 0 it is set to 5000 again and, when Ai_LineOfSightBlocked (00017a00) answers 0, the descriptor stashed at +0x54 is installed and +0xa7 cleared. Every tick it walks at 0x100 toward the point +0x61 from the blocker at the bearing from the blocker to the machine +/-0x4000 (Math_OffsetPointByBearing (00063d8c)), Mech_LocomotionTick (00012038)(machine, 0, 0x100, the bearing error >> 4), and runs Mech_CenterTorsoTick (000186f8)(machine, 0); on the tick the stashed descriptor is installed it does this over the zeroed scratch, range 0 and side +, steering at the blocker itself. Returns 0. ES2's Mech_BehaviourSkirtThink (DBSIM 0041dd64).

entries.name: Ai_BeginSkirtIfBlocked
entries.description: (machine), callee-cleaned: with +0xa7 set, installs skirting, stores the old descriptor at +0x54 and Math_DistanceBetweenPoints from the target +0x15e to the machine at +0x61, and returns 1; otherwise 0. ES2's Ai_BeginSkirtIfBlocked (DBSIM 0041de9c), which measures to the blocked point.

entries.name: Mech_BehaviourDriveOffThink
entries.description: (machine), callee-cleaned, the think of driving off en: with g = Mech_AiGoalPosition (000179a0) and t the target, the ground distances g-t and g-machine; Ai_BeginSkirtIfBlocked (00017bf8); the point p, Z 0, min(g-t / 2, 50000) from g toward t (Math_OffsetPointByBearing (00063d8c)). When g-t is at most that and the bearing errors to p and t differ by 0x1000 or more or g-t is at most g-machine, it returns Mech_BehaviourFaceOffThink (000172f0). Otherwise within 5000 of p Mech_LocomotionTick (00012038)(machine, 0, 0, the error to t >> 4), else at p at 0x100 within 0x2000 of the nose and -0x100 beyond; +0x240 = 750; Ai_AimAndFire (00018894)(machine, 0, the hand-built aspect); with Ai_ShouldAbandonTarget (000162b4) or the machine disarmed, immobilized or destroyed, +0x1dc = 0 and 1, else 0. ES2's Mech_BehaviourDriveOffThink (DBSIM 0041def0) returns the face off think's answer.

entries.name: Mech_BehaviourGuardThink
entries.description: (machine), callee-cleaned, the think of guarding: post = Mech_AiGoalPosition (000179a0); releases the target; while Math_CountdownTimerTick of +0x54 runs, or for a machine with no squad verb whose group's first member is PlayerMech (000bc42a), Ai_NavigationStep (00017478) and 0. Otherwise the squad order's target for verb 4 with one, the countdown left at 0, or, with +0x55 = 10000, the best of g_MechPool by Ai_IsTargetable (0000dce8)(machine, 0, candidate) that is not immobilized, scored (limit - ground distance to the post) / (holders + 1) with the alive tier ratcheting, limit 980000 or 945000 when the group's target +0x1c is set. None: Mech_CenterTorsoTick (000186f8), Ai_UpdateWeaponsFree (000161dc), Ai_DriveToPoint (00019580) beyond 20000, else the steer (int16)(bearing to the post - heading - 0x8000) >> 4, facing away from the post, at speed 0x100 under 10000 and 0 from 10000. One: installed; fleeing and +0x238 = -1 when the machine is disarmed, immobilized or destroyed, else driving off en, Mech_AiSelectAimComponent (00016cf4) and the radar +0x90 on unless a squadmate of the player without +0xac. Returns 0. ES2's Mech_BehaviourGuardThink (DBSIM 0041e224) with Ai_SelectDefenceTarget (DBSIM 0041e0e0).

entries.name: Mech_BehaviourRamTick
entries.description: (machine), callee-cleaned, the move of ramming: Mech_IntegrateMotion (00014148), Mech_PlaceLegsOnGround (000144dc), and when Mech_CollisionTest (00014174) answers non-zero or +0xab is set, Damage_ExplosiveBlastSweep (0001f75c)(2000, 3000, the machine's +0x20) and Mech_ComponentDamageWrite (00013250)(machine, machine, 32000, i) for each of the 28 components whose occupancy word at +0x1a4 is set. Returns 1. ES2's Mech_BehaviourRamTick (DBSIM 0041e488), which also sets the height from the terrain.

entries.name: Mech_BehaviourInertThink
entries.description: (machine), callee-cleaned, the think of dead and disabled: Mech_LocomotionTick (00012038)(machine, 0, 0, 0), returns 0. ES2's Mech_BehaviourInertThink (DBSIM 0041e554).

entries.name: Mech_BehaviourRamThink
entries.description: (machine), callee-cleaned, the think of ramming: on Timer_CountDown (00064178) of +0x54 at 0, Ai_SelectTarget (0000ddf4)(machine, 6), installed with the holder counts +0x15c and +0x97 set when it is not the target held, and +0x55 = 10000 as a dword; with no target Mech_LocomotionTick (00012038)(machine, 1, 0, 0); with one it steers at it at 0x100 with avoidance 1 and the bearing error >> 4; approaching (+0x59 clear), Math_CountdownTimerTick of +0x5b at 0 sets +0x59 and +0x5c = 3000 + Math_RandomBelow(1500); charging, Mech_BehaviourRamTick (00018278) and the steer twice more, then at the countdown's end +0x59 cleared and +0x5c = 8000 + Math_RandomBelow(4000). A detonation in the first Mech_BehaviourRamTick does not end the charge: the second can detonate again, and the countdown writes land in the scratch of the state the damage write installed. Returns 0. ES2's Mech_BehaviourRamThink (DBSIM 0041e570), which steers at >> 8 and tests the target between the charge's steps.

entries.name: Ai_BuildCombatGeometry
entries.description: (machine, target, block), callee-cleaned, the target 0 meaning +0x15e: the bearing to the target, the error from the heading +0xa and its magnitude, the aspect (the target's twist through slot +0x40 plus the bearing less 0x8000 less the target's heading) and its magnitude, the 3D range, approach 0, standoffs 15000 and 30000. ES2's Ai_BuildCombatGeometry (DBSIM 0041e758).

entries.name: Ai_CombatMoveStep
entries.description: (machine, block), callee-cleaned: under the near standoff the approach is 1 when the bearing error's magnitude is 0x4000 or more and -1 otherwise, over the far standoff 1 at 0x4000 or less and -1 otherwise; the magnitude is then recomputed; a non-zero approach is written to +0x54 and gives speed +/-0x100; Mech_LocomotionTick (00012038)(machine, 0, speed, bearing error >> 4). ES2's Ai_CombatMoveStep (DBSIM 0041e828).

entries.name: Mech_CenterTorsoTick
entries.description: (machine, range), callee-cleaned: Mech_TorsoTwistTick (000149ac)(machine, -clamp(Q10(250, twist +0x22e), +/-0x100)) and Mech_TorsoPitchTick (00014ba0)(machine, range, -clamp(Q10(250, pitch +0x230), +/-0x100)). ES2's Mech_CenterTorsoTick (DBSIM 0041e8d4), which also enables the snap.

entries.name: Ai_AimAndFireAtMech
entries.description: (machine, target, aspect), callee-cleaned: when the bearing error to the target plus the type record's twist limit +0x22 is below twice the limit, both compared as unsigned int16 values, the point is the target's component +0x238 through its slot +0x5c when that is not negative and the 3D range is 5000 to 19999, otherwise the translation of its slot +0x28 transform applied with its frame (Context_GetTransform); then Ai_FireAtPoint (000190ec)(machine, target, aspect, point). Beyond the limit, Mech_CenterTorsoTick (000186f8)(machine, 0). ES2's Ai_AimAndFireAtMech (DBSIM 0041e984).

entries.name: Ai_AimAndFire
entries.description: (machine, target, aspect), callee-cleaned, the target 0 meaning +0x15e: a target of class (+0x162) 0 goes to Ai_AimAndFireAtMech (0001879c); any other is shot through Ai_FireAtPoint (000190ec) at its position plus the offset triple its slot +0x34 fills. ES2's Ai_AimAndFire (DBSIM 0041ea7c), which aims at a structure's first surviving component.

entries.name: Mech_AiSelectBehaviour
entries.description: (machine), callee-cleaned: installs player for the player's machine (+0x9d); otherwise the state its group's word +4 names through Mech_AiSelectBehaviourVerbTable (00091d14): 1 search destroy, 3 ramming, 6 guarding, 7 and 8 patrolling, 10 sleeping, 11 travelling, or bulldog travel when the type record's +0x22 is over 0x7d00; any other word, 0, 2, 4, 5, 9 or one outside 0-11 by the unsigned test of the sign-extended word, installs the descriptor in EDI at entry. Then, when the target +0x15e is set, it takes 1 from that target's holders' count +0x15c, clears +0x15e and sets +0x97. It returns 1. ES2's Mech_AiSelectBehaviour (DBSIM 0041eb34), which also reads the standing squad order.

entries.name: Mech_ComputeCombatRating
entries.description: (machine), callee-cleaned: Mech_ReadDamageReadouts (0001583c) into a buffer, then the type record's +0x44, plus Q8(256 - reading, template +0x4e) for each mount i of +0x198 that is not null, whose reading (entry 32 + i) is not negative and whose slot +0x58 answers non-zero, the template being the mount's +0x1c, plus Q8(256 - reading, piece i's armor) for each of the 19 components whose reading (entry 1 + i) is not negative, the armor the first int16 of the 0x12-byte piece i in the array at +0 of the .DMG table the dword +0x1a8 points to, less the type record's +0x7e[i] for each of 10 systems reading over 0xb4; each Q8 the rounding Math_Q8Multiply (0005e7f8); shifted right 4 into +0x234, +0x8e set, the rating returned. es2_xref finds one call, from Mech_PerTickSystemsUpdate (00014ee0). ES2's Mech_ComputeCombatRating (DBSIM 0041edd8).

entries.name: Cockpit_TargetAnglesFromCameraBone
entries.description: (machine, point), callee-cleaned: sets TargetAngles_CalledOnce (000af710) on the first call. Slot +0x24 of the shape (the shape instance +0x2e's +4) with the type record's int16 +0xc gives the eye part, and the node's transform is the 32-byte entry at the instance's +0x16 + 0x20 x the part's int16 +4, copied from address 0 when the slot answers 0. The point goes through the machine's transform (Context_GetTransform (000016e8) of +6) and then the node's, each inverted with Transform_TransposeRotation (00063e05) and the negated translation through Transform_RotatePoint (0005ef74) and applied with Transform_ApplyToPoint (0005f58c); the record's +0x66 is subtracted from its Z, and Math_EulerToward (00063d2c)((0, 0, 0), point) goes into TargetAngles_Residual (000af714). The twist axis is Q8(-c, |-c|) with c = clamp(Q10(250, the yaw at +4), +/-0x100): the value is negated before the Math_Q8Multiply (0005e7f8), |-0x8000| taken as 0x7fff; the pitch axis is Q8(c, |c|) from the pitch at +0 the same way, unnegated, the Q10 through Math_Q10Multiply (0005e818). Then Mech_TorsoTwistTick (000149ac)(machine, twist axis) and Mech_TorsoPitchTick (00014ba0)(machine, Math_FastMagnitude3D (0006325a) of the point after the Z subtraction, pitch axis); returns the residual's address. ES2's Cockpit_TargetAnglesFromCameraBone (DBSIM 0041ef14), which damps small errors beyond 50000 and passes snap targets.

entries.name: Ai_ChooseWeapon
entries.description: (machine, target, range, aspect), callee-cleaned: the floor Math_MapRange (00065480)(fear +0x240, 0, 0x400, 150, -100); the shield from the target's slot +0x38 with the boolean -0x4000 <= aspect < 0x4000; jitter 35 for a class-0 target, 30 otherwise. Each mount of +0x198 whose slot +0x60 says it is unspent: a subtype (slot +0x64) 0 in range (WeaponMount_RangeAllows) puts the radar +0x90 on unless the silence +0x201 runs; one in range, of subtype 5 or 3 or with its lock flag at the manager's +6 up, and ready (slot +0x30), scores Q10(armor or shield damage of the projectile record +0x20, + 10000 when the shot breaks the shield, 100) - Q10(1000, template +0x34) + the product of two Math_RandomBelow (00063b3c)(jitter) draws, each Q10 the rounding Math_Q10Multiply (0005e818); a 32-bit score above the sign-extended best becomes the best, cut to an int16, and the best mount above the floor is returned. With every mount absent or spent and +0x9f clear: +0x9f set, Action_Activate (0001cc5c) of +0x170, MissionPollTimer_Count (000af79d) raised to 1000 when below it, a signed int16 compare. ES2's Ai_ChooseWeapon (DBSIM 0041f358).

entries.name: Ai_FireAtPoint
entries.description: (machine, target, aspect, point), callee-cleaned: range = Math_DistanceBetweenPoints2D to the point; the latched mount +0x242 while ready (slot +0x30) and in range, else with +0xaf set none (clearing it), else Ai_ChooseWeapon (00018e50) and the latch cleared. None: Cockpit_TargetAnglesFromCameraBone (00018b78) at the point. One: with the projectile speed (record +0x20, +0xa) above 0 and the target's speed (slot +0x3c) not 0, the point led along the target's heading (Math_OffsetPointByBearing (00063d8c)) by (int16)((int16)(range >> 2) x (speed x 4) / the projectile speed), the multiply and the signed divide in 32 bits; for a group side byte +0x14 not 0, scattered by three Math_RandomBelow (00063b3c) draws, added to x, y and z in that order, of AiAimScatterByDifficulty (00091ce0) at header word 7 (000bc4aa), or 3 while MissionModeFlag (000bc4a0) is set; aimed; fired through slot +0x2c (mount, 0, machine) when its subtype (slot +0x64) is not 5, that is a missile launcher, or when both residual angles lie in [-1000, 1000); latched when template +0x56 is 3. ES2's Ai_FireAtPoint (DBSIM 0041f5a0), which latches weapons 6 and 22.

entries.name: Mech_AiFriendlyFireComplaint
entries.description: (machine), callee-cleaned: when the countdown +0x20e is 0, sets it to 40000 and posts Ai_PostSquadMessage (0001a188)(machine, 0, 8). es2_xref finds two calls, from Mech_AiOnTakingFire (00019338) and Sim_RaycastObjectList (0001f1d0). ES2's Mech_AiFriendlyFireComplaint (DBSIM 0041f790).

entries.name: Mech_AiOnTakingFire
entries.description: (machine, damage, attacker), callee-cleaned, slot +0x54 of MechVtable (00091ae6): Mech_AiFriendlyFireComplaint (00019300) when the attacker is PlayerMech (000bc42a) in the machine's group; returns for an attacker of its own side (group +0x14); Mech_ShareContact (0000d760), +0x213 = 30000; in the player's group +0x217 accumulates the damage, read as an int16 (000193b7), and it returns under 8000; returns for the player's machine (+0x9d), while +0x209 runs, or for the committed machine's own target; +0x209 = 10000 (0001943a), before the tests on the descriptor's (+0x47) bytes +9, +0xa and +0xb. Not committed (byte +9 clear) under a player-led group: squad message 3 for a class-0 attacker and +0x94 cleared when the leader's target is the attacker. Byte +0xa: in a player-led group squad verb +0x1d2 = 4 with +0x1dc = 0, and the dwell +0x4c = 0. Byte +0xb: nothing. Otherwise Ai_SelectTarget (0000ddf4)(machine, 0), installed with the holder counts +0x15c and +0x97 set when it is not the target held; none, after one, runs Mech_AiSelectBehaviour (0001892c); one sets +0xa6 and runs Mech_AiEnterCombat (000174cc). ES2's Mech_AiOnTakingFire (DBSIM 0041f7b8).

entries.name: Ai_DriveToPoint
entries.description: (machine, point), callee-cleaned: Mech_LocomotionTick (00012038)(machine, 0, the cruise speed +0x1e6 or 0xaa when it is 0, the bearing error >> 4), returning whether Math_DistanceBetweenPoints2D to the point is under 10000. ES2's Ai_DriveToPoint (DBSIM 0041fac4), which also sprints with the Turbo Pod.

entries.name: Ai_FollowRoute
entries.description: (machine), callee-cleaned: Route_WaypointAt (0001cfb8) of the waypoint after the group's cursor (+6); with none Mech_LocomotionTick (00012038)(machine, 0, 0, 0), otherwise Ai_DriveToPoint (00019580) and, when it arrives, Route_AdvanceCursor (0001c8c0). ES2's Ai_FollowRoute (DBSIM 0041fb60).

entries.name: Ai_KeepFormation
entries.description: (machine), callee-cleaned: the post is the group's first member's position moved by Mech_ApplyFormationOffset (00012ed0); under 2000 from it, turn (-(heading - the leader's)) >> 4, negated before the shift, at speed 0; at or under 25000 with the leader's speed +0x224 outside [-25, 24], under 0x2000 of heading difference the turn -((difference >> 4) + (-lateral >> 5)) and speed the low 16 bits of the leader's + (-longitudinal >> 5), the offset in the leader's frame (Math_TransposeRotation2D, Math_Rotate2DPoint), and otherwise -0x100 with the turn +/-0x100; beyond, the bearing error >> 4 at dist >> 7 below 25000, or 0x100 from 25000. ES2's Ai_KeepFormation (DBSIM 0041fbb8).

entries.name: MechAi_StaticInitNoOp
entries.description: Frameless: RET. The static constructor table's entry 000adc00. ES2's MechAi_StaticInitNoOp (DBSIM 0041fdac).

entries.name: HeapPtr_DtorMechSysCopy
entries.description: (p, flags), callee-cleaned: byte for byte the code of HeapPtr_DtorGunlistCopy (0000baf0), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: ConfigPart_DtorMechSysCopy
entries.description: (part, flags), callee-cleaned: slot +0x1c of the vtable 00091d46: byte for byte the code of ConfigPart_DtorMountsCopy (0000a798), relocated operands aside, storing 00091d46 and 00091d7a where that stores 00090f0e and 00090eda.

entries.name: ConfigPart_GetClassTagMechSysCopy
entries.description: Frameless: a NOP, then XOR EAX,EAX and RET 4: returns 0. Slot +4 of the vtable 00091d46; the code of ConfigPart_GetClassTagMountsCopy (0000a78e).

entries.name: TSPartBase_DtorMechSysCopy
entries.description: (part, flags), callee-cleaned: slot +0x1c of the vtable 00091d7a (entered at its padding 000198c1): byte for byte the code of TSPartBase_Dtor (0005d614), relocated operands aside, storing 00091d7a where that stores 000974aa. ES2's TSPartBase_Dtor (DBSIM 0049224b).

entries.name: Mech_LoadResources
entries.description: No arguments: sets the 16-byte slot map g_MechTypeSlotIndex (000bc430) to 0xff and the slot count g_MechTypeCount (000bc42e) to 0; reads dat\mforms (asserting at severity 5, mechsys.cpp line 0x30, when the stream status is set): an int16 count to 000bc448 and that many 0x1c-byte records, constructed by MechFormation_ElementCtor (000199e4), to the pointer at 000bc44a; then, when g_LowMemory (000bda98) is 0, loads dba\light, medium, heavy and enemy (the name table 00091de4) with ClassItem_LoadFromFile into the four dwords at g_MechTextureGroupSlots (000bc450). ES2's Mech_LoadResources (DBSIM 0041fdb0), whose slot map is 0x55 bytes and which packs seven banks into atlases.

entries.name: MechFormation_ElementCtor
entries.description: (formation), callee-cleaned: allocates 0x1c bytes when formation is null, then __vec_ctor over its seven 4-byte slots with MechFormation_SlotCtor (00019a14) (passed as the padding entry 00019a12); returns formation. Mech_LoadResources passes it as 000199e3. ES2's MechFormation_ElementCtor (DBSIM 004207bb).

entries.name: MechFormation_SlotCtor
entries.description: (slot), callee-cleaned: allocates 4 bytes when slot is null and returns it, storing nothing; the element constructor MechFormation_ElementCtor runs over a formation's seven slots, where ES2's passes Rtl_ReturnArgCopy.

entries.name: MechTypeSlot_GetIndex
entries.description: (type), callee-cleaned: returns the byte for type in the slot map g_MechTypeSlotIndex (000bc430), 0xff when the type has no slot. ES2's maybe_MechTypeSlot_GetIndex (DBSIM 0041ff00).

entries.name: MechTypeSlot_Allocate
entries.description: (type), callee-cleaned: when MechTypeSlot_GetIndex(type) is 0xff, stores the slot count g_MechTypeCount (000bc42e) in the type's map byte, increments the count and takes GunLayout_Reserve(1), keeping its result in 000bc44e when the count has become 1; then, every call, CollisionTable_Reserve(1) and DmgTable_Reserve(1). One caller found by es2_xref, in DBSim_LoadScriptDat (0001d850). ES2's maybe_MechTypeSlot_Allocate (DBSIM 0041ff10).

entries.name: Shape_RemapTransformId
entries.description: (map, id), callee-cleaned: when the int16 at id is not negative, replaces it with the signed byte map[*id]. ES2's Shape_RemapTransformId (DBSIM 0041ff68).

entries.name: Shape_RemapTransformIds
entries.description: (nodeCount, map, part) in stack order, its arguments removed by this function: ES2's Shape_RemapTransformIds (DBSIM 0041ff88), whose tag comes from vtable +0 and whose arguments are (part, map, nodeCount). Takes the part's class tag from its vtable +4, finds it among the ten tags at Shape_RemapTransformIdsTags (00091e14) with REPNE SCASD and jumps through the ten targets after them: 0x140005, 0x1e0005 and 0x140006 return; 0x140014 (TSGroup) passes (map, part+4) to Shape_RemapTransformId (00019aa0) and returns; 0x140015 (TSBSPPart) passes each int16 of the array +0x1c (count +0x16) that is above 0, below nodeCount and maps to a byte above -1, then visits the children; 0x14000b (TSCellAnimPart) passes part+4, then visits the children; 0x1e0003, 0x140008, 0x140007 and 0x14000c visit the children only, calling itself (entered at its padding 00019ac3) with nodeCount, map and each pointer of the array +0x12 (count +0x10); any other tag returns. The cases are jump targets inside the function, 00019aef-00019b93, ending at its RET 0xc.

entries.name: MechType_RemapDetailRootTransforms
entries.description: (partIds, detailSet) in stack order, callee-cleaned: with more than one root (int16 detailSet+0xc), fills a 400-byte stack table with 0xff; for each part id up to 50 or the first negative, finds the part in root 0 through the root's vtable +0x24 and, for each later root that has it, stores root 0's transform id (part+4) at that root's row [its own transform id]; then Shape_RemapTransformIds for each root after the first with its row and int16 +0x10 of root 0's +0x2a record. ES2's MechType_RemapDetailRootTransforms (DBSIM 00420090), whose find goes through vtable +0x20 and whose arguments are (detailSet, partIds).

entries.name: MechType_InitOne
entries.description: (type), callee-cleaned: loads one chassis into its slot's 0x1c4-byte record in g_MechTypeTable (000bc444). Reads 0xc0 bytes of dat\<name> (name from g_MechTypeNames (000bc440)) into +2 with Ovl_ReadFile, stores the slot at +0 and the type at +0x6c; Shape_LoadAllRoots(skip, 0x1e0003, dts\<name>, +0xc6), skip being int16 +0x48 when g_LowMemory (000bda98) is set and 0 otherwise; the count to +0xd2, g_ShapeDetailThresholds (00091dac) to +0xca and a __vec_new of count CONNECT_INFO_Ctor pairs to +0xce; MechType_RemapDetailRootTransforms(+0x30, +0xc6); GunLayout_LoadForMechType(slot + 000bc44e, gl\<name>) and GunLayout_CollectHardpointBones; per root MechType_BindHardpointSlots and root+0x26 = the dword at g_MechTextureGroupSlots (000bc450) + int16 +0x96 * 4; PaperDoll_Load(slot, name) to +0xc2. entries.name: Flyer_AttackRun
entries.description: (flyer), its argument removed by this function: the attack pass on the target +0x15e, its phase in +0x194. The error is Math_HeadingToward (00063cc8) from +0x20 to the target's +0x20 less the heading, the range Math_DistanceBetweenPoints2D (00063c64), the speeds each one's slot +0x3c, the range capped at 200000. The shot speed is the flyer's speed, and in phase 1 within 45000 Proj_LookupRecordByIndex (0000c2bc)(2)'s +0xa; with a positive shot speed and a non-zero target speed, Math_OffsetPointByBearing (00063d8c) moves the target point (int16)((int16)(capped range >> 3) * target speed * 8 / shot speed) along the target's heading and the error is taken again to the moved point, as are the elevations below; the range is not. Phase 0: the error + 0x8000, the word +0x54 = 0, phase 1 beyond 80000, Flyer_PitchToAltitude (0001b708)(flyer, 10000). Phase 1 within 45000: Flyer_PitchToAltitude(flyer, 0) with +0xa8 set, else Flyer_PitchCommand (0001b6c0)(flyer, Math_ElevationAngle (00063cf0)(+0x20, target point)); with the byte +0x1b7 clear it is set and (Math_RandomNext (00063af4)(000b5bd4) & 0xfff) >> 31, always 0, is tested for phase 2; then phase 0 and +0x1b7 cleared when the error is outside [-0x2000, 0x1fff] or the Z +0x28 below 0x157c. Phase 2 sets +0x1b2 by range, levels the wings through Flyer_ApplyFlightCommand (0001b794), pitches toward 0xec78, sets the heading rate to Math_Q8Multiply (0005e7f8)(error >> 4, the record's +0x10), moves the velocity's X +0x1c7 toward 500 and, when Timer_CountDown (00064178)(+0x1cd) answers 0, sets phase 3 and +0x8c = 0; phase 3 levels wings and pitch, brings the heading rate and X to 0 with Math_RateLimitedMoveToward (0005e598) and returns to phase 0 once X is 0. The shot, outside phase 0 within 45000, with the error and the pitch error (the elevation less +6) within [-1000, 999], the pitch rate +0x18a within [-10, 9] and Math_CountdownTimerTick (0006410c)(+0x1b4) at 0, each tested only when those before it pass, so the countdown steps only then: the muzzle (500, 200, -100) through Transform_ApplyToShortPoint (0005e858); with the word +0x54 clear within 30000, Rocket_Fire (00007748)(the dword at +0x1c9, flyer, angles +6, muzzle, 0) and the word +0x54 = 1, otherwise Bullet_Fire (00008134)(flyer, angles, muzzle, 2) twice, the second from the muzzle with X negated; the counter +0x1b5 = 1500. Below phase 2, +0x1b2 = 0xb4 and Flyer_SteerAndFly (0001b8c4)(flyer, 0, error). ES2's Flyer_AttackRun (DBSIM 004226a0), with phases 0 and 1, 90000, 65000, and its heights over the target's.

entries.description: (group, order) in stack order, callee-cleaned (RET 8): ES2's Squad_BroadcastOrder (DBSIM 004231a4) with ES1's offsets. Verbs 3, 6, 9-0xe and above 0xf leave the score word [EBP-0x2e] as the stack held it. A member scoring below the best is skipped; otherwise it becomes the choice when Math_DistanceBetweenPoints (00063c20)(issuer +0x20, member +0x20) is below the nearest or its score above the best. The choice gets the order through slot +0x2c of the table at its +2 with (member, the reply word pushed as a dword whose high word the function never writes, order); a non-zero AX makes the reply 2, a zero one makes a reply of 0 into 1, the member is marked told, and verbs 0 and 2 stop at a reply of 2. entries.description: (): the world load's second pass over the shell's handoff, building the mission's objects, ES2's DBSim_SpawnMissionObjects (DBSIM 004253d8) in role. Sets the word at Mission_StatusRaised (000bc49a) to 0xffff, reopens data\script (Path_WithExtension) and reads past the 20-byte header and blocks 1-5 into a 2000-byte stack buffer. Block 6 (98-byte mechs) and then the player.mec entries, between WeaponModels_LoadShapeChunks and WeaponModels_FreeShapeChunks: each live slot (000af7b4) gets Mech_Constructor (00011330)(null, type); a record gives the position from its point ref +0x3e, the point's Z plus the type record's (+0x188) int16 +0x16 with no ground query, or the sentinel at 000afa00 (0, 0, -1), and the rotation (0, 0, heading) from its heading ref +0x40 or the sentinel at 000afa10 (-0x8000, -0x8000, 0), into +0x20 and +6, zeroing the int16 +0x2c; then Mech_ConfigureLoadout(mech, +0x46, +0x2a) in stack order, +0x91 set when +0 is not 0, the action refs +0x5c and +0x5e as 16-byte action pointers into +0x16c and +0x170, +0x42 and +0x44 into +0x174 and +0x176, Mech_ApplyStartingCondition(mech, +0x60), and +2 into +0x1e6 when not negative. A player.mec entry (0x7e bytes from 000af9e4) takes both sentinels, Mech_ConfigureLoadout(mech, +0x20, +8), Mech_ApplySquadCondition(mech +0x19c, +0x6a, +0x56, +0x3c) and its +0 into +0x232; the one whose index is the word at 000af9fa is stored at PlayerMech (000bc42a) with +0x9d set to 1. Block 7 (56-byte flyers), each live slot (000af8e0): Flyer_Constructor(null, +0x2c), point ref +0x28 with no height added, heading ref +0x2a, actions +0x32 and +0x34, pair +0x2e and +0x30. Block 8 (16-byte bases), each live slot (000af948): Base_Construct(the slot's byte at 000af9b0, record), point ref +2, heading ref +4, actions +0xa and +0xc, pair +6 and +8. Block 9: one 82-byte record per element of MissionGroups (000bc476): member refs +0x34 remapped through the slot-to-pool map their kind +0x28 names (000af818, 000af914, 000af97c), the first record's replaced by the mech map's entries at block-6 count + k for each player.mec entry k and -1 after, and its +0x2c made 8 when 11; the target ref +0x48 remapped for target kinds 1-3; the heading from ref +0x30, or Math_HeadingToward (00063cc8) from the route's first waypoint to its second when it has two or more, else 0; then DBSim_BuildGroupRecord (0001cff4)(group, the point ref +0x2e's point, MissionGroups, heading, the action ref +0x4a's action, the route ref +0x32's waypoint group, record) in stack order. Closes the file. es2_xref finds one call, from Sim_StartMission (0005a9dc).

entries.name: Sim_RaycastObjectList
entries.description: (shot), callee-cleaned: ES2's Sim_RaycastObjectList (DBSIM 00426528) on ES1's fields, with a flat ground and the zone's shapes in place of ES2's terrain query. The shot record holds the ray record at +0 (frame pointer +0, length +4, the world-to-ray transform cached at +0xa), the damage figures at +4 and +6, an impact-effect table pointer at +0xa and the owner at +0xe. It caches the transform; when the ray's end has a negative Z it cuts the length where the ray crosses Z 0, to 0 when the start's Z is negative and otherwise to (Z << 14) / Math_CosBam(d - 0x4000), d the negated Math_ElevationAngle (00063cf0) from start to end, a strike that is no object; then RaycastShapeMinDistance_Clear (00020880), Zone_RaycastShapeObjects (00020b50)(ray, result), whose hit cuts the length and names the blocker, RaycastShapeMinDistance_Get (0002088c) into 000afa1c and the clear again. It walks LiveObjectList (000bc416, count LiveObjectList_Count (000bc41c)), skipping the owner and any object whose group's +0x16 is set; slot +0x24(object, shot) answers the hit distance. On a hit, an object whose group's side byte +0x14 differs from the owner's sets the owner's +0x98 to 1, has its +0x16c action passed to Action_Activate (0001cc5c) unless its +0x9c is set, and clears the blocker; one on the owner's side becomes the blocker. Unless the object is destroyed (+0x93), or of the other side with +0x9e or +0x9f set, it calls slot +0x54(object, the shot's dword +4, owner), after passing Group_NearestLiveMember (0001cea4)(owner's group, owner), when within 30000 of the owner, to Mech_AiFriendlyFireComplaint if the owner's +0x9d is set and the object is of its side in another group. The length becomes the hit distance and the walk goes on while that is 500 or more; RaycastShapeMinDistance_Get then goes to 000afa18. A strike with no object struck spawns Explosion_Construct (00005af0)(null, the ray's end with its Z raised to 0, the int16 at the effect table's +8 + 2 * (Math_RandomNext(000b5bd4) & 3)). With a blocker and the owner's +0x15e set, a Math_DistanceBetweenPoints2D from the ray's end to the owner below the Math_DistanceBetweenPoints from +0x15e to the owner and a bearing difference, each bearing less the owner's heading +0xa, below 0x2000 as a signed int16 call the owner's slot +0x68(owner, blocker +6). Returns the length + 1 after a strike, else 0. The owner is read with no null test. es2_xref finds three calls, from Rocket_TickUpdate (00007198), Bullet_TickUpdate (00007f84) and Bullet_FireBurst (000088cc).

entries.description: (theater, zone) in stack order, callee-cleaned, terrain.cpp: loads the shapes standing on a zone. Otherwise it builds dat\zone<zone> by ltoa (radix 10) over the XXXX of a copy of 'zoneXXXX' (000924b0) and ResourcePath_BuildFolderName, opens it with VolRStream_CtorFromPath (severity-5 assert, terrain.cpp line 0x32, when it fails), reads the word at +0 into a local it does not use again and the record count into Zone_ShapeCount. When the count is not 0 it allocates count pointers at Zone_ShapeObjects and for each 20-byte record reads a shape index (2 bytes), a position (12) and three angles (6), and builds a 0x3f-byte object: TSObj_Ctor(object, roots[index]) and the vptr 000924be at +2 (both skipped when Mem_New fails, the stores below not); the angles to +6 and the position to +0x20, the orientation block's angles and translation; 0 to +0x2c; at +0x3b the address of the index's 24-byte record, or 0 when that record's int32 at +8 is negative. entries.name: Sim_RaycastShapeVolume
entries.description: (count, objects, ray, result) in stack order, callee-cleaned: ES2's Sim_RaycastShapeVolume (DBSIM 00427da8) over a pointer array of count objects, with ES2's ray record (+0 frame pointer, +4 length, +8 int16 clearance, +0xa world-to-ray transform). On a hit the ray's +4 becomes the distance from the start to the hit point at out +4, result +0 that distance and result +4 the object, and the walk ends when the distance is below 500. Returns 1 in AX when anything was hit, otherwise 0. ES2's result takes the object's +0xc. es2_xref finds calls from Sim_RaycastShapeList (000037e0) (a stack array and its count), from Base_DirectFireHitTest (00003a58) (count 1) and from Zone_RaycastShapeObjects (00020b50); the five dwords it lists equal to the padding entry 00020893 are bytes of MOV [EBX+0x208] instructions.

entries.name: Label_SetRectAroundPoint
entries.description: (label, flags, text, point) in stack order, callee-cleaned: sizes the label's rect +4..+0x13 to the text around point {x, y}. With w = HudFont_MeasureString(font, text): flags & 2 gives x0 = x - w/2, x1 = x0 + w and anchor x +0x14 = x0 + (x1 - x0 + 1)/2; flags & 4 gives x1 = x, x0 = x - w + 1 and anchor x = x; otherwise x0 = x, x1 = x + w and anchor x = x. y0 = y - HudFont_CellHeight2 (00069d50)(font, text), y1 = y, anchor y +0x16 = y1 + y. Stores flags at +0x18 and returns label + 4. ES2's Label_SetRectAroundPoint (DBSIM 004387d0) takes half the cell height, adds the font's ink height to the anchor y and stores the flags at +0x19. No reference found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Label_SetRect
entries.description: (label, flags, rect, margin) in stack order, callee-cleaned: copies the rect {x0, y0, x1, y1} to +4..+0x10 and computes the text anchor. x (+0x14): flags & 2 centres it, (x1 - x0) / 2 + x0 + margin[0]; flags & 4 right-aligns it, x1 - margin[0] + 1; otherwise x0 + margin[0]. y (+0x16): (y1 - y0 + HudFont_CellHeight(font)) / 2 + y0 + margin[2], margin being int16s. Stores flags at +0x18 and returns label + 4. ES2's Label_SetRect (DBSIM 00438884) right-aligns at x1 - margin[0] and centres y on half the font's ink height (+0x16) plus 1.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 00031080, against ES2's Label_SetRect

entries.name: Label_SetText
entries.description: (label, text), callee-cleaned: draws text in the label. Sets the pen (Label_Pen (000b11bc), 000b11c0) to the anchor (+0x14, +0x16), moving x left by (w - 1) for flags & 4 or by (w - 1) / 2 for flags & 2, w being HudFont_MeasureString(font, text). When the fill colour +0x1c is non-zero it installs the brush {0, colour} at the current render context's +0x22c (the GL display's (000bdd28) +0x44 less 4), fills the label's rect with Raster_FillRect and puts the old brush back. Then HudFont_DrawString(font, text, pen). ES2's Label_SetText (DBSIM 00438920) measures the text for every alignment, subtracts 1 << VideoMode_XCoordShift rather than 1, and offsets a panel-relative label.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 0003114c, against ES2's Label_SetText

entries.name: Label_SetNumber
entries.description: (label, n) in stack order, callee-cleaned: ltoa(n, a 32-byte stack buffer, 10), then Label_SetText(label, buffer). ES2's Label_SetNumber (DBSIM 00438a40), which uses _itoa. No reference found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Label_CtorWithAltFont
entries.description: (label, font) in stack order, callee-cleaned: allocates 0x24 bytes with Mem_New when label is null (returning null when that fails), runs Label_Ctor(label, font) and stores font again at +0x20, the hotkey font Label_SetTextWithHotkey draws its one character in. ES2's Label_CtorWithAltFont (DBSIM 00438a70), whose label has the hotkey font at +0x21. es2_xref finds calls from 00035cb8 and 0003f29e.

entries.name: Label_SetText_Thunk
entries.description: (label, text) in stack order, callee-cleaned: Label_SetText(label, text). ES2's Label_SetText_Thunk (DBSIM 00438a94).

entries.name: Label_SetTextWithHotkey
entries.description: (label, index, text) in stack order, callee-cleaned: Label_SetText_Thunk(label, text); then, when index is at most strlen(text), puts a NUL at text[index], keeps HudFont_MeasureString(font, text) and the character in two stack locals and restores the character. Whatever the index, it then adds the width to the pen x Label_Pen (000b11bc) and draws the character with HudFont_DrawGlyph (00069d64)(the font at +0x20, character, Label_Pen), so with index past the length both come from locals the function never wrote. ES2's Label_SetTextWithHotkey (DBSIM 00438aac) does both only when index is at most the length. es2_xref finds six calls, from MfdFlashCommScreen_Paint (00035d20), MfdFlashCommScreen_Update (00035e14) (two), HddCommandScreen_Update (0003f578) (two) and HddCommandScreen_RefreshOrders (00040948).

entries.name: Label_StaticInitNoOp
entries.description: Frameless: a lone RET, entry 000adc3c of the static constructor table, closing the label object file; three zero bytes follow and the next file starts at PanelGauge_Ctor (00031318). ES2's Label_StaticInitNoOp (DBSIM 00438b1c).

entries.name: PanelGauge_Ctor
entries.description: (gauge, cockpit, rect) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the base constructor of the cockpit's instruments. Copies the rect {x0, y0, x1, y1} to +0, stores cockpit at +0x10 and PanelGaugeVtable (0009338e) at +0x76, clears the int16 condition +0x68 and the bytes +0x74 (dark) and +0x75, and returns gauge. Its head is the rect's inlined constructor: with gauge null it allocates 0x10 bytes into a local and still writes through the null gauge pointer. ES2's PanelGauge_Ctor (DBSIM 00438b20) keeps its vtable at +0, the rect at +4 and the cockpit at +0x14, and also clears the sequencer, dropout ranges and power-up fields. es2_xref finds nine calls, from 00034b19, 00036f5e, 00037bfa, 00038f61, 00039845, 00039c94, 0003b101, 0003c288 and CockpitClock_Ctor.

entries.name: PanelGauge_OnChildClickNoOp
entries.description: Frameless: three NOPs and RET 0xc, (gauge, flags, child). Slot +4 of PanelGaugeVtable (0009338e), which Widget_ForwardClickToOwner reaches on a child's click. ES2's PanelGauge_OnChildClickNoOp (DBSIM 0045233f).

entries.name: PanelGauge_KeyDispatchNone
entries.description: Frameless: NOP, XOR EAX,EAX and RET 8, (gauge, key): returns 0. Slot +0x10 of PanelGaugeVtable (0009338e). ES2's PanelGauge_KeyDispatchNone (DBSIM 00452344).

entries.name: PanelGauge_ScheduleDropout
entries.description: (gauge), callee-cleaned: schedules the next sensor-dropout burst on the clock 000981c4: +0x6c and +0x70 = the clock + ((Math_RandomNext(000b5c48) & 0xffff) % 6 + 2) * 60, and the int16 +0x6a = (a second draw & 0xffff) % 240 + 1, the burst's length. ES2's PanelGauge_RollDuration (DBSIM 00438d6c) draws a spell's length instead. es2_xref finds one call, from PanelGauge_TickDropout (00031400).

entries.name: PanelGauge_TickDropout
entries.description: (gauge), its arguments removed by this function: the sensor dropout's flicker. With the int16 condition +0x68 equal to 3, sets the dark byte +0x74 and returns, leaving +0x75 as it is. Otherwise, on the clock 000981c4: while the clock is past +0x6c and short of +0x6c + the int16 +0x6a (unsigned compares, both ends excluded), each time it is past +0x70 it flips +0x74, sets +0x75 to 2, puts +0x70 at the clock + 1 + (Math_RandomNext(000b5c48) & 0xffff) % 30 and, on going dark, plays sound 0x1c with Sound_Play; once the clock reaches +0x6c + +0x6a it runs PanelGauge_ScheduleDropout, sets +0x74 to 1 for a condition of 2 or more and to 0 below, and +0x75 to 2. Its RET 4 at 0003149b is followed by two zero bytes and the next object file. ES2's PanelGauge_TickDropout (DBSIM 00438bc0) alternates dark and shown spells of rolled lengths, with a sprite sequencer, and forces dark at condition 0. es2_xref finds three calls, from Gunsight_UpdateAndPaint (00034f3c), MfdDisplay_Update (0003a2a8) and HddDisplay_Update (0003cd28).

entries.name: Widget_ClickSound
entries.description: Frameless: Sound_Play(0x11) and RET 4, (mixin). The click sound at +0xc of the PanelGadget mixin's tables: es2_xref finds 16 stored pointers to it, and es1_naming.py vtables lists nine three-slot tables holding it at +0xc. The gadget object file starts here, after two zero bytes. ES2's Widget_ClickSound (DBSIM 00438e2c).

entries.name: Widget_ForwardClickToOwner
entries.description: (gadget, flags) in stack order, callee-cleaned: with flags bit 0 set, calls slot +4 of the table at owner+0x76 with (owner, flags, gadget), the owner being the gadget's +0x20; then the gadget's slot +8 (invalidate) through its vptr +0x1c, and slot +0xc (the click sound) of the mixin table at +0x24 on gadget+0x20. ES2's Widget_ForwardClickToOwner (DBSIM 00438e3c). es2_xref finds it in eight tables, at +0xc of PanelSelectGadgetVtable (000933aa), 00093b7e, 00093e6e, ShieldsSelectGadgetVtable (00093eae), PanelSelectGadgetVtableMfdDisplayCopy (00094136), MFDSelectGadgetVtable (00094176), 0009470e and 00094f56.

entries.name: PanelSelectGadget_Dtor
entries.description: (gadget, flags) in stack order, callee-cleaned (RET 8): stores PanelSelectGadgetVtable (000933aa) at +0x1c, Mem_Delete(+0x2c), and destroys each of the three objects at +0x30, +0x34 and +0x38 that is set through its slot +0x1c with flags 3. It tests neither gadget nor flags and frees nothing of the gadget itself. ES2's PanelSelectGadget_Dtor (DBSIM 00438e70). No reference found by es2_xref.

entries.name: CTLButtonControl_PaintNoOpGadgetsCopy
entries.description: Frameless: a NOP and RET 4. Slot +4 (paint) of PanelSelectGadgetVtable (000933aa). ES2's CTLButtonControl_PaintNoOp (DBSIM 00455545).

entries.name: Widget_InvalidateDeferredGadgetsCopy
entries.description: (gadget), callee-cleaned: sets the byte +0x1b to 2, the deferred-repaint counter. Slot +8 of PanelSelectGadgetVtable (000933aa), entered through its padding 00031527. ES2's Widget_InvalidateDeferred (DBSIM 00455524), which sets +0x1f.

entries.name: CTLControl_FlushDeferredPaintNoOpGadgetsCopy
entries.description: Frameless: RET 4. Slot +0x10 (per frame) of PanelSelectGadgetVtable (000933aa). ES2's CTLControl_FlushDeferredPaintNoOp (DBSIM 0045554a).

entries.name: Widget_GetButtonValueGadgetsCopy
entries.description: Frameless: a NOP, then returns the int16 at Widget_ClickButtons (00094b84) in AX with RET 4. Slot +0x14 (value) of PanelSelectGadgetVtable (000933aa); the code of Widget_GetButtonValuePanelCopy. ES2's Widget_GetButtonValue (DBSIM 00455530).

entries.name: CTLControl_SetValueNoOpGadgetsCopy
entries.description: Frameless: three NOPs and RET 8. Slot +0x18 (set value) of PanelSelectGadgetVtable (000933aa). ES2's CTLControl_SetValueNoOp (DBSIM 0045553b).

entries.name: CTLControl_DragMoveNoOpGadgetsCopy
entries.description: Frameless: a NOP and RET 8. Slot +0x1c (drag) of PanelSelectGadgetVtable (000933aa). ES2's CTLControl_DragMoveNoOp (DBSIM 00455540).

entries.name: PanelStateGadget_OnClick
entries.description: (gadget, flags) in stack order, callee-cleaned: with flags bit 0 set, flips the lit byte +0x3c, then makes Widget_ForwardClickToOwner's three calls: slot +4 of the table at owner+0x76 with (owner, flags, gadget), the owner being +0x20; the gadget's slot +8 through +0x1c; slot +0xc of the mixin table at +0x24 on gadget+0x20. ES2's PanelStateGadget_OnClick (DBSIM 00438f14), whose lit byte is +0x40. es2_xref finds it at +0xc of 00093d76 and 00094736.

entries.name: PanelSliderGadget_Dtor
entries.description: (mixin, flags) in stack order, callee-cleaned (RET 8): stores PanelSliderGadgetVtable (000933d2) at +4, Mem_Delete(+8), destroys the object at +0x10 through its slot +0x1c with flags 3, Mem_Delete(+0x14) when set, GLBitmapArray_Dtor(+0x38, 3), then destroys the GLRectangleRegion at +0x18 in place, storing 000933ea, 00093412 and 0009343a there in turn. It tests neither mixin nor flags and frees nothing of the gadget. ES2's PanelSliderGadget_Dtor (DBSIM 00438f4c). No reference found by es2_xref.

entries.name: GLRectangleRegion_DtorGadgetsCopy
entries.description: (object, flags) in stack order, callee-cleaned: slot +0x1c of 000933ea, the first of the gadget file's three copies of GLRectangleRegion's vtables, whose slot +4 returns the class tag 0x28000c (entered at its padding 000315ea): with the object non-null stores 000933ea, 00093412 and 0009343a in turn at +0 and deletes the object with Mem_Delete when bit 0 of flags is set.

entries.name: GLRegion_DtorGadgetsCopy
entries.description: (object, flags) in stack order, callee-cleaned: slot +0x1c of 00093412 (entered at its padding 0003161a): with the object non-null stores 00093412 and 0009343a in turn at +0 and deletes the object with Mem_Delete when bit 0 of flags is set.

entries.name: GLBase_DtorGadgetsCopy
entries.description: (object, flags) in stack order, callee-cleaned: slot +0x1c of 0009343a: with the object non-null stores 0009343a at +0 and deletes the object with Mem_Delete when bit 0 of flags is set.

entries.name: Widget_NoClickSound
entries.description: Frameless: two NOPs and RET 4, (mixin). Slot +0xc, the click sound, of PanelSliderGadgetVtable (000933d2), so a slider is silent. ES2's Widget_NoClickSound (DBSIM 00439014).

entries.name: HSliderGadget_OnClick
entries.description: (slider, value) in stack order, callee-cleaned: slot +4 of the table at owner+0x76 with (owner, value, slider), the owner being +0x3e; the slider's slot +8 through its vptr +0x1c; slot +0xc of the mixin table at +0x42 on slider+0x3e. The value is not tested. ES2's HSliderGadget_OnClick (DBSIM 0043901c). es2_xref finds it at +0xc of five tables, 00093d06, WeaponSliderGadgetVtable (00093d4a), 000943b6, ThrottleHSliderGadgetVtable (000943fa) and 00095006, whose value slot +0x14 is SliderWidget_GetValueH (00043ac8), which reads the knob's +0x2e against the slider's x0.

entries.name: VSliderGadget_OnClick
entries.description: (slider, value) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the same statements as HSliderGadget_OnClick (0003166c). ES2's VSliderGadget_OnClick (DBSIM 0043904c). es2_xref finds it at +0xc of 0009431a and ThrottleVSliderGadgetVtable (0009435e), whose value slot +0x14 is SliderWidget_GetValueV (00043be8), the statements of ES2's SliderWidget_GetValueV. Its RET 8 at 000316ce is followed by three zero bytes and the next object file.

entries.name: BarGraph_Ctor
entries.description: (bar, rect) in stack order, callee-cleaned (RET 8): copies the rect {x0, y0, x1, y1} to +0. Its head is the rect's inlined constructor: with bar null it allocates 0x10 bytes into a local and still writes through the null bar pointer. The bar graph object file starts here, after three zero bytes. ES2's BarGraph_Ctor (DBSIM 0043907c), which stores BarGraph's vtable at +0 and the rect at +4. es2_xref finds calls from BarGraphH_Ctor (00031740) and BarGraphV_Ctor (00031aac), and the address as a dword at 000ac6cc.

entries.name: BarGraph_NoOp
entries.description: Frameless: a NOP and RET 8. ES2's BarGraph_NoOp (DBSIM 004390b0) sits in the same place, between BarGraph_Ctor and BarGraph_GetRect. No reference found by es2_xref.

entries.name: BarGraph_GetRect
entries.description: (bar), callee-cleaned, frameless: MOV EAX,[ESP+4] and RET 4, returning the bar, whose rect is at +0. ES2's BarGraph_GetRect (DBSIM 004390b8) returns bar + 4. es2_xref finds ten calls, one each from EnergyPoolGauge_Paint (00039a28) and EnergyPoolGauge_Update (00039abc) and four each from ThrottleSlider_PaintV (0003b804) and ThrottleSlider_FlushPaintH (0003bf18), the counts of ES2's calls from EnergyPoolGauge_Paint, EnergyPoolGauge_Update, ThrottleSlider_PaintV and ThrottleSlider_FlushPaintH; EnergyPoolGauge_Paint (00039a28) passes the object at its +0x7e and calls that object's slot +8 through its +0x28, where a bar graph keeps its vtable.

entries.name: BarGraphH_Ctor
entries.description: (bar, range, rect) in stack order, callee-cleaned: allocates 0x2c bytes with Mem_New when bar is null (returning null when that fails), runs BarGraph_Ctor(bar, rect), stores BarGraphHVtable (00093462) at +0x28 and sets the span +0x10 = (x1 - x0) * 0x10000 / range, the start +0x14 = x0, the end +0x18 = x1, and the fill position +0x1c = the end when the span is below 1, else the start. ES2's LedBarGraph_CtorBase (DBSIM 004390c4), the BarGraphH constructor, with each field 4 higher and the vtable at +0. es2_xref finds calls from 00031e47 and 0003250c.

entries.name: BarGraphH_ResetToEmpty
entries.description: (bar), callee-cleaned: the fill position +0x1c = the end +0x18 when the span +0x10 is below 1, else the start +0x14. es2_xref finds it at +0xc of BarGraphHVtable (00093462) by its padding 000317a3, and of LEDBarGraphHVtable (00093492) and LEDBMBarGraphHVtable (0009355e). ES2's BarGraphH_ResetToEmpty (DBSIM 0043a211).

entries.name: BarGraphH_PaintToValue
entries.description: (bar, value) in stack order, callee-cleaned: p = the start +0x14 + (value * span >> 16) when the span +0x10 is 1 or more, else the end +0x18 - (value * span >> 16); returns when p equals the stored position +0x1c, q. Otherwise sets the rect's x0 and x1 (+0, +8) to q and p in order and fills it with Raster_FillRect: when the bar shrinks (p < q filling from the start, p > q filling from the end) with the color of the brush at +0x228 of the display's (000bdd28) +0x44 set to +0x20 for that fill and put back, else with that brush as it stands. Stores p at +0x1c. Slot +4 of BarGraphHVtable (00093462). ES2's BarGraphH_PaintToValue (DBSIM 00439118) fills the whole track on every call, lit in +0x28 and unlit in +0x24.

entries.name: BarGraphH_RepaintSpan
entries.description: (bar, a, b) in stack order, callee-cleaned: orders a and b, clamps them to the start +0x14 and end +0x18 as lo and hi, and fills x lo..hi with Raster_FillRect against the position +0x1c, p. Filling from the start (span +0x10 of 1 or more): in the unlit color +0x20 when p < lo, with the brush as it stands when hi < p, else lo..p unlit and p..hi with the brush. Filling from the end: unlit when hi < p, the brush when p < lo, else lo..p with the brush and p..hi unlit. So a run p splits is lit on the side BarGraphH_PaintToValue leaves unlit. Slot +8 of BarGraphHVtable (00093462). ES2's BarGraphH_RepaintSpan (DBSIM 004391e0), the same statements with +0x24 as the unlit color.

entries.name: BarGraphV_Ctor
entries.description: (bar, range, rect) in stack order, callee-cleaned: BarGraphH_Ctor on y: allocates 0x2c bytes when bar is null, runs BarGraph_Ctor, stores BarGraphVVtable (0009347a) at +0x28, the span +0x10 = (y1 - y0) * 0x10000 / range, the start +0x14 = y0, the end +0x18 = y1, and the position +0x1c = the start when the span is below 1, else the end. ES2's LedBarGraph_CtorV (DBSIM 00439344). es2_xref finds calls from 0003218b and 00032a40.

entries.name: BarGraphV_ResetToEmpty
entries.description: (bar), callee-cleaned: the fill position +0x1c = the start +0x14 when the span +0x10 is below 1, else the end +0x18. es2_xref finds it at +0xc of BarGraphVVtable (0009347a) by its padding 00031b0e, and of LEDBarGraphVVtable (000934aa) and LEDBMBarGraphVVtable (00093576). ES2's BarGraphV_ResetToEmpty (DBSIM 0043a190).

entries.name: BarGraphV_PaintToValue
entries.description: (bar, value) in stack order, callee-cleaned: BarGraphH_PaintToValue on the rect's y0 and y1 (+4, +0xc), filling from the start when the span +0x10 is below 1, p = the start + (value * span >> 16), and from the end otherwise, p = the end - (value * span >> 16). Slot +4 of BarGraphVVtable (0009347a). ES2's BarGraphV_PaintToValue (DBSIM 00439398) tests the span below 0, fills the whole track and writes x0 and x1.

entries.name: BarGraphV_RepaintSpan
entries.description: (bar, a, b) in stack order, callee-cleaned: BarGraphH_RepaintSpan on the rect's y0 and y1 (+4, +0xc) with the side tests mirrored, so a run the position p splits is lit on the side BarGraphV_PaintToValue lights. Filling from the start (span +0x10 below 1): unlit (+0x20) when p < lo, the brush as it stands when hi < p, else lo..p with the brush and p..hi unlit; filling from the end: unlit when hi < p, the brush when p < lo, else lo..p unlit and p..hi with the brush. Slot +8 of BarGraphVVtable (0009347a). ES2's BarGraphV_RepaintSpan (DBSIM 00439460).

entries.name: LedBarGraph_Ctor
entries.description: (bar, range, rect) in stack order, callee-cleaned: allocates 0x34 bytes with Mem_New when bar is null (returning null when that fails), runs BarGraphH_Ctor (00031740)(bar, range, rect) and stores LEDBarGraphHVtable (00093492) at +0x28. It sets neither shade (+0x2c, +0x30) nor the unlit color +0x20. ES2's LedBarGraph_Ctor (DBSIM 004395c4). es2_xref finds calls from 0003889e, 000399c2, 00046c1f and 00047990.

entries.name: LedBarGraph_PaintToValue
entries.description: (bar, value) in stack order, callee-cleaned: slot +4 of LEDBarGraphHVtable (00093492). Repaints only the strip between the stored position q (+0x1c) and the new one p, returning at once when they are equal. Span +0x10 of 1 or more, p = start (+0x14) + (value * span >> 16): growing, q..p through LedBarGraph_FillPinstripe (00032078) by its padding; shrinking, p + 1..q unlit. Otherwise p = end (+0x18) - (value * span >> 16): growing (p below q), p..q through the pinstripe; shrinking, q..p unlit. The unlit strip goes through a temporary brush {0, +0x20} installed at the render context's +0x22c (the display's (000bdd28) +0x44 less 4) for one Raster_FillRect. Writes the rect's x0 and x1 for each fill and stores p. ES2's LedBarGraph_PaintToValue (DBSIM 004395e8) redraws the whole bar.

entries.name: LedBarGraph_RepaintToValue
entries.description: (bar, a, value) in stack order, callee-cleaned (RET 0xc), a not read: slot +8 of LEDBarGraphHVtable (00093492). Draws the whole bar for value without storing it: p = start (+0x14) + (value * span >> 16) for a span +0x10 of 1 or more, else end (+0x18) - (value * span >> 16); start..p through LedBarGraph_FillPinstripe (00032078), then p + 1..end through a temporary brush {0, +0x20} at the render context's +0x22c, put back after. ES2's LedBarGraph_RepaintToValue (DBSIM 004396a8), (bar, value), with the fields 4 lower here.

entries.name: LedBarGraph_FillPinstripe
entries.description: (bar, rect) in stack order, callee-cleaned: installs a temporary pen {0, shade} at the render context's +0x228 (the display's (000bdd28) +0x44 less 4), draws Raster_DrawLine from (x, y0) to (x, y1) for every even column x of x0..x1 in shade +0x2c, then for every odd one in +0x30, and puts the old pen back. ES2's LedBarGraph_FillPinstripe (DBSIM 00439758), the same statements. es2_xref finds four calls, all at its padding 00032077, two each from LedBarGraph_PaintToValue (00031e5c) and LedBarGraph_RepaintToValue (00031fac).

entries.name: LEDBarGraphV_Ctor
entries.description: (bar, range, rect) in stack order, callee-cleaned: allocates 0x3c bytes with Mem_New when bar is null (returning null when that fails), runs BarGraphV_Ctor (00031aac)(bar, range, rect) and stores LEDBarGraphVVtable (000934aa) at +0x28; it sets no color. ES2's LEDBarGraphV_Ctor (DBSIM 00439834). es2_xref finds one call, from 000399f1.

entries.name: LedBarGraphV_PaintToValue
entries.description: (bar, value) in stack order, callee-cleaned: slot +4 of LEDBarGraphVVtable (000934aa). LedBarGraph_PaintToValue (00031e5c) on the rect's y0 and y1 (+4, +0xc) with LedBarGraphV_FillPinstripe (000323f0) by its padding for the lit strip. Span +0x10 below 1, p = start + (value * span >> 16): growing, q..p lit; shrinking, p..q unlit. Otherwise p = end - (value * span >> 16): growing (p below q), p..q lit; shrinking, q..p unlit. Returns at once when p equals the stored q (+0x1c), else stores p. ES2's LedBarGraphV_PaintToValue (DBSIM 00439858) redraws the whole bar, tests the span below 0 and writes x0 and x1.

entries.name: LedBarGraphV_Repaint
entries.description: (bar, a, b) in stack order, callee-cleaned (RET 0xc), neither argument read: slot +8 of LEDBarGraphVVtable (000934aa). Redraws the whole bar at the stored position q (+0x1c) on the rect's y0 and y1 (+4, +0xc): with the span +0x10 below 1, start..q through LedBarGraphV_FillPinstripe (000323f0) and q + 1..end through a temporary brush {0, +0x20} at the render context's +0x22c; otherwise start..q through that brush and q + 1..end through the pinstripe. entries.name: Gunsight_TargetIndicatorPaint
entries.description: (child), callee-cleaned: slot +4 of HUDLockingGunsightVtable (0009378a). Draws only while the state block at +0x24 has an object at +6 and its byte +0x24 set. Saves the 32 bytes at g_ModelTransformPtr (000bdb4e), installs the identity with Raster_SetModelTransform (0005c140)(0), and with r = block +0x1c and (x, y, z) = block +0xa..+0x15 takes (x, y, z - r/2) and (x, y, z - r/2 + 2r) through Raster_ModelToView (0005c290); with either view depth (+4) below 0x100 it puts the transform back and returns. Projects both (Raster_PerspectiveDivide (0005c318), Raster_ProjectToScreen (0005c410)); h = |row difference|, and below 25 or above 75 each row moves by half the difference, int16, to make h 25 or 75. The box +0x28..+0x34 = (second x - h/2, second row, second x + h/2, first row). Corner lengths: +0x18 when the box is wider (taller) than that, else half its width (height). Colour 1 when the byte +0x14 of the object's group (+0x3f) is 0, else 0x35. Saving the pen +0x228 and brush +0x22c of the installed render context (000bdbda), with block byte +0x25 clear it draws with the pen {0, colour} two Raster_DrawLine (0006a064) lines along the edges at each corner; with it set, with the brush {0, colour}, four triangles through Raster_DrawPolygonDispatch (00068be0), each the inner half of a corner's square. Builds its three points with __vec_ctor (000610cb) and Point_DefaultCtorGunsightCopy (000345a0). Restores the pen, brush and transform. ES2's Gunsight_TargetIndicatorPaint (DBSIM 0043b950) blits HUD sprites and draws an off-screen arrow.

entries.description: (indicator), callee-cleaned: slot +4 of HNavGaugeVtable (00093816), the waypoint indicator's paint. With e = m's int16 +0xa - +0x3a, unsigned 16-bit: +0x4a = 1 for e 0xe39-0x7fff, +0x49 = 1 for e 0x8000-0xf1c7, both 0 otherwise. Inside Cockpit_PushCanvasContext (0002b00c), with the brush {0, 1} at the context's +0x22c, fills a triangle with Raster_DrawPolygonDispatch (00068be0): with neither flag (x, y0+8), (x-2, y0+5), (x+2, y0+5), x = x1 - ((+0x3a - +0x24) & 0xffff) * +0x28 / +0x2c unsigned; with +0x49 (x0, y0+6), (x0, y0+10), (x0-2, y0+8); with +0x4a (x1, y0+6), (x1+2, y0+8), (x1, y0+10). Then +0x45 = Hud_WorldUnitsToMetres (0002e2a0)(+0x45) and the label +0x4b gets 'WP ' (HudWaypoint_CaptionPrefix (00093832)), ltoa (00064720)(n), ': ' (00093836), the metres and ' M.' (00093839) by strcat (00064ca0) through Label_SetText (0003114c); Cockpit_PopRenderContext (0002b03c). Builds its points with __vec_ctor (000610cb) and Point_DefaultCtorGunsightCopy (000345a0). Then +0xcc = Label_Ctor (00030f44)(0, the font at 00092d60), Label_SetRect (00031080)(label, 2, {x0 - 3, y0 + 10, x0 + 12, y0 + 15} of child 1's top-left, {0, 0}) and the label's +0x1c = 0x38; zeroes +0x64, the state block (memset (00060b40)) and the int16 +0x68; returns gunsight. entries.name: MfdRadarScreen_Paint
entries.description: (screen) in stack order, callee-cleaned (RET 4): slot +4 of MFDRadarVtable (00093862). First reads the heading h, the int16 +0x10 of View_GetActiveObject (00059280). When the range, +0xc of the block at +4, differs from +0x28, stores it there and sets +0x24 = range / +0x20 (IDIV). Installs a pen and a brush of mode 0 on its stack at +0x228 and +0x22c of the render context 000bdbda, the pen's colour written before each pixel and the brush's never, and leaves both installed; blits +0xc at +0x10 with Bitmap_Blit (00067048). Sets +0x2c to 1 when the byte +0x90 of CockpitViewInstance's +0x1ff machine is 0, else 0, and label +0x30 takes the font ColorSchemePanels[2] when +0x2c is 1, else [1], at its +0 and the text of group 25 (000bd480) entry +0x2c. For each LiveObjectList object other than the machine, with +0x9e and +0x93 clear and the dword +0x16 of its group (+0x3f) zero: the position is +0x20/+0x24 when +0x8f is set or the group's side byte +0x14 is not 1; otherwise, while bit 0x20 of 000981c4 is clear and +0xa1 is clear, the point at +0x164; else the object is skipped. With d = Math_FastMagnitude2D (00063234) of the offset (dx, dy) from the machine's +0x20/+0x24, 1 for 0, an object with d < +0x28 is plotted: d negated when dy > 0, a = 0x4000 - Math_AsinBam (0005f54c)((dx << 14) / d) + h, x = Math_Q14Multiply (0005e838)(d, Math_CosBam (0006477c)(a)) / +0x24 + +0x18, y = Math_Q14Multiply(d, Math_CosBam(a - 0x4000)) / +0x24 + +0x1c, one Gfx_PlotPixel (00069058) with the pen {0, c}, c being 0x32 for side 0, else 0x35, 0x37, 0x3b or 0x3e for the int16 class +0x162 of 0, 1, 2 or any other. For CockpitViewInstance's selection +0x20c it keeps the point and Hud_WorldUnitsToMetres (0002e2a0)(|d|), and after the walk outlines (x-2, y-2)-(x+2, y+2) with Raster_FillRect (00053d9c) under the brush {4, 0x3b}. Then Label_SetText (0003114c) writes DST: (000bd48c) to +0x34, the selection's meters, 0 when it was not plotted, to +0x38, RNG: (000bd488) to +0x3c and Hud_WorldUnitsToMetres of the range to +0x40, each number through ltoa (00064720) and right-aligned and zero-padded in four characters. Its calls are all direct, Widget_DrawToCockpit (0002b058) not among them. ES2's MfdRadarScreen_Paint (DBSIM 0043eecc), with the contact walk of ES2's MfdRadarScreen_Update (DBSIM 0043ebe0).
