entries.description: (value), frameless, its argument removed by this function: the handler Prefs_Init (0004afe8) registers for option 2: stores (value != 0) in the byte Sound_SpeechEnabled (000959e4) and (value != 1) in MessagePort_ShowEnabled (000930d2). The role of ES2's Prefs_ApplyPilotMessageOption (DBSIM 00459cc4).

entries.name: Prefs_ApplyMouseOption
entries.description: (value), the handler Prefs_Init (0004afe8) registers for option 11: when the value differs from Prefs_MouseOptionApplied (000956c0), stores it there and, when Input_GetMouseDevice_Thunk (0004c634) answers a device, calls Mouse_EnableDriver (00055a90) for a value that is not 0 and Mouse_DisableDriver (00055a76) for 0.

entries.name: Input_SetStickMode
entries.description: (value), frameless, its argument removed by this function: Input_StickMode (00095819) = the value's low byte. Preferences option 8's handler: Prefs_Init (0004afe8) registers it with Prefs_SetHandler (0004ac4c).

entries.name: Input_SetThrottleLeverMode
entries.description: (value), frameless, its argument removed by this function: ThrottleLeverMode (000919ce) = 1 when the value's low byte is non-zero, else 0. Preferences option 10's handler: Prefs_Init (0004afe8) registers it with Prefs_SetHandler (0004ac4c). ES2's Input_SetThrottleLeverMode (DBSIM 00459d20), which also asks whether a throttle control is fitted.

entries.name: Prefs_LimitDetailInLowMemory
entries.description: (value), frameless, its argument removed by this function: the handler of preferences option 6. With g_LowMemory (000bda98) set and the option byte 000bd568 above 160: while the byte PrefsInitInProgress (000b1734) is set, Prefs_SetOption (0004a914)(1, 160, 6); otherwise Prefs_UndoSetOption (0004a900)(6), the panel StatusAlertPanel_Ctor (00046efc)(0, 0, 1, 0x11), its +0x314's slot +0xc on it, and GeneralAlert_Dtor (000472b0)(panel, 3). It reads the option from 000bd568 and not its argument. Prefs_Init (0004afe8) registers it with Prefs_SetHandler (0004ac4c) for option 6.

entries.name: Joystick_LoadCalibration
entries.description: (path, device) in stack order, its arguments removed by this function: fopens path with mode rb; when it opens, freads 0x40 bytes into a stack block and fcloses it, the fread's count unchecked; otherwise fills the block with min 0, max 0x50, center band low edge 0x28 and high edge 0x50 for each of the four axes. Then DVJoystick_SetRanges (0006b868)(device, block) and the word +0x66, the normalisation's shift, = 7. es2_xref finds calls from Input_CreateJoystickDevices (0004af0c) and ControlsPanel_ApplyDevices (00048e98).

entries.name: Joystick_SaveCalibration
entries.description: (path, device) in stack order, its arguments removed by this function: DVJoystick_GetRanges (0006b890)(device, block) into a 0x40-byte stack block, fopen(path, wb), fwrite of the block, fclose; the fopen's answer is passed on untested, and the block is left as the stack held it when the device is disabled. es2_xref finds one call, from 00049f30.

entries.name: Voice_ArchiveExists
entries.description: No arguments: fopens vol\simvoice.vol with mode rb, fcloses it when it opened and returns 1, otherwise 0. ES2's Voice_ArchiveExists (DBSIM 00459d6c) builds a localised name; this one uses the fixed path. es2_xref finds one call, from Prefs_Init (0004afe8).

entries.name: Input_CreateJoystickDevices
entries.description: No arguments: builds the joystick devices preferences option 7 (000bd569) names, each with mode 1: 1 IMJoystick1_Ctor (0004be30); 2 that and IMJoystick2_Ctor (0004be94); 3 IMThrustmasterFCS_Ctor (0004bef8); 4 IMFlightstick_Ctor (0004c054); 5 IMFlightstickPro_Ctor (0004c114); any other value none. With option 9 (000bd56b) set, option 7 of 2 clears option 9 through Prefs_SetOption (0004a914)(1, 0, 9), and any other value builds IMThrustmasterRCS_Ctor (0004bfe0) as the second device. For each device built, Joystick_LoadCalibration (0004ae0c)(Path_ApplyAltDrive (000592a4)(data\joy1.cal or data\joy2.cal), device), then InputDevice_Enable (0004b1c0) on its +0x78. es2_xref finds one call, from Prefs_Init (0004afe8).

entries.name: Prefs_Init
entries.description: No arguments: sets PrefsInitInProgress (000b1734); registers through Prefs_SetHandler (0004ac4c) Prefs_ApplyMusicOption (0004ad0c) for option 0, Prefs_ApplySoundsOption (0004acfc) for 1, Prefs_ApplyRadioOption (0004ad30) for 2, Prefs_ApplyMouseOption (0004ad54) for 0xb, Input_SetStickMode (0004ad88) for 8, Input_SetThrottleLeverMode (0004ad94) for 10 and Prefs_LimitDetailInLowMemory (0004adb0) for 6. Prefs_Load (0004a744)(1); under DemoMode it clears DemoMode for that load, sets it again, runs Prefs_Load(0) and Prefs_RevertSelectedOptions (0004aaf0)(0009570c, 7). Sets VoiceArchivePresent (000956bf) from Voice_ArchiveExists (0004aed8) and, when that is 0, Prefs_SetOption (0004a914)(1, 0, 2). Then Input_CreateJoystickDevices (0004af0c), 000956be = 0xf0, and clears PrefsInitInProgress. ES2's Prefs_Init (DBSIM 0045a19c). es2_xref finds one call, from Prefs_ClearHandlersAndInit (0004a724).

entries.name: InputDevice_Register

Fills the source table: 000b17e0-000b17ec the block's axes 000b17b9-000b17bf, 000b17f0-000b17fc its buttons 000b17c1-000b17c4, 000b1800-000b180c the keyboard pairs 000b188c-000b1898, 000b1810-000b181c the live block's +0xd, +0x11, +0x15, +0x19, 000b1820-000b182c 000b189c-000b189f, 000b1830-000b183c the live block's +0x1d-+0x20. Clears Input_ButtonLatch (000bd634-000bd637) and calls Keyjoy_LoadConfig (0004d918). ES2's Input_BuildSourceTable (DBSIM 0045a5c0).

entries.name: Input_ReadPlayerInput
entries.description: No arguments: the per-tick input read into PlayerInputBlock (000b17ac, 0x2b bytes), which it returns. Reads the live block's command word, skipping zero-scancode words through Input_ReadKeyboardCommand (0004c458)(1, word), masks it with SimCommandMask (000958b8). During playback reads a 14-byte record and an int32 count from TapeFile, sets DemoAbort under DemoMode for a live command, passes the word to Sim_HandleWindowKey, and on a short read or command 0x412 sets DemoAbort, closes the tape, clears TapePlayback and sets CockpitMouseLive; otherwise feeds each 14-byte mouse event to CockpitMouseQueue_Push (00044830) with its point to Input_CursorPos, and fills the command word, axes +0xd-+0x13, buttons +0x15-+0x1c from bit 0-7 and +0x29 (the delta), bits 8-11 being the source buttons. Live: Input_BuildKeyboardAxes (0004c818)(slow, 000b188c), slow in Input_StickMode 1 without InputDrivesCamera or under maybe_WeaponChain_EoHold. CockpitMouse_ProcessQueue (000444d0) gives the mouse events; source button 1 pressed with a mode set calls Input_ToggleStickMode once (latch 000958bc). The missile arm 000958bf, the keyboard pair moves and the Tilt and Missile reversals are ES2's; then, live, preferences option 7 (000bd569) picks each axis's and button's source (options 9 and 10, 000bd56b and 000bd56c, adding the third axis and dropping the stick's Y), the copy, and the latches Input_ButtonLatch/Input_ButtonLatchState (000bd634, Input_ButtonLatchState (000bd638)), and the pointer, mouse bytes, buttons 4-7 and command word from the live block. Recording appends the frame to <TapeStem>.tap (mode ab, assert appinput.cpp 0x2bd). The camera-axis pointers +0x1d/+0x21, the latched-row zeroing, option 10's Input_KeyThrottleStep as the throttle, and Backturn. ES2's Input_ReadPlayerInput (DBSIM 0045a7f4).

entries.name: Input_ReadMaskedKeyboardCommand
entries.description: (out), callee-cleaned: Input_ReadKeyboardCommand (0004c458)(1, out), repeated while it returns non-zero with *out non-zero and its low byte zero; then *out &= the word at 00095918 (0x47ff). No reference found by es2_xref. ES2's Input_ReadMaskedKeyboardCommand (DBSIM 0045b640).

entries.name: SimInput_SetEnabled
entries.description: (enabled), callee-cleaned: when enabled differs from the flag SimInput_Enabled (00095818), returns 0 when Input_GetKeyboardDevice_Thunk (0004c62c) returns 0; turning input on, unless 00095894 is set, registers Input_KeyjoyAxisKey (0004c6ec) against KeyjoyWantedCodes (0009586c) with Keyboard_AddSubscriber (0006c2bb), whose answer it returns; flips the flag; turning it off clears the three 14-byte blocks at Input_KeyHeld (000b1844), 000b1854 and 000b1864 with memset. Returns 1 otherwise. ES2's SimInput_SetEnabled (DBSIM 0045b670), which registers two listeners and clears 15-byte blocks.

entries.name: Input_LatchButton
entries.description: (state, button) in stack order, callee-cleaned: Input_ButtonLatch (000bd634)[button - 1] = 1 and Input_ButtonLatchState (000bd638)[button - 1] = state. ES2's Input_LatchButton (DBSIM 0045b718), for four buttons.

entries.name: Input_ToggleStickMode
entries.description: Frameless, no arguments, Ghidra's function starting on the three 0x90 bytes before its first instruction at 0004d8e4: while the preferences byte 000bd56a is set, Input_StickMode (00095819) becomes 2 when it is 1 and 1 otherwise; returns the mode in AL.

entries.name: Input_GetCursorPos
entries.description: Frameless, no arguments: returns the address of Input_CursorPos (000b17d8). ES2's Input_GetCursorPos (DBSIM 0045b734).

entries.name: Keyjoy_LoadConfig
entries.description: No arguments: opens Config_BuildPath (00059300)('keyjoy.cfg') with mode rt and reads it a word at a time with fscanf ' %s', comparing each with Str_CompareNoCaseN against the seven words of the table 00095948: '=' arms a value, '#' skips the line, TILT, BACKTURN and MISSILE choose the key, DEFAULT with a value armed disarms it and REVERSE with a value armed sets Keyjoy_TiltReversed (0009580c), Keyjoy_BackturnReversed (00095810) or Keyjoy_MissileReversed (00095814); the read ends at a DEFAULT or REVERSE that comes before its '=', and at a REVERSE before any key word. ES2's Keyjoy_LoadConfig (DBSIM 0045b78c) reads four keys through GetPrivateProfileStringA.

entries.name: Input_InitKeyboardAxisTable
entries.description: Frameless static initializer, the static constructor table's entry 000adc60: writes the 12 (dx, dy) byte pairs of KeyboardAxisDeltas (000b1874), keypad 7 (-1,-1), 8 (0,-1), 9 (1,-1), 4 (-1,0), 6 (1,0), 1 (-1,1), 2 (0,1), 3 (1,1), M (0,-1), J (-1,0), K (1,0), I (0,1), the last as the word 1 at 000b188b. ES2's Input_InitKeyboardAxisTable (DBSIM 0045b888) writes 14.

entries.name: AppInput_ExitNoOp

entries.name: Sound_Init
entries.description: (midiPort, port, dma, irq, midiDevice, digiDevice) in stack order: sets the voice-line slot count 000bd73c to 10, or 1 when g_LowMemory is set, and allocates the slots (__vec_new, 0x3a bytes each, to 000bd734) and 100 bytes per slot (000bd738). When digiDevice is non-zero: makes the sound manager Sound_Manager (000959ac) with SoundManager_Ctor (0004eb40), stores the six values over the driver defaults block (00095a08, 00095a00, 000959f8, 000959fc, 00095a0c, 00095a04), runs SoundManager_LoadDrivers (0004ef8c), calls SoundManager_SetMemoryLimit (00050008)(manager, 0xffffffff) and clears the manager's +0x503, or in the low-memory mode SoundManager_SetMemoryLimit (00050008)(manager, 200000) and sets it, calls SoundManager_SetHearingRange (0004ffe0)(manager, 100000), zeroes SoundCatalog_Count (000bd72c) and runs SoundCatalog_Load (0004dc70). Sets Sound_ListenerCountdown (000959b4) to 10 either way. es2_xref finds one call, from Sim_StartMission (0005ab6f).

entries.name: VoiceSlot_ElementCtor
entries.description: (slot), its argument removed by this function: allocates 0x3a bytes with Mem_New (000015a4) when slot is null, returning 0 when that fails; runs Snc_Ctor (0004e444) on it, clears the byte +0x33 and the dword +0x2f, and returns slot. es2_xref finds one stored pointer, to its padding 0004dc3e, which Sound_Init (0004db14) pushes for __vec_new. ES2's VoiceSlot_ElementCtor (DBSIM 00463520), which allocates nothing and clears +0x3b and +0x37 of its 0x42-byte record.

entries.name: SoundCatalog_Load
entries.description: Loads str\SOUNDS.STR (ResourcePath_BuildFolderName, StringTable_LoadFromFile into SoundCatalog_StringTable (000b1e44)) and reads it with StringTable_ReadNext into the name array SoundCatalog_Names (000b18a4) and the attribute pointer array SoundCatalog_Attributes (000b1994); passes the names to SoundManager_SetSampleNames (0004f888). For each row up to the first empty name: SoundCatalog_Objects (000bd63c)[row] = SoundManager_CreateObject (0004f4e8)(manager, 2, attribute byte 3, row), then the object's slot +0x28(-1, -1, attribute byte 0) and +0x2c(attribute byte 1), SoundObject_LoadSample when attribute byte 2 is set, and SoundCatalog_OfferedDistance (000b1a84)[row] = 0; the row count is left in SoundCatalog_Count (000bd72c). Then for each voice-line slot (000bd734, stride 0x3a, count 000bd73c) stores the next index past the rows at +0x34 and SoundManager_CreateObject(manager, 0, 0, index) at +0x36. Called last by Sound_Init (0004db14).

entries.name: Sound_Preload

entries.description: (id), callee-cleaned: plays the sound object SoundCatalog_Objects (000bd63c)[id] through its vtable +0x10 when the sound manager Sound_Manager (000959ac) is set and SoundObject_IsCategoryEnabled(object) holds. The +0x10 of MidiSoundVtable (00095c82) is the MIDI object's play (its error message reads SoundObject::playMIDI), that of DigiSoundVtable (00095cd6) the sample's. ES2's Sound_Play (DBSIM 0046272c).

entries.name: Sound_OfferPosition

Its test of a set dword compares two loads of the dword with each other (0004df4d), so a set one stays. es2_xref finds one call, from Flyer_DispatchMove (0001afa8).

ES2's Sound_Stop (DBSIM 004629c0).

entries.description: (camera), its argument removed by this function: stores the camera in Sound_Listener (000bd730). With the sound manager Sound_Manager (000959ac) set, for each catalog row up to the count SoundCatalog_Count (000bd72c) whose dword SoundCatalog_OfferedDistance (000b1a84)[row] is not 0, SoundObject_SetPosition (00050120)(SoundCatalog_Objects (000bd63c)[row], SoundCatalog_Positions (000b1b74) + 12 * row) and zeroes the dword; then on every tenth call (the countdown Sound_ListenerCountdown (000959b4), reset to 10) builds BuildEulerRotationMatrixQ14 (0005f0ac) of (0, 0, 0) with the camera's first three dwords as its translation and passes it to SoundManager_UpdateListener (0004fb60)(manager, matrix). es2_xref finds one call, from Sim_FrameSoundTick (00058574), which passes ViewObjectPtr.

entries.name: Voice_EvictLru
entries.description: No arguments: walks the voice-line slots (000bd734, stride 0x3a, count 000bd73c) for the first whose dword +0x2f is the lowest, compared unsigned and below 0xffffffff; points that slot's +0x27 at its 100-byte script buffer, the slot's index * 100 added to the pointer 000bd738, and returns the slot. ES2's Voice_EvictLru (DBSIM 00462a2c), which also closes the voice the slot held.

entries.name: SpeechLine_Load
entries.description: (sncName, voiceName) in stack order: finds the voice-line slot (000bd734, stride 0x3a, count 000bd73c) whose +0x2b holds the key Voice_KeyOfName (0004e208) gives for voiceName, and returns it as it is, loading neither sample nor script again; with none, takes a slot from Voice_EvictLru (0004e08c) (returning 0 when it gives none), stores the key at +0x2b and 1 at +0x33, and, when the sound manager Sound_Manager (000959ac) exists and the byte Sound_SpeechEnabled (000959e4) is set, builds simvoice\<voiceName>.sfx in the slot's +0xe, names it as the slot's index +0x34 with SoundManager_SetSampleName (0004f99c) and loads the slot's sound +0x36 with SoundObject_LoadSample, returning 0 when that fails, with the key and +0x33 already stored and no script loaded; then Snc_Load(slot, sound +0x36, sncName). Stores 000981c4, as read on entry, at +0x2f and returns the slot. es2_xref finds one call, from 0003e1a8 in CommBox_BeginMessage (0003e060).

entries.name: Voice_KeyOfName
entries.description: (name), callee-cleaned (RET 4): copies name with its zero into a 12-byte stack buffer, its length unchecked, upper-cases the copy with Str_ToUpperInPlace (0006d4b4), and returns (character 1 - '0') * 0x1000000 + characters 3 to 7 read as five decimal digits, each less '0', signed, times 10000, 1000, 100, 10 and 1; P1_01000 gives 0x1000000 + 1000. es2_xref finds one call, from SpeechLine_Load (0004e0f0), by its padding 0004e206, which compares the result with each voice-line slot's +0x2b.

entries.name: Sound_SetMusicEnabled
entries.description: (on), its argument removed by this function: when on differs from Sound_MusicEnabled (000959b8) and is 0, with the sound manager Sound_Manager (000959ac) set, Sound_StopSongs (0004e2f9); then stores on (zero-extended) in Sound_MusicEnabled. es2_xref finds calls from Prefs_ApplyMusicOption (0004ad0c) and Sim_StartMission (0005b4a1, with 1).

entries.description: No arguments: Sound_StopDigitalSounds (0004e34c) for songs: with the sound manager Sound_Manager (000959ac) set, for each object slot below the catalog's row count SoundCatalog_Count (000bd72c), SoundManager_GetObject (0004f660); an object whose kind byte +0x17 is set and whose vtable (+0x3b) slot +0x30 answers non-zero is stopped through its slot +0x14. es2_xref finds one call, from Sound_SetMusicEnabled (0004e294).

entries.name: Sound_StopDigitalSounds
entries.description: No arguments: with the sound manager Sound_Manager (000959ac) set and the catalog's row count SoundCatalog_Count (000bd72c) not 0, for each object slot from 0 below that count, SoundManager_GetObject (0004f660)(manager, slot); an object whose kind byte +0x17 is 0, a digital sound, and whose vtable's (+0x3b) slot +0x30 answers non-zero, playing, is stopped through its slot +0x14, DigiSound_Stop (00050c88) for a digital sound. A song (kind 1) plays on. es2_xref finds one call, from Sim_DeathFlash (00058414). ES2's Sim_DeathFlash (DBSIM 0045dc34) calls Sound_MuteEffects (DBSIM 00462cd8) at the same point.

entries.name: Snc_TimerTick
entries.description: No arguments, frameless: the lip-sync player's timer callback, which Snc_InstallTimer (0004e434) registers at a count of 2. Adds 1 to Snc_Clock (000959dc); then, for each pointer of SncQueue_Order (000b1ea4) from the first while its index is below the int16 SncQueue_Count (000959e2): when the entry's due count (its dword +0) equals the clock, takes 1 off the count, calls Snc_Step (0004e5f8) through its padding 0004e5f6 on the entry's slot (+4) and returns; when the due count is below the clock (unsigned), moves each later pointer down one place, taking 1 off the count for each one moved while the count less 1 is above the index, and returns; otherwise goes on to the next pointer. ES2's Snc_ServiceQueue (DBSIM 004631c0), which a frame runs on the coarse tick.

entries.name: Snc_InstallTimer
entries.description: No arguments, frameless: Timer_AddCallback (0006d289)(2, Snc_TimerTick (0004e39c)), removing the two arguments after the call and keeping no slot, so the tick runs on every second PC timer interrupt. es2_xref finds one call, from Snc_MissionInit (0004e498).

entries.name: Snc_Ctor
entries.description: (slot), its argument removed by this function: allocates 0x2b bytes with Mem_New (000015a4) when slot is null, returning 0 when that fails; clears the script buffer pointer +0x27 and the sound object +0, and returns slot. es2_xref finds one call, from VoiceSlot_ElementCtor (0004dc40). ES2's Snc_ClearSlot (DBSIM 00463238), which allocates nothing and clears +0x2f.

entries.name: Snc_CtorLoad
entries.description: (slot, object, name) in stack order, its arguments removed by this function: allocates 0x2b bytes with Mem_New (000015a4) when slot is null, returning 0 when that fails; passes its three arguments unchanged to Snc_Load (0004e4a8) through its padding 0004e4a7, and returns slot. No reference found by es2_xref. ES2's maybe_Snc_Ctor (DBSIM 0046324c), which allocates nothing.

entries.name: Snc_MissionInit
entries.description: No arguments, frameless: runs Snc_InstallTimer (0004e434) when the byte Snc_SkipTimerInstall (000959e0) is 0. es2_xref finds one call, from Sim_StartMission (0005a9dc). ES2's Sim_InitMissionSessionNoOp (DBSIM 0046326c), an empty body in the same place in the file.

entries.name: Snc_Load
entries.description: (slot, object, name) in stack order, callee-cleaned: opens snc\<name> (ResourcePath_BuildFolderName (00060698) on 000959e5, VolRStream_CtorFromPath (000567cc)), reads an int32 length and that many bytes through the read slot +0x1c into the buffer the dword slot +0x27 points to, appends 0xff, stores object at slot +0, clears the object's byte +0x16 when it is non-null, and destroys the stream with VolRStream_Dtor (00056824). It tests nothing after the open: a stream that did not open has its status set, its read slot reads nothing, and the length is the stack dword as it was; the length is not bounded by the slot's 100-byte buffer. ES2's Snc_Load takes a path, writes only the terminator when it has none, and keeps its buffer pointer at +0x2f. es2_xref finds calls from SpeechLine_Load (0004e0f0) and Snc_CtorLoad (0004e46c), through the padding before the prologue.

entries.name: Snc_Start
entries.description: (slot) callee-cleaned: copies the script pointer +0x27 to the cursor +0xa, stores Snc_ReadFrame (0004e59c)'s answer as the int16 frame +8 and Snc_ReadDueTime (0004e5c4)'s at +4, and calls Snc_Enqueue (0004e624)(slot, that); then, when the slot's object +0 is set, Sound_SpeechEnabled (000959e4) is set and the frame is not 0, returns in AL slot +0x10 of the table at the object's +0x3b, else 1. es2_xref finds one call, from HddDisplay_ServiceCommBoxes (0003e574). ES2's Snc_Start (DBSIM 004632fc).

entries.name: Snc_IsVoicePlaying
entries.description: (slot), its argument removed by this function: with the slot's sound object +0 non-null, returns what slot +0x30 of the object's vtable (+0x3b) returns for the object, for the voice's DigiSound DigiSound_IsPlaying (00050c18), 1 while its voice is busy; otherwise 0. No reference found by es2_xref. ES2's SfxHandle_IsPlaying (DBSIM 00463360).

entries.name: Snc_ReadFrame
entries.description: (slot), its argument removed by this function: reads the byte at the cursor +0xa and moves the cursor on by one; returns 0xffff in AX for 0xff, otherwise the byte zero-extended. es2_xref finds calls from Snc_Start (0004e518), through its padding 0004e59a, and from Snc_Step (0004e5f8).

entries.name: Snc_ReadDueTime
entries.description: (slot), its argument removed by this function: reads the byte at the cursor +0xa and moves the cursor on by one; returns -1 for 0xff, otherwise the byte zero-extended plus Snc_Clock (000959dc). es2_xref finds calls from Snc_Start (0004e518) and Snc_Step (0004e5f8).

entries.name: Snc_Step
entries.description: (slot), its argument removed by this function: stores Snc_ReadFrame (0004e59c) as the int16 frame +8; unless that is -1, stores Snc_ReadDueTime (0004e5c4) as the due count +4 and calls Snc_Enqueue (0004e624)(slot, that). es2_xref finds one call, from Snc_TimerTick (0004e39c), through its padding 0004e5f6. ES2's Snc_Advance (DBSIM 004633ac), which reads whole pairs and passes over those whose time has gone.

entries.name: Snc_Enqueue
entries.description: (slot, due) in stack order, its arguments removed by this function: when the int16 SncQueue_Count (000959e2) is above 0 and the due count of the entry SncQueue_Order (000b1ea4)[0] points at is above due (unsigned), takes 1 off the count and moves the pointers after the first down one place, as many as the new count; then stores due and slot in the 8-byte entry SncQueue_Entries (000b1e54)[count], points SncQueue_Order[0] at it and adds 1 to the count. es2_xref finds calls from Snc_Start (0004e518) and Snc_Step (0004e5f8). The queuing that ends ES2's Snc_Advance (DBSIM 004633ac), which compares the pair's delta with the entry's time.

entries.name: Sound_StaticInit
entries.description: Static constructor table entry 000adc64; frameless, with no Ghidra function: __vec_ctor (000610cb)(maybe_Point3I_CtorSoundCopy (0004e6e0) by its padding 0004e6dd, 60, 0xc, SoundCatalog_Positions (000b1b74)) in stack order, then StringTable_Ctor (00044f14)(SoundCatalog_StringTable (000b1e44)), and RET. ES2's Sound_StaticInit (DBSIM 0046349c), which builds the string table alone.

entries.name: Sound_StaticDtor
entries.description: Exit table entry 000adcc8; frameless, with no Ghidra function: OwnedArray_Dtor (00044f48)(SoundCatalog_StringTable (000b1e44), 2) in stack order, and RET. ES2's Sound_StaticDtor (DBSIM 004634cc).

entries.name: maybe_Point3I_CtorSoundCopy
entries.description: (p), its argument removed by this function: allocates 0xc bytes when p is null, returning 0 when that fails, inlines an 8-byte base's constructor and returns p. The sound file's copy of maybe_Point3I_Ctor (000633fc), identical after normalisation by es2_naming diff. Sound_StaticInit (0004e6b0) passes its padding 0004e6dd to __vec_ctor as the element constructor of SoundCatalog_Positions (000b1b74).

entries.name: SoundManager_TimerCallback
entries.description: Frameless: a far call through the far pointer 000b1ed0, which the static initialiser SoundManager_InitTimerPointer (00050d18) sets to HmiTimer_Dispatch (0006da51), then RET. SoundManager_LoadDrivers registers it with Timer_AddCallback at a count of the timer's interrupts a second over 120.

entries.name: MidiSound_LoopCallback
entries.description: (a, handle, c, flags), the far callback MidiSound_Play (000505c8) registers through HmiMidi_SetLoopCallback (0006ee87): answers 1 when bit 0x80 of flags is clear. Otherwise finds among the 60 slots of SoundManager_Instance (000bd73e) the object with +0x17 set whose word +0x1d is the handle, answering 0 with none; its repeat count is the word +0x23 while slot +0x30 answers non-zero, else +0x21: -1 answers 1, 0 answers 0, any other count c goes back through slot +0x28(-1, -1, c - 1) and answers 1.

entries.description: (a, handle), the far callback MidiSound_Play (000505c8) stores at the song block's +0xc7: finds among the 60 slots of SoundManager_Instance (000bd73e) the object with +0x17 set whose word +0x1d is the handle and stops it through its vtable slot +0x14; returns with none.

entries.description: (a, b, event, voice), the far callback DigiSound_Play (000509c4) puts in the start block's +0x1c: with event 2, sets +0x19 to -1 and the word +0x1d to 0xffff on the first object among the 60 slots of SoundManager_Instance (000bd73e) whose +0x17 is 0 and whose +0x19 is the voice.

entries.name: SoundManager_PrintMono

entries.description: (object), callee-cleaned: brings a sound object's sample into memory. Returns 0 unless bit 1 of the flags +0xd is set, and 1 at once when bit 0 (loaded) is. It then allocates the size, reads the sample through the manager's volume stream +0x504 (VolRStream_Open with the object's name at +0, the stream's vtable +0x1c), stores the block's far pointer in the manager's 6-byte slot +0x38e, counts a reference in the byte +0x352 (adding the size to +0x4f6 on the first and raising the high-water mark +0x4fa), sets bit 0 of +0xd and returns 1.

entries.name: DigiSound_Play
entries.description: (sound), slot +0x10 of vtable DigiSoundVtable (00095cd6). When HmiDigi_CountBusyVoices (0006e055)(000bd8c8) is above 30, picks among the 60 objects (SoundManager_GetObject on SoundManager_Instance (000bd73e)) the digital one (+0x17 clear) whose slot +0x30 returns non-zero with the lowest SoundObject_GetVolume (0005049c) value below 100, and stops it through its slot +0x14; returns 0 with none. Returns 0 when SoundObject_LoadSample fails. The volume is byte +0x31 * 0x7fff * the manager's byte +0x241 / 10000, or the word +0x32 when the positional byte +0x15 is set; at volume 0 with +0x18 clear it returns 1. Otherwise builds a start block: the data far pointer (manager +0x38e for the index), its size +0x262 as the length at +8, the word +0x21 at +0xc (also copied to +0x23), +0x3f at +0x10, the volume at +0x14, 0x1000 + the slot byte +8 at +0x18, the far callback DigiSound_DoneCallback (0004e7fc) at +0x1c, flags 0x4100 at +0x28 (0x4300 with +0x1f at +0x40 when positional), +0x43 at +0x38 when +0x47 is set, and with +0x21 non-zero and neither +0x48 nor +0x4c -1 those two at +0x30 and +0x34 and the flags' low byte 0x40. Stores the slot in the word +0x1d and HmiDigi_StartSample (0006dad9)(000bd8c8, block) in +0x19; on -1 sets +4 and +0x19 to -1 and +0x1d to 0xffff and returns 0; else returns 1.

entries.name: DigiSound_IsPlaying
entries.description: (object), its argument removed by this function, slot +0x30 of the DigiSound vtable DigiSoundVtable (00095cd6): 1 when the voice +0x19 is not -1 and HmiDigi_IsVoiceDone (0006df9d)(the driver handle 000bd8c8, voice) answers 0, else 0.

entries.name: DigiSound_GetVoiceStatus
entries.description: (object), slot +0x0c of DigiSoundVtable (00095cd6) through its padding 00050c47: 0 with the voice +0x19 at -1, else the word +0x30 of the voice's record, through the far pointer at 0009d10c + 000bd8c8 * 0xc0 + voice * 6.

entries.name: DigiSound_Stop
entries.description: (sound), slot +0x14 of vtable DigiSoundVtable (00095cd6): when the voice +0x19 is not -1, calls HmiDigi_StopSample (0006dd7f)(000bd8c8, voice), then sets +0x19 to -1 and the word +0x1d to 0xffff.

entries.name: DigiSound_SetRepeats
entries.description: (object, start, end, count), slot +0x28 of DigiSoundVtable (00095cd6): while slot +0x30 answers non-zero, the count's word to +0x23 and to the word +0x38 of the voice's record (the far pointer at 0009d10c + 000bd8c8 * 0xc0 + voice * 6); otherwise the count to +0x23 and +0x21, end to +0x48 and start to +0x4c.

entries.name: SoundManager_InitTimerPointer
entries.description: Frameless: stores the far pointer CS:HmiTimer_Dispatch (0006da51), made with maybe_MK_FP, at 000b1ed0 (selector 000b1ed4), then RET. es2_xref finds one stored pointer to it, at 000adc68.

entries.name: HmiTimer_Tick
entries.description: No arguments, frameless, with no Ghidra function: while HmiTimer_Enabled (000b1ed8) is set and the reentry count HmiTimer_Busy (000b1ee8) is 0, raises the count, makes a far call through the far pointer HmiTimer_Callback (000b1ee0) and lowers the count. es2_xref finds its address stored at 00050de3, in HmiTimer_Install (00050d98), which registers it with Timer_AddCallback (0006d289).

entries.name: HmiTimer_TickUnguarded
entries.description: No arguments, frameless, with no Ghidra function: while HmiTimer_Enabled (000b1ed8) is set, makes a far call through HmiTimer_Callback (000b1ee0), with no reentry count. HmiTimer_TickUnguarded2 (00050d70) has the same bytes. No reference found by es2_xref.

entries.name: HmiTimer_TickUnguarded2
entries.description: No arguments, frameless, with no Ghidra function: the bytes of HmiTimer_TickUnguarded (00050d60). No reference found by es2_xref.

entries.name: HmiTimer_Enable
entries.description: No arguments, frameless: sets HmiTimer_Enabled (000b1ed8) to 1. es2_xref finds calls from the HMI code at HmiTimer_Init (0006d4f5), HmiTimer_Uninit (0006d5c2), HmiTimer_AddEvent (0006d5e6), HmiTimer_SetEventRate (0006d78c) and HmiTimer_RemoveEvent (0006d8d5).

entries.name: HmiTimer_Disable
entries.description: No arguments, frameless: sets HmiTimer_Enabled (000b1ed8) to 0. es2_xref finds calls from the HMI code at HmiTimer_Init (0006d4f5), HmiTimer_Uninit (0006d5c2), HmiTimer_AddEvent (0006d5e6), HmiTimer_SetEventRate (0006d78c) and HmiTimer_RemoveEvent (0006d8d5).

entries.name: HmiTimer_Install
entries.description: (a, offset, selector), C convention: stores the far pointer selector:offset in HmiTimer_Callback (000b1ee0, the selector at 000b1ee4) and registers HmiTimer_Tick (00050d38) with Timer_AddCallback (0006d289) at a count of (1000000 / Math_Q14Multiply(word +4 of the structure 000bdd0c points to, 0x35a1)) / 60, keeping the slot in the word HmiTimer_Slot (000b1edc). es2_xref finds one call, from the HMI code at HmiTimer_Init (0006d4f5).

entries.name: HmiTimer_Remove
entries.description: No arguments, frameless: passes the dword at HmiTimer_Slot (000b1edc) to Timer_RemoveCallback (0006d337), the call Ttm_ManagerDtor gives its timer slot. es2_xref finds one call, from the HMI code at HmiTimer_Uninit (0006d5c2).

entries.name: HmiTimer_NoOp
entries.description: Frameless: RET. es2_xref finds one call, from the HMI code at 0006da46, which passes it one argument.

entries.name: HmiHook_NoOp
entries.description: Frameless: RET, with no Ghidra function. es2_xref finds one call, from 0006dacf in the HMI code, a CALL followed by RETF.

entries.name: HmiLock_RegionStart
entries.description: Frameless: RET, with no Ghidra function: a marker. es2_xref finds its address stored at 0006fafd, 0006fb05, 0006fd22 and 0006fd2a, where the HMI code takes HmiLock_RegionEnd (00050e1c) less it as a size and passes it with this address, made a far pointer by maybe_MK_FP (0006d4e2), to a region call: X32_UnlockRegion (00060b91) at 0006fd3b.

entries.name: HmiLock_RegionEnd
entries.description: Frameless: RET, with no Ghidra function, followed by three zero bytes: the end marker of the region HmiLock_RegionStart (00050e18) opens. es2_xref finds its address stored at 0006faf8 and 0006fd1d.

entries.name: Profile_Load
entries.description: (name), callee-cleaned: loads a profile file into memory. Clears the dirty flag Profile_Dirty (00095d10). When the file opens as a FileRStream, copies name to Profile_FileName (000bd8e6), mallocs its size plus 2000 bytes into Profile_Buffer (000bd8e2), reads the file into it, sets Profile_TextEnd (000bd8f8) to the buffer plus the size plus 1 and Profile_BufferEnd (000bd8fc) to its last byte, and splits the text into a list of 12-byte nodes {line, next, previous} from Mem_New, its head at Profile_Lines (000bd8f4): bytes below 0x20 or above 0x7e before a line are skipped, a line runs while its bytes are 0x20 to 0x7e, and the byte that ends it is overwritten with 0. When the file does not open, mallocs 2000 bytes, sets the text end to the buffer's start and the buffer end to its last byte, copies the name and leaves the list empty.

entries.name: Profile_GetInt
entries.description: (file, default, key, section) in stack order, callee-cleaned: Windows' GetPrivateProfileInt with its arguments in that order reversed. Returns default when section, key or file is null. Loads file with Profile_Load (00050e20) when Profile_FileName is empty, and when it names another file saves that one first with Profile_Save (00051478) while Profile_Dirty is set and loads this one. Finds the first line beginning '[section]' and, among the lines after it up to one beginning '[', the first beginning 'key=', the comparisons ignoring case (Str_CompareNoCaseN over the pattern's length); returns atol of what follows that line's first '=', or default when the section or the key is missing.

entries.name: Profile_GetString
entries.description: (file, size, buffer, default, key, section) in stack order, callee-cleaned: Windows' GetPrivateProfileString with its arguments in that order reversed. Loads the file as Profile_GetInt (00050ffc) does. With the key found in the section, copies what follows the line's first '=' into buffer and returns its length; with key null, copies each line of the section, each ended by a 0, into buffer and returns the length less 1, or, when they reach size - 1 bytes, ends the buffer with two 0 bytes and returns size - 1. Otherwise, and when section or file is null, copies default into buffer and returns its length. Only the section listing is held to size.

entries.name: Profile_Save
entries.description: (name), callee-cleaned, entered also at its padding 00051476: writes the profile in memory to name. Returns 0 when the FileWStream's status is not 0 after opening. Otherwise writes each line of Profile_Lines followed by CR LF through the stream's write slot +0x18, freeing each node, empties the list and Profile_FileName, frees Profile_Buffer, closes the stream and returns 1.

entries.name: Profile_DeleteSection
entries.description: (header), callee-cleaned: finds the first line beginning with header, ignoring case, and unlinks it and the lines after it up to the next one beginning '[' from Profile_Lines, without freeing them; returns 1 whether or not it finds it.

entries.name: Profile_FindOrAddSection
entries.description: (header), callee-cleaned: returns the first line node of Profile_Lines beginning with header, ignoring case; with none, copies header to Profile_TextEnd (000bd8f8), advances it past the copy and its 0, and appends a node for it to the list, returning that node.

entries.name: Profile_WriteString
entries.description: (file, value, key, section) in stack order, callee-cleaned: Windows' WritePrivateProfileString with its arguments in that order reversed. Returns 0 for a null file. Loads it with Profile_Load (00050e20) when Profile_FileName is empty, and when that names another file saves it with Profile_Save (00051478) and loads this one. With section, key and value all null, returns Profile_Save(file). Returns 0 for a null section or a null value. Sets Profile_Dirty (00095d10); with key null returns Profile_DeleteSection (0005155c) of '[section]'. Otherwise takes the section's line from Profile_FindOrAddSection (0005165c) and looks for 'key=' among the lines after it up to one beginning '['. When the section lacks the key, writes 'key=' and the value at Profile_TextEnd and links a node for it after the last line it looked at. With one whose value is at least as long, clears the old value with 00072ecc(old, 0, length) and copies the new over it; with a longer value, writes the line anew at Profile_TextEnd and replaces the node, freeing the old one. Returns 1 while more than 0x95 bytes are left between Profile_TextEnd and Profile_BufferEnd, and otherwise Profile_Save(file). No reference found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Dongle_PrintStatus
entries.description: (status), callee-cleaned: looks status up among the nine dwords at 00095e40 (-999, -5, -4, -3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2) with REPNE SCASD and jumps through the table after them to printf one message: 'Invalid Dongle Service requested', 'Write to dongle failed', 'Attempting Memo operations on a non-memo Hasp', 'Hasp does not match given password', 'Invalid Address given to dongle', 'Dongle Timed-Out', 'Dongle is okay', 'Dongle is Missing' or 'Dongle has the wrong Password' (00095d28-00095e0b); any other prints 'BOGUS STATUS CODE %d'. Ghidra has the case blocks from 00051b6f as undefined bytes. No reference found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Dongle_IsOk
entries.description: No arguments: builds a dongle object on its stack with Dongle_Ctor (0007303c), returns 1 when Dongle_Check (00073078) answers 0 and 0 otherwise, and destroys the object with Dongle_Dtor (00073058) and flags 2. No reference found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Dongle_VersionString
entries.description: Frameless, with no Ghidra function and no arguments. It calls 00072faa with 000b1eec, which decodes the string at 0009de3e with the key 0009de3a into it, and returns 000b1eec. The image's bytes decode to 'Dongle Version!'. No reference found by es2_xref.

entries.name: VGA8_CopyRectBetweenPages
entries.description: (rect, offset), C convention: the VGA_8 driver's slot 20 (000a7bc0). ES1GO's VGA8_CopyRectBetweenPages (ES1GO 000733bc) with each row's offset computed as the row times 0xa0, where the shell's reads its row table; the pages' offsets and pans are 0009e600, 0009e604, 0009e60c and 0009e610, and the row-by-row path calls slots 21 and 22 through 0009df28 and 0009df2c.

entries.name: VGA8_WriteRowTransparent
entries.description: (pixels, y, x0, x1), C convention: the VGA_8 driver's slot 23 (000a7bcc): writes the run of pixels to row y, columns x0 to x1, of the draw page (offset 0009e604, pan 0009e610, the row times 0xa0), a plane at a time, every fourth pixel, leaving a pixel whose byte is 0 unwritten. While the current clip block's mode (+0x204 of the block 00098d64 points at) is 2 it writes the run once for each region of the block's list holding the row, cut to it: a rect region (type 0) to its columns, a span region (type 2) to its span on that row, any other passed over; in any other mode once, uncut.

entries.name: VGA8_WriteRow
entries.description: (pixels, y, x0, x1), C convention: the VGA_8 driver's slot 22 (000a7bc8): writes the pixels to row y, columns x0 to x1, of the draw page (offset 0009e604, pan 0009e610, the row times 0xa0), a plane at a time through the sequencer's map mask, every byte written.

entries.name: VGA8_ReadRow
entries.description: (pixels, y, x0, x1), C convention: the VGA_8 driver's slot 21 (000a7bc4): reads row y, columns x0 to x1, of the source page (offset 0009e600, pan 0009e60c, the row times 0xa0) into the pixels, a plane at a time through the graphics controller's read map select (port 3CE index 4).

entries.name: Vga_WaitVerticalRetrace
entries.description: Frameless, no arguments: MOV DX,0x3DA; IN AL,DX; TEST AL,8; JZ back: spins until the VGA input-status register reports vertical retrace. ES2's Vga_WaitVerticalRetrace (DBSIM 0045c61c).

entries.name: Vga_WaitRetraceEnd
entries.description: Frameless, with no Ghidra function: MOV DX,0x3da / IN AL,DX / TEST AL,8 / JNZ: spins while the VGA input-status register reports vertical retrace. ES2's Vga_WaitRetraceEnd (DBSIM 0045c626), the same instructions. No reference found by es2_xref.

entries.name: MonoComponentPanel_Init
entries.description: (block), callee-cleaned: ES2's MonoComponentPanel_Init (DBSIM 0045c630): stores block at MonoComponentPanel_Block (000bd900) and block + 2 at the cursor MonoComponentPanel_Cursor (000bd904), Mono_Clear (00060d78), then for each of the 41 label pointers at MonoComponentPanel_Labels (00095ffc) prints the label with Mono_Printf at (MonoComponentPanel_LabelColumn, MonoComponentPanel_Row) (the words MonoComponentPanel_LabelColumn (000bd908), MonoComponentPanel_Row (000bd90a)), zeroes the value at the cursor and prints it with '%d' at MonoComponentPanel_ValueColumn (000bd90c), steps the row and the cursor, and on reaching row 0x17 goes back to row 1 with both columns 0x28 further right; then puts the cursor back at block + 2, the columns at 2 and 0x1e and the row at 1, and prints '>' at (1, 1). ES2's passes '%d' no value. No reference found by es2_xref.
entries.source: Herculan/docs/es1/simulation/debug-monitor.md#the-component-panel; es2_naming.py diff ES1DBSIM 000523b8 DBSIM 0045c630; ES1DBSIM disassembly

entries.name: MonoComponentPanel_CursorDown
entries.description: No arguments, frameless, with no Ghidra function: ES2's MonoComponentPanel_CursorDown (DBSIM 0045c71c): prints ' ' at (MonoComponentPanel_LabelColumn - 1, MonoComponentPanel_Row); unless the cursor is at MonoComponentPanel_Block + 0x52, advances it by 2 and the row by 1, going to row 1 with both columns 0x28 further right on reaching row 0x17; prints '>' at the row. Mono_Printf (00060e78) throughout. No reference found by es2_xref.

entries.name: MonoComponentPanel_CursorUp
entries.description: No arguments, frameless, with no Ghidra function: ES2's MonoComponentPanel_CursorUp (DBSIM 0045c79c): prints ' ' at (MonoComponentPanel_LabelColumn - 1, MonoComponentPanel_Row); unless the cursor is at MonoComponentPanel_Block + 2, moves it back 2 and the row up 1, going to row 0x16 with both columns 0x28 further left on reaching row 0; prints '>' at the row. Mono_Printf (00060e78) throughout. No reference found by es2_xref.

entries.name: MonoComponentPanel_IncreaseValue
entries.description: No arguments, frameless, with no Ghidra function: ES2's MonoComponentPanel_IncreaseValue (DBSIM 0045c81c): adds 0x20 to the int16 at the cursor, holds it to 0xff and prints it with '%d     ' at (MonoComponentPanel_ValueColumn, MonoComponentPanel_Row) through Mono_Printf (00060e78). No reference found by es2_xref.

entries.name: MonoComponentPanel_DecreaseValue
entries.description: No arguments, frameless, with no Ghidra function: ES2's MonoComponentPanel_DecreaseValue (DBSIM 0045c860): subtracts 0x20 from the int16 at the cursor, holds it to 0 and prints it with '%d     ' at (MonoComponentPanel_ValueColumn, MonoComponentPanel_Row) through Mono_Printf (00060e78). No reference found by es2_xref.

entries.name: VGA8_SetSourcePage
entries.description: (page), C convention: the VGA_8 driver's slot 16 (table 000a7b70 +0x40): stores page at 00098dd6, its plane offset (VGA8_PageOffsets (0009e5ce) + 4*page) at 0009e600 and its pan byte (VGA8_PagePans (0009e5f6) + page) shifted right 1 at 0009e60c. ES1GO's VGA8_SetSourcePage with the store of the page added.

entries.name: VGA8_SetDrawPage
entries.description: (page), C convention: the VGA_8 driver's slot 17: VGA8_SetSourcePage (00052644) into 00098dda, 0009e604 and 0009e610, the draw page.

entries.name: VGA8_ShowPage
entries.description: (page), C convention: the VGA_8 driver's slot 18. ES1GO's VGA8_ShowPage (ES1GO 00070216) with the simulator's globals (the wait mode Display_RetraceWaitMode (00098dba), the pan switch Display_PanEnabled (00098dbe), the page tables VGA8_PageOffsets (0009e5ce) and VGA8_PagePans (0009e5f6), the flag VGA8_ShowPageIdle (00098d96), the routines at 0009df50 and 0009df4c while Cursor_Shown (00098d6c) is set, the 8 bytes Cursor_Position (00098d70) and Cursor_PendingPosition (00098d9a)) and two differences: while the word Display_FlipWithoutPan (000bda96) is 1 it skips the wait for the next retrace and the write of the pan to the attribute controller, and it also stores the page at 00098dd2. The offset goes to 0009e608 and the pan >> 1 to 0009e614.
entries.source: Herculan/docs/es1/rendering/screen-pages.md#the-simulators-own-page-routines; ES1DBSIM disassembly at 00052690; es2_naming.py diff ES1DBSIM ES1GO 00052690:00070216

entries.name: VGA8_SetPageOrigin
entries.description: (page, point), C convention: the VGA_8 driver's slot 15. The code of ES1GO's VGA8_SetPageOrigin (ES1GO 00070313), relocated operands aside: the page's offset, the row table VGA8_RowOffsets (0009df8e)'s word for point.y plus point.x >> 2, to VGA8_PageOffsets (0009e5ce) + 4 * page, and its pan, (point.x & 3) * 2 while Display_PanEnabled (00098dbe) is set and 0 otherwise, to the byte VGA8_PagePans (0009e5f6) + page; then VGA8_SetDrawPage (0005266a), VGA8_SetSourcePage (00052644) or VGA8_ShowPage (00052690) when the page is the current draw (00098dda), source (00098dd6) or visible (00098dd2) page.
entries.source: Herculan/docs/es1/rendering/screen-pages.md#the-simulators-own-page-routines; ES1DBSIM disassembly at 0005279d; es2_naming.py match ES1DBSIM ES1GO

entries.name: TSTransformState_Dtor
entries.description: (state, flags) in stack order, callee-cleaned: for a non-null state, destroys the ten 0x16-byte TSContexts at +0x34 with __vec_dtor (000610fd) and TSTransformState_ContextDtor (00052844), and deletes state when bit 0 of flags is set.

entries.name: TSTransformState_ContextDtor
entries.description: (context, flags), frameless, with no Ghidra function: loads the vptr at the context's +0x12 and jumps to its slot +4, the context's destructor, with the arguments as they are.

entries.name: ShapeInst_BindNodeTransformArray
entries.description: (a, nodeTransforms) in stack order, callee-cleaned: ES2's ShapeInst_BindNodeTransformArray (DBSIM 00475fd8): stores the array in g_ShapeNodeWorldTransforms (000bd90e); when it is not null, clears the 0x32-byte flag block g_ShapeNodeTransformCacheFlags (000bd916), saves the renderer's state into slot 0 of g_TSTransformStates (000b1f6c) with Raster_SaveState, sets the block's first byte and sets the installed slot 000bd948 to 0.

entries.name: TSGroup_BindNodeTransform
entries.description: (part, out) in stack order, callee-cleaned: ShapeNode_InstallTransform (000528ac)(part, the part's transform id +4, out). ES2's TSGroup_BindNodeTransform (DBSIM 00476014).

entries.name: ShapeNode_InstallTransform
entries.description: (part, transformId, out) in stack order, callee-cleaned, entered also at its padding 000528ab: ES2's ShapeNode_InstallTransform (DBSIM 00476030). Stores at out + 0x20 the slot installed before it, 000bd948, or -1 when it changes nothing. For a non-negative id whose slot, id + 1, is not the one installed: the first time since the bind (its flag at 000bd917 + id clear) sets the flag, Transform_Concat(g_ShapeNodeWorldTransforms + id * 0x20, g_ShapeObjectModelTransformPtr (000b1f8c), out), Raster_SetModelTransform(out) and Raster_SaveState into slot id + 1 of g_TSTransformStates (0x110 bytes each); later Raster_RestoreState of that slot. A negative id, while a node's state is installed, restores slot 0 and sets the installed slot to 0.

entries.name: Render_NoOp
entries.description: Frameless: RET 8, removing the (part, out) the part draws pass it after drawing. ES2's Render_NoOp (DBSIM 00476118).

entries.name: TSPartBase_FindPart
entries.description: (part, id) in stack order, callee-cleaned: returns part when its id number (+6) equals id, else 0. Slot +0x24 of TSPartBase's vtables and of the other vtables es1_naming.py vtables lists with it, 104 in all. ES2's TSPartBase_FindPart (DBSIM 00476120).

entries.name: TSPartBase_FindPartSlot
entries.description: (part, id), callee-cleaned, no frame: returns 0 (xor eax, eax; ret 8). Slot +0x28 of the vtables holding TSPartBase_FindPart. ES2's TSPartBase_FindPartSlot (DBSIM 00476134).

entries.name: TSBounds_ScreenVisibility
entries.description: (bounds), callee-cleaned: ES2's TSBounds_ScreenVisibility (DBSIM 0047613c), statement for statement: returns 0 unless the near plane Raster_NearPlane is below the radius (+8) plus the centre's (+0xa, +0xc, +0xe) view depth; rebuilds TSBounds_RadiusScale (000b56b8) = 0x1000000 / Math_CosBam(Math_Atan2Bam(1 << Raster_FocalShift, width)) when the render context's (000bdbda) width differs from TSBounds_CachedViewWidth (000960a0); projects the centre and the scaled radius, and returns 0 when the box 3 pixels wider than the circle misses the clip rect (+0x210 to +0x21c), 2 when it lies strictly inside it in clip mode (+0x208) 1, and 1 otherwise.

entries.name: TSBitmapPart_Render
entries.description: (part), callee-cleaned: the draw slot +0x20 of TSBitmapPart. Binds the part's node with TSGroup_BindNodeTransform (00052890), takes the bitmap the tag +0x10 names in the active bank (000bdb5e, its pointer array at +8) and returns at once when it is null. Otherwise, when the centre's view depth is beyond Raster_NearPlane: s = Raster_PerspectiveScale of the depth and the radius * 4, the centre projected to the screen, less Math_Q8Multiply(s, x offset +0x12) and Math_Q8Multiply(s, y offset +0x13), both read signed, and the size {Math_Q8Multiply(s, columns +6), Math_Q8Multiply(s, rows +4)}; when both are below 200, Bitmap_BlitScaled (00067178)(bitmap, size, 0, point). Ends with Render_NoOp (0005298c). ES2's (DBSIM 004762e8) rotates and squashes the quad, reads the y offset unsigned and culls a centre outside +-1000 after the divide instead of the 200 limit.
entries.source: Herculan/docs/es1/formats/dts-shape.md#drawing-and-finding-parts; ES1DBSIM disassembly at 00052b90; es2_naming.py diff ES1DBSIM 00052b90 DBSIM 004762e8

entries.name: TSPartList_Ctor
entries.description: (list), callee-cleaned: allocates 0x16 bytes when list is null and returns null when that fails; stores the vtables 000960a6, 000960ca (TSBase's) and 000960f6 (TSPartBase's) and then TSPartList's 0009612a, and clears the child count +0x10 (word) and the pointer array +0x12 (dword); returns list. ES2's TSPartList_Ctor (DBSIM 00476604).

entries.name: TSPartBase_DtorCopy
entries.description: (part, flags), callee-cleaned: TSPartBase_Dtor (0005d614)'s code with TSPartBase's second vtable 000960f6, whose slot +0x1c holds it: stores that vtable, runs TSBase_Dtor(part, 0) and calls Mem_Delete on part when flags bit 0 is set; returns at once for a null part. TSPartList_Ctor (00052cc0) installs 000960f6. ES2's TSPartBase_Dtor (DBSIM 0049224b).

entries.name: TSPartList_Dtor
entries.description: (list, flags), callee-cleaned: slot +0x1c of TSPartList's vtable 0009612a. Returns at once for a null list; otherwise stores that vtable, calls each non-null child's destructor slot (+0x1c) with flags 3, Mem_Delete on the pointer array +0x12, stores TSPartBase's vtable 000960f6, runs TSBase_Dtor(list, 0) and calls Mem_Delete on list when flags bit 0 is set. ES2's TSPartList_Dtor (DBSIM 00476648).

entries.name: TSPartList_Render
entries.description: (list), callee-cleaned: ES2's TSPartList_Render (DBSIM 004766fc): binds the list's node with TSGroup_BindNodeTransform (00052890), calls each of its +0x10 children's draw slot +0x20 from the pointer array +0x12 in order, and ends with Render_NoOp (0005298c).

entries.name: TSPartList_FindPart
entries.description: (list, id) in stack order, callee-cleaned: ES2's TSPartList_FindPart (DBSIM 00476744): returns the list when its id number (+6) is id, else each child's find slot +0x24 in order until one answers non-zero, and that answer, or 0.

entries.name: TSPartList_FindPartSlot
entries.description: (list, id) in stack order, callee-cleaned: ES2's TSPartList_FindPartSlot (DBSIM 00476784): returns the address of the first entry of the pointer array +0x12 whose child's id number (+6) is id, else each child's slot +0x28 in order until one answers non-zero, and that answer, or 0. The list's own id is not tested.

entries.name: TSCellAnimPart_Render
entries.description: (part), callee-cleaned: ES2's TSCellAnimPart_Render (DBSIM 004767e4): binds the part's node with TSGroup_BindNodeTransform (00052890), draws through slot +0x20 the one child cellFrames[sequence +0x16] % child count, the cell frames at 000bd912, and ends with Render_NoOp (0005298c).

entries.name: TSDetailPart_Ctor
entries.description: (part), callee-cleaned: allocates 0x1a bytes when part is null and returns null when that fails; runs TSPartList_Ctor, stores TSDetailPart's vtable 00096162 and clears the threshold pointer +0x16; returns part. ES2's TSDetailPart_Ctor (DBSIM 00476834).

entries.name: TSDetailPart_Dtor
entries.description: (part, flags), callee-cleaned: slot +0x1c of TSDetailPart's vtable 00096162. Returns at once for a null part; otherwise stores that vtable, calls Mem_Delete on the thresholds +0x16, runs TSPartList_Dtor(part, 0) and calls Mem_Delete on part when flags bit 0 is set. ES2's TSDetailPart_Dtor (DBSIM 0047685c).

entries.name: TSDetailPart_SetSizeScale
entries.description: (scale), frameless, with no Ghidra function: stores the word scale in g_TSDetailPartSizeScaleQ10 (0009615a) and returns with RET 4. ES2's TSDetailPart_SetSizeScale (DBSIM 0047689c). No reference found by es2_xref.

entries.name: TSDetailPart_SetBias
entries.description: (bias), callee-cleaned, frameless: stores its argument at g_TSDetailPartBias (0009615c) and returns. ES2's TSDetailPart_SetBias (DBSIM 004768ac).

entries.name: TSDetailPart_Render
entries.description: (part), callee-cleaned: ES2's TSDetailPart_Render (DBSIM 004768bc): binds the part's node with TSGroup_BindNodeTransform (00052890); size = (radius << Raster_FocalShift) / max(Math_FastMagnitude3D(g_EyeInModelSpace) - radius, 1), at least 1; t = Math_Q10Multiply(size, g_TSDetailPartSizeScaleQ10 (0009615a)); from i = g_TSDetailPartBias (0009615c), steps i while i < count - 1 and the threshold i (+0x16) is below t; draws child min(i - bias, count - 1) through slot +0x20 and ends with Render_NoOp (0005298c).

entries.name: TSBSPPart_Ctor
entries.description: (part), callee-cleaned: allocates 0x20 bytes when part is null and returns null when that fails; runs TSPartList_Ctor, stores TSBSPPart's vtable 00096196, and clears the node count +0x16 (word) and the node and transform-id pointers +0x18 and +0x1c; returns part. ES2's TSBSPPart_Ctor (DBSIM 004769a0).

entries.name: TSBSPPart_Dtor
entries.description: (part, flags), callee-cleaned: slot +0x1c of TSBSPPart's vtable 00096196. Returns at once for a null part; otherwise stores that vtable, calls __vec_delete(0, 0xe, 7, nodes +0x18), which with no destructor and flags bit 0 set calls Mem_Delete on the address 4 bytes before the nodes, calls Mem_Delete on the transform ids +0x1c, runs TSPartList_Dtor(part, 0) and calls Mem_Delete on part when flags bit 0 is set. ES2's TSBSPPart_Dtor (DBSIM 004769d4) frees the nodes with Mem_DeleteArray.

entries.name: TSBSPPart_RenderNode
entries.description: (part, node) in stack order, callee-cleaned, entered also at its padding 0005323d: ES2's TSBSPPart_RenderNode (DBSIM 00476a1c) with no depth-buffer flag. For the 14-byte node at +0x18 and its transform id at +0x1c: d = DotProductVec3Int(the node's normal, the eye 000b56ac), or for an id other than -1 Transform_LocalPointDotNormal (000733c0)(the eye, g_ShapeNodeWorldTransforms + id * 0x20, the normal), less the node's int32 coefficient; with d < 0 the front entry (+0xa) first and the back (+0xc) second, otherwise the back first. An entry below 0 draws nothing, one with bit 0x4000 draws child (entry & 0x3fff) through slot +0x20, and any other recurses into that node.

entries.name: TSBSPPart_Render
entries.description: (part), callee-cleaned: ES2's TSBSPPart_Render (DBSIM 00476b0c): binds the part's node with TSGroup_BindNodeTransform (00052890), copies g_EyeInModelSpace to 000b56ac, walks the tree from node 0 with TSBSPPart_RenderNode (00053240) and ends with Render_NoOp (0005298c).

entries.name: TSTransformState_StaticInit
entries.description: No arguments, frameless, with no Ghidra function: the static initializer (static constructor table entry 000adc6c): __vec_ctor (000610cb)(TSTransformState_Ctor's padding entry 000533d7, 0x34, 0x110, g_TSTransformStates (000b1f6c)), 52 states of 0x110 bytes. ES2's TSTransformState_StaticInit (DBSIM 00476b64).

entries.name: TSTransformState_StaticDtor
entries.description: No arguments, frameless, with no Ghidra function: the exit routine (exit table entry 000adccc): __vec_dtor (000610fd)(TSTransformState_Dtor (00052814), 0x34, 0x110, g_TSTransformStates (000b1f6c)). ES2's TSTransformState_StaticDtor (DBSIM 00476ba4).

entries.name: TSTransformState_Ctor
entries.description: (state), callee-cleaned, entered also at its padding 000533d7: allocates 0x110 bytes when state is null and returns 0 when that fails; the inlined constructors of its members test the allocation again at sizes 0x20, 0x14, 0xc and 8; builds the ten 0x16-byte TSContexts at +0x34 with __vec_ctor (000610cb) and TSContext_Ctor; returns state. ES2's TSTransformState_Ctor (DBSIM 00476bc0).

entries.name: VGA8_FillBitmapPolygon
entries.description: (count, points), C convention: the VGA_8 driver's table +0x84 (0009df58), which Raster_DrawPolygonDispatch calls for brush modes 5 and 7. Reads the brush at the clip block's (00098d64) +0x228: +8 the int32 {u, v} texture points, +0xc the bitmap header, +0x10 the colour table only for mode 7 (0 otherwise). Nothing for fewer than 3 points, a polygon with no height or no width, or one wholly outside the clip rect +0x20c..+0x218; one whose smallest y is above the rect's top is cut there with VGA8_BitmapPolyClipTop into 000b56d0/000b57d4 and redone. Walks by columns when the clip mode +0x204 is not 2 (edges from the first leftmost vertex, A forward and B backward, VGA8_BitmapEdgeSetupColumns/StepColumns, x in 000bd950, VGA8_SpanBitmapColumn per column from the rect's left) and by rows when it is 2 (from the first topmost vertex, A backward and B forward, the Rows pair, y in 000bd94c, VGA8_SpanBitmapRow from the rect's top); stops when either edge ends at the far vertex, past the rect's far side, or when A's other coordinate exceeds B's, so the far vertex's column or row is never drawn. ES2's Raster_FillBitmapPolygon (DBSIM 0048a818) walks rows only.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile and disassembly at 000534ac (mode test 0005350b, clip and walk loops 00053610-0005385d); driver table 000a7b70 +0x84 read from the image

entries.name: VGA8_BitmapPolyPointCtor
entries.description: (p), callee-cleaned: the empty constructor of an 8-byte int32 point, allocating 8 bytes when p is null; VGA8_FillBitmapPolygon's element constructor for its two 32-point clip buffers 000b56d0 and 000b57d4, built on first use (flags 000b56cc, 000b57d0).
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 00053864 and its __vec_ctor calls in 000534ac

entries.name: VGA8_BitmapPolyClipTop
entries.description: (top, texOut, pointsOut, countOut, texIn, pointsIn, countIn) in stack order, callee-cleaned: cuts a polygon and its texture points at y = top, keeping y >= top. Walking the ring from vertex 0, emits each vertex with y >= top and, when the edge to the next vertex crosses, the crossing c = c_i + (top - y_i) * (c_n - c_i) / (y_n - y_i) for each of x, u and v, from the vertex the edge leaves, the division truncating; the new count goes to countOut.

entries.name: VGA8_BitmapEdgeStepRows
entries.description: (edge), callee-cleaned: steps a row-walk edge of VGA8_FillBitmapPolygon one row: decrements +4 and at 0 starts the next edge from vertex +8 with VGA8_BitmapEdgeSetupRows, returning 0 when that fails; otherwise adds +0x14 to u +0xc, +0x18 to v +0x10, +0x20 to x +0x1c, +0x2c to the error +0x28 and, when the error is positive, +0x24 (+-1) to x and subtracts +0x30. Returns 1. ES2's Raster_BitmapEdgeStep (DBSIM 0048a944).
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 000539e4; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 0048a944

entries.name: VGA8_BitmapEdgeStepColumns
entries.description: (edge), callee-cleaned: VGA8_BitmapEdgeStepRows for a column-walk edge, starting the next edge with VGA8_BitmapEdgeSetupColumns; +0x1c is then the edge's y.

entries.name: VGA8_BitmapEdgeSetupRows
entries.description: (vertex, edge), callee-cleaned: starts a row-walk edge of VGA8_FillBitmapPolygon from vertex: steps the index by the edge's +0 (+-1, wrapping round the count 000b56c0) past vertices with the same y, and returns 0 on reaching the far vertex 000b56bc. Otherwise stores the row count dy at +4, the next vertex at +8, u and v (texture point << 16) at +0xc/+0x10 and their steps Math_Q16Divide(du << 16, dy << 16) at +0x14/+0x18, x at +0x1c, its whole step dx / dy at +0x20, the +-1 carry at +0x24, the error at +0x28 (0, or 1 - dy for a leftward edge), the remainder |dx| % dy at +0x2c and dy at +0x30, so step k's x is x0 + ceil(k * dx / dy); returns 1. ES2's Raster_BitmapEdgeSetup (DBSIM 0048a9a0).
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 00053a94; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 0048a9a0

entries.name: VGA8_BitmapEdgeSetupColumns
entries.description: (vertex, edge), callee-cleaned: VGA8_BitmapEdgeSetupRows with x and y exchanged: the count is the vertices' x difference, +0x1c the edge's y and its steps from the y difference.

entries.name: Raster_FillRect
entries.description: (rect), C convention: fills the inclusive rect {x0, y0, x1, y1} with the brush at the installed clip block's +0x228 (the block 00098d64 points at). Brush mode 0 fills through g_RasterRoutines slot 2 (0009dedc), mode 6 remaps through slot 3 (0009dee0), and mode 4 draws the rect's outline with Raster_DrawLine under a temporary pen at +0x224; a colour whose top byte is 4 is read from the colour-ramp records at 0009a6f5. The rect moves by the block's translation when +0x208 is set and is clipped by its mode +0x204: 0 none, 1 the rect at +0x20c (Rect_Intersect (00073dc4)), otherwise each region of the list at +0, a rect region through Rect_Intersect (00073dc4) and a span region through SpanList_FromRect (00073d8c) and SpanRegion_Intersect (00073b7c). ES2's Raster_FillRect (DBSIM 004865f8), statement for statement.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 00053d9c, against ES2's Raster_FillRect

entries.name: TSNullObj_Render
entries.description: Frameless: RET 4. Slot +0x20 of the vtable 0009b0da, which es2_xref finds stored at 00067512 and 00067545, in TSNullObj's load function. ES2's TSNullObj_Render (DBSIM 00474da4).

entries.name: TSPoly_Render
entries.description: Frameless: RET 4. Slot +0x20 of the vtable 0009b132, which es2_xref finds stored 16 times by the poly classes' load functions from 00067603 to 0006824b, and of 000929ea and 00092b5a. ES2's TSPoly_Render (DBSIM 00474dac).

entries.name: TSSolidPoly_Render
entries.description: (this), callee-cleaned: TSSolidPoly's vtable (0009b19a) slot +0x20. ES2's TSSolidPoly_Render (DBSIM 00474db4) without the .RMP: the chosen surface entries go to the brush colour 000b5f04 and PolyFill_LineColour as they are, brush mode 0, Poly_ProjectShapeVertices, Poly_ClipRingToNearPlane when needed, PolyFill_FillThenOutline(back).

entries.name: TSTexture4Poly_Render
entries.description: (this), callee-cleaned: TSTexture4Poly's vtable (0009b1d2) slot +0x20. Picks the front or back value by ES2's -1 rule, takes that frame of the active bitmap bank (000bdb5e +8), and fills through the brush {7, the ring's point count, corners, the frame's bitmap header, table} at the render context's +0x22c (then PolyFill_FillBrush): the texture points are the frame's corners (0,0), (cols-1,0), (cols-1,rows-1), (0,rows-1) at 000b58d8 (Poly_ClipRingToNearPlaneWithUV into 000b59dc when clipped, the count then the clip's); table is 0 while 000973f4 is 0, else 000973f0[(000973f4 - 1) * light / 255] with Light_ComputeShadeForFace's light, the normal negated for a back face. Fills with PolyFill_FillThenOutline (0005d2f0)(reversed), reversed 0 for the front value and 1 for the back value, with no winding test.

entries.name: TSTexture4Poly_PointElementCtor
entries.description: (p), callee-cleaned, entered also at its padding 000543c5-000543c7: returns p, or 8 new bytes when p is null; the code of VGA8_BitmapPolyPointCtor (00053864). es2_xref finds the padding entries stored at 000542cb and 000542ed, in TSTexture4Poly_Render (0005410c), which builds its texture point buffers with it, and at 0000acec and 000184b4.

entries.name: TSShadedPoly_Render
entries.description: (this), callee-cleaned: TSShadedPoly's vtable (0009b1fe) slot +0x20. As TSSolidPoly_Render (0005403c), after ORing (Light_ComputeShadeForFace & 0xff) << 16, the normal negated for a back face, into both colours, so a top byte of 4 picks that ramp entry from g_RasterColourRamps (0009a6f5). VSHELL's TSShadedPoly_Render (00423024) does the same; ES2's DBSIM one uses Palette_ShadeRampLookup and the .RMP.

entries.name: TSGouraudPoly_Render
entries.description: (this), callee-cleaned: TSGouraudPoly's vtable (0009b22a) slot +0x20. ES2's TSGouraudPoly_Render (DBSIM 004755c8): a Light_ComputeShadeForFace light per corner from the normal list (+0xe) and vertex list (+0xa), normals negated for a back face, into a stack array that 000b5f0c points at (through Poly_ClipRingToNearPlaneWithShade when clipped), brush mode 1, PolyFill_FillThenOutline(back).

entries.name: TSGroup_Ctor
entries.description: (this), callee-cleaned: TSGroup's constructor, ES2's TSGroup_Ctor (DBSIM 004757a8): allocates 0x28 bytes for a null this, returning 0 when that fails; stores the vptrs 000961ca and 000961ee, runs the inlined constructor of a 6-byte member at +0xa, stores 0009621a and then TSGroup's 0009624e, zeroes +0x10, +0x14, +0x18 and +0x1c, and returns this. es2_xref finds three calls, one from Hzline_Ctor (00026180).

entries.name: TSPartBase_DtorGroupCopy
entries.description: (part, flags) in stack order, callee-cleaned, entered also at its padding 0005485b: slot +0x1c of the vtable 0009621a, a copy of TSPartBase's table that TSGroup_Ctor and TSGroup_Dtor store: stores 0009621a, runs TSBase_Dtor(part, 0) and deletes part when bit 0 of flags is set. The code of TSPartBase_Dtor (0005d614), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: TSGroup_Dtor
entries.description: (group, flags), callee-cleaned: slot +0x1c of TSGroup's vtable 0009624e (entered at its padding 00054886). For a non-null group stores 0009624e, Mem_Delete (000015f8) of +0x10, __vec_delete of +0x14, Mem_Delete of +0x18; calls slot +0x1c with flags 3 on each non-null pointer of the uint16 count +0x26 in the array +0x1c and deletes the array; stores 0009621a, calls TSBase_Dtor (0005ba58)(group, 0) and Mem_Delete on flags bit 0. ES2's TSGroup_Dtor (DBSIM 004757f4), which counts destructors and frees +0x14 as a plain array.

entries.name: TSGroup_RenderPolys
entries.description: (group), callee-cleaned: TSGroup's draw slot +0x20. ES2's TSGroup_RenderPolys (DBSIM 004758c8): binds the group's node with TSGroup_BindNodeTransform (00052890); saves the render context's (000bdbda) line brush +0x228, fill brush +0x22c and +0x20c, installs PolyFill_LineBrush and PolyFill_FillBrush and sets +0x20c to 0; binds the surfaces +0x18 (000b6732), the colour count +0x22 (000b672c), the points +0x14 (Poly_ShortPoints) and the indexes +0x10 (Poly_IndexList, 000bdb62 when null), clearing Poly_PointState over the colour count; calls each of the +0x26 polys' draw slot +0x20 from +0x1c in order; puts the three back and ends with Render_NoOp (0005298c).

entries.name: TSBSPGroup_Ctor
entries.description: (group), callee-cleaned: allocates 0x2e bytes when group is null, returning 0 when that fails; runs TSGroup_Ctor (000547b4), stores the vtable 00096282 and clears the word +0x28 and the node array +0x2a. ES2's TSBSPGroup_Ctor (DBSIM 004759b4). es2_xref finds one call, from 00068908.

entries.name: TSBSPGroup_Dtor
entries.description: (group, flags) in stack order, callee-cleaned: slot +0x1c of 00096282. For a non-null group stores 00096282, deletes the node array +0x2a, runs TSGroup_Dtor (00054888)(group, 0) and deletes group when bit 0 of flags is set. ES2's TSBSPGroup_Dtor (DBSIM 004759e0).

entries.name: TSBSPGroup_RenderNode
entries.description: (group, node) in stack order, callee-cleaned, entered also at its padding 00054aa3: ES2's TSBSPGroup_RenderNode (DBSIM 00475a20): for the 10-byte node at +0x2a, d = DotProductVec3Int(the node poly's normal point, g_EyeInModelSpace) less the node's int32 constant; with d < 0 the +6 entry, the node's poly, then the +8 entry, otherwise +8 first. An entry below 0 draws nothing, one with bit 0x4000 draws poly (entry & 0x3fff) through slot +0x20, any other recurses.

entries.name: TSBSPGroup_Render
entries.description: (group), callee-cleaned, entered also at its padding 00054bbb: slot +0x20 of 00096282. ES2's TSBSPGroup_Render (DBSIM 00475af8): TSGroup_RenderPolys' set-up and restore, drawing through TSBSPGroup_RenderNode (00054aa4) from node 0 in place of the poly walk.

entries.name: TSAliasSolidPoly_Render
entries.description: (poly), callee-cleaned: the draw slot of TSAliasSolidPoly's vtable 0009b266. The code of TSSolidPoly_Render (0005403c), relocated operands aside, but for the fill, which goes through PolyFill_FillThenOutline_Thunk (0005d3c0) where that calls PolyFill_FillThenOutline (0005d2f0). ES2's TSAliasSolidPoly_Render (DBSIM 00475bc4).
entries.source: Herculan/docs/es1/rendering/polygon-shading.md#the-four-poly-types; es2_naming.py match ES1DBSIM ES1GO and diff ES1DBSIM 00054c9c DBSIM 00475bc4

entries.name: TSAliasShadedPoly_Render
entries.description: (poly), callee-cleaned: the draw slot of TSAliasShadedPoly's vtable 0009b292. The code of TSShadedPoly_Render (000543e4), relocated operands aside, but for the fill, which goes through PolyFill_FillThenOutline_Thunk (0005d3c0) where that calls PolyFill_FillThenOutline (0005d2f0). ES2's TSAliasShadedPoly_Render (DBSIM 00475c80).
entries.source: Herculan/docs/es1/rendering/polygon-shading.md#the-four-poly-types; es2_naming.py match ES1DBSIM ES1GO and diff ES1DBSIM 00054d6c DBSIM 00475c80

entries.name: TSAliasGouraudPoly_Render
entries.description: (poly), callee-cleaned: the draw slot of TSAliasGouraudPoly's vtable 0009b2be. The code of TSGouraudPoly_Render (00054578), relocated operands aside, but for the fill, which goes through PolyFill_FillThenOutline_Thunk (0005d3c0) where that calls PolyFill_FillThenOutline (0005d2f0). ES2's TSAliasGouraudPoly_Render (DBSIM 00475de0).

entries.name: ClassItem_RegisterBucket
entries.description: (count, entries) in stack order, callee-cleaned: when count is nonzero, appends {entries, count} to the bucket list at 000bd958 (8 bytes per bucket, entries first) and increments its count 000962b4. Light_ResetSystem (000632ec) registers g_TSObjectTypeRegistry with it. ES2's ClassItem_RegisterBucket (DBSIM 00479fac).

entries.name: ClassItem_RegisterProbeBucket
entries.description: (count, entries) in stack order, callee-cleaned: ES2's ClassItem_RegisterProbeBucket (DBSIM 00479fdc): when count is not 0, raises ClassItem_ProbeHeaderSize (000962bc) over the 12-byte entries' +8 dwords as ES2's does, appends {entries, count} to the probe buckets at 000bd9f8 and increments their count 000962b8. No reference found by es2_xref.

entries.name: ClassItem_LoadResource
entries.description: (mode, stream) in stack order, callee-cleaned: loads one class item. Points ClassItem_CurrentFrame (000b5adc) at a frame on its stack, reads the 8-byte type tag with ClassItem_ReadTypeTag (00055754), and for a tag other than -1 looks its handler up with 000554e2 and calls the handler's load function (+4) with (mode, stream); then runs 0005591d on the stream, restores the frame pointer and returns the item, or 0. ES2's ClassItem_LoadResource (DBSIM 0047a038), statement for statement.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 000551e0, against ES2's ClassItem_LoadResource

entries.name: ClassItem_StoreItem
entries.description: (item, mode, stream) in stack order, callee-cleaned: writes one class item. Points ClassItem_CurrentFrame at a frame on its stack and restores it on exit. When the item's body length (vtable +8) is 0 and the stream's slot +0x10 answers query 3 with 0, it makes a stream over the stream on its stack (00073f34(local, 0, 0, stream)), opens the item in it (ClassItem_OpenItemForWrite (000556cc)) with the item's tag (vtable +4), calls the item's write slot (+0x14) with (mode, that stream), closes the item (ClassItem_CloseItemForWrite (00055860)) and destroys the stream (00073fd0, flags 2); otherwise it runs the same open, write and close on the stream itself. ES2's ClassItem_StoreItem (DBSIM 0047a0a0).

entries.name: Arena_Alloc
entries.description: (arena, size) in stack order, callee-cleaned: bump-allocates from an arena {base +0, limit +4, cursor +8}: when arena is non-null and cursor + size is at most the limit it returns base + cursor and advances the cursor by size; otherwise it returns Mem_New(size). ES2's Arena_Alloc (DBSIM 0047a1bc).

entries.name: ClassItem_PeekTypeTag
entries.description: (tag, stream) in stack order, callee-cleaned: saves the stream position (slot +8), reads the 8-byte type tag into tag (-1, 0 beforehand) through the read slot (+0x1c) and, when no handler is registered for it (through the thunk to ClassItem_FindHandler (000554e4)) and 000962b8 is set, copies it to ClassItem_ProbeHeader (000bda48), reads the rest of the header (ClassItem_ProbeHeaderSize (000962bc) less 8 bytes) into 000bda50 and calls ClassItem_TryEveryLoader (00055568) through its thunk; seeks back (slot +0xc) unless the status (+0) is 2; returns status == 0. ES2's ClassItem_PeekTypeTag (DBSIM 0047a1fc).

entries.name: ClassItem_Skip
entries.description: (stream), callee-cleaned: reads a class item's 8-byte type tag and seeks past its body, the tag's second dword rounded up to an even length; returns status == 0. ES2's ClassItem_Skip (DBSIM 0047a2a8).

entries.name: ArenaStack_Push
entries.description: (cursor, limit, base) in stack order, callee-cleaned: increments the depth 000962c0, stores {base, limit, cursor} in the 12-byte entry at 000b5ae0 + depth * 12, points the current arena 000bd954 at it and returns base. ES2's ArenaStack_Push (DBSIM 0047a2f0).

entries.name: ArenaStack_PushAlloc
entries.description: (size), callee-cleaned: ES2's ArenaStack_PushAlloc (DBSIM 0047a324), through Arena_Alloc (000552f8)(the current arena 000bd954, size) where ES2's calls Arena_AllocDup: carves size bytes from the current arena, increments the depth 000962c0, stores {block, size, 0} in the entry at 000b5ae0 + depth * 12, makes it the current arena and returns block. No reference found by es2_xref.

entries.name: ArenaStack_Pop
entries.description: No arguments: decrements the depth 000962c0 and points the current arena 000bd954 at the entry below, or at null when the depth has gone negative (a signed test). ES2's ArenaStack_Pop (DBSIM 0047a368), whose test of the depth (TEST, JNC) can never take its null branch.

entries.name: ClassItem_FindHandler
entries.description: (tag), callee-cleaned, entered also at its padding 000554e2: ES2's ClassItem_FindHandler (DBSIM 0047a394): returns the first 12-byte {tag, load function, name} entry, in the buckets ClassItem_RegisterBucket appends at 000bd958 (count 000962b4), whose tag matches, or 0.

entries.name: ClassItem_TryEveryLoader
entries.description: (tag, stream) in stack order, callee-cleaned, entered also at its padding 00055567: ES2's ClassItem_TryEveryLoader (DBSIM 0047a3d8): calls each probe bucket entry's function (+4) with (stream, tag, ClassItem_ProbeHeader (000bda48)) in stack order and returns 1 at the first that answers non-zero, 0 when none does.

entries.name: ClassItem_TagTotalSize
entries.description: (tag), callee-cleaned: an item's total length from its 8-byte type tag: the dword at +4 as it is when the high nibble of byte 3 is set, otherwise that dword + 9 with bit 0 cleared, the length with the tag rounded up to an even count. ES2's ClassItem_TagTotalSize (DBSIM 0047a434).

entries.name: ClassItem_ItemTotalSize
entries.description: (item), callee-cleaned: builds {tag = vtable +4, length = vtable +8} on its stack and returns ClassItem_TagTotalSize (000555ec) of it, or 0 when the length is 0. ES2's ClassItem_ItemTotalSize (DBSIM 0047a450).

entries.name: ClassItem_DebugPrintType
entries.description: (item, indent, unused) in stack order, callee-cleaned: prints indent spaces and 'Class type: %d:%d' with the high and low words of the item's tag (vtable +4) to stdout, then ' "%s"' with the name in the handler entry ClassItem_FindHandler (000554e4) finds for the tag, when it finds one, and a newline. ES2's ClassItem_DebugPrintType (DBSIM 0047a488).

entries.name: ClassItem_OpenItemForWrite

entries.description: No arguments: the death flash, ES2's Sim_DeathFlash (DBSIM 0045dc34). Loads dpl\death1, dpl\death2 and dpl\world0 with Palette_LoadDpl (00063584), each path from ResourcePath_BuildFolderName (00060698) with the folder name the dword 000980d0 points at, dpl; Sound_StopDigitalSounds (0004e34c); the shake's end = the clock 000981c4 + 30; CockpitView_SetShakeBand (000243d4)(10); Sound_Play (0004de84)(0x26); Palette_InstallRange (00027e98)(the colors death1's dword +8 points at, 0xff, 0); Palette_BeginCrossFade (00028528)(0x78, death2, death1), then while Palette_StepCrossFade (000287a8) answers more than 0x14, compared unsigned: Sim_EndFrame (00059b40), CockpitView_StepShake (00024564)(Math_RandomBelow (00063b3c)(000b5c48, 10)) while the clock is below the shake's end, compared unsigned, and Sim_RenderFrame (00059c08). Then Palette_BeginCrossFade(0x78, 0, death2) and, while Palette_StepCrossFade answers non-zero, Sim_EndFrame and Sim_RenderFrame. Then the raster slot 35 (0009df60), C convention, with (+0x88, 0) and then (+0x8c, 0) of the display 000bdd28; Palette_InstallRange(world0's colors, 0xff, 0); Sim_EndFrame; StatusAlertPanel_Ctor (00046efc)(0, 0, 0, 2), run through slot +0xc of its +0x314, its answer unused, and GeneralAlert_Dtor (000472b0)(panel, 3). es2_xref finds one call, from Sim_MainTick (00059700), for status 2.
