entries.name: Music_Tick
entries.description: No arguments; es2_xref finds calls from Sim_FrameSoundTick (00058574) and Prefs_ApplyMusicOption (0004ad0c). It does nothing without the sound manager Sound_Manager (000959ac) or with preferences option 0 (Prefs_Options (000bd562)) clear. On the first call (Music_Song Music_Song (00096d0c) at -1) it picks song Math_RandomBelow (00063b3c)(000b5c48, 3), Sound_Preload (0004dde0), Music_SongObject (00096d14), Music_Battle (00096d0e) 0 and Music_NextCheck (00096d10) now + 300, now being 000981c4. While Music_Switching (00096d18) is set it lowers the song's SoundObject_GetVolume (0005049c) by 15 through slot +0x2c and returns, and at 0 Sound_Stop (0004df70) and moves Music_Song by +3 (battle) or -3 (calm), preloads it and sets it to 100. Past Music_NextCheck it walks LiveObjectList for an object not disabled (+0x9e) or destroyed (+0x93) whose group (+0x3f) has no action (+0x16) and side byte +0x14 1, seen when TargetSelect_CanTarget (0002d624) and TargetSelect_InForwardCone (0002d71c) answer non-zero from CockpitViewInstance or within 25000 of the player: in battle a seen one returns; calm, it starts the switch to battle. In battle with none seen it switches to calm unless g_FlyerPool holds a flyer not disabled or destroyed more than 0x49f0 from the player. Last, Sound_Play (0004de84)(song) when Sound_IsPlaying (0004e05c) answers 0.

entries.name: ViewChain_Apply
entries.description: No arguments; es2_xref finds one call, from Sim_MainTick (00059700). ES2's ViewChain_Apply (DBSIM 0045de14) on CockpitViewManagerPublished's step flag +0x18. With it clear, in view 3 viewing LocalPlayerMech, copies ViewChain_CameraControlPreferred (000b5bb8) to InputDrivesCamera. With it set and ViewChain_PendingView not ViewChain_View, copies it over: view 1 sets the camera's mode +0x36 to 0 and InputDrivesCamera to ViewChain_CameraControlPreferred (000b5bb8); view 2 ViewChain_ViewObject (00058a44)(LocalPlayerMech), mode 2, InputDrivesCamera 0; view 3 ViewChain_ViewObject(ViewChain_Chosen), mode 1, ViewChain_CaptionFrames 2. Then while ViewChain_CaptionFrames is not 0, ViewChain_DrawCaption (00058b68) and 1 off the count. ES2's has view 4, follows ViewChain_Chosen in view 2 under ViewChain_FollowChosen, and tests the camera lock +0x4a.

entries.name: Sim_Main
entries.description: (argc, argv), main.cpp: the simulator's main. Mem_InitHeap(6000000), asserting at severity 5 (line 0xe3) when it gives 100000 bytes or fewer; Sim_PreParseCommandLine (00058e30)(argv, argc); copies to 000b5d9c, for 00056ecc, the ALT_DRIVE variable (taken as null unless Sim_AltDriveAllowed (000b5bce) is set) when PREFER_ALT is set and the empty string otherwise; writes the heap size (4 bytes) to data\mem.got and an int16 0 to data\exit.cfg, asserting (lines 0xf1, 0xf9) when either does not open; Sim_ParseCommandLine (00058e74)(argv, argc). No reference found by es2_xref. ES2's Math_RateLimitedMoveTowardInt (DBSIM 00467a24).

entries.name: Slew_Step
entries.description: (slew), callee-cleaned: advances a Slew one step and returns its position (+6, int16). With the error = target (+8) - position: when the error and the velocity (+0xa) do not have opposite signs and the error is inside the settle band (+4), the velocity becomes error >> shift (+0x10, arithmetic) and the acceleration (+0xc) 0; when they do not have opposite signs and the error is outside it, the acceleration moves toward the limit (+0) by the jerk (+2) and the velocity toward the top speed (+0xe) in the error's direction by the acceleration, both through Math_RateLimitedMoveToward; when they have opposite signs, the acceleration moves toward the limit the same way and the velocity steps toward the target by it, held at the error. The position then adds the velocity. No reference found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Slew_Ctor
entries.description: (slew, top speed, shift) in stack order, callee-cleaned: a Slew's constructor, allocating 0x12 bytes when slew is null. Stores the top speed (+0xe, uint16) and the shift (+0x10, byte), zeroes the velocity (+0xa) and the acceleration (+0xc), and derives the acceleration limit +0 = top speed >> shift and the jerk +2 = limit >> shift, each raised to 1 when 0, and the settle band +4 = top speed << shift. Leaves the position (+6) and target (+8) as they were. Returns slew. No reference found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Math_Q8Multiply
entries.description: (int a, int16 b), C convention: Q8 multiply rounded to nearest. IMUL of a by the sign-extended b, then SBB/XOR adds 0x80 when the product fits in 32 bits and 0xffffff7f when it does not, and SHRD EAX,EDX,8. ES2's Math_Q8Multiply (DBSIM 0047df94) truncates.

entries.name: Math_Q10Multiply
entries.description: (int a, int16 b), C convention: Q10 multiply rounded to nearest. Math_Q8Multiply's body with 0x200 (0xfffffdff when the product overflows 32 bits) and a shift of 10. ES2's Math_Q10Multiply (DBSIM 0047dfa4) truncates.

entries.name: Math_Q14Multiply
entries.description: (int a, int16 b), C convention: Q14 multiply rounded to nearest. Math_Q8Multiply's body with 0x2000 (0xffffdfff when the product overflows 32 bits) and a shift of 14. ES2's Math_Q14Multiply (DBSIM 0047dfb4) truncates.

entries.name: Transform_ApplyToShortPoint
entries.description: (point, transform, out), C convention: transforms an int16 point by a 32-byte transform into an int32 result, rotation then translation, Q14 with +0x2000 rounding. Rank byte (+0x12) below 1: translation only; 1: rotates x and y only and passes z through; otherwise the full 3x3. ES2's Transform_ApplyToShortPoint (DBSIM 004800c8), whose decompile is the same after normalisation.

entries.name: Transform_RotationToEuler
entries.description: (rotation, out), C convention: out[0] = Math_AsinBam(m[5]); at a quarter turn either way out[1] = 0 and out[2] = Math_Atan2Bam(m[0], m[1]), otherwise out[1] = Math_Atan2Bam(m[8], -m[4]) and out[2] = Math_Atan2Bam(m[3], -m[2]). ES2's Transform_RotationToEuler (DBSIM 0047f894), whose decompile is the same after normalisation.

entries.name: Transform_Concat
entries.description: (a, b, out), C convention: composes two 32-byte transforms (nine Q14 int16 matrix entries, the rank byte +0x12, int translations +0x14, +0x18, +0x1c): out's rotation is a's times b's, each entry rounded (+0x2000 >> 14), and out's translation is a's rotated by b's rotation (64-bit, rounded) plus b's. A rank of 0 or less copies the other's rotation; two rank-1 operands (2x2) give a rank-1 result with +0x10 = 0x4000; anything else is rank 2. es2_naming.py diff finds it identical to ES2's Transform_Concat (DBSIM 0047f914).
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 0005ea08, against ES2's Transform_Concat

entries.name: Transform_RotatePoint
entries.description: (point, transform, out), C convention: Transform_ApplyToPoint without the translation -- the rotation alone on an int32 point, Q14 with +0x2000 rounding and 64-bit intermediates, with the rank-byte fast paths. ES2's Transform_RotatePoint (DBSIM 004801f8), whose decompile is the same after normalisation.

ES2's BuildEulerRotationMatrixQ14 (DBSIM 0047eaac), whose decompile is the same after normalisation.

entries.name: Math_AsinBam
entries.description: (sine), C convention: the arcsine of a Q14 sine as a binary angle. Takes the magnitude, rounded to a multiple of 4 (SAR 2, ADC 0); below 0xe00 it reads the coarse table 00097634 at a further 8x step, rounded the same way, and from 0xe00 the fine table addressed from 00095db4 (its entries from 0xe00 on lie at 000979b4); the sign is restored at the end. entries.name: Transform_ApplyToPoint
entries.description: (point, transform, out), C convention: transforms an int32 point by a 32-byte transform, rotation then translation, Q14 with +0x2000 rounding and 64-bit intermediates. Rank byte (+0x12) below 1: translation only; 1: rotates x and y only and passes z through; otherwise the full 3x3. entries.name: fprintf
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `fprintf`, from `printf.c`: (stream, format, ...), C convention: returns vfprintf(stream, format, the address of the arguments after format). Symantec C++ 6.1's code for it matches here and at sprintf (0005f77c), as does its code for spawnl and spawnlp; the call to vfprintf settles it.

entries.name: vfprintf
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `vfprintf`, from `printf.c`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. The match covers 27 bytes from here.

entries.name: printf
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `printf`, from `printf.c`: (format, ...), C convention: returns vprintf(format, the address of the arguments after format). Symantec C++ 6.1's code for printf, execl and execlp matches here; the call to vprintf settles it.

entries.name: vprintf
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `vprintf`, from `printf.c`: (format, args), C convention: formats through _pformat (0005f7ca) with fputc onto stdout (_iob's second FILE, 0009e864), then calls fflush (000753e8) on stdout when bit 0x40 of its flags word (+0xc) is set, and returns the formatter's result.

entries.name: Printf_StoreChar
entries.description: (c, &cursor), C convention: the output routine vsprintf hands the formatter: stores c at *cursor, advances the cursor and returns c as an unsigned byte. printf.c's static helper between vprintf and sprintf; the library gives it no public name.

entries.name: sprintf
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `sprintf`, from `printf.c`: (buffer, format, ...), C convention: returns vsprintf(buffer, format, the address of the arguments after format). Symantec C++ 6.1's code for it matches here and at fprintf (0005f6e0), as does its code for spawnl and spawnlp; the call to vsprintf settles it.

entries.name: vsprintf
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `vsprintf`, from `printf.c`: (buffer, format, args), C convention: formats through _pformat (0005f7ca) with Printf_StoreChar and a cursor on buffer, then stores a NUL at buffer plus the formatter's result, or at buffer itself when the result is negative.

entries.name: _pformat
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `_pformat`, from `printf.c`: (output, stream, format, args), C convention: the formatter vprintf, vfprintf and vsprintf share. Sends each character through output(c, stream) and returns the count sent, or -1 when output returns -1 or a conversion is not in its table. The flag characters are the table 00097ddc ('-', '+', ' ', '#', '0', '*'), digits are tested through the ctype table 0009edc5, and the conversions are the 18-entry table 00097e14 (s % c d i b o u p X x f F e E G g n), each with a handler address 0x48 bytes on; 6.1's printf.c reads F as a size modifier instead. Integer arguments come through getlong (0006010f).

entries.name: getlong
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `getlong`, from `printf.c`: (flags, &args) in stack order, callee-cleaned (Pascal): takes the next int from args and advances it; with flag 0x800 ('h') it sign-extends the low 16 bits, or zero-extends them when flag 0x200 (unsigned) is set too. _pformat's integer conversions call it. printf.c's static helper, the same as 6.1's 32-bit getlong.

entries.name: __DOSIGN
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `__DOSIGN`, from `printf.c`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. The match covers 48 bytes from here.

entries.name: Mono_PrintfRow
entries.description: (format, row, ...), C convention: vsprintf into a 100-byte buffer and Mono_WriteText(buffer, row, 0), at the start of the row. The frame-rate meter's lines print with it.

entries.name: FrameRate_PrintRate
entries.description: (row, label, hundredths, whole) in stack order, callee-cleaned: prints label and a rate on a monochrome-screen row with Mono_PrintfRow, as "%s%2d.%02d fps." (the string 00097ee0 points to), or as "%s--.-- fps." (through 00097f04) when the rate is 999.99 or 0.00, the worst and best FrameRate_Update starts from.

entries.name: FrameRate_TimerTick
entries.description: No arguments, frameless: decrements FrameRate_Countdown (000b5e24) while it is non-zero. FrameRate_Update registers it with Timer_AddCallback (0006d289), count 1.

entries.name: FrameRate_GetFrameCount
entries.description: No arguments, frameless: returns FrameRate_FrameCount (000b5e28). Vcr_FlushCheckpoints (00000c84), in vcr.cpp, passes it to sprintf for its "Playback error. Frame #%ld" message.

entries.name: FrameRate_Update
entries.description: No arguments: the frame-rate meter, called once a frame. On its first call (FrameRate_TicksPerSecond FrameRate_TicksPerSecond (000b5e2c) is 0) it registers FrameRate_TimerTick with Timer_AddCallback (0006d289) at count 1, sets the ticks per second to 1000000 / Math_Q14Multiply(word +4 of the structure 000bdd0c points to, 0x35a1), loads FrameRate_Countdown (000b5e24) with 32000 and returns. Later calls take the ticks elapsed, e = 32000 - countdown, and reload it. e = 32000 prints "Current: Slower than %d fps." (00097f54) with 32000 / ticks per second on row 4. Otherwise, for e above the ticks per second, x = 10e / ticks per second and the rate shown is x / 10 and x % 10 as whole and hundredths, the seconds per frame in tenths printed as frames per second; for any other e, x = 100 * ticks per second / e, or 99999 when e is 0, and the rate is x / 100 and x % 100, which raises the best (FrameRate_Best (00097f58), whole then hundredths) when it is higher and neither 999 nor 99 hundredths, and lowers the worst (FrameRate_Worst (00097f5c)) when it is lower. It prints "Best:" on row 3 and "Worst:" on row 5 with FrameRate_PrintRate, then on row 4 "Current: Faster than %d fps." (00097f2c) with the ticks per second when x is 99999, or "Current:" and the rate. Each call after the first adds 1 to FrameRate_FrameCount (000b5e28) and prints "Frame # %d" on row 1. No reference found by es2_xref.

entries.name: fclose
entries.description: The runtime's fclose (stream), C convention: -1 for a null stream. For one open in any mode (flags +0xc & 0x83) it flushes it with fflush unless flag 4 (unbuffered) is set, and closes the handle +0x10; when the stream's temporary-file number at 000bdbe6[(stream - _iob) / 0x18] is set it removes the file named by that number in decimal (ltoa, remove) and clears it; then File_FreeBuffer and a memset of the FILE's 0x18 bytes. Returns the or of fflush's and close's results.

entries.name: fwrite
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `fwrite`, from `fread.c`: (buffer, size, count, stream), C convention: writes size * count bytes and returns the number of whole items written. A stream with flag 0x100 (+0xc) takes them one fputc at a time; a buffered one (flag 4 clear) copies them into its buffer (pointer +0, room +4) with memmove, calling 00075fd5 with the byte when the room is 0; an unbuffered one in write mode (flags & 0x32 == 2, a read-write stream with 0x80 switched to it first) takes one write to its handle (+0x10), setting the error flag 0x20 on a short count, and otherwise writes nothing.

entries.name: fopen
entries.description: The runtime's fopen (name, mode), C convention: takes the first FILE of _iob whose flags +0xc & 0x83 are clear, up to the one ending at 0009eb57, and returns 000761dc(stream, mode, name); with none free it sets errno to 4 and returns 0.

entries.name: Str_ReplaceFirst
entries.description: (replace, find, s) in stack order, callee-cleaned: replaces the first occurrence of the character find in s with replace (strchr) and returns s. ES2's Str_ReplaceFirst (DBSIM 00492a5c).

entries.name: Path_WithExtension
entries.description: (extension, path) in stack order, callee-cleaned: copies path into the static buffer 000b5e30, cuts it at the first '.' (Str_ReplaceFirst), appends '.' and extension, and returns the buffer. ES2's Path_WithExtension (DBSIM 00492a84).

entries.name: ResourcePath_BuildFolderName
entries.description: (folder, name) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the resource path folder\name.folder. Path_WithExtension(name, folder), then copies folder into the static buffer 000b5e50, appends '\' and the Path_WithExtension result, and returns the buffer. ES2's ResourcePath_BuildFolderName (DBSIM 00492ae0).

entries.name: NameList_Split
entries.description: (out, buffer) in stack order, callee-cleaned: walks the NUL-terminated names in buffer until one starts with a '\n' byte, storing each name's address in out when out is non-null, and returns the count. ES2's NameList_Split (DBSIM 00492b40).

entries.name: VolFile_GetSize
entries.description: (path), callee-cleaned: opens path as a VolRStream and returns VolRStream_GetSize, or 0 when the stream's status word (+0) is set after the open. ES2's VolFile_GetSize (DBSIM 00492b78), which reads the status through Stream_GetStatus.

entries.description: (stride, capacity, mod mask, name) in stack order, callee-cleaned: loads the type-name list nam\<name>.NAM and the mod lists nam\<name>1.NAM to nam\<name>8.NAM into a table of capacity pointers (operator new, zeroed) and returns it. List k from 1 to 8 is read only when bit k-1 of the mask is set. Each file read is sized with VolFile_GetSize, all of them are read whole into one buffer, and NameList_Split stores each file's names: the base list's from entry 0, and list k's from entry capacity - 8 * stride + (k - 1) * stride. Mechs_InitAllTypes calls it with ('mechs', 0x60 entries, stride 10) and FlyerTypes_LoadAll (0001c770) with ('flyers', 0x52, 10), both with mask 0. ES2's LoadNameList (DBSIM 00492bf4) takes (name, capacity) and loads the base list only.

entries.name: X32_LockRegion
entries.description: (offset, selector, size), C convention: INT 21h AX=252Bh with BX=0501h, ES:ECX the region's far address and EDX its size; returns 0, or -1 when the call sets the carry. AX=252Bh is the Phar Lap memory-region call the extender provides, whose subfunction BH=5 locks pages and BH=6 unlocks them. 0006f971 locks a list of code and data ranges with it, and 0006fb96 unlocks the same ranges with X32_UnlockRegion.

entries.name: X32_UnlockRegion
entries.description: (offset, selector, size), C convention: loads BX=0601h and jumps into X32_LockRegion's INT 21h AX=252Bh body: the Phar Lap memory-region call's unlock subfunction (BH=6).

entries.name: maybe_X32_AllocSelector
entries.description: (linear), C convention: INT 21h AX=3501h, then AX=3503h with ECX = linear and AX=3505h with ECX = 0xffffffff on the selector it returned in BX; returns EAX = 0 and EDX = that selector. When 3503h or 3505h fails it frees the selector (AX=3502h) and returns -1; when 3501h fails it returns linear with DX the data selector 0009003a. The service names (allocate, free, set base, set limit) are inferred; compiler.md lists the AX=35xxh calls as Open.

entries.name: maybe_X32_FreeSelector
entries.description: (offset, selector), C convention: returns -1 for the data selector 0009003a; otherwise loads 0 into whichever of ES, FS and GS holds the selector, calls INT 21h AX=3502h and returns 0, or -1 on carry. offset is not read. maybe_X32_AllocSelector frees through the same call.

entries.description: (ch, row, column) in stack order, callee-cleaned: writes ch with the attribute byte 00097fa0 to the monochrome screen cell (row * 80 + column) while the bytes Mono_Screen (000b5e70) and 000b5e71 share a set bit and row is 0-24. No reference found by es2_xref.

entries.description: (text, row, column) in stack order, callee-cleaned: writes a NUL-terminated string with the attribute byte 00097fa0 to the monochrome screen from the cell (row * 80 + column), under Mono_WriteChar's gate. ES2's MonoDevice_WriteText goes through a device object.

entries.name: Mono_Printf
entries.description: (column, row, format, ...), C convention: vsprintf into a 256-byte buffer and Mono_WriteText(buffer, row, column), under Mono_WriteChar's gate. The memory, driver and slot listings at SoundManager_PrintMono (0004e858) and the grenade distance at GrenadeMount_PushGaugeState (0000b714) print with it. ES2's Mono_Printf (DBSIM 00495508).

entries.name: __vec_new

entries.name: __vec_ctor

entries.description: (queue, pool) in stack order, callee-cleaned: for each queued object calls vtable +0xc of the vptr at its +2 with flags 2 and returns it to pool with Pool_Free, then zeroes the count +0x50. ES2's ObjectPool_FlushDeleteQueue (DBSIM 00478538).

entries.name: Pool_LinkFreeList
entries.description: (pool, elementSize, count, buffer) in stack order, callee-cleaned: writes the pool header (free count +0 = count, in-use count +2 = 0, element size +4, buffer +6, free head +0xa = buffer, in-use head +0xe = 0) and chains count nodes of elementSize + 8 bytes in buffer, next at +0 and previous at +4, the last next 0. ES2's Pool_LinkFreeList (DBSIM 00471944).
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 000637e4, against ES2's Pool_LinkFreeList

entries.name: Pool_Init
entries.description: (pool, elementSize, count) in stack order, callee-cleaned: a constructor, allocating the 0x12-byte pool when pool is null; allocates count * (elementSize + 8) bytes (none for a count of 0) and links them with Pool_LinkFreeList. It does not zero the block itself; Mem_New (000015a4) takes it from Memory_Alloc (00000ec0), which zero-fills it while the heap is on. ES2's Pool_Init (DBSIM 004719cc) zeroes it.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 00063878, against ES2's Pool_Init

entries.name: Pool_Alloc
entries.description: (pool), callee-cleaned: pops the free-list head, moves it to the head of the in-use list and returns it + 8, or 0 when the free count is 0; the node's other bytes are left as they were. ES2's Pool_Alloc (DBSIM 00471a24).
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 000638c8, against ES2's Pool_Alloc

entries.name: Pool_AllocThunk
entries.description: (pool, unused) in stack order, callee-cleaned: returns Pool_Alloc(pool), removing a second argument it does not read. No reference found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Pool_AllocZeroed
entries.description: (pool), callee-cleaned: Pool_Alloc(pool), then a memset of the element size (+4) bytes to 0 when it returned an element. No reference found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Pool_Free
entries.description: (pool, element) in stack order, callee-cleaned: returns element - 8 to the pool: decrements the in-use count, increments the free count, unlinks the node from the in-use list, pushes it on the free list and clears its previous link. es2_xref finds one call, from ObjectPool_FlushDeleteQueue. ES2's Pool_Free (DBSIM 00471abc).
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 0006398c, against ES2's Pool_Free

entries.name: Pool_Next
entries.description: (pool, node), callee-cleaned: the in-use node after node (the link at node - 8), or the first in-use node (+0xe) when node is null; returns it as node + 8, or 0 at the end. ES2's Pool_Next (DBSIM 00471b0c) without its diagnostic for a node below 0x100000.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 000639ec, against ES2's Pool_Next

entries.name: Pool_Prev
entries.description: (pool, node), callee-cleaned: the in-use node before node (the link at node - 4), returned as node + 8 or 0; with a null node, walks Pool_Next from the start to the last in-use node. ES2's Pool_Prev (DBSIM 00471b64).
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 00063a20, against ES2's Pool_Prev

entries.name: Pool_Nth
entries.description: (pool, n), callee-cleaned (RET 8): walks the pool with Pool_Prev from 0, n + 1 steps, keeping n in DX across the calls, and returns the node reached, or 0 when the walk ends first. ES2's Pool_Nth (DBSIM 00471ba4).

entries.name: Math_RandomSeed
entries.description: (state), callee-cleaned: sets the cursors +0x70 to 0x18 and +0x71 to 0x37 and copies the 112-byte seed table 00098150 over the state's 56 shorts. Calls nothing else, where ES2's Math_RandomSeed (DBSIM 00492d7c) goes on to an empty function.

entries.name: Math_RandomNext
entries.description: (state), callee-cleaned: ES2's additive lagged Fibonacci generator (Math_RandomNext, DBSIM 00492dd4). table[+0x71] += table[+0x70] over the 56 shorts at the state's start; returns the new table[+0x71], then advances both cursors, each wrapping from 56 to 0.

entries.name: Math_RandomBelow
entries.description: (state, int16 bound), callee-cleaned: (Math_RandomNext(state) & 0x7fff) % bound, as ES2's Math_RandomBelow (DBSIM 00492e18).

entries.name: Math_NormalizeVec3ToLength
entries.description: (length, vector) in stack order, its arguments removed by this function (RET 8): rescales the int32 vector in place to the int16 length and returns it. With m = Math_FastMagnitude3D (0006325a) of the vector, an m of 0 zeroes its 12 bytes with memset (00060b40); otherwise s = (length << 16) / m by IDIV, narrowed to int16, and each component becomes Math_Q16Multiply2 (0007358c)(s, component), the rounding multiply, truncated to 16 bits and sign-extended (CWDE). ES2's Math_NormalizeVec3ToLength (DBSIM 004926e4), (vector, length), which divides through Math_DivInt and keeps each product of the truncating Math_Q16Multiply whole. es2_xref finds two calls, from GridShape_Raycast (0001fccc) and from BeamTracer_Ctor (00008268). It opens an object file: the RET 8 at 00063b57 before it is followed by two zero bytes.
entries.source: Herculan/docs/es1/simulation/fixed-point-math.md#rescaling-a-vector; ES1DBSIM disassembly at 00063b5c; es2_naming.py diff against DBSIM 004926e4

entries.name: Math_DistanceBetweenPoints
entries.description: (a, b), two int32 triples, callee-cleaned: Math_FastMagnitude3D of the three component differences, subtracted in line. ES2's Math_DistanceBetweenPoints (DBSIM 00492780) copies and subtracts through Vec3_Subtract.

entries.name: Math_DistanceBetweenPoints2D
entries.description: (a, b) in stack order, callee-cleaned: Math_FastMagnitude2D(b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y) over two int points.

entries.name: Math_Atan2Guarded
entries.description: (x, y) in source order (y at [ebp+8], x at [ebp+0xc]), callee-cleaned: sets x to 1 when x and y are both 0, then returns Math_Atan2Bam(x, y), its EAX passed through. ES2's Math_Atan2Guarded (DBSIM 00492800).

entries.name: Math_HeadingToward
entries.description: (to, from) in source order (from at [ebp+8], to at [ebp+0xc]), callee-cleaned: Math_Atan2Guarded(to.x - from.x, to.y - from.y) less a quarter turn (ADD AX,0xc000). ES2's Math_HeadingToward (DBSIM 00492828), which also takes the destination first.

entries.name: Math_ElevationAngle
entries.description: (a, b) in stack order, callee-cleaned: Math_Atan2Guarded (00063ca0) with x Math_FastMagnitude2D (00063234)(b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y) and y b.z - a.z, on int32 triples: the elevation of b seen from a. ES2's Math_ElevationAngle (DBSIM 00492850), which answers that of a seen from b. es2_xref finds four calls, from Flyer_MovementTick (0001b084), Flyer_AttackRun (0001bba4) (two) and Sim_RaycastObjectList.

entries.name: Math_EulerToward
entries.description: (from, to, out) in stack order, callee-cleaned, d = to - from: out[2] = Math_Atan2Guarded (00063ca0)(x = d.x, y = d.y) - 0x4000, out[1] = 0, out[0] = Math_Atan2Guarded(x = Math_FastMagnitude2D (00063234)(d.x, d.y), y = d.z), the Euler angles that turn model Y toward to; returns out. ES2's Math_EulerToward (DBSIM 00492884), (out, to, from), which reaches the magnitude through a thunk.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 00063d2c, against ES2's Math_EulerToward

entries.name: Math_OffsetPointByBearing
entries.description: (distance, bearing, point), callee-cleaned: adds Math_Q14Multiply(distance, Math_CosBam(bearing + 0x4000)) to the point's x and Math_Q14Multiply(distance, Math_CosBam(bearing)) to its y. The distance is a dword and each product is added at its full 32 bits. ES2's Math_OffsetPointByBearing (DBSIM 004928f0), its arguments reversed, which takes the distance's low word and adds sign-extended int16 products, so its offset wraps past 32767.

entries.name: Math_TransposeRotation2D
entries.description: (matrix), C convention: swaps the 2x2 int16 matrix's +2 and +4 entries. ES2's Math_TransposeRotation2D (DBSIM 0047ddf8), byte for byte.

entries.name: Transform_TransposeRotation
entries.description: (transform), C convention: transposes the rotation in place, exchanging the int16s +2 and +4, +8 and +0xc, +0xa and +0xe; the rank byte is left alone. ES2's Transform_TransposeRotation (DBSIM 0047de0d).

entries.name: Time_GetSimClockCountdown
entries.description: Frameless, no arguments: returns SimClock_Countdown (000bba46) in AX.

entries.name: Time_SimClockTimerTick
entries.description: Frameless, no arguments, the timer callback Time_InitSimClock registers: takes 1 from SimClock_Countdown (000bba46) while it is not 0, adds 1 to the dword 000981c8, and adds 1 to the dword 000981c4 when 000981c8 was odd. No Ghidra function.

entries.name: Time_InitSimClock
entries.description: No arguments: SimTickDelta and SimTickDelta2 (000bdbd2) = 0x100; while 000981c0 is 0, stores there the pointer at 000bdd0c, registers Time_SimClockTimerTick (00063e3c) with Timer_AddCallback (0006d289) at count 1, sets SimClock_TicksPerSecond (000bba44) and 000bba40 to 1000000 / Math_Q14Multiply(that structure's word +4, 0x35a1), SimClock_TicksPer100ms (000bba42), 000bdbd4, 000bdbd6 and 000bdbd8 to a tenth of it, and SimClock_Countdown (000bba46) to SimClock_TicksPerSecond. ES2's Time_InitSimClock (DBSIM 0046773c) works from GetTickCount.

entries.name: Time_ElapsedToQ8Clamped
entries.description: (elapsed, unit) in stack order, callee-cleaned: (elapsed << 8) / unit clamped to 0x40-0x1c2, returned in AX. ES2's Time_ElapsedToQ8Clamped (DBSIM 00467790).

entries.name: Time_BeginSimTick
entries.description: No arguments: spins until Time_GetSimClockCountdown (00063e34) is at least 2 below SimClock_TicksPerSecond (000bba44), then stores the elapsed ticks SimClock_TicksPerSecond - SimClock_Countdown at 000bdbd8, sets SimTickDelta = Time_ElapsedToQ8Clamped (00063f04)(elapsed, 000bdbd4) and SimTickDelta2 (000bdbd2) the same with 000bdbd6, and reloads SimClock_Countdown (000bba46). ES2's Time_BeginSimTick (DBSIM 004677bc), which waits 40 ms of GetTickCount.

entries.name: Math_IntegrateRateOverTick
entries.description: (rate), callee-cleaned: the rate read as an int16 (MOVSX at 00063fae), then Math_Q8Multiply(rate, the short at SimTickDelta (000bdbd0)), sign-extended from 16 bits and clamped to +/-0x7fff. ES2's Math_IntegrateRateOverTick (DBSIM 00467820) saturates where this wraps.

entries.name: Math_IntegrateRateOverTick2
entries.description: (rate), callee-cleaned: Math_IntegrateRateOverTick with the short at SimTickDelta2 (000bdbd2); the clamps return 0x8001 or 0x7fff in AX. ES2's Math_IntegrateRateOverTick2 (DBSIM 00467858).

entries.name: Math_CountdownTimerTick
entries.description: (record), callee-cleaned: the short at record+1 less the short at SimTickDelta (000bdbd0), set to 0 when negative, and returned in AX. ES2's Math_CountdownTimerTick (DBSIM 00467944) subtracts SimTickDelta.

entries.name: Timer_CountDown
entries.description: (record), callee-cleaned: the int32 at record+1 less SimTickDelta (000bdbd0), set to 0 when negative, stored and returned. ES2's Timer_CountDown (DBSIM 004679a4).

entries.name: Colour_Distance
entries.description: (a, b) in stack order, callee-cleaned: Math_FastMagnitude3D of b - a over three int16 channels.

entries.name: Vec2_DistanceBetween
entries.description: (a, b) in stack order, callee-cleaned (RET 8): returns Math_FastMagnitude2D (00063234)(b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y), the two int32 points' approximate distance. ES2's Vec2_DistanceBetween (DBSIM 0047d588).

entries.name: Point3I_DistanceBetween
entries.description: (a, b), callee-cleaned: copies b, subtracts a and returns Math_FastMagnitude3D of the difference. ES2's Point3I_DistanceBetween (DBSIM 0047d628).

entries.name: ltoa
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `ltoa`, from `itoa.ASM`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. The match covers 89 bytes from here.

entries.name: Math_CosBam
entries.description: (int16 angle), C convention: cosine of a binary angle in Q14 from the quarter-turn table Math_CosTableQ14 (000981cc): the angle rounded to a step of 16 ((a >> 4) plus bit 3), its magnitude i, then table[i] below 0x400 and -table[0x800 - i] from there. ES2's Math_CosBam (DBSIM 0047dee4) but for the table's address.

entries.name: Transform_ConcatRotation
entries.description: (a, b, out), C convention: copies b's three int32 translations (+0x14/+0x18/+0x1c) into out, then composes a's and b's rotations (nine Q14 int16 entries, rank byte +0x12) into out as a times b. A rank below 1 on a copies b's rotation and rank, on b copies a's; two rank-1 operands give rank 1 (entries 4 to 7 zeroed, entry 8 0x4000); any other mix gives rank 2, each entry rounded with +0x2000 >> 14. Returns out. es2_naming.py diff finds it identical after normalisation to ES2's Transform_ConcatRotation (DBSIM 0047f3e8). es2_xref finds one call, from WeaponMount_PrepareShot (0000add4), which passes the convergence rotation as a and the bone's frame as b.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile and disassembly at 000647f4; es2_naming diff against DBSIM 0047f3e8

entries.name: strcat
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `strcat`, from `strings.ASM`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. The match covers 65 bytes from here.

entries.name: Stream_BaseCtor
entries.description: StreamIO constructor, callee-cleaned (this): allocates 8 bytes through Mem_New when this is null (0 if that fails), installs the vtable 000989d2 at +4 and clears the status at +0. ES2's Stream_BaseCtor (DBSIM 0047a77c).

entries.name: Stream_BaseDtor
entries.description: StreamIO destructor (this, flags), vtable slot +4: restores the vtable 000989d2, calls StreamIO_Flush directly, through the padding at 00064d69, and Mem_Delete when bit 0 of the flags is set. ES2's counterpart is Stream_BaseDtor (DBSIM 0047a798).

entries.name: StreamIO_GetCapabilities
entries.description: StreamIO vtable slot +0x10 (stream, query), entered through the padding at 00064d3e: a jump table at 000989f8 for queries 0-4 whose five entries all go to the code that returns 0, as other queries do. Answers 0 to everything, as ES2's StreamIO_GetCapabilities (DBSIM 0047a7c8).

entries.name: StreamIO_GetPosition
entries.description: StreamIO vtable slot +8, entered through the padding at 00064d5a: XOR EAX,EAX; RET 4.

entries.name: StreamIO_SetPosition
entries.description: StreamIO vtable slot +0xc, entered through the padding at 00064d61: MOV AL,1; RET 8.

entries.name: StreamIO_Flush
entries.description: StreamIO vtable slot +0x14, entered through the padding at 00064d69, where Ghidra starts its function: MOV AL,1; RET 4. Stream_BaseDtor calls 00064d69.

entries.name: StreamIO_Write
entries.description: StreamIO vtable slot +0x18, entered through the padding at 00064d71: MOV AL,1; RET 0xC.

entries.name: StreamIO_Read
entries.description: StreamIO vtable slot +0x1c, entered through the padding at 00064d79: MOV AL,1; RET 0xC.

entries.name: MemRWStream_Ctor
entries.description: (stream, buffer, size) in stack order, callee-cleaned: allocates the 0x14-byte stream when stream is null, runs Stream_BaseCtor, stores the vtable 00098a0e at +4 and buffer at +8 and +0x10 (the cursor) and buffer + size at +0xc, the fields of ES2's MemRWStream (VSHELL MemRWStream_Ctor, 0044ed78). The code of ES1GO's MemRWStream_Ctor (0005da60), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: MemRWStream_Dtor
entries.description: (stream, flags) in stack order, callee-cleaned: slot +4 of MemRWStream's vtable 00098a0e (entered at its padding 00064dc3): returns at once for a null stream; otherwise stores 00098a0e at +4, runs Stream_BaseDtor (00064d10)(stream, 0) and calls Mem_Delete (000015f8) when flags bit 0 is set. VSHELL's MemRWStream_Dtor (004536a1).

entries.name: Math_Rotate2DPoint
entries.description: (point, matrix, out), C convention: rotates an {int x, int y} point by a 2x2 Q14 int16 matrix: out.x = (x * m0 + y * m2 + 0x2000) >> 14 and out.y = (x * m1 + y * m3 + 0x2000) >> 14, in 64 bits. ES2's Math_Rotate2DPoint (DBSIM 0047fedc).

entries.name: Rotation_Concat
entries.description: (a, b, out), C convention: composes two rotations (nine Q14 int16 entries, rank byte +0x12) into out as a times b, each entry rounded (+0x2000 >> 14), with no translation. A rank below 1 on a copies b's 20 bytes, on b copies a's; two rank-1 operands give rank 1 (entries 4 to 7 zeroed, entry 8 0x4000); a rank-1 a with a rank-2 b takes entries 6 to 8 from b, a rank-2 a with a rank-1 b takes entries 4, 5 and 8 from a; every mix but two rank-1 operands gives rank 2. Returns out. es2_naming.py diff finds it identical after normalisation to ES2's Rotation_Concat (DBSIM 0047ef4c). es2_xref finds one call, from Mech_ComponentDamageWrite (00013250).

entries.name: Math_MapRange
entries.description: (value, inLo, inHi, outLo, outHi), C convention: (value - inLo) x (outHi - outLo) plus a rounding bias of |inHi - inLo| - 1, signed by the output's direction, divided by (inHi - inLo), plus outLo. Identical to ES2's Math_MapRange (DBSIM 0047de3c) after normalisation.

entries.name: Ovl_ReadFile
entries.description: (path, count, size, dst) in stack order, callee-cleaned: opens path, asserting at severity 5 (util\ovl.cpp line 0x15) when the stream status is set, reads count * size bytes into dst, asserting at severity 5 (line 0x17) when the read fails, and closes the stream. ES2's Ovl_ReadFile (DBSIM 00492e48), whose arguments are (dst, size, count, path).

entries.name: FileRStream_CtorDefault
entries.description: FileRStream() constructor, callee-cleaned (this): allocates 0xb bytes when this is null (0 if that fails), Stream_BaseCtor, the vtable 00098a76 at +4, handle -1 at +8, status 5 and +0xa (owns the handle) cleared. ES2's FileRStream_CtorDefault (DBSIM 0047abb8).

entries.name: FileRStream_CtorFromHandle
entries.description: FileRStream(handle) constructor, callee-cleaned: allocates 0xb bytes when this is null, Stream_BaseCtor, the vtable 00098a76, adopts the handle at +8 without owning it (+0xa = 0) and probes it with lseek(h, 0, SEEK_CUR), FileRStream_SetIoError on -1. ES2's FileRStream_CtorFromHandle (DBSIM 0047abec).

entries.name: FileRStream_Ctor
entries.description: FileRStream(path) constructor, callee-cleaned: allocates 0xb bytes when this is null, Stream_BaseCtor, the vtable 00098a76, handle -1, +0xa cleared, then FileRStream_Open(path). ES2's FileRStream_Ctor (DBSIM 0047ac34).

entries.name: FileRStream_Dtor
entries.description: FileRStream destructor (this, flags), vtable slot +4: restores the vtable 00098a76, FileRStream_Close, Stream_BaseDtor(this, 0), and Mem_Delete when bit 0 of the flags is set. ES2's FileRStream_Dtor (DBSIM 0047ac6c).

entries.name: FileRStream_GetCapabilities
entries.description: FileRStream vtable slot +0x10 (stream, query): query 0 answers 2, queries 2 and 3 answer 1, anything else 0. ES2's FileRStream_GetCapabilities (DBSIM 0047aca8).

entries.name: FileRStream_SetFile
entries.description: (stream, handle): FileRStream_Close, adopts the handle at +8 without owning it (+0xa = 0) and probes it with lseek(h, 0, SEEK_CUR): status 0 on success, FileRStream_SetIoError on -1. ES2's FileRStream_SetFile (DBSIM 0047acd8).

entries.name: FileRStream_Close
entries.description: (stream): closes the handle at +8 when the stream owns it (+0xa) and it is not -1, returning 0 with status 3 when close fails; otherwise sets the handle to -1 and status 5 and returns 1. ES2's FileRStream_Close (DBSIM 0047ad1c).

entries.name: FileRStream_Open
entries.description: (stream, path): FileRStream_Close, then open(path, 0) into the handle at +8: status 1 and 0 returned on failure, else status 0, +0xa (owns the handle) set and 1 returned. ES2's FileRStream_Open (DBSIM 0047ad5c).

entries.name: FileRStream_Tell
entries.description: FileRStream vtable slot +8 (stream): returns lseek(h, 0, SEEK_CUR) of the handle at +8. ES2's FileRStream_Tell (DBSIM 0047ada4).

entries.name: FileRStream_Seek
entries.description: FileRStream vtable slot +0xc (stream, position): a status of 2 is cleared first and any other nonzero status returns 0; lseek(h, position, SEEK_SET), FileRStream_SetIoError on -1, else 1. ES2's FileRStream_Seek (DBSIM 0047adc0).

entries.name: FileRStream_GetSize
entries.description: (stream): 0 unless the status is 0 or 2. Otherwise saves the position (slot +8), takes lseek(h, 0, SEEK_END), restores the position (slot +0xc) and returns the end offset. ES2's FileRStream_GetSize (DBSIM 0047ae04).

entries.name: FileRStream_Flush
entries.description: FileRStream vtable slot +0x14, entered through the padding at 00065806: MOV AL,1; RET 4. ES2's FileRStream_Flush (DBSIM 0047ae4c).

entries.name: FileRStream_SetIoError
entries.description: (stream): sets the status at +0 to 3 when errno (000973d3) is 0, otherwise 1, and returns 0. ES2's FileRStream_SetIoError (DBSIM 0047ae54).

entries.name: FileRStream_Write
entries.description: FileRStream vtable slot +0x18: sets status 4 and returns 0. ES2's FileRStream_Write (DBSIM 0047ae78).

entries.name: FileRStream_Read
entries.description: FileRStream vtable slot +0x1c (stream, buffer, count): 0 when the status is nonzero, 1 for a count of 0; otherwise read() from the handle at +8, FileRStream_SetIoError on -1, status 2 and 0 on a short read, else 1. ES2's FileRStream_Read (DBSIM 0047ae8c).

entries.name: FileWStream_CtorDefault
entries.description: FileWStream() constructor, callee-cleaned (this): allocates 0xc bytes when this is null (0 if that fails), Stream_BaseCtor, the vtable 00098ab2 at +4, handle -1 at +8, status 5 and +0xa (owns the handle) cleared. ES2's FileWStream_CtorDefault (DBSIM 0047aedc).

entries.name: FileWStream_CtorFromHandle
entries.description: FileWStream(handle) constructor, callee-cleaned: allocates 0xc bytes when this is null, Stream_BaseCtor, the vtable 00098ab2, adopts the handle at +8 without owning it (+0xa = 0) and probes it with lseek(h, 0, SEEK_CUR), FileWStream_SetIoError on -1. ES2's FileWStream_CtorFromHandle (DBSIM 0047af10).

entries.name: FileWStream_Ctor
entries.description: FileWStream(path) constructor, callee-cleaned: allocates 0xc bytes when this is null, Stream_BaseCtor, the vtable 00098ab2, handle -1, +0xa cleared, then FileWStream_Open(path). ES2's FileWStream_Ctor (DBSIM 0047af58).

entries.name: FileWStream_Dtor
entries.description: FileWStream destructor (this, flags), vtable slot +4: restores the vtable 00098ab2, FileWStream_Close, Stream_BaseDtor(this, 0), and Mem_Delete when bit 0 of the flags is set. ES2's FileWStream_Dtor (DBSIM 0047af90).

entries.name: FileWStream_GetCapabilities
entries.description: FileWStream vtable slot +0x10 (stream, query): query 0 answers 3, queries 1 and 3 answer 1, anything else 0. ES2's FileWStream_GetCapabilities (DBSIM 0047afcc).

entries.name: FileWStream_SetFile
entries.description: (stream, handle): FileWStream_Close, adopts the handle at +8 without owning it (+0xa = 0) and probes it with lseek(h, 0, SEEK_CUR): status 0 on success, FileWStream_SetIoError on -1. ES2's FileWStream_SetFile (DBSIM 0047b008).

entries.name: FileWStream_Close
entries.description: (stream): closes the handle at +8 when the stream owns it (+0xa) and it is not -1, returning 0 with status 3 when close fails; otherwise sets the handle to -1 and status 5 and returns 1. ES2's FileWStream_Close (DBSIM 0047b04c).

entries.name: FileWStream_Open
entries.description: (stream, path): FileWStream_Close, then open(path, 0x301, 0x180) into the handle at +8, write-only, created when missing and truncated when present: status 1 and 0 returned on failure, else status 0, +0xa (owns the handle) set and 1 returned. ES2's FileWStream_Open (DBSIM 0047b08c).

entries.name: FileWStream_Tell
entries.description: FileWStream vtable slot +8 (stream): returns lseek(h, 0, SEEK_CUR) of the handle at +8. ES2's FileWStream_Tell (DBSIM 0047b0d8).

entries.name: FileWStream_Seek
entries.description: FileWStream vtable slot +0xc (stream, position): a status of 2 is cleared first and any other nonzero status returns 0; lseek(h, position, SEEK_SET), FileWStream_SetIoError on -1, else 1. ES2's FileWStream_Seek (DBSIM 0047b0f4).

entries.name: FileWStream_GetSize
entries.description: (stream): 0 unless the status is 0 or 2. Otherwise saves the position (slot +8), takes lseek(h, 0, SEEK_END), restores the position (slot +0xc) and returns the end offset. ES2's FileWStream_GetSize (DBSIM 0047b138).

entries.name: FileWStream_Flush

entries.name: Region_RestoreRect
entries.description: (region, point, buffer), C convention: wraps buffer in a stack bitmap header the size of the region's rect (format 8, flags 0x10) and draws it at point with Raster_BlitDispatch (0006a8e0). ES2's Region_RestoreRect (DBSIM 00487f6c).

entries.name: Region_RestoreSpans
entries.description: (region, point, buffer), C convention: Region_Restore for a type-2 region: for each row of its span list draws x1 - x0 + 1 bytes of buffer at the row, offset by point (and by the drawing context's translation when 00098d64's +0x208 is set), through the raster routine 0009df30 (buffer, row, x0, x1). ES2's 00487fb0.

entries.name: Region_Restore
entries.description: (region, point, buffer), C convention: puts saved pixels back: Region_RestoreRect for a type-0 region, Region_RestoreSpans for a type-2 one. A region is {int type; ...}: type 0 carries a rect {x0, y0, x1, y1} at +4, type 2 a pointer to a span list ({int16 top row, int16 row count, {x0, x1} per row}) at +4. ES2's Region_Restore (DBSIM 00488037).
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 0006641f, against ES2's Region_Restore

entries.name: Rect_PixelCount
entries.description: (rect), C convention: (x1 - x0 + 1) * (y1 - y0 + 1) as an int64 in EDX:EAX. ES2's Rect_PixelCount (DBSIM 00487d88).

entries.name: Region_SaveRect
entries.description: (region, buffer), C convention: wraps buffer in a stack bitmap header the size of the region's rect (translated by the drawing context's offset when 00098d64's +0x208 is set) and grabs the screen into it with Bitmap_GrabClipDispatch (0006aa70)(header, rect, 0). ES2's Region_SaveRect (DBSIM 00487da0).

entries.name: SpanRegion_PixelCount
entries.description: (spans), C convention: sums x1 - x0 over a span list's rows into EAX: the INC after each add increments the x1 it loaded, not the sum, so a row counts one pixel fewer than Region_SaveSpans copies. Its bytes end at MOV EAX,EDX with no LEAVE or RET, so execution runs on into Region_SaveSpans. The same bytes as ES2's SpanRegion_PixelCount (DBSIM 00487e3c).
entries.source: ES1DBSIM disassembly at 0006650c, against ES2's SpanRegion_PixelCount

entries.name: Region_SaveSpans
entries.description: (region, buffer), C convention: Region_Save for a type-2 region: copies each row of its span list from the screen into buffer through the raster routine 0009df28 (buffer, row, x0, x1), advancing buffer by x1 - x0 + 1. When the drawing context's +0x208 is set it first translates the list into the scratch span buffer 00098de1 points to, adding CX + ctx+0x210 - ctx+0x220 to the top row and DX + ctx+0x20c - ctx+0x21c to each x, with ECX and EDX as the caller left them. ES2's Region_SaveSpans (DBSIM 00487e5e).
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 0006652e, against ES2's Region_SaveSpans

entries.name: Region_Save
entries.description: (region, buffer), C convention: copies the screen pixels a region covers into buffer: Region_SaveRect for a type-0 region, Region_SaveSpans for a type-2 one (the region layout is under Region_Restore). ES2's Region_Save (DBSIM 00487f06).
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 000665d6, against ES2's Region_Save

entries.name: Region_PixelCount
entries.description: (region), C convention: Rect_PixelCount of the rect at +4 for a type-0 region, SpanRegion_PixelCount of the span list +4 points to for type 2, else EAX as the type left it. The same bytes as ES2's Region_PixelCount (DBSIM 00487f39).

entries.name: Cursor_SetImage
entries.description: (bitmap, hotspot), C convention: hides the cursor (g_RasterRoutines slot 31, 0009df50) while it is shown (Cursor_Shown (00098d6c)), stores bitmap at Cursor_Bitmap (00098d68) and the hotspot's two dwords at Cursor_Hotspot (00098d78), frees the save-under buffer 00098d8a, and for a non-null bitmap stores its int16s +0 and +2 at Cursor_SaveUnder (00098d80) and 00098d82 and their product at 00098d86, allocates that many bytes as the new save-under, and shows the cursor again (slot 30) when it was shown and the allocation succeeded.

ES2's Cursor_SyncPosition (DBSIM 00486d70), statement for statement.

entries.name: Bitmap_Blit
entries.description: (bitmap, flags, point) in stack order, callee-cleaned: draws a bitmap object's data (+4) at point with Raster_BlitDispatch (0006a8e0)(data, point, flags). A packed bitmap (+0x12 non-zero) is first unpacked by Bitmap_UnpackToScratch (000672cc) into Bitmap_UnpackScratch (000bdbe2), which stands in for the data pointer +0xe, with the unpacked size in +0xa, during the draw; afterwards both fields are put back and the scratch buffer is deleted unless Bitmap_UseCallerScratch (000bdbde) is set. ES2's Bitmap_Blit (DBSIM 0048159c), which reaches the clip dispatcher through GL_Blit.

entries.name: Raster_DrawPolygonDispatch
entries.description: (count, points), C convention: draws a polygon with the brush {mode, colour} at the installed clip block's (00098d64) +0x228, translating the points by (+0x20c - +0x21c, +0x210 - +0x220) first when +0x208 is set. Fewer than three points, or brush mode 4, draw in the brush colour through a temporary brush at +0x224: one point through Gfx_PlotPixel (00069058), two through Raster_DrawLine, more as a line loop. For three or more: mode 0 fills through g_RasterRoutines slot 0 with the colour (a palette index for top byte 0, the ramp entry from 0009a6f5 for top byte 4, nothing otherwise), mode 1 goes to Raster_FillContourPolygon (0007965c), modes 5 and 7 to the routine at 0009df58, mode 6 fills through slot 1 (0009ded8) with the brush's second field. The fills scan-convert with Poly_ScanConvertToSpanRegion (00076f54) and clip per the clip mode +0x204: 0 none, 1 through Poly_ClipToRect (000788e4) against the rect at +0x20c, otherwise against each region of the block's list (rects through Poly_ClipToRect (000788e4), span regions through SpanRegion_Intersect (00073b7c)). es2_naming.py diff finds it identical to ES2's Raster_DrawPolygonDispatch (DBSIM 00483dac) but for labels.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 00068be0, against ES2's Raster_DrawPolygonDispatch

entries.name: Raster_DrawPolygonReversed
entries.description: (count, points), C convention: ES2's Raster_DrawPolygonReversed (DBSIM 00484116): for three or more points copies them last to first into a local ring and, when the brush at the clip block's (00098d64) +0x228 is mode 5, points its +8 list at a reversed local copy for the call; then Raster_DrawPolygonDispatch.

entries.name: Raster_DrawPolygonEitherWinding
entries.description: (count, points), C convention: ES2's Raster_DrawPolygonEitherWinding (DBSIM 004841af): for three or more points sums the signed area in 64 bits and hands a sum of zero or less to Raster_DrawPolygonReversed; anything else, and rings of one or two points, to Raster_DrawPolygonDispatch. Nothing for a count of 0.

entries.name: Gfx_PlotPixel
entries.description: (point), C convention: ES2's Gfx_PlotPixel (DBSIM 004894e0), the same statements after normalisation. Works on the clip block 00098d64 points at, the render context's +4. The pen is the block's +0x224: mode 0 resolves the colour by its top byte (0 the value, 4 ramp entry (bits 16-23 * length) >> 8 of g_RasterColourRamps, else nothing) and plots through 0009dee8 with (point, colour); mode 2 hands pen + 4 to 0009deec; other modes plot nothing. When +0x208 is set it adds the rect's corner less the origin, (+0x20c - +0x21c, +0x210 - +0x220), to the point, then clips the moved point by +0x204: 0 none, 1 the rect +0x20c-+0x218 inclusive, otherwise the block's regions (int16 count at +0, pointers from +4) from the last to the first, a type-0 rect or a type-2 span list holding the point, plotting once in the first that holds it.

entries.description: (first, count, records, extra), C convention: copies count 8-byte records {int16 *entries, int16 length} into g_RasterColourRamps (0009a6f5) from index first, two LODSD/STOSD a record; extra goes to EBX unread. ES2's Raster_SetColourRamps (DBSIM 00486d04).

The same statements as ES1GO's GLPalette_Dtor (0005a824).

entries.description: (point, xform, out), C convention: out = the {int x, int y} point through the 2x2 int16 matrix (x * m0 + y * m2, x * m1 + y * m3, each + 0x2000 >> 14 in 64 bits) plus the int32 translation at +8/+0xc. ES2's Transform2D_ApplyToPoint (DBSIM 0047ff44).

entries.name: Ttm_ManagerCtor
entries.description: (manager, a, b, count) in stack order: allocates the 0xb-byte .TTM handle manager when given none (returning 0 when that fails); stores count at its byte +4, b at 0009f248, 000bdd28 at 0009f24c and a at 0009f250; clears the path prefix with Ttm_SetPathPrefix (00069940)(manager, 0) through its padding entry; passes clock() to srand (0007cd4a). es2_xref finds one call, from Cockpit_LoadPanel (0002c9d8), with a count of 10.

entries.name: Ttm_ManagerDtor
entries.description: (manager, flags): returns for none; otherwise passes the timer slot word +9 to Timer_RemoveCallback (0006d337), destroys every handle's script with Ttm_CloseAll (00069a04) through its padding entry, deletes the handle table +5, and deletes the manager when bit 0 of flags is set. ES1GO's Ttm_Shutdown keeps the table in globals. No caller found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Ttm_RunAll
entries.description: (manager): returns 0 while the byte 0009b404 is 0. Otherwise notes the word 0009b406 and the installed render context 000bdbda; stores the default context 0009f248's +4 (0 with none) at +0x44 of the display object 0009f24c, through Raster_SetClipBlock when the display is 000bdd28, and installs the default context with Raster_InstallRenderContext; clears 0009b404; calls TtmScript_Run (00079a14)(script, the noted count) for each handle of the table +5 below the count byte +4 that holds a script; does the same for the noted context, subtracts the noted count from 0009b406 and returns 1. ES1GO's Ttm_RunAll (0004652e) waits for its tick instead of returning. es2_xref finds calls from Cockpit_LoadPanel (0002c9d8) and Cockpit_RunTtmScripts (0002e0ec).

entries.description: (): the timer callback of the simulator's scripts, a frameless stub: sets the byte 0009b404 to 1 and adds 1 to the word 0009b406. ES1GO's Ttm_TimerTick (00046681) first tests a byte the fades set. es2_xref finds its address stored at 0006980b, in Ttm_AllocHandles (00069780).

entries.description: (manager, handle): the page byte +1 of the handle's script, or 0xffff for an empty handle. ES1GO's Ttm_GetPage (0004669f) with the manager's table. No caller found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Ttm_GetMode
entries.description: (manager, handle): the mode dword +0xe of the handle's script, without testing the handle for one. No caller found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Ttm_GetLoop
entries.description: (manager, handle): the loop flag dword +0x13 of the handle's script, without testing the handle for one. No caller found by es2_xref.

entries.description: (manager, timer count): allocates the handle table +5, a dword per handle of the count byte +4, returning 0 when that fails, and zeroes it; takes 000bdd0c into +0, or DVTimer_Ctor (0006c6f8)(0, 0x4da6) when that is 0, deleting the table and returning 0 when +0 is still 0; registers Ttm_TimerTick (000696f4) with Timer_AddCallback(count, it), stores the slot at the word +9 and returns 1. es2_xref finds one call, from Cockpit_LoadPanel (0002c9d8), with a count of 2.

entries.name: Ttm_SetDefaultContext
entries.description: (manager, context): stores context at 0009f248, the default render context Ttm_ManagerCtor (00069540) sets from its b and Ttm_RunAll (000695e0) installs, and returns the one before. es2_xref finds one call, from Cockpit_RunTtmScripts (0002e0ec), which passes the installed render context 000bdbda.

entries.name: Ttm_Open
entries.description: (manager, a, b, name) in stack order: returns 0xff when the count byte +4 is 0 or every handle of the table +5 holds a script; otherwise makes a script with TtmScript_Ctor (000797ac)(0) in the first empty handle and loads it with TtmScript_Load (0007a54c)(script, a, b, name), destroying it with TtmScript_Dtor (000799cc)(script, 3), emptying the handle and returning 0xff on a nonzero result; returns the handle's index. ES1GO's Ttm_Open keeps its table in globals and passes a third argument. es2_xref finds one call, from CockpitClock_Ctor (000433cc).

entries.description: (manager, page, handle): when the handle holds a script and page is below its page count byte +0, stores page at +1 and returns 1; otherwise returns 0. Leaves the wait, mode and flags, which ES1GO's TtmScript_SetPage (000470e7) resets. No caller found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Ttm_SetPathPrefix
entries.description: (manager, prefix): stores the string pointer at 0009f254, the folder TtmScript_BuildPath puts before a .TTM name, and returns the one before. es2_xref finds Cockpit_LoadPanel (0002c9d8) passing ttm\ (00092f2e).

entries.name: Ttm_SetMode
entries.description: (manager, mode, handle): stores mode at the dword +0xe of the handle's script and returns 1, or returns 0 for an empty handle. No caller found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Ttm_SetLoop
entries.description: (manager, loop, handle): stores loop at the dword +0x13 of the handle's script and returns 1, or returns 0 for an empty handle. No caller found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Ttm_Close
entries.description: (manager, handle): when the handle holds a script destroys it with TtmScript_Dtor(script, 3), empties the handle and returns 1; otherwise returns 0. No caller found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Ttm_CloseAll
entries.description: (manager): destroys the script of every handle of the table +5 below the count byte +4 with TtmScript_Dtor(script, 3) and empties the handle. es2_xref finds one call, from Ttm_ManagerDtor (00069598), through the padding entry 00069a02.

entries.name: GLViewport_Ctor
entries.description: (viewport) in stack order, callee-cleaned: allocates 0x239 bytes with Mem_New when viewport is null; stores 0009b40a, 0009b42e and 0009b456 in turn at +0, runs the inlined constructor of the rect at +0x210, copies 0x8b dwords from the viewport the GL display's (000bdd28) +0x40 points at to +4, and clears the byte +0x230 and the dwords +0x231 and +0x235. entries.name: Raster_InstallRenderContext
entries.description: (ctx), callee-cleaned: stores ctx at 000bdbda, the installed render context, and its clip block ctx + 4 (0 for a null ctx) at the GL display's (000bdd28) +0x44; passes the block to Raster_SetClipBlock (0007599c) when 000bdd28, read again, still holds that display, and passes it to Raster_SetClipBlock (0007599c) again. ES2's Raster_InstallRenderContext (DBSIM 00480c38) does the same through GLDisplay_SetClipBlock and Raster_SetClipBlock.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM disassembly at 00069be0, against ES2's Raster_InstallRenderContext

entries.name: HudFont_GlyphWidth
entries.description: (font, c) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the int16 at font+0xc when it is not -1, otherwise the width byte at (the pointer at font+0x2a)[c - the int16 at font+8]. ES2's HudFont_GlyphWidth (DBSIM 0048238c).

entries.name: HudFont_MeasureString
entries.description: (font, text), callee-cleaned: the sum of HudFont_GlyphWidth (00069ce0)(font, c) over the characters of the NUL-terminated text. ES2's HudFont_MeasureString (DBSIM 004823e0).

entries.name: HudFont_CellHeight
entries.description: (font, c), callee-cleaned: returns the int16 at font + 0xa, the glyph cell height, sign-extended; c is not read. Label_SetRect passes '0'. ES2's HudFont_CellHeight (DBSIM 00482410) takes the font alone.

entries.name: HudFont_CellHeight2
entries.description: (font, text) in stack order, callee-cleaned (RET 8): returns the int16 at font+0xa sign-extended, the glyph cell height; the text argument is ignored. ES2's HudFont_CellHeight2 (DBSIM 0048241c) takes the font alone.

entries.name: HudFont_DrawGlyph
entries.description: (font, c, pen) in stack order, callee-cleaned: blits glyph c as a block HudFont_CellHeight(font, c) rows high and HudFont_GlyphWidth(font, c) wide, of the depth byte at font+0x12, its pixels at the pointer at font+0x22 plus (the offset array at font+0x26)[c - the int16 at font+8], through Raster_BlitDispatch to (pen x, pen y - the int16 at font+0x16). When the render context 000bdbda is set and its byte +0x230 is non-zero, then draws a line with Raster_DrawLine from (pen x, pen y) to (pen x + the glyph's width, pen y). ES2's HudFont_DrawGlyph (DBSIM 00482428), less the message it formats first.

entries.name: HudFont_DrawString
entries.description: (font, text, pen) in stack order, callee-cleaned: draws a NUL-terminated run from the {x, y} pen. With the installed render context's (000bdbda) +0x231 at 1 it first moves x right by the field width +0x235 less HudFont_MeasureString, at 2 by half of that. Each character goes to HudFont_DrawGlyph (00069d64)(font, c, position) and x advances by HudFont_GlyphWidth (00069ce0)(font, c). ES2's HudFont_DrawString (DBSIM 00482528).
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 00069e38, against ES2's HudFont_DrawString

entries.name: strncat
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `strncat`, from `strings.ASM`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. The match covers 70 bytes from here.

entries.name: Raster_DrawLine
entries.description: (from, to), C convention: draws a line between two {x, y} points with the pen at the installed clip block's +0x224 (the block 00098d64 points at): pen mode 0 a flat colour, mode 2 a span remap through g_RasterRoutines slot 1 (0009ded8), any other mode nothing; a colour whose top byte is 4 is read from the colour ramps at 0009a6f5. The points move by the block's translation, (+0x20c - +0x21c, +0x210 - +0x220), when +0x208 is set. Clip mode 0 draws the whole line and mode 1 the line cut to the rect at +0x20c by Line_ClipToRect (0007d4a4), nothing when that answers 0: a flat colour through slot 34 (0009df5c), a remap as the span list Line_ScanConvertToSpanRegion (0007d358) makes of it in the list 00098de1 points at. Any other clip mode takes the regions of the list at +0 from the last to the first: a rect region (type 0) cuts a copy of the line to its rect with Line_ClipToRect and draws the piece's span list; at the first span region (type 2) the line itself is cut to the rect at +0x20c, the function returning when nothing of it is left, and made once into a span list in the list 00098de5 points at, which SpanRegion_Intersect (00073b7c) intersects with each span region; other region types are passed over. In those modes each piece goes to the pen's span routine, slot 0 for a flat colour. ES2's Raster_DrawLine (DBSIM 004838f8), statement for statement.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 0006a064, against ES2's Raster_DrawLine

entries.name: Str_CompareNoCaseN
entries.description: (a, b, n), C convention: compares up to n characters with toupper applied to each, stopping at a NUL in a or at the first difference, and returns the difference of the last uppercased pair as bytes; 0 for n of 0.

entries.name: GLDisplay_Ctor
entries.description: (display, kindName), callee-cleaned: allocates 0x48 bytes for a null display, GL_ClaimGlobal(display, display, 7), registers 0006a34c with Assert_AddHook (0005730c) and 0006a384 with atexit (0007d628), clears +0, and stores Raster_DriverByName(display, kindName) at +0x30. ES2's GLDisplay_Ctor (DBSIM 00480e4c). es2_xref finds no reference to it.

entries.name: GLDisplay_CtorAndOpen
entries.description: (display, bitmap, kindName), callee-cleaned: GLDisplay_Ctor's body, then GLDisplay_Open(display, bitmap). ES2's GLDisplay_CtorAndOpen (DBSIM 00480e98). Its callers found by es2_xref are Sim_CreateDisplay and 00069a68.

entries.name: GLDisplay_Open
entries.description: (display, bitmap), callee-cleaned: when +0 is 0: increments 0009b4cc, calling 000732ac the first time; RasterDriver_OpenDisplay(+0x30, bitmap, display + 4); on success allocates two 0x22c-byte clip blocks, sets up the first with ClipBlock_Init for the width +8 and height +0xc and copies it into the second (0x8b dwords), stores them at +0x40 and +0x44, zeroes +0x34, +0x38 and +0x3c, sets bit 0 of +0 and returns 1. Returns 0 when already open or when the driver refuses. ES2's GLDisplay_Open (DBSIM 00480f1c).

entries.name: Raster_SelectRenderTarget
entries.description: (display), callee-cleaned: makes display the current one (GL slot 7, 000bdd28) and installs it: when a display is current, GL_SetGlobal(0, 7), which always returns 0, so the early return of 1 never runs; GL_SetGlobal(display, 7); Raster_InstallDriverTable(+0x30); copies +4..+0x2c to 00098da2..00098dca; calls the driver's routines at 0009df1c, 0009df14 and 0009df18 with +0x34, +0x38 and +0x3c; Raster_InstallViewport(+0x40); Raster_SetClipBlock(+0x44); returns 0. ES2's Raster_SelectRenderTarget (DBSIM 00481118). Its one caller found by es2_xref is Sim_CreateDisplay.

entries.name: Raster_DriverByName
entries.description: (unused, name) in stack order: the display driver number for a name, matching it whole against the table 0009b4e4: VGA_8 1, VGA_4 0, BMP_8 3; 4, the table's end, for any other name.

entries.name: GLDisplay_GetAttribute
entries.description: (display, which), callee-cleaned: ES2's GLDisplay_GetAttribute (DBSIM 00481244) statement for statement: 0 +8 (width), 1 +0xc (height), 2 +0x28, 3 +0x2c, 4 +0x10, 6 +0x14, 7 +0x18, 9 +0x1c, 10 +0x20, 11 +0x24, 5, 8 and 16 three globals, anything else 0.

entries.name: GLDisplay_SetAttribute
entries.description: (display, value, attribute) in stack order, its arguments removed by this function, entered also at its padding 0006a823: finds the attribute in the six dwords at 0009b544 with REPNE SCASD and jumps through the table after them. Attribute 2 calls the routine pointer 0009def0, the driver's slot 7, with (value, display + 4) and, when display is the current one (000bdd28), copies +0x28 and +0x2c to 00098dc6 and 00098dca; 9, 10 and 11 store value at +0x1c, +0x20 and +0x24 and, for the current display, at Display_RetraceWaitMode (00098dba), Display_PanEnabled (00098dbe) and 00098dc2; 0x10 stores it at 00098dde; 0x11 calls the routine pointer 0009df54 with it. Returns 1, or 0 for any other attribute. ES2's GLDisplay_SetAttribute (DBSIM 004812ec), whose arguments are (display, attribute, value). es2_xref finds calls from Sim_StartMission (0005a9dc), with (display, 640, 2), and from the display's assert hook at 0006a34c, with attribute 0x10 and the value 1.

entries.name: Raster_BlitDispatch
entries.description: (header, point, flags) in stack order: draws a bitmap at point on the canvas 00098d64, the point moved by the canvas's +0x20c/+0x210 less +0x21c/+0x220 when its +0x208 is 1. A bitmap of type 1 (low four bits of header byte +5) goes to Bitmap_BlitTransparent (0007d66c); otherwise, by the canvas's +0x204: 0 the driver blit at 0009df3c(header, point, 0, flags), 1, or 2 with a positive canvas +0, the driver's clipped blit at 0009df44(header, point, canvas + 0x20c, flags). The point Bitmap_Blit (00067048) draws through.

entries.name: Bitmap_GrabClipDispatch
entries.description: (header, point, flags), C convention: reads the screen into a bitmap. Clears the low four bits of the header's flags byte +5; sets its format byte +4 to 8 when the display depth 00098db2 is 8 or 4 and the byte differs from it; zeroes its pixels (+0xa, size +6) with memset; moves the point by the clip block's (the one 00098d64 points at) +0x20c/+0x210 less +0x21c/+0x220 when its +0x208 is 1; and by its clip mode +0x204 calls g_RasterRoutines slot 27 (0009df40, VGA8_ReadBitmap (0008be88)) with (header, point, clip, flags): clip 0 for mode 0, the block's rect +0x20c for mode 1, and for mode 2 once for each entry of the block's list (count +0) whose region type is 0, with that region's rect. ES2's Bitmap_GrabClipDispatch (DBSIM 00488868), the same statements. es2_xref finds two calls, from Region_SaveRect (00066470) and 0004571c.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 0006aa70, diffed against ES2's Bitmap_GrabClipDispatch

entries.name: FileRWStream_CtorDefault
entries.description: FileRWStream() constructor, callee-cleaned (this): allocates 0xb bytes when this is null (0 if that fails), Stream_BaseCtor, the vtable 0009b576 at +4, handle -1 at +8, status 5 and +0xa (owns the handle) cleared. ES2's FileRWStream_Ctor (DBSIM 0047a810).

entries.name: FileRWStream_CtorFromHandle
entries.description: FileRWStream(handle) constructor, callee-cleaned: allocates 0xb bytes when this is null, Stream_BaseCtor, the vtable 0009b576, adopts the handle at +8 without owning it (+0xa = 0) and probes it with lseek(h, 0, SEEK_CUR), FileRWStream_SetIoError on -1. ES2's FileRWStream_CtorFromHandle (DBSIM 0047a844).

entries.name: FileRWStream_Ctor
entries.description: FileRWStream(path) constructor, callee-cleaned: allocates 0xb bytes when this is null, Stream_BaseCtor, the vtable 0009b576, handle -1, +0xa cleared, then FileRWStream_Open(path). ES2's FileRWStream_CtorFromPath (DBSIM 0047a88c).

entries.name: FileRWStream_Dtor
entries.description: FileRWStream destructor (this, flags), vtable slot +4: restores the vtable 0009b576, FileRWStream_Close, Stream_BaseDtor(this, 0), and Mem_Delete when bit 0 of the flags is set. ES2's FileRWStream_Dtor (DBSIM 0047a8c4).

entries.name: FileRWStream_GetCapabilities
entries.description: FileRWStream vtable slot +0x10 (stream, query): queries 0 to 3 answer 1, anything else 0. ES2's FileRWStream_GetCapabilities (DBSIM 0047a900).

entries.name: FileRWStream_SetFile
entries.description: (stream, handle): FileRWStream_Close, adopts the handle at +8 without owning it (+0xa = 0) and probes it with lseek(h, 0, SEEK_CUR): status 0 on success, FileRWStream_SetIoError on -1. ES2's FileRWStream_SetFile (DBSIM 0047a92c).

entries.name: FileRWStream_Close
entries.description: (stream): closes the handle at +8 when the stream owns it (+0xa) and it is not -1, returning 0 with status 3 when close fails; otherwise sets the handle to -1 and status 5 and returns 1. ES2's FileRWStream_Close (DBSIM 0047a970).

entries.name: FileRWStream_Open
entries.description: (stream, path): FileRWStream_Close, then open(path, 0x102, 0x180) into the handle at +8, read-write, created when missing: status 1 and 0 returned on failure, else status 0, +0xa (owns the handle) set and 1 returned. ES2's FileRWStream_Open (DBSIM 0047a9b0).

entries.name: FileRWStream_Tell
entries.description: FileRWStream vtable slot +8 (stream): returns lseek(h, 0, SEEK_CUR) of the handle at +8. ES2's FileRWStream_Tell (DBSIM 0047a9fc).

entries.name: FileRWStream_Seek
entries.description: FileRWStream vtable slot +0xc (stream, position): a status of 2 is cleared first and any other nonzero status returns 0; lseek(h, position, SEEK_SET), FileRWStream_SetIoError on -1, else 1. ES2's FileRWStream_Seek (DBSIM 0047aa18).

entries.name: FileRWStream_GetSize
entries.description: (stream): 0 unless the status is 0 or 2. Otherwise saves the position (slot +8), takes lseek(h, 0, SEEK_END), restores the position (slot +0xc) and returns the end offset. ES2's FileRWStream_GetSize (DBSIM 0047aa5c).

entries.name: FileRWStream_Flush
entries.description: FileRWStream vtable slot +0x14, entered through the padding at 0006ae6e: MOV AL,1; RET 4. ES2's FileRWStream_Flush (DBSIM 0047aaa4).

entries.name: FileRWStream_SetIoError
entries.description: (stream): sets the status at +0 to 3 when errno (000973d3) is 0, otherwise 1, and returns 0. ES2's FileRWStream_SetIoError (DBSIM 0047aaac).

entries.name: FileRWStream_Write
entries.description: FileRWStream vtable slot +0x18 (stream, buffer, count): 0 when the status is nonzero, 1 for a count of 0; otherwise write() to the handle at +8, FileRWStream_SetIoError on -1, else 1. A short write is not checked. ES2's FileRWStream_Write (DBSIM 0047aad0).

entries.name: FileRWStream_Read
entries.description: FileRWStream vtable slot +0x1c (stream, buffer, count): 0 when the status is nonzero, 1 for a count of 0; otherwise read() from the handle at +8, FileRWStream_SetIoError on -1, status 2 and 0 on a short read, else 1. ES2's FileRWStream_Read (DBSIM 0047ab10).

entries.name: GLCursor_Ctor
entries.description: (this), callee-cleaned: allocates 0x10 bytes when this is 0; stores the vtables 0009b626, 0009b64a and the cursor's 0009b672 in turn and zeroes the bitmap +4. DBSIM's GLCursor_Ctor (00483480).

entries.name: GLCursor_Dtor
entries.description: (cursor, flags) in stack order, callee-cleaned: slot +0x1c of the GLCursor vtable 0009b672, entered through the padding at 0006b3ca. Returns for a null cursor; stores the vtable 0009b672, destroys a non-null bitmap +4 through its slot +0x1c with 3, stores the base vtable 0009b64a, and frees the cursor when flags bit 0 is set.
