entries.name: DirtyList_Flush
entries.description: (drawPage, sourcePage) in stack order, callee-cleaned: ES1GO's DirtyList_Flush without its render-context install and restore: sets the display 000bdd28's source page +0x38 and draw page +0x3c (copied to 00098dd6 and 00098dda and passed to raster slots 0009df14 and 0009df18 while it is the current display), copies each delay-0 box of the list 000bbc84 as the region {x, y, x + width, y + height} at offset (0, 0) with Region_CopyBetweenPages (00066914), lowers every delay by 1, puts back the two pages' low bytes, and calls DirtyList_Prune (00083ae4). es2_xref finds no reference to it.

entries.name: Emu8000_WriteWord
entries.description: (value, register) in stack order, callee-cleaned: writes a word to a Sound Blaster AWE32 EMU8000 register with interrupts off (restored only when they were on). The register code's bits 0-4 (channel) and bits 12-14 (moved to bits 5-7) go to the pointer port, the Data0 port 000acd42 + 0x802; the value goes to Data0 + (code & 0xc00), plus 2 when bit 9 is set. 00084516 sets Data0 to the base it is given, adding 0x400 to one below 0x300 (0x220 becomes 0x620).

entries.name: Emu8000_ReadWord
entries.description: (register), callee-cleaned: Emu8000_WriteWord's port selection, reading the word with IN instead.

entries.name: Emu8000_WriteDword
entries.description: (value, register) in stack order, callee-cleaned: Emu8000_WriteWord for a 32-bit register: the low word to the selected data port and the high word to that port + 2.

entries.name: Emu8000_ReadDword
entries.description: (register), callee-cleaned: Emu8000_ReadWord for a 32-bit register: the low word from the selected data port, the high word from that port + 2.

entries.name: VGA8_ShowCursor
entries.description: No arguments: slot 30 of the VGA_8 driver's table (000a7b70) and of the VGA_4 driver's table (000a7ae0), the stored pointers es2_xref finds. With a bitmap at Cursor_Bitmap (00098d68) and Cursor_Shown (00098d6c) clear, with interrupts off: sets Cursor_Shown, stores Cursor_Position (00098d70) less Cursor_Hotspot (00098d78) at Cursor_DrawCorner (00098d8e), sets the source and draw pages' offsets 0009e600/0009e604 to the visible page's 0009e608 and their pans 0009e60c/0009e610 to 0009e614, reads the pixels under the corner into Cursor_SaveUnder (00098d80) through g_RasterRoutines slot 27 (0009df40) and draws the bitmap there through slot 26 (0009df3c), each with the clip rect 00098d34 and flags 0, then puts the four back.

entries.name: VGA8_HideCursor
entries.description: No arguments, frameless, with no Ghidra function: slot 31 of the VGA_8 driver's table (000a7b70) and of the VGA_4 driver's table (000a7ae0), the stored pointers es2_xref finds. With a bitmap at Cursor_Bitmap (00098d68) and Cursor_Shown (00098d6c) set, with interrupts off: clears Cursor_Shown, sets the draw page's offset 0009e604 and pan 0009e610 to the visible page's 0009e608 and 0009e614, and while the dword 00098dc2 is set draws Cursor_SaveUnder (00098d80) back at Cursor_DrawCorner (00098d8e) through g_RasterRoutines slot 26 (0009df3c) with the clip rect 00098d34 and flags 0; then puts the two back.

entries.name: VGA8_FillSpans
entries.description: (spans, colour), C convention: slot 0 of the VGA_8 driver's table 000a7b70, which Raster_DrawPolygonDispatch, Raster_DrawLine and Raster_FillSpanList call through g_RasterRoutines (0009ded4). Fills a span list {int16 top row, int16 row count, {x0, x1} per row} on the draw page (offset 0009e604, pan 0009e610 added to each x, row table VGA8_RowOffsets, row bytes VGA8_RowBytes) with the colour byte through the sequencer's map mask (port 3C4 index 2), skipping a row whose x0 is past its x1: a row within one group of four columns in one write with the mask 0009e61c[4 * (x0 & 3) + ((x1 - x0 + 1) & 3)], otherwise the first group's mask 0009e62c[x0 & 3], the whole groups with 0xf, and the last group's 0009e630[the remaining count & 3]. A count below 1 still draws the first row.

entries.name: VGA8_RemapSpans
entries.description: (spans, table), C convention: slot 1 of the VGA_8 driver's table 000a7b70 (g_RasterRoutines 0009ded8), brush mode 6's fill: rewrites each pixel from x0 to x1 of each row of the span list as table[pixel], a pixel at a time, reading its plane through the graphics controller (port 3CE index 4) and writing it under the map mask 000ad76c[plane] (1, 2, 4, 8). A row whose x0 is past its x1 is skipped; a count below 1 still does the first row.

entries.name: VGA8_FillRect
entries.description: (rect, colour), C convention: slot 2 of the VGA_8 driver's table 000a7b70 (g_RasterRoutines 0009dedc), which Raster_FillRect, VGA8_ClearPage and 0008aeb0 call: fills the inclusive rect {x0, y0, x1, y1} on the draw page with the colour, each row as VGA8_FillSpans (0008aef8) fills one, with the same masks; reads the map mask register at the start and writes it back at the end.

entries.name: VGA8_RemapRect
entries.description: (rect, table), C convention: slot 3 of the VGA_8 driver's table 000a7b70 (g_RasterRoutines 0009dee0), Raster_FillRect's for brush mode 6: rewrites each pixel of the inclusive rect as table[pixel], as VGA8_RemapSpans (0008afd4) does a row, the write mask from 000ad770 (1, 2, 4, 8).

entries.name: VGA8_PutPixel
entries.description: (point, colour), C convention, frameless: slot 5 of the VGA_8 driver's table 000a7b70 (g_RasterRoutines 0009dee8), which Gfx_PlotPixel, the object list's corner probes and the paper doll's recolouring call: writes the colour byte at {x, y} of the draw page (offset 0009e604, pan 0009e610, row table VGA8_RowOffsets, selector 0009df84 in FS) under the map mask 1 << ((x + pan) & 3).

entries.name: VGA8_RemapPixel
entries.description: (point, table), C convention: slot 6 of the VGA_8 driver's table 000a7b70 (g_RasterRoutines 0009deec), Gfx_PlotPixel's for pen mode 2: rewrites the pixel at {x, y} of the draw page as table[pixel], its plane read through the graphics controller (port 3CE index 4) and written under the map mask 1 << ((x + pan) & 3).

entries.name: VGA8_SetVirtualWidth
entries.description: (width, info), C convention, info being a display's +4: the VGA_8 driver's slot 7 (000a7b8c). Stores width & ~3 at info+0x24 and 0x40000 divided by it at info+0x28, the rows the 256 KB of video memory hold at that width; stores width >> 2, the bytes a row takes in each plane, at VGA8_RowBytes (0009df86), and that less info+4 >> 2 at VGA8_RowExtraBytes (0009df8a); fills the 800 int16 at VGA8_RowOffsets (0009df8e) with y * (width >> 2); and writes width >> 3 to the CRTC's offset register (port 3D4, index 0x13). RasterDriver_OpenDisplay (0007330a) calls it with (info+0x24, info), and GLDisplay_SetAttribute (0006a824) for attribute 2 through the routine pointer 0009def0.

entries.name: VGA8_IsModeUnsupported
entries.description: Frameless, (mode), C convention, with no Ghidra function: the VGA_8 driver's slot 8 (000a7b90). Returns 0 for modes 0, 1 and 2 and 1 for any other. RasterDriver_OpenDisplay (0007330a) calls it first and fails the open when it returns non-zero.

entries.name: VGA8_OpenMode
entries.description: (mode, info), C convention, info being a display's +4: the VGA_8 driver's slot 11 (000a7b9c). Sets the ten dwords at VGA8_PageOffsets (0009e5ce) to i times the mode's page size, the dword VGA8_ModePageSizes (000ad8e8)[mode], or to 0 where that reaches 0x10000, and the ten bytes at VGA8_PagePans (0009e5f6) to 0; zeroes the dwords 0009e600, 0009e604, 0009e608, 0009e60c, 0009e610 and 0009e614; calls 0008b408(mode); and copies the mode's 0x2c bytes at VGA8_ModeRecords (000ad788) + 0x2c * mode to info. RasterDriver_OpenDisplay (0007330a) calls it with (the bitmap argument, info).

entries.name: VGA8_SpanFill
entries.description: (colour, y, x0, x1), C convention: slot 24 of the VGA_8 driver's table 000a7b70 (g_RasterRoutines 0009df34), which Bitmap_BlitTransparent (0007d66c) calls: fills x0 to x1 of row y of the draw page with the colour, the end groups under their masks as VGA8_FillSpans (0008aef8) does and the whole groups between with all planes; reads the map mask register at the start and writes it back at the end.

entries.name: VGA8_SpanFillRegion
entries.description: (colour, y, x0, x1), C convention: slot 25 of the VGA_8 driver's table 000a7b70 (g_RasterRoutines 0009df38), which Bitmap_BlitTransparent (0007d66c) calls in clip mode 2. With the clip block's (00098d64) mode +0x204 2 it fills the row as VGA8_SpanFill (0008b764) does once for each region of the block's list (count +0, pointers from +4), first to last, that holds row y and overlaps x0 to x1, cut to it: a rect region {type 0, x0 +4, y0 +8, x1 +0xc, y1 +0x10} to its columns, a span region (type 2, its span list at +4) to that row's pair; other types are skipped. In any other mode it fills x0 to x1 once.

entries.name: VGA8_BlitBitmap
entries.description: (header, point, clip, flags) in stack order: the VGA_8 driver's bitmap blit, its table's +0x68: clips the bitmap's rows (+0) and columns (+2) against clip when clip is non-null, mirrors by flags bits 1 and 2, and writes the bytes to display memory through the sequencer's map mask (ports 3c4/3c5) a plane at a time. With header byte +5's bit 4 set every byte is written; with it clear a 0 byte is skipped, leaving the pixel.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM disassembly at 0008b9a8 (head, clip, flag tests and copy loops)

entries.name: VGA8_ReadBitmap
entries.description: (header, point, clip, flags), C convention: slot 27 of the VGA_8 driver's table (000a7b70), the one stored pointer es2_xref finds. The reverse of VGA8_BlitBitmap (0008b9a8): with a clip rect, returns when the bitmap's rows (+0) and columns (+2) at the point miss it and otherwise cuts them to it; mirrors by the flags 1 and 2; reads the rect of the source page (offset 0009e600, pan 0009e60c, the row table VGA8_RowOffsets) a plane at a time through the graphics controller's read map select (port 3ce index 4, its value put back after) into the pixels the dword +0xa points at. With flags 0 the first pixel read goes to byte T * columns + L, T and L the rows and columns cut at the top and the left, and each row steps a whole row of the bitmap, so every pixel lands at its own row and column and the bytes the clip cuts off are not written.

entries.name: VGA8_BlitBitmapClipped
entries.description: (header, point, clip, flags), C convention: the VGA_8 driver's clipped blit, its table's +0x70 (0009df44): with clip non-null trims the bitmap's columns and rows to the rect clip (returning when nothing is left), picks the start and the row and column steps by flags bits 1 and 2, and draws each destination row with VGA8_BlitClippedRow, a plane at a time. With header byte +5's bit 4 set every byte is written; with it clear a 0 byte is skipped (OR AL,AL / JZ at 0008c58b).

entries.name: VGA8_BlitClippedRow
entries.description: A block of VGA8_BlitBitmapClipped, near-called with its frame (EBP) per destination row ([EBP-0x38]): in clip mode +0x204 2 clips the row to each region of the clip block's list in turn, a type-0 rect or a type-2 span region, passing over regions of other types; otherwise draws it once. For each of the four planes writes that plane's pixels of the row, every byte when header bit 4 is set, and only the non-zero ones when it is clear.

entries.name: VGA8_BlitBitmapScaled
entries.description: (header, w, h, point, clip, flags), C convention: VGA_8's slot 29 in the simulator, the scaled blit, its code not the shell's. Reads the bitmap's rows (+0), columns (+2), size (+6) and pixels (+0xa). With a clip rect it returns when the box misses it and takes L, R, T and B, how far the box passes the rect's left, right, top and bottom edges, each 0 when it does not; it returns when w - L - R or h - T - B is 0. VGA8_ScaleStepSetup (0008cb75) gives the column step from the columns, negated with flags & 2, over w, and the row step from the rows, negated with flags & 1, over h. With T non-zero the source offset is ((T * row step) >> 16) * columns and the running fraction the low 16 bits of (T + B) * row step, otherwise both 0; flags & 1 adds size - columns to the offset and flags & 2 adds columns. For each of the h - T - B rows from point.y + T it runs VGA8_BlitScaledRow (0008c8d0), then adds the row step to the running fraction, never reduced, and sets the offset to the first row's plus (fraction / 0xffff, signed) * columns.

entries.name: VGA8_BlitScaledRow
entries.description: A block of VGA8_BlitBitmapScaled (0008c744), near-called with its frame (EBP) per destination row ([EBP-0x34]): in clip mode +0x204 2 clips the row to each region of the clip block's list in turn, a type-0 rect or a type-2 span region, passing over regions of other types; otherwise draws it once. For each of the four planes, through the sequencer's map mask (port 3C4 index 2), writes that plane's pixels of the run on the draw page, pixel j taking source byte (A + j * column step) >> 16 of the row, A = (L + the region's left cut) * the column step, and writes only the non-zero bytes.

entries.name: VGA8_ScaleStepSetup
entries.description: Register helper of VGA8_BlitBitmapScaled (0008c744): with EBX, the destination size, non-zero stores at [EDI+4] (EAX << 16) / EBX, the IDIV truncating toward zero, plus 1 when that quotient is not negative and minus 1 when it is; 0 for an EBX of 0.

entries.name: VGA8_DrawLine
entries.description: (colour, a, b), C convention: the VGA_8 driver's line, slot 34 of its table 000a7b70 (+0x88), which Raster_DrawLine (0006a064) calls through 0009df5c for a flat colour. Draws on the draw page (offset 0009e604, pan 0009e610 added to each x, row table 0009df8e, row bytes 0009df86, selector 0009df84 in FS) through the sequencer's map mask (port 3C4 index 2). It starts from the point with the smaller x, a when the two are equal; dx is the x distance and dy the absolute y distance, the row step negated when the line rises. dy 0: the dx + 1 pixels of the row, in one write with the mask 0009e61c[4 * (x & 3) + ((dx + 1) & 3)] when they stay in one group of four columns, else the first group's mask 0009e62c[x & 3], the whole groups with mask 0xf (REP STOSW), and the last group's 0009e630[the remaining count & 3]. dx 0: dy + 1 pixels of the column. dx <= dy: on row i from 0 to dy the pixel at column x + floor(i * (dx + 1) / (dy + 1)). dx > dy: on column j from 0 to dx the pixel floor(j * (dy + 1) / (dx + 1)) rows on, the pixels of one group of four on one row written together. So both end points are drawn, and the pixels do not depend on the order of a and b. es2_xref finds one reference, the table's slot.

entries.name: VGA8_ClearPage
entries.description: (page, color), C convention: VGA_8's slot 35, the dword at 000a7bfc in its table 000a7b70, which the simulator calls through 0009df60. Fills the page with the color. When the dword 00098da6 equals 00098dc6, it writes (00098da6 * 00098daa) >> 4 dwords of the color byte repeated four times with REP STOSD from VGA8_PageOffsets (0009e5ce)[page], through the selector 0009df84, with the sequencer's map mask (port 3C4 index 2) set to 0xf and put back after. Otherwise it keeps Raster_GetDrawPage (0008fcde), makes the page the draw page through slot 17 (0009df18), passes the rect {0, 0, 00098da6 - 1, 00098daa - 1} and the color to slot 2 (0009dedc), and passes the kept page to slot 17 again. es2_xref finds one stored pointer to it, in VGA_8's table, and es2_xref --decode two calls through 0009df60, both from Sim_DeathFlash (00058414). ES2's Sim_DeathFlash calls g_RasterRoutines_ClearSurface at the same point.

entries.name: BMP8_BlitBitmap
entries.description: The BMP_8 driver's bitmap blit, its table's +0x68: copies the bitmap's rows into the canvas bitmap, by flag bits 1 and 2 in one of four orders (cases 0-3). With header byte +5's bit 4 set each row goes by REP MOVSD/MOVSB, or byte by byte when mirrored; with it clear each 0 byte is skipped, leaving the destination. The clipped blit 0008dc3c calls it.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM disassembly at 0008d700 (the case blocks and copy loops)

entries.name: Raster_FillSpanList
entries.description: (spans, origin), C convention: ES2's Raster_FillSpanList (DBSIM 00486928) statement for statement, with the clip block 00098d64 and the colour ramps 0009a6f5.

entries.name: DetAnimObjVtable

entries.name: BaseFiringWindow
entries.description: Two int16, 10000 and 10000: the counter Base_ArmedThinkTick (00003364) reloads the firing window +0x1b1 with, indexed by the flag +0x1b4 it has just flipped.

entries.name: BaseTurret_Gain
entries.description: Two int16, 2000 and 2500: the per-axis gain of Base_AimTurret (00003058), elevation then traverse.

entries.name: BaseTurret_RateLimit
entries.description: Two int16, 200 and 800: the per-axis rate limit of Base_AimTurret (00003058).

entries.name: BaseTurret_MinAngle
entries.description: Two int16, -4000 and -32768: the lower stops of Base_AimTurret (00003058).

entries.name: BaseTurret_MaxAngle
entries.description: Two int16, 4000 and 32767: the upper stops of Base_AimTurret (00003058).

entries.name: BaseHit_Occupancy
entries.description: The int16 1, followed by two zero words before the table copy at 000904a6: the occupancy flags Base_DirectFireHitTest (00003a58) passes Mech_SelectStruckComponent (00009064) for a structure's collision model. Mech_ComponentGeometryTest_Candidate (00008f84) reads them one int16 per component (CMP word ptr at 0000901e), so a cluster naming component 0 is tested and one naming 1 or 2 is not.

entries.name: StructureVtable
entries.description: The plain structure's table, BASES.DAT types 0-4 and 7, which Base_Construct (00003cbc) stores in every arm before a class's own: Structure_DrawWithDetailBias (00002d18) at +4, Base_Dtor (00004318) at +0xc, Base_ThinkTick (00002df8) at +0x1c, Base_DirectFireHitTest (00003a58) at +0x24.

entries.name: StructureRadarVtable
entries.description: The radar mast's table, BASES.DAT types 5 and 6, which Base_Construct (00003cbc) stores: the slots of StructureVtable (00090522) with Base_RadarDtor (00004360) at +0xc.

entries.name: StructureArmedVtable
entries.description: The GUN TOWER's table, BASES.DAT type 8, which Base_Construct (00003cbc) stores: the slots of StructureVtable (00090522) with Base_ArmedDtor (000043a8) at +0xc, Base_ArmedThinkTick (00003364) at +0x1c and Base_GetTurretAngle (00002dc0) at +0x40.

entries.name: ExplosionVtable
entries.description: The impact effect's vtable: slot +4 TSObj_RenderExploCopy (000059c8), +8 TSObj_GetPositionExploCopy (000059e8), +0xc Explosion_Destruct (00005940), +0x10 TSObj_ReturnZeroExploCopy (000059fc), +0x14 TSObj_GetRadiusExploCopy (00005a04). Explosion_Construct (00005af0) stores it.

entries.name: FlatObjVtableExploCopy
entries.description: explo.cpp's copy of the ground shape's vtable, which Explosion_Construct (00005af0) stores on an effect's ground shape: slot +4 FlatObj_DrawExploCopy (00005ca8), +0xc FlatObj_DtorExploCopy (00005cd8).

entries.name: DebrisVtable
entries.description: The debris piece's vtable: slot +4 Debris_Draw (000065c4), +8 TSObj_GetPositionDebrisCopy (000061fc), +0xc Debris_Destruct (00006210), +0x10 TSObj_ReturnZeroDebrisCopy (00006264), +0x14 TSObj_GetRadiusDebrisCopy (0000626c). Debris_Construct (00006168) stores it.

entries.name: Smoke_PuffCountByKind
entries.description: int16[3]: 200, 500 and 1000, the number of balls a smoke emitter of kind 0, 1 and 2 puffs, which Smoke_Construct (000069ec) stores at +0x1e. ES2's table at DBSIM 00497eec holds the same.

entries.name: SmokeBallVtable
entries.description: The smoke ball's vtable: slot +4 TSObj_RenderSmokeCopy (000067c0), +8 TSObj_GetPositionSmokeCopy (000067e0), +0xc SmokeBall_Dtor (000067f4), +0x10 TSObj_ReturnZeroSmokeCopy (00006848), +0x14 TSObj_GetRadiusSmokeCopy (00006850). SmokeBall_Construct (00006704) stores it.

entries.name: SmokeVtable
entries.description: The smoke emitter's vtable: slot +4 Smoke_DrawNoOp (00006ae9), +8 Smoke_GetPositionNull (00006aef), +0xc Smoke_Dtor (00006af8) by its padding, +0x10 TSObj_ReturnZeroSmokeCopy (00006848), +0x14 Drawable_GetRadiusSmokeCopy (0000691e) entered at 00006920. Smoke_Construct (000069ec) stores it.

entries.name: ProjectileBaseVtableRocketCopy
entries.description: rocket.cpp's copy of the projectile base's table, which Rocket_Construct (000074e4) stores before RocketVtable (00090ad6): TSObj_RenderRocketCopy (00007580), TSObj_GetPositionRocketCopy (000075a0), ProjectileBase_DtorRocketCopy (000075b4), TSObj_ReturnZeroRocketCopy (000075f3) and TSObj_GetRadiusRocketCopy (000075fc) at +4 to +0x14, 0 at +0x18. ES2's ProjectileBaseVtable (DBSIM 004987a0).

entries.name: RocketVtable
entries.description: The missile's table: ProjectileBaseVtableRocketCopy (00090ab2)'s slots with Rocket_Dtor (00007644) at +0xc and Rocket_TickUpdate (00007198) at +0x18. ES2's RocketVtable (DBSIM 00498448), its slots 4 lower.

entries.name: ProjectileBaseVtableGrenadeCopy
entries.description: The thrown round's file's copy of the projectile base's table, which Grenade_Construct (000078c4) stores before GrenadeVtable (00090b7e), with ProjectileBase_DtorGrenadeCopy (000079b0) at +0xc.

entries.name: GrenadeVtable
entries.description: The thrown round's table: ProjectileBaseVtableGrenadeCopy (00090b5a)'s slots with Grenade_Dtor (00007a40) at +0xc and Grenade_TickNoOp (00007b47) at +0x18. ES2's GrenadeVtable (DBSIM 004984fc).

entries.name: ProjectileBaseVtableBulletCopy
entries.description: bullet.cpp's copy of the projectile base's table, which Bullet_Construct (00007d08) stores before BulletVtable (00090c56), with ProjectileBase_DtorBulletCopy (00007df0) at +0xc.

entries.name: BulletVtable
entries.description: The gun round's table: ProjectileBaseVtableBulletCopy (00090c32)'s slots with Bullet_Dtor (00007e80) at +0xc and Bullet_TickUpdate (00007f84) at +0x18. ES2's BulletVtable (DBSIM 00498628).

entries.name: Beam_HalfWidths
entries.description: Six int16 half-widths by beam subtype, 60, 30, 120, 20, 25, 30, which BeamTracer_Ctor (00008268) adds to and takes from the tracer's points. ES2 reads them from dat\beam.

entries.name: Beam_Colors
entries.description: Six int16 palette indices by beam subtype, 10, 102, 10, 88, 88, 88, which BeamTracer_Draw (000087e0) fills with. ES2 reads them from dat\beam.

entries.name: Beam_QuadIndexOffsets
entries.description: Four int16, 1, 0, 1, 2, from which Beam_BuildIndexTable (00008230) builds Beam_QuadIndexTable (000bc202). ES2's BeamQuadIndexOffsets (DBSIM 00498640).

entries.name: ProjectileBaseVtableBeamCopy
entries.description: The beams' file's copy of the projectile base's table, which BeamTracer_Ctor (00008268) stores before BeamTracerVtable (00090d1e), with ProjectileBase_DtorBeamCopy (00008604) at +0xc.

entries.name: BeamTracerVtable
entries.description: The beam tracer's table: BeamTracer_Draw (000087e0) at +4, TSObj_GetPositionBeamCopy (000085f0) at +8, BeamTracer_Dtor (00008768) at +0xc, TSObj_ReturnZeroBeamCopy (00008643) at +0x10, TSObj_GetRadiusBeamCopy (0000864c) at +0x14 and BeamTracer_LifeTick (000089a8) at +0x18. ES2's BeamTracerVtable (DBSIM 004987c4).

entries.name: CollisionTable_Count
entries.description: int16: the collision slots reserved, which CollisionTable_Reserve (00009350) returns and adds to and CollisionTable_Alloc (00009368) allocates 6 bytes each of.

entries.name: CollisionTable_Cursor
entries.description: int16: the next collision slot Collision_RegisterObject (00009580) fills, which it increments.

entries.name: DmgTable_Cursor
entries.description: int16: the next 12-byte .DMG slot Damage_LoadMechDmgFile (00009a2c) fills, which it increments.

entries.name: DmgTable_Count
entries.description: int16: the .DMG slots reserved, which DmgTable_Reserve (00009a9c) returns and adds to and DmgTable_Alloc (00009ab4) allocates 12 bytes each of.

entries.name: maybe_ComponentDependencyList
entries.description: Pointer to the 6-byte list Component_LinkMaxRefData (00009c28) makes on its first call: an array of 0x14 bytes at +0, the capacity byte 10 at +4 and the count byte at +5. Component_DestroyAndCascade (00009cd4) appends to it with no test of the capacity, and Component_ApplyDamageAndCascade (00009f7c) drains it from its last entry. ES2's maybe_ComponentDependencyList, whose capacity is 20.

entries.name: Shape_TranslatePointListsTags
entries.description: Eleven class tags (0x1e0005, 0x1e0003, 0x140005, 0x14000a, 0x140014, 0x140006, 0x140015, 0x140008, 0x140007, 0x14000b, 0x14000c) followed by their eleven case targets inside Shape_TranslatePointLists (0000a308), which searches them with REPNE SCASD.

entries.name: Shape_TranslatePointPolyTags
entries.description: Five poly class tags (0x140001, 0x140002, 0x140003, 0x140009, 0x14000f) followed by five targets, all 0000a393, the case of Shape_TranslatePointLists (0000a308) that marks a poly's points.

entries.name: WeaponMountBaseVtableMountsCopy
entries.description: The weapon mount base class's vtable in the mount classes' object file, which WeaponMount_CtorBase (0000a530) stores: the slots of WeaponMountBaseVtable (000914a2), with this file's own class tag, destructor WeaponMount_DtorBaseMountsCopy (0000a7d8), trigger and stub copies; fire +0x2c WeaponMount_PrepareShot (0000add4), 0 at ready +0x30, gauge push +0x54, gauge factory +0x68 and +0x6c.

entries.name: EnergyMountVtableMountsCopy
entries.description: The energy mounts' vtable in the mount classes' object file, which WeaponMount_CtorEnergy (0000a84c) stores: the slots of EnergyMountVtable (0009142e), with this file's own class tag, destructor WeaponMount_DtorEnergyMountsCopy (0000a8c4), trigger and stub copies; 0 at +0x6c.

entries.name: AmmunitionMountVtableMountsCopy
entries.description: The ammunition mounts' vtable in the mount classes' object file, which WeaponMount_CtorAmmunition (0000a9e4) stores: the slots of AmmunitionMountVtable (00091516), with this file's own class tag, destructor WeaponMount_DtorAmmunitionMountsCopy (0000aa3c), trigger and stub copies; 0 at +0x6c.

entries.name: MissileAmmoNameTable
entries.description: Four char pointers indexed by a rocket record's subtype: SARH, ARH, ARM, EO (strings 0009109a-000910a7). Read by WeaponMount_GetDisplayName (0000aa9c). ES2's MissileAmmoNameTable (DBSIM 004989c8).

entries.name: EcmMountVtable
entries.description: The ECM mount's vtable, its only one, which EcmMount_Ctor (0000ab50) and EcmMount_Dtor (0000aba0) store: fire +0x2c EcmMount_FireNoOp (0000af3c), ready +0x30 EcmMount_CanFireNever (0000b270), trigger +0x34 EcmMount_TriggerHeldNever (0000acab), pool turn +0x38 WeaponMount_RefireTick (0000b408), the base's stubs from +0x3c, gauge push +0x54 EcmMount_PushGaugeState (0000b588), gauge match +0x5c WeaponMount_MatchGaugeNever (0000a4f0), subtype +0x64 WeaponMount_GetEnergyAmmoType (0000ac54), gauge factory +0x68 EcmMount_CreateGauge (0000abec), 0 at +0x6c.

entries.name: WeaponMountsBaseVtable
entries.description: The base weapon-mount manager's vtable: a zero dword and one slot, WeaponMounts_ArbitrateEnergyNoSelection (0000c5bc) by its padding entry. MechLoadout_ConstructWeaponMounts (0000c31c) stores it at the manager's +0x10. ES2's GUNLIST vtable (DBSIM 00499338).

entries.name: ElfMountVtable
entries.description: The ELF mounts' vtable: the energy table EnergyMountVtable (0009142e) with its own destructor ElfMount_Dtor (0000c5d4) at +0x1c and its own fire (+0x2c, ElfMount_FireDispatch (0000b218)), ready (+0x30, ElfMount_CanFire (0000b384)), trigger (+0x34, ElfMount_TriggerHeld (0000acb4)) and pool turn (+0x38, ElfMount_SpinUpAndChargeTick (0000b748)) slots, the four slots ES2's ElfMountVtable (DBSIM 004992c0) replaces. MechLoadout_ConstructWeaponMounts (0000c31c) stores it over the energy constructor's table for weapon id 3.

entries.name: GrenadeMountVtable
entries.description: The grenade mounts' vtable: the ammunition table AmmunitionMountVtable (00091516) with its own destructor GrenadeMount_Dtor (0000c69c) at +0x1c and its own fire (+0x2c, GrenadeMount_FireDispatch (0000afd4)), trigger (+0x34, GrenadeMount_TriggerHeld (0000ad54)) and gauge push (+0x54, GrenadeMount_PushGaugeState (0000b714)) slots, the three slots ES2's GrenadeMountVtable (DBSIM 00499248) replaces. MechLoadout_ConstructWeaponMounts (0000c31c) stores it over the ammunition constructor's table for weapon id 5, GREN.

entries.name: EnergyMountVtable
entries.description: gunlist.cpp's copy of the energy mounts' vtable, ES2's ENERGY_WPN table (DBSIM 00498dcc) with every slot 4 higher, ending with the gauge factory at +0x68 and 0 at +0x6c. ElfMount_Dtor (0000c5d4) and WeaponMount_DtorEnergy (0000c71c) store it; the energy constructor WeaponMount_CtorEnergy (0000a84c) stores its own file's copy EnergyMountVtableMountsCopy (00090fb6).

entries.name: WeaponMountBaseVtable
entries.description: gunlist.cpp's copy of the mount base's vtable, ES2's GUN_STATE table (DBSIM 00498e44) with every slot 4 higher; it holds 0 at ready (+0x30), gauge push (+0x54) and gauge factory (+0x68), where ES2's holds Rtl_PureVirtualCalled, and 0 at +0x6c. The five destructors from ElfMount_Dtor (0000c5d4) to WeaponMount_DtorAmmunition (0000c7bc) store it; the base constructor WeaponMount_CtorBase (0000a530) stores its own file's copy WeaponMountBaseVtableMountsCopy (00090f42).

entries.name: AmmunitionMountVtable
entries.description: gunlist.cpp's copy of the ammunition mounts' vtable, ES2's PROJECTILE_WPN table (DBSIM 00498d54) with every slot 4 higher, ending with the gauge factory at +0x68 and 0 at +0x6c. GrenadeMount_Dtor (0000c69c) and WeaponMount_DtorAmmunition (0000c7bc) store it; the ammunition constructor WeaponMount_CtorAmmunition (0000a9e4) stores its own file's copy AmmunitionMountVtableMountsCopy (0009102a).

entries.name: WeaponMountsLocalVtable
entries.description: The local weapon mount manager's vtable: a zero dword, then at +4 0000c991, the padding entry of WeaponMounts_ArbitrateEnergyWithSelection (0000c994). WeaponMounts_CtorLocal (0000c808) stores it at the manager's +0x10. ES2's PLAYER_GUNLISTVtable (DBSIM 00499238).

entries.name: WeaponMounts_CommandCodes
entries.description: 17 dwords, the codes WeaponMounts_HandleCommand (0000d4b4) matches by REPNE SCASD (0x2c, 0x30, 0x11, 0x211, 0x0c, 0x0d, 0x4a, 0x4e, 0x202-0x20a), then from 000915dc the 17 addresses it jumps to, 0000d4de to 0000d5bd.

entries.name: Mission_StatusWorthRaising
entries.description: 20 int16 indexed by status, non-zero for 2, 3, 6, 7, 8, 9 and 18: Mission_PollStatus (0000f454) raises only those. ES2's table at DBSIM 0049935c holds the same.

entries.name: Mission_StatusBySelector
entries.description: 10 int16 indexed by header word 3, the status Mission_Status (0000f4e8) gives a clear machine whose selector's test does not hold: 12, 11, 11, 15, 13, 14, 16, 14, 16, 16.

entries.name: SalvageInternalWeights
entries.description: 12 int16, the weight of internals 0-11 in Mech_WeightedArmorRemaining (00010c38): 1500, 1500, 0, 0, 1000, 3000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 0, 1500, 1500, ES2's values at DBSIM 0049a006.

entries.name: ThrottleLeverMode
entries.description: int16, 0 in the image: Input_SetThrottleLeverMode (0004ad94), preferences option 10's handler, sets it to 1 when the option is on and 0 when off; Sim_DispatchCommand's Ctrl+1 (0x402) sets it to -1 when it is above 0 and to 1 otherwise. Mech_ApplyThrottleInput (00011afc) negates the throttle axis when it is negative and narrows the throttle's clamp to one side by its sign. ES2's ThrottleLeverMode (DBSIM 0049a06e).

entries.name: Mech_HandleCommandCodes
entries.description: The REPNE SCASD table of Mech_HandleCommand (00011050): 19 dword codes (0x4c, 0x619, 0x602-0x60a, 0x24b, 0x24d, 0x248, 0x250, 0x44b, 0x44d, 0x1b, 0x1a), then 19 jump targets.

entries.name: MechVtable
entries.description: The HERC's vtable, 29 slots from +4 to +0x74 after a zero dword, each ES2's MECH slot 4 bytes lower to +0x6c, then the lock reader at +0x74. Mech_Constructor (00011330) and Mech_Dtor (00011920) store it at +2.

entries.name: FlatObjVtableMechCopy
entries.description: The HERC shadows' vtable: FlatObj_DrawMechCopy (00011988), TSObj_GetPositionMechCopy (0001185c), FlatObj_DtorMechCopy (000119b8), TSObj_ReturnZeroMechCopy (00011892), TSObj_GetRadiusMechCopy (0001189c). Mech_Constructor (00011330) stores it on each shadow.

entries.name: Shape_StampTransformIdTags
entries.description: The REPNE SCASD table of Shape_StampTransformId (00012b58): ten dword class tags (0x1e0003, 0x1e0005, 0x140005, 0x140006, 0x140014, 0x140015, 0x14000b, 0x140008, 0x140007, 0x14000c), then ten jump targets.

entries.name: TwistServo_Latch
entries.description: byte: Mech_TorsoTwistServoSound (00014afc) sets it when it starts sound 0x21 and clears it when it stops it; TwistServo_LastAngle (00091c56), int16, the twist it saw last.

entries.name: TwistServo_LastAngle
entries.description: int16: the turret twist Mech_TorsoTwistServoSound (00014afc) saw on its last call.

entries.name: PitchServo_Latch
entries.description: byte: Mech_TorsoPitchServoSound (00014dc4) sets it when it starts sound 0x21 and clears it when it stops it.

entries.name: PitchServo_LastAngle
entries.description: int16: the turret pitch Mech_TorsoPitchServoSound (00014dc4) saw on its last call.

entries.name: LockTone_PhaseSounded
entries.description: byte: Mech_LockTonePlay (0001552c) sets it when the lock tone sounds in a phase of bit 0x40 of 000981c4 and clears it in the other phase. ES2's LockTone_PhaseSounded.

entries.name: LockTone_WasLocked
entries.description: byte: Mech_LockTonePlay (0001552c) sets it while the lamp is lit and clears it after the loss tone. ES2's LockTone_WasLocked.

entries.name: AiAimScatterByDifficulty
entries.description: int16[4] {1000, 666, 333, 0}: Ai_FireAtPoint (000190ec)'s aim scatter for a machine whose group's side byte is not 0, indexed by header word 7 or 3. ES2's AiAimScatterByDifficulty (DBSIM 0049a30c) holds {1000, 800, 400, 200}.

entries.name: DataLink_StepDelays
entries.description: int32[4] {5000, 5000, 0xffff9c40 (-25536), 0}: the delay Mech_BehaviourPlayerThink (00015f80) loads into DataLink_Timer (000af704) before each data link line, ES2's values. Timer_CountDown (00064178) clamps the negative third to 0 on its next tick.

entries.name: AiFlee_InternalComponents
entries.description: int16[6] {0, 1, 4, 5, 6, 7}: the internals Mech_AiFleeCheck (00016a74) reads for its fear bands.

entries.name: AiFlee_BandPenalties
entries.description: int16[3] {5, 25, 50}: the fear Mech_AiFleeCheck (00016a74) adds per internal past each band.

entries.name: AiFlee_BandThresholds
entries.description: int16[3] {60, 120, 180}: Mech_AiFleeCheck (00016a74)'s Q8 damage bands.

entries.name: Mech_AiSelectBehaviourVerbTable
entries.description: Twelve code addresses, Mech_AiSelectBehaviour (0001892c)'s jump table over its group's word 0-11.

entries.name: g_ShapeDetailThresholds
entries.description: Seven int32 {75, 60, 45, 25, 18, 12, 6}, the address MechType_InitOne stores at every chassis record's +0xca. ES2's g_ShapeDetailThresholds (DBSIM 0049a344), with the same values.

entries.name: Shape_RemapTransformIdsTags
entries.description: Ten class tags (0x140005, 0x1e0005, 0x140006, 0x140014, 0x140015, 0x14000b, 0x1e0003, 0x140008, 0x140007, 0x14000c) followed by their ten case targets inside Shape_RemapTransformIds (00019ac4), which searches them with REPNE SCASD.

entries.name: DamageScaleByDifficulty
entries.description: Four int16, 2800, 2000, 1400 and 1000: the Q10 factors Damage_ScaleByDifficulty (0001f82c) indexes by script.dat header word 7, or by 3 when the header word at offset 4 is not 0. ES2's DamageScaleBySide0Difficulty (DBSIM 0049a73c) holds 3500, 2800, 2100 and 1400, and ES2 has a second table for the other side.

entries.name: Terrain_TheaterNames
entries.description: Four string pointers indexed by the theater, header word 0 of data\script.dat: 0 desert, 1 temper, 2 ice, 3 urban. Terrain_LoadZoneShapes (00020238) names dgs\<name> and dat\<name> by it. ES1GO's ShellMap_TheaterNames (0007e228) has the order temper, ice, desert, urban.

entries.name: ObjList_Count
entries.description: int16: the number of objects in ObjList_Objects (000bc58e). ObjList_Add (00020d5c) stores at it and increments it; ObjList_RebuildFrame (00020de0) resets it to ObjList_ZoneShapeCount (000bc596).

entries.name: ObjProbe_Armed
entries.description: byte: set by ObjProbe_Arm (0002125c) and cleared by ObjProbe_TestCorners (0002146c); while it is set ObjList_DrawEntryRender (00020f40) and ObjList_DrawFrameObjects (00021008) run the probe's steps, and ObjProbe_IsIdle (000213d0) answers 0.

entries.name: ObjList_SortEye
entries.description: The camera ObjList_SetSortEye (00021554) stores for the sort's comparisons.

entries.name: ObjList_SortNodes
entries.description: Pointer to the 0x1d-byte sort nodes ObjList_AllocSortNodes (00021560) allocates; ObjList_SortAndDraw (00021d04) draws the tree from the first. ObjList_FreeSortNodes (000215c8) frees them. ES2's ObjList_SortNodes (DBSIM 0049ac40).

entries.name: CockpitScheme_ColorIndices
entries.description: Eight int16 {0x2c, 0x25, 0x2d, 0x27, 0x2d, 0x2d, 0x2d, 0x28}, one per cockpit color scheme: the live palette entry whose color CockpitViewManager_LoadViews (00021fb0) copies into entry 0x40 after installing the scheme.

entries.name: CockpitViewShakeArmed
entries.description: byte: set by CockpitView_SetShakeBand (000243d4) and cleared by CockpitView_ClearShake (00024750); CockpitView_StepShake (00024564), CockpitView_ClearShake and CockpitView_ApplyViewState (000222c0) test it. ES2's CockpitViewShakeArmed.

entries.name: CockpitShakeReseedAfterSlide
entries.description: byte: CockpitView_ApplyViewState (000222c0) sets it when a view change clears an armed shake and clears it on a change to view 4; CockpitView_StepViewTransition (00022904) then calls CockpitView_SetShakeBand (000243d4)(10). ES2's CockpitShakeReseedAfterSlide.

entries.name: CockpitPaletteSingleton
entries.description: dword: the dpl\cockpit palette CockpitViewManager_Ctor (00021dd4) loads while it is 0; CockpitViewManager_LoadViews (00021fb0) installs the scheme's colours from its +8 and calls its slot +0x1c. ES2's CockpitPaletteSingleton.

entries.name: CockpitOverride_Index
entries.description: int16: the chassis index CockpitChassis_SelectByName (00024394) stores for the -C option; CockpitViewManager_Ctor (00021dd4) takes it as the scheme word while CockpitOverride_Name is set. ES2's CockpitOverride_Index.

entries.name: CockpitOverride_Name
entries.description: char *: the -C option's text, stored by CockpitChassis_SelectByName (00024394); when it is set CockpitViewManager_Ctor (00021dd4) takes it in place of the chassis name. ES2's CockpitOverride_Name.

entries.name: g_TheaterHzline
entries.description: Pointer to the theater's hzline, built by Hzline_Ctor (00026180) in World_LoadTheater (000251c4). ES2's g_TheaterHzline (DBSIM 0049aee0).

entries.name: World_Clouds
entries.description: Pointer to the 0x113-byte object World_LoadTheater (000251c4) builds with TexPoly_Ctor (000271c0) and the vptr 000928f6 when the world file's second string is not empty; left as it was otherwise.

entries.name: World_PointScatter
entries.description: Pointer to the PointScatter_Ctor (00026dec) object World_LoadTheater (000251c4) builds when the world file's point count is not 0, its +0x15 set to the file's short 8; left as it was otherwise.

entries.name: World_FlatSetSelector
entries.description: int16: the world file's short 9, which World_LoadTheater (000251c4) passes to FlatObj_LoadResources (00006cf8): 0 loads dts\flat, anything else dts\flat2. ES2's World_FlatSetSelector (DBSIM 0049aeea).

entries.name: PitchGradient_Enabled
entries.description: Byte, 1 in the image: Palette_BlendRangeByPitch (00025fe4) rewrites palette entries 64-79 only while it is set. es2_xref --decode finds its writes in LiftStart_DarkenPalette (00057cf4), 0 at 00057f89, and LiftStart_Rise (00057ffc), 1 at 00058407.

entries.name: PitchGradient_ForcedStep

entries.name: CTLButtonControlVtableWeaponGaugeCopy
entries.description: The module's copy of the button base table, which WeaponSelectGadget_Ctor (000380fc) and WeaponRangeSelectGadget_Ctor (00038ce4) store first: a zero dword, then CTLButtonControl_PaintNoOpWeaponGaugeCopy (0003820f), CTLControl_InvalidateNoOpWeaponGaugeCopy (00038213), CTLControl_OnClickNoOpWeaponGaugeCopy (00038217), CTLControl_FlushDeferredPaintNoOpWeaponGaugeCopy (0003821b), Widget_GetButtonValueWeaponGaugeCopy (0003821f), CTLControl_SetValueNoOpWeaponGaugeCopy (00038229) and CTLControl_DragMoveNoOpWeaponGaugeCopy (0003822f).

entries.name: WeaponSelectGadgetVtable
entries.description: The plain number button's vtable, which WeaponSelectGadget_Ctor (000380fc) stores last at +0x1c: WeaponSelectGadget_PaintUnderlay (0003825c), Widget_InvalidateDeferredWeaponGaugeCopy (00038234), WeaponSelectGadget_OnClick (00038304), WeaponSelectGadget_FlushDeferredPaint (000382cc) and the button base's three value slots. Its mixin table is 00093ba6. ES2's WeaponSelectGadgetVtable (DBSIM 0049c81c).

entries.name: ChainedWeaponSelectGadgetVtable
entries.description: The chained number button's vtable, which ChainedWeaponSelectGadget_Ctor (00038338) stores at +0x1c: WeaponSelectGadget_Paint (00038464), Widget_InvalidateDeferredWeaponGaugeCopy (00038234), ChainedWeaponSelectGadget_OnClick (0003866c), ChainedWeaponSelectGadget_FlushDeferredPaint (0003861c) and the button base's three value slots. Its mixin table is 00093be6. ES2's ChainedWeaponSelectGadgetVtable (DBSIM 0049c7dc).

entries.name: CTLSliderControlVtableWeaponGaugeCopy
entries.description: The module's copy of the slider base table, which WeaponSliderGadget_Ctor (000386a0) stores first: CTLSliderControl_PaintNoOpWeaponGaugeCopy (000388fd), CTLSliderControl_InvalidateNoOpWeaponGaugeCopy (00038903), the button base copy's click and flush stubs by 00038218 and 0003821c, SliderWidget_GetValueH, SliderWidget_SetValueH, SliderWidget_DragToPointH and SliderWidget_RecomputeScaleH.

entries.name: WeaponSliderGadgetVtable
entries.description: The charge bar's vtable, which WeaponSliderGadget_Ctor (000386a0) stores last at +0x1c: WeaponSliderGadget_Paint (000389ac), HSliderGadget_InvalidateDeferredWeaponGaugeCopy (00038984), HSliderGadget_OnClick (0003166c), WeaponSliderGadget_FlushDeferredPaint (00038b30), then SliderWidget_GetValueH, SliderWidget_SetValueH, SliderWidget_DragToPointH and SliderWidget_RecomputeScaleH. Its mixin table is 00093d32.

entries.name: WeaponRangeSelectGadgetVtable
entries.description: The console button's vtable, which WeaponRangeSelectGadget_Ctor (00038ce4) stores last at +0x1c: ConsoleButton_Paint (00038d90), Widget_InvalidateDeferredWeaponGaugeCopy (00038234), WeaponRangeSelectGadget_OnClick (00038ec0), WeaponRangeSelectGadget_FlushDeferredPaint (00038e88) and the button base's three value slots. Its mixin table is 00093d9e.

entries.name: ShieldRingColors
entries.description: Three int32, 25, 59 and 23: the shield rings' base color, which ShieldsGauge_UpdateRingPalette (00039340) dims and ShieldsGauge_Ctor (00038f34) stores whole at ShieldRingBaseEntry (000b13ec). ES2's ShieldRingColors (DBSIM 0049c9cb) base.

entries.name: ShieldsGaugeVtable
entries.description: ShieldsGauge's vtable, which ShieldsGauge_Ctor (00038f34) stores at +0x76: a zero dword, then ShieldsGauge_OnClick (00039254) at +4, ShieldsGauge_Paint (00039178) at +8, ShieldsGauge_Update (000391ac) at +0xc, each by its padding, and PanelGauge_KeyDispatchNoneShieldsGaugeCopy (0003916f) at +0x10.

entries.name: CTLButtonControlVtableShieldsGaugeCopy
entries.description: The shield display file's copy of the button base table, which ShieldsGauge_FacingCtor (000396ac) stores first: a zero dword, then the file's seven no-op and value slots CTLButtonControl_PaintNoOpShieldsGaugeCopy (00039735), CTLControl_InvalidateNoOpShieldsGaugeCopy (0003973b), CTLControl_OnClickNoOpShieldsGaugeCopy (0003973f), CTLControl_FlushDeferredPaintNoOpShieldsGaugeCopy (00039743), Widget_GetButtonValueShieldsGaugeCopy (00039747), CTLControl_SetValueNoOpShieldsGaugeCopy (00039751) and CTLControl_DragMoveNoOpShieldsGaugeCopy (00039757) at +4 to +0x1c.

entries.name: ShieldsSelectGadget_PanelGadgetVtable
entries.description: The shield button's mixin table, which ShieldsGauge_FacingCtor (000396ac) stores at +0x24 last: a zero dword, then ShieldsSelectGadget_PaintThunk (0003976c) at +4, ShieldsSelectGadget_FlushDeferredPaintThunk (00039778) at +8 and Widget_ClickSound (000314a0) at +0xc. ES2's ShieldsSelectGadget_PanelGadgetVtable (DBSIM).

entries.name: ShieldsSelectGadgetVtable
entries.description: The shield button's vtable, which ShieldsGauge_FacingCtor (000396ac) stores at +0x1c last: a zero dword, then ShieldFacing_Paint (00039784) at +4, Widget_InvalidateDeferredShieldsGaugeCopy (0003975c) at +8, Widget_ForwardClickToOwner (000314ac) at +0xc, ShieldFacing_FlushDeferredPaint (000397b8) at +0x10 and the copies Widget_GetButtonValueShieldsGaugeCopy (00039747), CTLControl_SetValueNoOpShieldsGaugeCopy (00039751) and CTLControl_DragMoveNoOpShieldsGaugeCopy (00039757) at +0x14 to +0x1c. ES2's ShieldsSelectGadgetVtable (DBSIM).

entries.name: EnergyPoolGaugeVtable
entries.description: EnergyPoolGauge's vtable, which EnergyPoolGauge_Ctor (00039818) stores at +0x76: a zero dword, then PanelGauge_OnChildClickNoOpEnergyGaugeCopy (00039bad) at +4, EnergyPoolGauge_Paint (00039a28) at +8 and EnergyPoolGauge_Update (00039abc) at +0xc, each by its padding, and PanelGauge_KeyDispatchNoneEnergyGaugeCopy (00039a1d) at +0x10. ES2's EnergyPoolGaugeVtable (DBSIM).

entries.name: g_MfdMissileCamSavedMode
entries.description: int16, 0 in the image: the MFD's mode MfdDisplay_SyncMissileCamMode (0003ad08) saves as it switches to mode 5 and selects again when its condition ends. ES2's g_MfdMissileCamSavedMode (DBSIM 0049cbc4).

entries.name: g_MfdMissileCamMode
entries.description: int16, -1 in the image: 5 while MfdDisplay_SyncMissileCamMode (0003ad08) holds the MFD on the missile camera, set back to -1 by MfdDisplay_SetMode (0003a9ec). ES2's g_MfdMissileCamMode (DBSIM 0049cbc6).

entries.name: g_MfdMissileCamArmed
entries.description: Byte, 1 in the image: with it set MfdDisplay_SyncMissileCamMode (0003ad08) saves the mode and selects mode 5 when its condition starts; MfdDisplay_SetMode (0003a9ec) clears it while the switch holds. ES2's g_MfdMissileCamArmed (DBSIM 0049cbc8).

entries.name: MfdDisplay_OfflineLabel
entries.description: Pointer, 0 in the image: the label MfdDisplay_Ctor (00039c64) builds once, in cpred centered over the screen rect with fill 0x3f, into which MfdDisplay_Repaint (0003a1f0) and MfdDisplay_Update (0003a2a8) write OFFLINE or an empty string while the display is dark.

entries.name: MfdButtonVisibility
entries.description: Six rows of 13 bytes, one a mode: 1 for the MFD buttons the mode uses. Buttons 0 to 6 in every row; besides them 9 in modes 0, 2, 4 and 5, 9 to 12 in mode 1, and 7 to 9 in mode 3. MfdDisplay_SetMode (0003a9ec) and MfdDisplay_KeyDispatch (0003a5e8) read it. ES2's MfdButtonVisibility (DBSIM 0049cbd8).

entries.name: MfdDisplayVtable
entries.description: The MFD's vtable, which MfdDisplay_Ctor (00039c64) stores at +0x76: a zero dword, then MfdButton_OnClick (0003a46c), MfdDisplay_Repaint (0003a1f0), MfdDisplay_Update (0003a2a8) and MfdDisplay_KeyDispatch (0003a5e8), each by its padding.

entries.name: CTLButtonControlVtableMfdDisplayCopy
entries.description: The MFD display file's copy of the button base table, which MFDSelectGadget_Ctor (0003ae50) and MFDListGadget_Ctor (0003afe0) store first: a zero dword, then the copies CTLButtonControl_PaintNoOpMfdDisplayCopy (0003aed8), CTLControl_InvalidateNoOpMfdDisplayCopy (0003aedb), CTLControl_OnClickNoOpMfdDisplayCopy (0003aedf), CTLControl_FlushDeferredPaintNoOpMfdDisplayCopy (0003aee3), Widget_GetButtonValueMfdDisplayCopy (0003aee7), CTLControl_SetValueNoOpMfdDisplayCopy (0003aef1) and CTLControl_DragMoveNoOpMfdDisplayCopy (0003aef7).

entries.name: PanelGadgetVtableMfdDisplayCopy
entries.description: The MFD display file's copy of the gadget mixin's table, which MFDSelectGadget_Ctor (0003ae50) and MFDListGadget_Ctor (0003afe0) store at +0x24 first: a zero dword, 0 at +4 and +8 and Widget_ClickSound (000314a0) at +0xc.

entries.name: PanelSelectGadgetVtableMfdDisplayCopy
entries.description: The MFD display file's copy of PanelSelectGadget's table, which MFDSelectGadget_Ctor (0003ae50) stores at +0x1c second: a zero dword, then CTLButtonControl_PaintNoOpMfdDisplayCopy (0003aed8), Widget_InvalidateDeferredMfdDisplayCopy (0003aefc) by its padding, Widget_ForwardClickToOwner (000314ac), CTLControl_FlushDeferredPaintNoOpMfdDisplayCopy (0003aee3) and the copies Widget_GetButtonValueMfdDisplayCopy (0003aee7), CTLControl_SetValueNoOpMfdDisplayCopy (0003aef1) and CTLControl_DragMoveNoOpMfdDisplayCopy (0003aef7).

entries.name: MFDSelectGadget_PanelGadgetVtable
entries.description: The MFD button's mixin table, which MFDSelectGadget_Ctor (0003ae50) stores at +0x24 last: a zero dword, then MFDSelectGadget_PaintThunk (0003af0c) at +4, MFDSelectGadget_FlushDeferredPaintThunk (0003af18) at +8 and Widget_ClickSound (000314a0) at +0xc. ES2's MFDSelectGadget_PanelGadgetVtable (DBSIM).

entries.name: MFDSelectGadgetVtable
entries.description: The MFD button's vtable, which MFDSelectGadget_Ctor (0003ae50) stores at +0x1c last: a zero dword, then MFDSelectGadget_Paint (0003af24) at +4 by its padding, Widget_InvalidateDeferredMfdDisplayCopy (0003aefc) at +8 by its padding, Widget_ForwardClickToOwner (000314ac) at +0xc, ShieldFacing_FlushDeferredPaintMfdDisplayCopy (0003afa8) at +0x10 by its padding and the copies Widget_GetButtonValueMfdDisplayCopy (0003aee7), CTLControl_SetValueNoOpMfdDisplayCopy (0003aef1) and CTLControl_DragMoveNoOpMfdDisplayCopy (0003aef7) at +0x14 to +0x1c. ES2's MFDSelectGadgetVtable (DBSIM).

entries.name: MFDListGadget_PanelGadgetVtable
entries.description: The MFD click surface's mixin table, which MFDListGadget_Ctor (0003afe0) stores at +0x24 last: a zero dword, then MFDListGadget_PaintNoOpThunk (0003b064) at +4, MFDListGadget_FlushDeferredPaintNoOpThunk (0003b070) at +8 and Widget_ClickSound (000314a0) at +0xc.

entries.name: PanelListGadgetVtableMfdDisplayCopy
entries.description: The table MFDListGadget_Ctor (0003afe0) stores at +0x1c second: a zero dword, then MFDListGadget_PaintNoOp (0003b07a), MFDListGadget_InvalidateNoOp (0003b07f), 0 at +0xc, MFDListGadget_FlushDeferredPaintNoOp (0003b083) and the copies Widget_GetButtonValueMfdDisplayCopy (0003aee7), CTLControl_SetValueNoOpMfdDisplayCopy (0003aef1) and CTLControl_DragMoveNoOpMfdDisplayCopy (0003aef7), each entered one byte on.

entries.name: MFDListGadgetVtable
entries.description: The MFD click surface's vtable, which MFDListGadget_Ctor (0003afe0) stores at +0x1c last: PanelListGadgetVtableMfdDisplayCopy (000941b6)'s slots with MFDListGadget_OnClick (0003b088) at +0xc by its padding.

entries.name: ThrottleGaugeVtable
entries.description: The throttle gauge's vtable, which ThrottleGauge_Ctor (0003b0d4) stores at +0x76: a zero dword, then ThrottleGauge_OnChildValue (0003b25c) by its padding, ThrottleGauge_Paint (0003b1d0) by its padding, ThrottleGauge_Update (0003b1e8) and PanelGauge_KeyDispatchNoneThrottleGaugeCopy (0003b1c5). ES2's ThrottleGaugeVtable (DBSIM 0049d1e0) one slot further on.

entries.name: ThrottleVSliderGadget_PanelSliderGadgetVtable
entries.description: The vertical throttle slider's mixin table, which ThrottleSlider_CtorV (0003b2c8) stores at +0x42: a zero dword, ThrottleVSliderGadget_DrawKnobVThunk (0003b678), ThrottleVSliderGadget_PaintVThunk (0003b684) and 00031668, the RET 4 of Widget_NoClickSound (00031666).

entries.name: ThrottleVSliderGadgetVtable
entries.description: The vertical throttle slider's primary vtable, which ThrottleSlider_CtorV (0003b2c8) stores at +0x1c last: a zero dword, then ThrottleSlider_DrawKnobV (0003b690), VSliderGadget_InvalidateDeferred (0003b668), VSliderGadget_OnClick (000316a0), ThrottleSlider_PaintV (0003b804), the first, second and fourth by their padding, then SliderWidget_GetValueV (00043be8), SliderWidget_SetValueV (00043c08), SliderWidget_DragToPointV (00043b80) and SliderWidget_RecomputeScaleV (00043c74).

entries.name: ThrottleHSliderGadget_PanelSliderGadgetVtable
entries.description: The horizontal throttle slider's mixin table, which ThrottleSlider_CtorFixed (0003ba74) stores at +0x42: a zero dword, ThrottleHSliderGadget_PaintHThunk (0003bd90), ThrottleHSliderGadget_FlushPaintHThunk (0003bd9c) and 00031668, the RET 4 of Widget_NoClickSound (00031666).

entries.name: ThrottleHSliderGadgetVtable
entries.description: The horizontal throttle slider's primary vtable, which ThrottleSlider_CtorFixed (0003ba74) stores at +0x1c last: a zero dword, then ThrottleSlider_PaintH (0003bda8) by its padding, HSliderGadget_InvalidateDeferredThrottleGaugeCopy (0003bd80) by its padding, HSliderGadget_OnClick (0003166c), ThrottleSlider_FlushPaintH (0003bf18), then SliderWidget_GetValueH (00043ac8), SliderWidget_SetValueH (00043ae4), SliderWidget_DragToPointH (00043a68) and SliderWidget_RecomputeScaleH (00043b4c).

entries.name: HddLowMemFrameMap
entries.description: 28 int16: the low-memory pilot bank's frame for each of the 28 portrait frames, 0-23 to 0-5, 24-26 to 6, 27 to 7, which HddGauge_PaintPilotFrame (0003e1cc) reads while the gauge's +0x133 is clear. The same values as ES2's DAT_0049d1f6.

entries.name: HddDisplayInstance
entries.description: Dword: the Heads-Down Display, which HddDisplay_Ctor (0003c258) stores; the comm-box callbacks and HddGauge_Name/FindByName reach the gauges through it. ES2's 0049d230.

entries.name: HddStaticBank
entries.description: Dword: the dba\static bank, five frames HddGauge_PaintStatic (0003e400) cycles; HddDisplay_Ctor (0003c258) loads it the first time. ES2's HddStaticBank.

entries.name: HddPilotNameTable
entries.description: Dword: the str\pilots string table, which HddDisplay_Ctor (0003c258) loads the first time and HddGauge_LoadPilotFrames (0003dab4) walks to a pilot's portrait number for the comm box's name.

entries.name: CommBox0PilotOverride
entries.description: Int, -1 in the image: the -t<n> value Sim_SetCommBox0PilotOverride (0003ea50) stores; HddGauge_LoadPilotFrames (0003dab4) takes it as comm box 0's pilot when it is not negative. ES2's CommBox0PilotOverride.

entries.name: HddPageWidgetVisibility
entries.description: 2 rows x 15 bytes, [page][button], which HddDisplay_SetPage (0003d8b4) applies: page 0 shows buttons 0-7 and 10-14, page 1 buttons 0-5 and 10-12. ES2's HddPageWidgetVisibility, whose rows hide 10-12.

entries.name: HDDisplayVtable
entries.description: The Heads-Down Display pages' base table, which HDDisplay_Ctor (0003c228) stores at +0xc: +4 and +8 0, +0xc HDDisplay_HideNoOp (0003c248), +0x10 HDDisplay_ShowNoOp (0003c24b), +0x14 HDDisplay_KeyDispatchNone (0003c24f).

entries.name: HDDGaugeVtable
entries.description: The Heads-Down Display's table, at the display's +0x76: +4 HddDisplay_OnChildClick (0003d430), +8 HddDisplay_Repaint, +0xc HddDisplay_Update, +0x10 HddDisplay_KeyDispatch, the last three by their padding. ES2's HDDGaugeVtable.

entries.name: HddDisplay_LastTarget
entries.description: Dword: the target subject HddDisplay_Update (0003cd28) last saw, to detect a change.

entries.name: HddDebugMessageId
entries.description: Int, -1 in the image: the message id that the Ctrl+Alt keys of HddDisplay_KeyDispatch (0003d12c) step and post for the first squadmate.

entries.name: HddDisplay_KeyCodes
entries.description: 17 dwords of key codes and then their 17 handler addresses in HddDisplay_KeyDispatch (0003d12c): 0x64b, 0x64d, 0x62b, 0x48, 0x50, 0x4b, 0x4d, 2, 3, 4, 0xd, 0x4e, 0xc, 0x4a, 0x1f, 0x17, 0x11.

entries.name: CommBox_IdleRepaintPending
entries.description: Byte: set by HddDisplay_ServiceCommBoxes (0003e574) when an idle box's copy to the other page did nothing (Widget_DrawToCockpit returned 0), so the next frame repaints idle boxes again.

entries.name: HddButton_MixinVtable
entries.description: The Heads-Down Display buttons' PanelGadget mixin table, at a button's +0x24: +4 HddButton_PaintThunk (0003eb24), +8 HddButton_FlushDeferredPaintThunk (0003eb30), +0xc Widget_ClickSound.

entries.name: HDDSelectGadgetVtable
entries.description: The Heads-Down Display buttons' primary table, at a button's +0x1c, slots from +4: HddButton_Paint, Widget_InvalidateDeferredHddCopy, HddButton_OnClick (0003ed2c), HddButton_FlushDeferredPaint, then the button base's value, set-value and drag copies. ES2's HDDSelectGadgetVtable.

entries.name: HDDisplayGadgetVtable
entries.description: The pages' click regions' base table, which HDDisplayGadget_Ctor (0003ed60) stores: paint, invalidate and click 0, then the button base's per-frame, value, set-value and drag copies.

entries.name: HddCommandScreen_MarkerRepaintPending
entries.description: Byte: HddCommandScreen_BlinkTick (0003fe83) sets it; HddCommandScreen_Update (0003f578) tests it at stage 1 or 2, repaints the selected pilot's marker with Widget_PaintUnlessByte37 (00041f90) and clears it. es2_xref --decode finds those three accesses.

entries.name: HddCommandScreen_BlinkPhase
entries.description: Byte: HddCommandScreen_Ctor (0003ee58) sets it to 1 and HddCommandScreen_BlinkTick (0003fe83) flips it; es2_xref --decode finds those and a read in HddCommandScreen_DrawMap (00040d4c). ES2's DAT_0049d6ad.

entries.name: HddCommandScreen_MapDirty
entries.description: Byte: makes HddCommandScreen_Update (0003f578) redraw the map at stage 1 or 2 and clear it. HddCommandScreen_Ctor clears it; the zooms, the pans, HddCommandScreen_BlinkTick, HddCommandScreen_PickTarget and HddCommandScreen_PickPilot set it (es2_xref --decode). ES2's DAT_0049d6ae.

entries.name: HddCommandScreenInstance
entries.description: The Heads-Down Display's command screen, which HddCommandScreen_Ctor (0003ee58) stores; the screen's functions reach the display through its +4.

entries.name: HddMarker_Icons
entries.description: The map markers' icons, DBA\ICONS.DBA, which HddMarker_Ctor (00041c50) loads once with ClassItem_LoadFromFile; HddMarker_Paint (00041d04) reads its frames from the array at its +8. 0 in the image. ES2's DAT_0049d6b4.

entries.name: HddMarker_OctantNudge
entries.description: Eight signed bytes, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, -2, -4, -2: HddMarker_Paint (00041d04) adds entry [octant] to both x and y of a HERC's or flyer's icon. ES2's pair DAT_004d1d54 and DAT_004d1d5c, one per axis.

entries.name: HDDMapVtable
entries.description: The command screen's vtable, stored at +0xc by HddCommandScreen_Ctor (0003ee58): a zero dword, then by their padding HddCommandScreen_Repaint (0003f490), HddCommandScreen_Update (0003f578), HddCommandScreen_Hide (0003fc14), HddCommandScreen_Show (0003fbb8) and HddCommandScreen_KeyDispatch (0003f938).

entries.name: HddCommandScreen_KeyCodes
entries.description: 15 dwords, the key codes HddCommandScreen_KeyDispatch (0003f938) answers (0x20, 0x1e, 0x21, 0x14, 0x22, 0x18, 0x2e, 0x12, 0x2d, 0x0e, 0x34, 0x33, 0x1c, 0x0f, 0x4c), then their 15 case addresses.

entries.name: HddMarkerVtable
entries.description: The map marker's vtable, which HddMarker_Ctor (00041c50) stores at +0x1c: a zero dword, then HddMarker_Paint (00041d04), HddMarker_Invalidate (00041f10), HddMarker_OnClick (00041f78) and HddMarker_FlushDeferredPaint (00041f38), all but the click by their padding, and Widget_GetButtonValueHddCommandCopy (00041cef), CTLControl_SetValueNoOpHddCommandCopy (00041cf9) and CTLControl_DragMoveNoOpHddCommandCopy (00041cff). ES2's HDDMapGadget table (DBSIM 0049d9b0).

entries.name: CTLButtonControlVtableHddCommandCopy
entries.description: The command screen file's copy of the button base table, which HDDListGadget_Ctor (00041fcc) stores first: a zero dword, then CTLButtonControl_PaintNoOpHddCommandCopy (00042055), CTLControl_InvalidateNoOpHddCommandCopy (0004205b), CTLControl_OnClickNoOpHddCommandCopy (0004205f), CTLControl_FlushDeferredPaintNoOpHddCommandCopy (00042063) and Widget_GetButtonValueHddCommandCopy, CTLControl_SetValueNoOpHddCommandCopy and CTLControl_DragMoveNoOpHddCommandCopy entered one byte on (00041cf0, 00041cfc, 00041d00).

entries.name: PanelGadgetVtableHddCommandCopy
entries.description: The command screen file's copy of the gadget mixin's table, which HDDListGadget_Ctor (00041fcc) stores at +0x24 first: a zero dword, 0 at +4 and +8 and Widget_ClickSound (000314a0) at +0xc.

entries.name: HDDListGadget_PanelGadgetVtable
entries.description: The command screen's click regions' mixin table, which HDDListGadget_Ctor (00041fcc) stores at +0x24 last: a zero dword, then HDDListGadget_PaintNoOpThunk (00042068) at +4, HDDListGadget_FlushDeferredPaintNoOpThunk (00042074) at +8 and Widget_ClickSound (000314a0) at +0xc.

entries.name: PanelListGadgetVtableHddCommandCopy
entries.description: The table HDDListGadget_Ctor (00041fcc) stores at +0x1c second: a zero dword, then MFDListGadget_PaintNoOpHddCommandCopy (0004207e), MFDListGadget_InvalidateNoOpHddCommandCopy (00042083), 0 at +0xc, MFDListGadget_FlushDeferredPaintNoOpHddCommandCopy (00042087) and the copies Widget_GetButtonValueHddCommandCopy, CTLControl_SetValueNoOpHddCommandCopy and CTLControl_DragMoveNoOpHddCommandCopy, each entered one byte on.

entries.name: HDDListGadgetVtable
entries.description: The command screen's click regions' vtable, which HDDListGadget_Ctor (00041fcc) stores at +0x1c last: PanelListGadgetVtableHddCommandCopy (000949e2)'s slots with HDDListGadget_OnClick (0004208c) at +0xc by its padding. The damage screen's file's tables start after it, at 00094a32.

entries.name: HddDamageColorIds
entries.description: Four dwords, 0x3f, 0x35, 0x3b and 0x38, in the damage screen's data where ES2's HddDamageColorIds (DBSIM 0049d9ec) holds the color ids 19, 9, 15 and 12. es2_xref finds no reference to any of the four.

entries.name: HDDDamageVtable
entries.description: The damage screen's vtable, stored at +0xc by HddDamageScreen_Ctor (00042164): a zero dword, then HddDamageScreen_Repaint (000423a8) and HddDamageScreen_Tick (000423c4) by their padding, HddDamageScreen_HideNoOp (00042399), HddDamageScreen_Show (00043294) and HddDamageScreen_KeyDispatch (0004239f). ES2's HDDDamageVtable (DBSIM 0049dab0).

entries.name: Widget_ClickButtons
entries.description: int16: the mouse buttons of the record CockpitMouse_ProcessQueue (000444d0) is on, with bit 0 or 1 added on a left or right release; what the button classes' value slots return, and what Widget_OnMouseUp (00043eac) tests for the right button. ES2's 0049db6c.

entries.name: CTLWindowVtable
entries.description: The root widget's vtable, which CTLWindow_Ctor (00043cac) stores at +0x352: 0 at +0, CTLWindow_Slot00NoOp (00043d96) at +4, 0 at +8 and +0xc. ES2's CTLWindowVtable (DBSIM 0049db7a).

entries.name: CockpitMouse_CallbackSlot
entries.description: int16: the slot Mouse_AddCallback returned to CockpitMouse_Init (000441cc), which CockpitMouse_Shutdown (000442fc) passes to Mouse_RemoveCallback.

entries.name: Widget_ActiveRoot
entries.description: The root widget CockpitMouse_ProcessQueue (000444d0) hit-tests against: Widget_ClearPressed (00044310) stores it, CockpitMouse_Init (000441cc) clears it. ES2's 0049dbd8.

entries.name: Widget_PressedIndex
entries.description: int16: the index in the active root's list of the widget a left press is held on, -1 for none. Widget_OnMouseDown (00043e00) and Widget_OnMouseUp (00043eac) store the hit test's answer in it. ES2's Widget_PressedIndex (DBSIM 0049dbdc).

entries.name: Widget_DragCapture
entries.description: Byte: set by Widget_OnMouseDown (00043e00) when the pressed widget's int16 +0x19 is 1; while it is set CockpitMouse_ProcessQueue (000444d0) hands each move to the widget's drag slot +0x1c and a release to its value and click slots, and clears it. ES2's Widget_DragCapture (DBSIM 0049dbde).

entries.name: Cursor_FollowsMouse
entries.description: byte: the mouse callback at CockpitMouse_OnEvent (00044464) passes the pointer's position to Cursor_SyncPosition (000669dc) only while it is set. CockpitView_StepViewTransition (00022904) clears it for the external view and sets it on the return. es2_xref finds it also read by CockpitMouse_ProcessQueue (000444d0) and AlertPanel_Enter (00045f00) and written by AlertPanel_Enter (00045f00), AlertPanel_Leave (000460b8) and PreferencesPanel_Raise (00057820).

entries.name: CockpitMouse_DoubleClick
entries.description: Byte: cleared by CockpitMouse_ProcessQueue (000444d0) for each record and set for a release that comes within CockpitMouse_DoubleClickTicks (000bd518) of that button's previous release. es2_xref finds reads in MfdButton_OnClick (0003a46c), MfdFlashComm_HandleListClick (0003ac04) and HddCommandScreen_QueueListClick (0003fed8). ES2's CockpitMouse_DoubleClick (DBSIM 0049dbe0).

entries.name: CockpitMouse_LastLeftRelease
entries.description: The time, in counts of the clock 000981c4, of the left button's last release, which CockpitMouse_ProcessQueue (000444d0) keeps for the double-click test. ES2's CockpitMouse_LastLeftRelease (DBSIM 0049dbe4).

entries.name: CockpitMouse_LastRightRelease
entries.description: The time, in counts of the clock 000981c4, of the right button's last release, which CockpitMouse_ProcessQueue (000444d0) keeps for the double-click test. ES2's CockpitMouse_LastRightRelease (DBSIM 0049dbe8).

entries.name: CTLWindowVtableCockpitMouseCopy
entries.description: The cockpit mouse file's copy of CTLWindowVtable (00094bde), which WidgetRoot_Delete (00044350) stores: 0 at +0 and CTLWindow_Slot00NoOpCockpitMouseCopy (00044383) at +4.

entries.name: CockpitMouse_LastEventTime
entries.description: The clock 000981c4 at the last mouse event CockpitMouse_OnEvent (00044464) took while the queue was live; a move with the buttons unchanged is queued only when the clock has passed it.

entries.name: AlertPanel_OpenCount
entries.description: int16: the number of in-mission panels up, which AlertPanel_Enter (00045f00) raises and AlertPanel_Leave (000460b8) lowers; es2_xref also finds MessagePort_CopyBoxBetweenPages (0002fdb2) reading it.

entries.name: AlertPanel_CursorImage
entries.description: The dci\alert cursor, which AlertPanel_Enter (00045f00) loads with Cursor_LoadWrapper the first time and passes to AlertPanel_LoadCursor (000463c0).

entries.name: AlertPanel_EnterHook
entries.description: A function AlertPanel_Enter (00045f00) calls when it is set: Sim_StartMission (0005a9dc) stores SimInput_PushDisable (0005a5b4).

entries.name: AlertPanel_LeaveHook
entries.description: A function AlertPanel_Leave (000460b8) calls when it is set: Sim_StartMission (0005a9dc) stores SimInput_PopEnable (0005a5d8).

entries.name: AlertVtable
entries.description: The in-mission panels' base vtable, which AlertPanel_CtorBase (00045988) and Alert_Dtor (00045d0c) store at +0x314: 0 at +0 and +4 (the paint), AlertPanel_SetTitleText (000461ec) at +8, 0 at +0xc (the run), AlertPanel_OnChildClickNoOp (00045d06) at +0x10, AlertPanel_HandleEvent (00046670) at +0x14 and 0 at +0x18 (the button caption). ES2's AlertVtable (DBSIM 0049e05c) one slot further on.

entries.name: AlertSelectGadget_PanelGadgetVtable
entries.description: The panel button's mixin table, which PanelButton_Ctor (000467c8) stores at +0x24: AlertSelectGadget_PaintThunk (000468c8) at +4, AlertSelectGadget_TickThunk (000468d4) at +8 and Widget_ClickSound (000314a0) at +0xc.

entries.name: AlertSelectGadgetVtable
entries.description: The panel button's table, which PanelButton_Ctor (000467c8) stores at +0x1c: PanelButton_Paint (000468e0) at +4, Widget_InvalidateDeferredAlertCopy (000468b8) at +8, PanelButton_OnClick (000469ac) at +0xc, PanelButton_Tick (0004698c) at +0x10, and the button base's value, set-value and drag copies from +0x14. ES2's AlertSelectGadgetVtable.

entries.name: AlertSlider_KnobBitmap
entries.description: Frame 0 of dba\alrtslid, which AlertSliderGadget_Ctor (000469ec) loads the first time and keeps in each slider at +0x4e.

entries.name: AlertSliderGadget_PanelSliderGadgetVtable
entries.description: The panel slider's mixin table, which AlertSliderGadget_Ctor (000469ec) stores at +0x42: AlertSliderGadget_PaintThunk (00046c88) at +4, AlertSliderGadget_FlushDeferredPaintNoOpThunk (00046c94) at +8 and Widget_NoClickSound at +0xc.

entries.name: AlertSliderGadgetVtable
entries.description: The panel slider's table, which AlertSliderGadget_Ctor (000469ec) stores at +0x1c: AlertSliderGadget_Paint (00046cc8) at +4, HSliderGadget_InvalidateDeferred (00046c78) at +8, AlertSliderGadget_OnClick (00046ca0) at +0xc, AlertSliderGadget_FlushDeferredPaintNoOp (00046e65) at +0x10, then SliderWidget_GetValueH, SliderWidget_SetValueH, SliderWidget_DragToPointH and SliderWidget_RecomputeScaleH. ES2's AlertSliderGadgetVtable.

entries.name: GeneralAlertVtable
entries.description: The status panel's table, which StatusAlertPanel_Ctor (00046efc) and GeneralAlert_Dtor (000472b0) store at +0x314: StatusAlertPanel_Paint (000473c4) at +4, AlertPanel_SetTitleText (000461ec) at +8, StatusAlertPanel_RunModal (0004730c) at +0xc, StatusAlertPanel_OnChildClick (000474e4) at +0x10, AlertPanel_HandleEvent (00046670) at +0x14, StatusAlertPanel_GetButtonCaption (0004755c) at +0x18, the three by their padding, and 0 at +0 and +0x1c. ES2's GeneralAlertVtable (DBSIM 0049e148) one slot further on.

entries.name: PreferencesPanel_SaveList
entries.description: Seven int16 option indices, 0 to 6, which PreferencesPanel_Save (000483a0) and PreferencesPanel_Revert (000483d4) test and pass on.

entries.name: PrefsAlertVtable
entries.description: The preferences panel's table: 0 at +0, PreferencesPanel_Paint (00047e90) at +4, AlertPanel_SetTitleText (000461ec) at +8, PreferencesPanel_Run (00047a88) at +0xc, PreferencesPanel_OnClick (000480f4) at +0x10, PreferencesPanel_HandleEvent (00048078) at +0x14, PreferencesPanel_GetButtonCaption (00048168) at +0x18, 0 at +0x1c; the paint, the click, the keys and the caption by their padding entries.

entries.name: ControlsAlertVtable
entries.description: The controls panel's table: 0 at +0, ControlsPanel_Paint (00048c58) at +4, AlertPanel_SetTitleText (000461ec) at +8, ControlsPanel_Run (00048810) at +0xc, ControlsPanel_OnClick (00048db0) at +0x10, AlertPanel_HandleEvent (00046670) at +0x14, ControlsPanel_GetButtonCaption (00048e80) at +0x18, 0 at +0x1c; the paint, the run, the click and the caption by their padding entries.

entries.name: ControlsPanel_SaveList
entries.description: Five int16 option indices, 7, 8, 10, 9 and 11, which ControlsPanel_ApplyDevices (00048e98) copies to the stack and saves.

entries.name: ObjectiveAlertVtable
entries.description: The objectives panel's table, which ObjectivesPanel_Ctor (0004a1b4) and ObjectivesPanel_Dtor (0004a480) store at +0x314: ObjectivesPanel_Paint (0004a5a4) at +4, AlertPanel_SetTitleText (000461ec) at +8, ObjectivesPanel_RunModal (0004a4ec) at +0xc, ObjectivesPanel_OnChildClick (0004a6a0) at +0x10, AlertPanel_HandleEvent (00046670) at +0x14, ObjectivesPanel_GetButtonCaption (0004a710) at +0x18, the three by their padding, and 0 at +0 and +0x1c. ES2's ObjectiveAlertVtable (DBSIM 0049e4f8) one slot further on.

entries.name: VoiceArchivePresent
entries.description: byte: Voice_ArchiveExists (0004aed8)'s answer, which Prefs_Init (0004afe8) stores. ES2's VoiceArchivePresent.

entries.name: Prefs_MouseOptionApplied
entries.description: Byte: the option 11 value Prefs_ApplyMouseOption (0004ad54) last acted on.

entries.name: JoystickClaimedAxes
entries.description: byte, 0 in the image: the game-port axes the joystick devices have claimed, bits 0-3. es2_xref --decode finds JoystickDevice_Ctor (0004b6c0) setting bits, JoystickDevice_Dtor (0004b7a8) clearing them and Input_PollJoysticks (0004bd90) reading it.

entries.name: JoystickClaimedAxisCount
entries.description: byte, 0 in the image: how many axes JoystickClaimedAxes (0009571c) holds. es2_xref --decode finds JoystickDevice_Ctor (0004b6c0) adding, JoystickDevice_Dtor (0004b7a8) subtracting and Input_PollJoysticks (0004bd90) reading.

entries.name: IMJoystickVtable
entries.description: The vtable JoystickDevice_Ctor (0004b6c0), IMJoystick1_Ctor (0004be30), IMJoystick2_Ctor (0004be94) and JoystickDevice_Dtor (0004b7a8) store at +0x87: 0 at +0, Joystick_ReadWithResponse (0004b828) through its padding at +4, 0 at +8.

entries.name: IMThrustmasterFCSVtable
entries.description: The vtable IMThrustmasterFCS_Ctor (0004bef8) stores at +0x87: IMThrustmasterFCS_ReadState (0004bf50) through its padding at +4.

entries.name: IMThrustmasterRCSVtable
entries.description: The vtable IMThrustmasterRCS_Ctor (0004bfe0) stores at +0x87: IMThrustmasterRCS_ReadState (0004c034) through its padding at +4.

entries.name: IMFlightstickVtable
entries.description: The vtable IMFlightstick_Ctor (0004c054) stores at +0x87: IMFlightstick_ReadState (0004c0a4) through its padding at +4.

entries.name: IMFlightstickProVtable
entries.description: The vtable IMFlightstickPro_Ctor (0004c114) stores at +0x87: IMFlightstickPro_ReadState (0004c164) through its padding at +4.

entries.name: Keyjoy_TiltReversed
entries.description: dword: keyjoy.cfg's Tilt = Reverse; negates the keyboard's pitch.

entries.name: Keyjoy_BackturnReversed
entries.description: dword: keyjoy.cfg's Backturn = Reverse; negates the steering while the throttle axis is positive.

entries.name: Keyjoy_MissileReversed
entries.description: dword: keyjoy.cfg's Missile = Reverse; stops the keyboard pitch's negation while a round is flown.

entries.name: SimInput_Enabled
entries.description: byte: whether SimInput_SetEnabled has the axis keys on.

entries.name: Input_StickMode
entries.description: byte: 0, 1 (movement) or 2 (turret), preferences option 8, copied in by its handler Input_SetStickMode (0004ad88) and flipped by Input_ToggleStickMode.

entries.name: KeyQueueWantedCodes
entries.description: 78 make codes and a 0: 0x01-0x1b, 0x1e-0x29, 0x2b-0x35, 0x37, 0x3a, 0x3b-0x44, then 4c 49 4a 51 47 4f 4e 52 53 48 50 4b 4d 1c 57 58. Input_BuildSourceTable gives them to KeyQueue_Subscriber (0006c6e4) with Keyboard_AddSubscriberCodes (0006c3b4).

entries.name: KeyjoyWantedCodes
entries.description: 28 bytes: the axis keys' codes, then the same with 0x80. ES2's KeyjoyWantedCodes.

entries.name: KeyboardAxisDiagonalFlags
entries.description: 8 bytes, 1 for keypad 7, 9, 1 and 3. ES2's KeyboardAxisDiagonalFlags.

entries.name: Input_KeyThrottleStep
entries.description: int16: Ctrl+I and Ctrl+M's throttle steps, which Input_ReadPlayerInput gives the throttle axis under option 10 and clears.

entries.name: SimCommandMask
entries.description: word 0x47ff, which Input_ReadPlayerInput ANDs the command word with. ES2's SimCommandMask.

entries.name: Input_PlaybackCursorPending
entries.description: byte, 1 in the image: while it is set, Input_ReadPlayerInput (0004cb14)'s playback reads the cursor's position into Input_CursorPos (000b17d8) with Cursor_GetPosition and clears it, so the first playback frame does. es2_xref --decode finds that read and that clear and no other access.

entries.name: Sound_Manager
entries.description: The simulator's sound manager, made by Sound_Init (0004db14) with SoundManager_Ctor (0004eb40) when the digital device is not 0, and otherwise 0, with which the sound file's calls do nothing. Sound_Shutdown (0004de08) leaves it set.

entries.name: Sound_ListenerCountdown
entries.description: Sound_UpdateListener (0004df98)'s countdown to its next pass of the listener's frame to SoundManager_UpdateListener (0004fb60), every tenth call; Sound_Init (0004db14) sets it to 10, with or without a manager.

entries.name: Sound_MusicEnabled
entries.description: Dword, 0 in the image: preferences' MUSIC switch, stored by Sound_SetMusicEnabled (0004e294) and read by SoundObject_IsCategoryEnabled (0004de50) for a song; es2_xref --decode finds those absolute references and the setter's read.

entries.name: Sound_EffectsEnabled
entries.description: Dword, 0 in the image: preferences' SOUNDS switch, stored by Sound_SetEffectsEnabled (0004e2c8) and read by SoundObject_IsCategoryEnabled (0004de50) for a digital sound; es2_xref --decode finds those absolute references and the setter's read.

entries.name: Snc_Clock
entries.description: Dword, 0 in the image: the lip-sync player's clock. Snc_TimerTick (0004e39c) adds 1 to it on each call, every second PC timer interrupt, and Snc_ReadDueTime (0004e5c4) adds a script's delta to it for a due count. es2_xref --decode finds no other access.

entries.name: Snc_SkipTimerInstall
entries.description: Byte, 0 in the image: Snc_MissionInit (0004e498) installs the lip-sync timer only while it is 0. es2_xref --decode finds that read and no write.

entries.name: SncQueue_Count
entries.description: int16, 0 in the image: the number of entries in the lip-sync queue SncQueue_Entries (000b1e54). es2_xref --decode finds its reads and writes in Snc_TimerTick (0004e39c) and Snc_Enqueue (0004e624). ES2's DBSIM 0049f97c.

entries.name: Sound_SpeechEnabled
entries.description: Byte, 0 in the image: Prefs_ApplyRadioOption (0004ad30), preferences option 2's handler, stores (value != 0) here, and SpeechLine_Load (0004e0f0) builds and loads a voice line's sample only while it is set. es2_xref --decode finds one more read, in Snc_Start (0004e518). ES2's Sound_SpeechEnabled (DBSIM 0049f97e) has the role.

entries.name: SoundDriver_Defaults
entries.description: The sound driver's defaults block, nine dwords: the buffer 0x1000, the rate 11025 (000959f0), 0x78, DMA 1 (000959f8), IRQ 7 (000959fc), port 0x220 (00095a00), digital device 0xe000 (00095a04), MIDI port 0x388 (00095a08) and MIDI device 0xa002 (00095a0c). Sound_Init (0004db14) stores its six values over the last six, and SoundManager_LoadDrivers (0004ef8c) fills the driver's blocks from it.

entries.name: SoundObjectVtable
entries.description: The sound object base's vtable, stored by SoundObject_Ctor (00050020) and SoundObject_Dtor (000500d8): slot +0x08 SoundObject_Dtor and +0x28 SoundObject_SetRepeatCount (00050470); the other slots from +0x04 to +0x30 are NOP-opened stubs at SoundObject_SetPlacedVolume (000500a3)-000500d2.

entries.name: MidiSoundVtable
entries.description: MidiSound's vtable, stored by MidiSound_Ctor (000504dc) and MidiSound_Dtor (0005055c): slots +0x08 MidiSound_Dtor, +0x10 MidiSound_Play, +0x14 MidiSound_Stop, +0x18 maybe_MidiSound_Resume, +0x1c maybe_MidiSound_Pause, +0x28 SoundObject_SetRepeatCount, +0x2c MidiSound_SetVolume, +0x30 MidiSound_IsPlaying, +0x04 MidiSound_SetPlacedVolume, and the base's stubs for +0x0c, +0x20 and +0x24 one byte past their NOPs.

entries.name: DigiSoundVtable
entries.description: DigiSound's vtable, stored by DigiSound_Ctor (000507c8): slots +0x04 DigiSound_SetPlacedVolume, +0x08 DigiSound_Dtor, +0x0c DigiSound_GetVoiceStatus, +0x10 DigiSound_Play, +0x14 DigiSound_Stop, +0x18 maybe_DigiSound_Resume, +0x1c maybe_DigiSound_Pause, +0x20 maybe_DigiSound_SetPitch, +0x24 DigiSound_SetStartWord10, +0x28 DigiSound_SetRepeats, +0x2c DigiSound_SetVolume, +0x30 DigiSound_IsPlaying.

entries.name: Profile_Dirty
entries.description: byte: set by Profile_WriteString, cleared by Profile_Load; Profile_GetInt and Profile_GetString save the file in memory before loading another only while it is set.

entries.name: MonoComponentPanel_Labels
entries.description: 41 pointers to the panel's label strings, the first at 00095e88.

entries.name: g_TSDetailPartSizeScaleQ10
entries.description: int16: the Q10 factor TSDetailPart_Render applies to a detail part's projected size, 0x400 in the image; TSDetailPart_SetSizeScale writes it.

entries.name: g_TSDetailPartBias
