entries.name: WeaponMountTemplate_Table
entries.description: Pointer to the 17 0x58-byte mount templates Weapons_LoadResourceTables (0000bf48) builds with __vec_new and WeaponMountTemplate_Ctor (0000c0b4); WeaponMountTemplate_GetByWeaponId (0000c178) indexes it. ES2's WeaponMountTemplate_Table (DBSIM 004a9970).

entries.name: WeaponMountTemplate_Count
entries.description: int16 count of WeaponMountTemplate_Table (000bc2c2), which Weapons_LoadResourceTables (0000bf48) sets to 0x11, where ES2's reads it from the file. ES2's WeaponMountTemplate_Count (DBSIM 004a9974).

entries.name: WeaponModels_Mechwpn2Roots
entries.description: The shape roots Weapons_LoadResourceTables (0000bf48) loads from dts\mechwpn2 (dts\mwpn2b in low memory) with Shape_LoadAllRoots, WeaponModels_Mechwpn2RootCount (000bc2cc) of them. A search of the disassembly dump for the address finds the loader's push and read and one read, at 0000ba81, in WeaponMount_Destroy (0000b968).

entries.name: WeaponModels_Mechwpn2RootCount
entries.description: int16 count of WeaponModels_Mechwpn2Roots (000bc2c8), stored by Weapons_LoadResourceTables (0000bf48).

entries.name: ProjDat_RecordTable
entries.description: Pointer to the 19 0x24-byte projectile records Weapons_LoadResourceTables (0000bf48) reads from the end of dat\weapons. ES2's ProjDat_RecordTable, read from dat\proj.

entries.name: WeaponModels_ShapeChunks
entries.description: Array of pointers to the raw dts\mechwpns chunks WeaponModels_LoadShapeChunks (0000bc60) reads, WeaponModels_ShapeChunkCount (000bc412) of them; it ends 0xa0 bytes on, where WeaponModels_ShapeChunkSizes (000bc372) starts, room for 40. ES2's is at DBSIM 004a9988, 0xf0 bytes long.

entries.name: WeaponModels_ShapeChunkSizes
entries.description: Array of the byte lengths of the chunks in WeaponModels_ShapeChunks (000bc2d2), which WeaponModels_LoadShapeChunks (0000bc60) takes from ClassItem_TagTotalSize. ES2's is at DBSIM 004a9a78.

entries.name: WeaponModels_ShapeChunkCount
entries.description: int32 count of WeaponModels_ShapeChunks (000bc2d2), which WeaponModels_LoadShapeChunks (0000bc60) sets and WeaponModels_FreeShapeChunks (0000bd40) walks. ES2's is at DBSIM 004a9b68.

entries.name: LiveObjectList
entries.description: The live object list, a 0x10-byte record whose first dword, at this address, points at its array of object pointers: the int16 capacity at +4, the int16 count LiveObjectList_Count (000bc41c) at +6, and the pair cache at +8, whose record count, the int16 000bc420, lies in the zero-filled memory past the image's file bytes. DBSim_LoadScriptDat (0001d850) builds it with ObjectList_Init (0000db40), ObjectList_Add (0000db10) adds each object, and Sim_RaycastObjectList (0001f1d0), Sim_DetectionTick (0000e240) and the sensor functions walk it. ES2's maybe_GlobalLiveObjectList (DBSIM 004a9b7c), which has no pair cache.

entries.name: LiveObjectList_Count
entries.description: int16: the number of pointers in LiveObjectList (000bc416), the bound of Sim_RaycastObjectList's walk.

entries.name: Behaviour_DwellJitter
entries.description: int16: Behaviour_SetState (0000fdfc) adds 0xd to it and adds its low four bits to each new state's dwell countdown. ES2's Behaviour_DwellJitter (DBSIM 004a9bf4).

entries.name: Mech_DrawEnabled
entries.description: int16: Mech_Draw (00012ac4) draws only while it is set; Mech_ResetMissionGlobals (00010e10) sets it to 1. ES2's Mech_DrawEnabled.

entries.name: PlayerMech
entries.description: Pointer to the player's machine: Mech_HandleCommand (00011050) passes its weapon mount manager +0x198 to WeaponMounts_HandleCommand (0000d4b4), and Mech_AiEnemySighted (0000e760) compares its group (+0x3f) and reads its contact bytes (+0xbc). ES2's PlayerMech (DBSIM 004a9c08).

entries.name: g_MechTypeCount
entries.description: int16: the number of chassis slots allocated, set to 0 by Mech_LoadResources and incremented by MechTypeSlot_Allocate; Mechs_InitAllTypes allocates this many records.

entries.name: g_MechTypeSlotIndex
entries.description: 16 bytes, one per chassis type: its slot, or 0xff for none. Mech_LoadResources fills it with 0xff, MechTypeSlot_Allocate writes it and MechTypeSlot_GetIndex reads it.

entries.name: g_MechTypeNames
entries.description: Pointer to the name table LoadNameList builds from nam\mechs, indexed by chassis type; MechType_InitOne takes a type's file name from it.

entries.name: g_MechTypeTable
entries.description: Pointer to the chassis records, 0x1c4 bytes per slot, that Mechs_InitAllTypes allocates and MechType_InitOne fills.

entries.name: g_MechTextureGroupSlots
entries.description: Four dwords, the banks dba\light, medium, heavy and enemy that Mech_LoadResources loads when g_LowMemory (000bda98) is 0; MechType_InitOne stores the one a chassis' texture group (record +0x96) picks at each root's +0x26. ES2's g_MechTextureGroupSlots (DBSIM 004a9df6) is seven 8-byte slots whose address is stored instead.

entries.name: g_TSDetailBiasForFlyers
entries.description: int32: the TSDetailPart bias Flyer_Draw (0001ac34) sets around a flyer's draw. es2_xref --decode finds that read and one write, in ShapeDetail_ApplyDetailSetting (00057c08).

entries.name: MissionGroups
entries.description: Pointer to the 0x28-byte mission group records, their int16 count MissionGroups_Count (000bc47a) at +4: MissionGroups_Allocate (0001d260) fills the pair, DBSim_SpawnMissionObjects (0001e638) builds one record per element through DBSim_BuildGroupRecord, which takes its address, and Actions_EvaluateTriggers (0001f87c) walks them.

entries.name: MissionGroups_Count
entries.description: int16: the number of records at MissionGroups (000bc476), stored by MissionGroups_Allocate at the array's +4.

entries.name: MissionActions_Count
entries.description: int16: the number of 16-byte actions at MissionActions (000bc496), block 5's count, the bound of Actions_EvaluateTriggers' walk.

entries.name: MissionActions
entries.description: Pointer to the 16-byte action records DBSim_LoadScriptDat (0001d850) builds from script.dat block 5; DBSim_SpawnMissionObjects (0001e638) resolves the objects' and groups' action refs to records here and Actions_EvaluateTriggers (0001f87c) walks them.

entries.name: Mission_StatusRaised
entries.description: int16: the mission status last raised, which Mission_PollStatus (0000f454) compares and stores and DBSim_SpawnMissionObjects (0001e638) sets to 0xffff. ES2's Mission_StatusForAlert (DBSIM 00413180) and Mission_PollStatus (DBSIM 004131ac) keep theirs at DBSIM 004a9ed0.

entries.name: ScriptDatHeader
entries.description: The 20-byte header DBSim_LoadScriptDat (0001d850) reads from data\script.dat: ten int16 header words, word 0 the theater, word 1 the zone, words 8 and 9 the world file's. Mission_WriteResults (0001d698) passes the dword at 000bc4a2, word 3, to Group_StatusLineIndex and Mission_TotalSalvage. ES2's ScriptDatHeader (DBSIM 004a9ed2).

entries.name: MissionModeFlag
entries.description: int16, script.dat header word 2 (ScriptDatHeader (000bc49c) + 4): WeaponMounts_ArbitrateEnergy (0000cc2c) and WeaponMounts_FireTrigger (0000d2bc) test it for 0 beside UnlimitedAmmoFlag (000bc4a6) for 1. ES2's MissionModeFlag (DBSIM 004a9ed6).

entries.name: UnlimitedAmmoFlag
entries.description: int16, script.dat header word 5 (ScriptDatHeader (000bc49c) + 0xa): with MissionModeFlag (000bc4a0) at 0 and this at 1, WeaponMounts_ArbitrateEnergy (0000cc2c) returns the budget it was given and WeaponMounts_FireTrigger (0000d2bc) passes a free-shot flag of 1. ES2's UnlimitedAmmoFlag (DBSIM 004a9edc).

entries.name: MissionAlertArmed
entries.description: int16, past the image's file bytes, so 0 at load: set to 1 by Mission_PollStatus (0000f454) the first time a status worth raising appears, when it loads MissionAlertTimer_Count (000af7a1) with 10000, and cleared by Sim_DispatchCommand (00059df8)'s Q case after its panel (00059fdb). es2_xref --decode finds those two word stores and the poll's word compare, and no other instruction holding its address. ES2's MissionAlertArmed (DBSIM 004a9eec).

entries.name: Salvage_PairCount
entries.description: int16: the number of salvage pairs at Salvage_Pairs (000bc4b4), which Mission_WriteResults (0001d698) writes to data\results.dat ahead of them.

entries.name: Salvage_Pairs
entries.description: Pointer to the salvage pairs, two int16 each, that Mission_WriteResults (0001d698) writes to data\results.dat; Mech_SalvageValue (00014034) passes Salvage_QueueWeapon a pair for each surviving hardpoint of a wreck.

entries.name: MissionVars
entries.description: The 100 int16 campaign flags, 200 bytes, that DBSim_LoadScriptDat (0001d850) reads from data\mission.var, zeroing flag 7 (000bc4c6), and Mission_WriteResults (0001d698) writes back. Action_Activate (0001cc5c) and Group_ReportIfAllOutOfAction (0001d524) write a flag by an operation; Mission_WriteResults adds 25000 per unit of flag 7 to the salvage award. ES2's counters at DBSIM 004a9ef4 are 1,000.

entries.name: Zone_TheaterShapeRoots
entries.description: Pointer to the array of root shapes Shape_LoadAllRoots loads from the theater's dgs\<name> in Terrain_LoadZoneShapes (00020238); a zone's 20-byte records index it. Null after a load with a negative zone.

entries.name: Zone_ShapeObjects
entries.description: Pointer to the array of Zone_ShapeCount (000bc588) object pointers Terrain_LoadZoneShapes (00020238) builds, one 0x3f-byte object (TS_OBJ and a pointer at +0x3b, vptr 000924be) per zone record. Null after a load with a negative zone; a load with a count of 0 leaves it as it was.

entries.name: Zone_ShapeCount
entries.description: int16: the zone file's record count (its word at +2), the number of objects at Zone_ShapeObjects (000bc584). Terrain_LoadZoneShapes (00020238) reads it, or sets 0 for a negative zone.

entries.name: Zone_TheaterShapeRecords
entries.description: Pointer to the theater's 24-byte shape records, one per root shape, read from dat\<name> by Terrain_LoadZoneShapes (00020238) into a __vec_new array of TheaterShapeRecord_ElementCtor (000204d8) elements. A zone object's +0x3b points at its shape's record unless that record's int32 at +8 is negative.

entries.name: ObjList_Objects
entries.description: Pointer to the object list's 512 object pointers (0x800 bytes from ObjList_Init (00020c2c)), which ObjList_Add (00020d5c) fills; the count is ObjList_Count (00092558).

entries.name: ObjList_ZoneShapeCount
entries.description: int16: the number of zone shapes at the head of ObjList_Objects (000bc58e), stored once the mission start has added them; ObjList_RebuildFrame (00020de0) resets ObjList_Count (00092558) to it, and ObjList_DrawFrameObjects (00021008) gives the objects below it their dividing line.

entries.name: ObjList_Entries
entries.description: Pointer to the 512 draw entries of 0x36 bytes ObjList_Init (00020c2c) builds with ObjListEntry_Ctor (00020c80), which ObjList_DrawFrameObjects (00021008) fills each frame.

entries.name: ObjList_DrawList
entries.description: Pointer to 512 draw-entry pointers (0x800 bytes from ObjList_Init (00020c2c)): the entries ObjList_DrawFrameObjects (00021008) keeps for ObjList_SortAndDraw (00021d04).

entries.name: CockpitViewManagerPublished
entries.description: The cockpit view manager, stored by CockpitViewManager_Publish and returned by CockpitViewManager_Published. Widget_DrawToCockpit tests its byte +0x18. ES2's CockpitViewManagerPublished (DBSIM 004cfa20).

entries.name: WorldShades_TypeTable
entries.description: Pointer to the 5-byte records {byte count, pointer to count two-byte pairs} World_LoadShades (00025bc8) reads from dat\shades, the record count byte at 000bc5c4. ES2's WorldShades_TypeTable (DBSIM 004cfd64).

entries.name: WorldShades_DistanceOffsets
entries.description: Two int32, 000bc5c6 and 000bc5ca, read from the world file after its two counts by World_LoadTheater (000251c4). ES2's WorldShades_DistanceOffsets (DBSIM 004cfd6c).

entries.name: PaletteCycle_Slots
entries.description: Five pointers to cycle records {int16 first, int16 count, int16 delay}, filled by PaletteCycle_Register (000281cc), emptied by PaletteCycle_Unregister (00028228) and zeroed by Palette_LoadResources (00027e10).

entries.name: PaletteCycle_DueTimes
entries.description: Five int32 clock values, each slot's next step in Palette_CycleAnimatedRanges (00028260).

entries.name: PaletteCycle_Offsets
entries.description: Five int16 offsets into each slot's range, advanced by Palette_CycleAnimatedRanges (00028260) and zeroed by PaletteCycle_Register (000281cc).

entries.name: PaletteFade_From
entries.description: The palette the cross fade starts from, stored by Palette_BeginCrossFade (00028528); Palette_StepCrossFade (000287a8) copies its entries in modes 1 and 2.

entries.name: PaletteFade_FirstEntry
entries.description: int16: the first palette entry Palette_StepCrossFade (000287a8) writes. A grep of the disassembly by address finds its five reads, all in Palette_StepCrossFade, and no store.

entries.name: PaletteFade_EntryCount
entries.description: int16: the number of entries the cross fade writes, the palette's +4 that Palette_BeginCrossFade (00028528) read.

entries.name: PaletteFade_Duration
entries.description: int32: the cross fade's length in clock counts, stored by Palette_BeginCrossFade (00028528).

entries.name: PaletteFade_DeltaRed
entries.description: 256 int16: each entry's red delta in 8.8 per clock count, from Palette_BeginCrossFade (00028528).

entries.name: PaletteFade_DeltaGreen
entries.description: 256 int16: each entry's green delta, as PaletteFade_DeltaRed (000bc614).

entries.name: PaletteFade_DeltaBlue
entries.description: 256 int16: each entry's blue delta, as PaletteFade_DeltaRed (000bc614).

entries.name: PaletteFade_Mode
entries.description: int16: 0 to fade in from black, 1 to fade out to black, 2 between two palettes; set by Palette_BeginCrossFade (00028528), read by Palette_StepCrossFade (000287a8).

entries.name: g_SquadmateMachines
entries.description: Three machine pointers, the player's squadmates by slot: zeroed by ColorSchemePanels_LoadAll (0002aecc), filled by Cockpit_LoadSquadmatePilots (0002b308), indexed by Squad_SendOrderToSlot (0002b3e8) and Squad_CallsignOf (0002b46c). ES2's g_SquadmateMachines (DBSIM 004d044c).

entries.name: PilotMessageIndex
entries.description: Three 0x183-byte indexes, one per squadmate slot, of 9-byte slots {dword text, byte count, dword attributes} at id * 9, filled from PilotStringTables (000b0e14) by SystemMessages_Index (0002f1ec). ES2's at DBSIM 004d04e8.

entries.name: CommandMessageIndex
entries.description: The index of str\commandr.str, 9-byte slots at id * 9, which MessagePort_Post (0002ed94) reads for ids from 0x32 at 000bceea + id * 9.

entries.name: SystemMessageIndex
entries.description: The index of str\system.str, 9-byte slots at id * 9, which MessagePort_Post (0002ed94) reads for a record with no subject. ES2's at DBSIM 004d0b33.

entries.name: MessagePort_VariantSlot
entries.description: The 9-byte index slot MessagePort_StepToVariant (0002f31c) builds and returns: the string at +0, a count byte 0 at 000bd222 and the string's attributes at 000bd223. It follows the 34 slots of SystemMessageIndex (000bd0ec). ES2's at DBSIM 004d0d6a.

entries.name: SquadOrderStrings
entries.description: 18 string pointers, STRINGS0.STR group 0, the squadmate orders, filled by SimStrings_LoadAll (0002fe84). es2_xref finds the address at 00035dea, 00035e97, 00035f0a, 0003f75f, 0003f7fa and 00040a04. ES2's group 0 array (DBSIM 004d132c).

entries.name: SquadOrderAttributes
entries.description: 18 dwords, the attribute entries of STRINGS0.STR group 0 (one attribute byte per order in the retail file), filled by SimStrings_LoadAll (0002fe84) beside SquadOrderStrings (000bd228). es2_xref finds the address beside each of SquadOrderStrings' references. ES2's group 0 attribute array (DBSIM 004d1374).

entries.name: SquadCallsignStrings
entries.description: Three string pointers, which Squad_CallsignOf (0002b46c) returns by squadmate slot. ES2's SquadCallsignStrings (DBSIM 004d1424).

entries.name: MfdScannerRanges
entries.description: Three int32, the scanner's ranges in world units, which MfdDisplay_Ctor (00039c64) sets to 30000, 80000 and 120000; MfdDisplay_SetScannerRange (0003ab44) copies the selected one to the display's +0x86, and TargetSelect_CanTarget (0002d624) reads the third as the radar range. ES2's MfdScannerRanges (DBSIM), 50000, 100000 and 200000.

entries.name: CommBox_SavedContext
entries.description: Dword: the render context installed when CommBox_PushVideoClip (0003e790) ran, whose origin it subtracts from the clip rect.

entries.name: CockpitMouse_LeftHeld
entries.description: Byte: 1 from a record with the left button down to one with it up, as CockpitMouse_ProcessQueue (000444d0) finds the press and release edges.

entries.name: CockpitMouse_RightHeld
entries.description: Byte: 1 from a record with the right button down to one with it up, as CockpitMouse_ProcessQueue (000444d0) finds the press and release edges.

entries.name: CockpitMouseLive
entries.description: byte: CockpitMouse_OnEvent (00044464) queues nothing while it is clear. Sim_StartMission clears it and sets it at the end unless a tape plays, the tape's end sets it, and Sim_Shutdown clears it, as ES2's set and clear CockpitMouseLive.

entries.name: CockpitMouse_DoubleClickTicks
entries.description: The double-click window in counts of the clock 000981c4: CockpitMouse_Init (000441cc) sets it to the timer's interrupts a second halved, 60 with the simulator's divisor, so one second. ES2's CockpitMouse_DoubleClickTicks (DBSIM 004d1e70).

entries.name: CockpitMouseQueueA
entries.description: One of the two mouse queues CockpitMouse_Init (000441cc) makes: the int32 count, then at 000bd524 the buffer of 100 records of 14 bytes.

entries.name: CockpitMouseQueueB
entries.description: The other of the two mouse queues CockpitMouse_Init (000441cc) makes: the int32 count, then at 000bd52c the buffer of 100 records of 14 bytes.

entries.name: CockpitMouseQueue_Back
entries.description: The queue CockpitMouseQueue_Push (00044830) appends to; CockpitMouse_ProcessQueue (000444d0) swaps it with CockpitMouseQueue_Front (000bd534) once a tick.

entries.name: CockpitMouseQueue_Front
entries.description: The queue CockpitMouse_ProcessQueue (000444d0) drains after swapping it with CockpitMouseQueue_Back (000bd530), and returns.

entries.name: CockpitMouse_LastButtons
entries.description: The buttons of the last mouse event CockpitMouse_OnEvent (00044464) took; a change of them is always queued.

entries.name: WidgetCorners
entries.description: The dba\corners bank, which Widget_LoadStylesAndFonts (00045e10) loads through CockpitCorners_Load (00044d88); CornerFrame_DrawCorners (00044c64) and AlertPanel_SetTitleText (000461ec) blit its frames.

entries.name: WidgetFont_Title
entries.description: The dfn\title font, which Widget_LoadStylesAndFonts (00045e10) loads first of seven, 4 bytes apart.

entries.name: WidgetFont_Cpylw
entries.description: The dfn\cpylw font, which Widget_LoadStylesAndFonts (00045e10) loads second.

entries.name: WidgetFont_Active
entries.description: The dfn\active font, which Widget_LoadStylesAndFonts (00045e10) loads; PanelButton_Ctor (000467c8) gives it to a button for state 0.

entries.name: WidgetFont_Pushed
entries.description: The dfn\pushed font, which Widget_LoadStylesAndFonts (00045e10) loads; PanelButton_Ctor (000467c8) gives it to a button for state 1.

entries.name: WidgetFont_Inactive
entries.description: The dfn\inactive font, which Widget_LoadStylesAndFonts (00045e10) loads; PanelButton_Ctor (000467c8) gives it to a button for state 2.

entries.name: WidgetFont_Green6x8
entries.description: The dfn\green6x8 font, which Widget_LoadStylesAndFonts (00045e10) loads sixth.

entries.name: WidgetFont_Red6x8
entries.description: The dfn\red6x8 font, which Widget_LoadStylesAndFonts (00045e10) loads last.

entries.name: Prefs_Options
entries.description: 17 bytes: the preferences options, byte n option n, which Prefs_Load (0004a744) reads from data\prefs.cfg. ES2's SimOptions (DBSIM 004d1fbc), 0x36 bytes.

entries.name: Prefs_LoadedOptions
entries.description: 17 bytes: the options as loaded or last committed, which Prefs_Load (0004a744) copies from Prefs_Options (000bd562) and Prefs_CommitOptions (0004a83c) updates; Prefs_OptionChanged (0004ac2c) compares against it. ES2's load-time shadow (DBSIM 004d1ff2).

entries.name: Prefs_PreviousOptions
entries.description: 17 bytes: each option's value before its last write, which Prefs_SetOption (0004a914) and the step functions store. ES2's outgoing shadow (DBSIM 004d2028).

entries.name: Prefs_HandlerTable
entries.description: 17 dwords, one handler per preferences option, which Prefs_SetHandler (0004ac4c) stores and Prefs_ClearHandlersAndInit (0004a724) zeroes.

entries.name: Input_DeviceTable
entries.description: Dwords by input device kind, each the owner InputDevice_Register (0004b0b4) records; Input_DeviceSlot (0004b2d0) returns an entry.

entries.name: Input_DeviceEnabled
entries.description: Bytes by input device kind: 1 while that kind's device is enabled. InputDevice_Enable (0004b1c0) sets one, InputDevice_Register (0004b0b4), InputDevice_Disable (0004b2a4) and the keyboard's and the mouse's destructors clear it.

entries.name: Input_ButtonLatch
entries.description: 4 bytes: the press-once latches of buttons 1-4; Input_ButtonLatchState follows at Input_ButtonLatchState (000bd638).

entries.name: Input_ButtonLatchState
entries.description: 4 bytes: the state each latched button is masked in.

entries.name: SoundCatalog_Objects
entries.description: 60 sound object pointers, one per catalog row: SoundCatalog_Load (0004dc70) fills rows 0-46 from SOUNDS.STR with SoundManager_CreateObject (0004f4e8), and the start-up's zero fill leaves the rest 0. Sound_Play (0004de84) and its siblings index it unchecked. ES2's SoundCatalog_Voices (DBSIM 004d2cfc) holds voice handles.

entries.name: SoundCatalog_Count
entries.description: The catalog's row count: the rows SoundCatalog_Load (0004dc70) made objects for, up to the first empty name, 47 from SOUNDS.STR. ES2's SoundCatalog_Count (DBSIM 004d2dec).

entries.name: Sound_Listener
entries.description: The camera Sound_UpdateListener (0004df98) stores each frame, its first three dwords the listener's position.

entries.name: SoundManager_Instance
entries.description: Pointer to the sound manager, stored by SoundManager_Ctor (0004eb40); the driver's callbacks MidiSound_LoopCallback (0004e718), MidiSound_EndCallback (0004e7b4) and DigiSound_DoneCallback (0004e7fc), and DigiSound_Play (000509c4), read it.

entries.name: SoundDetect_Buffer
entries.description: The block SoundManager_DetectDigitalCard (0004ed68) passes its helpers: a path at +0, bytes +0x100 (open) and +0x101 (found), a block at +0x102 and the hardware block at +0x16e (port +0x16e, IRQ +0x172, DMA +0x176); the digital device id at +0x166.

entries.name: SoundManager_DriversLoaded
entries.description: Set by SoundManager_LoadDrivers (0004ef8c) when it succeeds; SoundManager_UnloadDrivers (0004f3d4) runs only while it is set and clears it.

entries.name: Profile_Buffer
entries.description: dword: the block Profile_Load mallocs, the file's text and 2000 bytes more.

entries.name: Profile_FileName
entries.description: 14 bytes before Profile_Lines: the name of the file in memory, copied whole by Profile_Load and emptied by Profile_Save.

entries.name: Profile_Lines
entries.description: dword: the head of the profile's line list, 12-byte nodes {line, next, previous}.

entries.name: Profile_TextEnd
entries.description: dword: where Profile_WriteString and Profile_FindOrAddSection write a new line in Profile_Buffer.

entries.name: Profile_BufferEnd
entries.description: dword: the last byte of Profile_Buffer.

entries.name: MonoComponentPanel_Block
entries.description: dword: the block MonoComponentPanel_Init was given, its 41 int16 values from +2.

entries.name: MonoComponentPanel_Cursor
entries.description: dword: the value of MonoComponentPanel_Block the panel's cursor is on.

entries.name: MonoComponentPanel_LabelColumn
entries.description: word: the column the panel prints its labels at, the cursor's '>' one to the left.

entries.name: MonoComponentPanel_Row
entries.description: word: the row of the panel's cursor, 1 to 0x16.

entries.name: MonoComponentPanel_ValueColumn
entries.description: word: the column the panel prints its values at.

entries.name: g_ShapeNodeWorldTransforms
entries.description: dword: the per-node transform array, 0x20 bytes per node, ShapeInst_BindNodeTransformArray binds.

entries.name: g_ShapeNodeTransformCacheFlags
entries.description: 0x32 bytes: a byte per state slot, set once that slot's node transform has been composed since the bind.

entries.name: ClassItem_ProbeHeader
entries.description: The header bytes ClassItem_ReadTypeTag and ClassItem_PeekTypeTag hand the probe functions: the 8-byte tag, then the rest from 000bda50.

entries.name: Display_FlipWithoutPan
entries.description: int16: while it is 1, VGA8_ShowPage (00052690) returns after writing the CRTC's start address, neither waiting for the next retrace nor writing the pan. Sim_EndFrame (00059b40) sets it to 1 while Sim_Frozen (000b5b92) is 0 and to 0 otherwise; CockpitView_StepViewTransition (00022904) sets it to 0 when it runs a command, and CockpitView_ProcessViewCommand (000226f0) after its retrace wait. es2_xref finds one more writer, PreferencesPanel_Raise (00057820).

entries.name: g_LowMemory
entries.description: int16: set to 1 at 000595b1 in Sim_Main (00059350) when the heap Mem_InitHeap (00001524) returns is under 0x3c45b0 bytes; a search of the disassembly dump for the address finds that store and 14 compares. When it is set Mech_LoadResources (000198f0) loads no texture banks and MechType_InitOne (00019cf0) skips record +0x48's count of shape roots.

entries.name: ViewChain_Viewed
entries.description: The object the controls and views follow: Sim_StartMission sets it to the player, N steps it, and Sim_DispatchCommand passes unclaimed codes to its slot +0x30. ES2's ViewChain_Viewed.

entries.name: ViewChain_SquadCameras
entries.description: One camera pointer per member of the player's group, built by Sim_StartMission. ES2's ViewChain_SquadCameras.

entries.name: Raster_ViewTransformPtr
entries.description: Pointer to the installed view transform, written by Raster_SetViewTransform. ES2's DBSIM 006c6078.

entries.name: g_ModelTransformPtr
entries.description: Pointer to the installed model transform, the identity at Transform_Identity (000b5eb4) when null is installed; written by Raster_SetModelTransform. ES2's g_ModelTransformPtr (DBSIM 006c607c).

entries.name: Raster_FocalShift
entries.description: The installed camera's focal shift (+0x1a): the projection is (x << shift) / depth, and 0 selects the orthographic form. ES2's DBSIM 006c60ac.

entries.name: Raster_NearPlane
entries.description: The installed camera's near-plane depth (+0x1e). ES2's DBSIM 006c60b0.

entries.name: Raster_OrthoDivisor
entries.description: The installed camera's orthographic divisor (+0x22), set only when the focal shift is 0. ES2's DBSIM 006c60b4.

entries.name: Light_ActiveCount
entries.description: Number of entries in Light_ActiveList. ES2's DBSIM 006c612c.

entries.name: Light_ActiveList
entries.description: The active light list, ten light pointers, which the shade functions walk. ES2's DBSIM 006c6130.

entries.name: Light_ModelSpaceEnabled
entries.description: Byte: when set, Raster_SetModelTransform moves each registered light into the model's space and the save and restore carry the lights' copies. ES2's DBSIM 006cbc88.

entries.name: SimTickDelta
entries.description: int16: the length of the simulation tick that Timer_CountDown (00064178) subtracts.

entries.name: SimTickDelta2
entries.description: int16: the second tick delta, which Time_BeginSimTick computes with the divisor 000bdbd6 and Math_IntegrateRateOverTick2 (00063fe0) multiplies by. ES2's 004d3bea.

entries.name: Bitmap_UseCallerScratch
entries.description: Flag Bitmap_Blit tests after drawing a packed bitmap: while it is 0 the blit deletes Bitmap_UnpackScratch. ES2's Bitmap_UseCallerScratch (DBSIM 006c5ff8).

entries.name: Bitmap_UnpackScratch
entries.description: The buffer a packed bitmap is unpacked into for drawing: Bitmap_Blit puts it in the bitmap's data pointer +0xe for the blit and deletes it afterwards unless Bitmap_UseCallerScratch is set. ES2's Bitmap_UnpackScratch (DBSIM 006c5ffc).
